en.description: Activations cluster around practice (medical professional practice), pleading (a legal statement or complaint), and massagers in one patent text. The first two are constrained by domain and collocational context; the three lack a clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: practice
patterns.context: Medical, clinical, or professional research context; activation falls on practice, occasionally with modifiers such as regional

patterns.name: pleading
patterns.context: Legal text concerning making a claim, pleading guilty, or pleading standards; the word itself is directly activated multiple times
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, legal discussions, and related web text

patterns.name: massagers in patent specifications
patterns.context: The background section of a patent introduces the field of the invention and massagers; activation falls on massagers, not the preceding invention

3_149.description: 激活集中于 practice（医学专业实践）、pleading（法律中的陈述或诉状）及一例专利文本中的 massagers。前两类分别受领域和搭配语境限定；三类之间缺少明确共同触发词。

patterns.name: practice
patterns.trigger: practice；同现于 “practice patterns”“clinical practice”“practice in the US”“academic university-based practice”
patterns.context: 医学、临床或专业研究语境；激活落在 practice 上，偶有 regional 等修饰语
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究介绍

patterns.name: pleading
patterns.context: 法律语境中有关提出主张、认罪或诉状标准的文字；多次直接激活该词
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法律论述及相关网页文本

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的 massagers
patterns.context: 专利背景部分介绍发明领域及按摩器；激活落在 massagers，而非前文 invention

en.description: Activations cluster around two types of words: practice and its collocations in medical titles or abstracts, and pleading in legal and historical narratives. The two contexts and word senses differ.

patterns.name: practice-related phrases
patterns.context: Appears in titles or abstracts to refer to clinical practice, professional practice, or practice patterns in medicine/healthcare; includes «practice patterns», «university-based practice», «clinical practice», «nursing practice» and «General practice».

patterns.name: pleading and its inflections
patterns.context: Appears in legal case narratives or legal standards, including litigation before a guilty plea, petitioning on someone’s behalf, parties’ pleas, and «pleading standard».
patterns.domain: Court decisions, legal discussions; also historical narratives

3_149.description: 激活集中在两类词语：医学标题或摘要中的 practice 及其搭配，以及法律和历史叙述中的 pleading。两类语境和词义不同。

patterns.name: practice 相关词组
patterns.context: 出现在标题或摘要中，指医学/医疗服务中的临床实践、执业或实践模式；包括 «practice patterns»、«university-based practice»、«clinical practice»、«nursing practice» 和 «General practice»。

patterns.name: pleading 及其词形
patterns.trigger: «pleading»；[2] 中为 «pleading»，另有 «pleading» 的相关诉讼语境
patterns.context: 出现在法律案件叙述或法律标准中，包括认罪前的诉讼程序、代人申诉、当事人恳求，以及 «pleading standard»。
patterns.domain: 判决书、法律论述；另有历史叙述

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the medical professional-practice term “practice” and the legal term “pleading”; there are also responses to Azure technical strings, clinical imaging descriptions, and NIH funding identifier RO1. Each trigger is quite specific in its source text, with limited cross-domain commonality.

patterns.name: practice and professional practice
patterns.context: Refers to practice, professional practice, or practice patterns in a professional or institutional context; sometimes forms a phrase with a preceding domain term.

patterns.name: legal pleading
patterns.context: Appears in legal contexts concerning guilty pleas, complaints, or legal charges; activation is concentrated on the word.

patterns.name: Azure technical strings
patterns.context: Appears as part of a cloud-service domain name, SSH key parameter, or API documentation path.

patterns.name: Medical clinical and imaging terminology
patterns.context: Describes clinical outcomes after carbon monoxide poisoning and clinical imaging methods such as CT; no clear practice or pleading trigger is present.

patterns.name: RO1 funding identifier
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of ongoing laboratory research and funding sources.

3_149.description: 激活主要落在“practice”这一医学专业实践词及法律词“pleading”上；另对 Azure 技术字符串、临床成像表述和 NIH 资助编号 RO1 有反应。各触发在原文中较具体，跨领域共性有限。

patterns.name: practice 及专业实践
patterns.context: 在专业领域或机构背景中指实践、执业或实践模式；有时与前置领域词组成短语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、研究资助文本

patterns.name: 法律 pleading
patterns.context: 出现在法律语境中，涉及认罪、诉状或法律指控；激活集中在该词。

patterns.name: Azure 技术字符串
patterns.trigger: “azure”及其周围的 Azure 资源、命令参数或 API 路径
patterns.context: 作为云服务域名、SSH 密钥参数或 API 文档路径的一部分出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、命令行/API 文本

patterns.name: 医学临床与成像术语
patterns.trigger: “month after CO intoxication”, “clinically routine”, “non-invasive imaging technique”
patterns.context: 描述一氧化碳中毒后的临床结局，以及 CT 等临床成像方法；未见明确的 practice 或 pleading 触发词。

patterns.name: RO1 资助编号
patterns.context: 出现在实验室研究延续及经费来源说明中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across biomedical titles and paper terminology, funding identifiers, Markdown filenames, Azure URLs/configuration fields, and C code fields; there is no apparent shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Rapamycin and stress-memory consolidation
patterns.context: Appears in a research title concerning time-dependent effects and consolidation induced by predator stress.

patterns.name: RO1 funding identifier
patterns.context: Appears in an NIH project description, referring to a previously funded RO1.

patterns.name: Image file path/marker
patterns.context: Appears in a filename extension after a Markdown image marker; surrounded by an image path and number.

patterns.name: Azure WebJobs API identifier
patterns.context: In a StackExchange URL, appears as part of the azurewebsites.net hostname; the path concerns getting a continuous job by name.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and Web API URLs

patterns.name: Geriatric clinical problem-solving
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title about clinical problem-solving and rehabilitation barriers in geriatrics.

patterns.name: Azure configuration field
patterns.context: Appears near configuration comments and an SSH public-key path, as part of the azure.pub path.

patterns.name: Retinal detachment surgery practice patterns
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title describing regional practice patterns in retinal detachment repair.

patterns.name: Clock-frequency field
patterns.context: Used as a C struct field prefix, followed by a clock-frequency value and unit.

patterns.name: Avian influenza reassortant virus
patterns.context: A fragment in an academic title modifying avian-human influenza A virus reassortants.

patterns.name: Familiarity judgment and FN400
patterns.context: Discusses the FN400 ERP component and whether it reflects familiarity or conceptual processing.

3_149.description: 激活分散在生物医学标题与论文术语、资助编号、Markdown 文件名、Azure URL/配置字段及 C 代码字段中；没有明显共享的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: Rapamycin与压力记忆巩固
patterns.context: 位于关于时间依赖效应及捕食者压力诱导的巩固过程的研究标题中。

patterns.name: RO1经费编号
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 项目说明中，指先前资助的 RO1。

patterns.name: 图像文件路径/标记

patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的 Markdown

patterns.name: Azure WebJobs API 标识
patterns.context: 在 StackExchange 的 URL 中，作为 azurewebsites.net 主机名的一部分；路径涉及按名称获取 continuous job。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 Web API URL

patterns.name: 老年医学临床问题解决
patterns.context: 出现在关于老年医学中临床问题解决及康复障碍的论文标题。

patterns.name: Azure配置字段
patterns.context: 出现在配置注释和 SSH 公钥路径附近，是 azure.pub 路径的一部分。

patterns.name: 视网膜脱离手术实践模式
patterns.context: 位于描述视网膜脱离修复区域性实践模式的论文标题中。

patterns.name: 时钟频率字段
patterns.context: 作为 C 结构体字段前缀，后接时钟频率数值与单位。

patterns.name: 禽流感重配病毒
patterns.context: 修饰禽—人流感 A 病毒重配体的学术标题片段。

patterns.name: 熟悉性判断与FN400
patterns.context: 讨论 ERP 的 FN400 成分及其是否反映熟悉性或概念加工。

en.description: Mainly responds to the initial rap fragment, found in both rapamycin and raphe; there are also sporadic word-form or terminology patterns involving problem-solving, RO1, non-heme iron enzymes, and globin switching.

patterns.name: rapamycin spelling fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into rap and amycin, with activation concentrated on rap; appears in drug-action or immunosuppression contexts

patterns.name: raphe anatomical word fragment
patterns.context: rap is the beginning of raphe, appearing in the neuroanatomical structure rostral raphe pallidus, not the drug rapamycin

patterns.name: clinical problem-solving phrase
patterns.context: The hyphenated compound problem-solving and its clinical/medical context; activation falls on the solving fragment

patterns.name: RO1 funding identifier
patterns.context: The RO1 (usually written R01) identifier appears in NIH funding project descriptions

patterns.name: non-heme iron oxidase terminology
patterns.context: non-heme iron extradiol dioxygenases in the catechol ring cleavage mechanism; activation spans multiple fragments of the split term

patterns.name: uncovered globin-switching text
patterns.context: Globin switch during fetal or infant development; the period and globin stem are activated, but do not fit the other patterns

3_149.description: 主要对 rap 词首片段起反应，既见于 rapamycin，也见于 raphe；另有 problem-solving、RO1、non-heme 铁酶及 globin 转换等零散词形或术语模式。

patterns.name: rapamycin拼写片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分为 rap 与 amycin，激活集中在 rap；出现在药物作用或免疫抑制语境
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与资助文本

patterns.name: raphe解剖词片段
patterns.context: rap 是 raphe 一词的开头，出现在神经解剖结构 rostral raphe pallidus 中，而非药物 rapamycin

patterns.name: 临床问题解决短语
patterns.context: problem-solving 连字符复合词及其临床/医学语境；激活落在 solving 片段
patterns.domain: 老年医学与临床决策文章

patterns.name: RO1资助编号
patterns.context: NIH 资助项目描述中出现 RO1（通常写作 R01）编号

patterns.name: 非血红素铁氧化酶术语
patterns.context: catechol ring cleavage 机制中的 non-heme iron extradiol dioxygenases；激活覆盖拆分术语的多个片段

patterns.name: 未覆盖的血红蛋白转换文本
patterns.context: 胎儿或婴儿发育期间的 globin switch，点号及 globin 词干有激活，但并不符合其他模式
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的发育生物学

en.description: Activations are scattered across col/HTML structures in web code, rapamycin/mTOR biomedical terminology, multi-compounds, medical abbreviations, and segmented proper nouns; the commonality is mainly specific subword fragments rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: col classes in web layouts
patterns.context: Appears in HTML/CSS grid class names or compounds containing “col”; includes both code markers and ordinary text tokenization
patterns.domain: StackExchange web development, Wikipedia sports articles

patterns.name: rapamycin/mTOR terminology
patterns.context: In biomedical contexts, drug or signaling-pathway names are split into rap-amycin and mTOR

patterns.name: multi-compounds
patterns.context: Technical or scientific compounds beginning with multi-, including pluripotent, multipoint, and multipole
patterns.domain: NIH research text, patent backgrounds, physics abstracts

patterns.name: HTML tags/structure
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, and row-layout structures appear in web-code snippets

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in medical abbreviations
patterns.context: Abbreviations in medical text are split into letters or subword fragments; this does not occur in all biomedical samples

patterns.name: Segmented proper noun
patterns.context: Indiana Hoosiers is tokenized into multiple fragments, with no clear code or scientific-terminology condition

3_149.description: 激活分散于网页代码中的 col/HTML 结构、rapamycin/mTOR 生物医学术语、multi-复合词、医学缩写及专有名词分词；共同点主要是特定子词片段，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: Web 布局中的 col 类
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML/CSS 网格类名或包含“col”的复合词中；既有代码标记，也有普通文本分词
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页开发、Wikipedia 体育条目

patterns.name: rapamycin/mTOR 术语
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中药物或信号通路名称被拆分为 rap-amycin、mTOR
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: multi-复合词
patterns.context: multi-开头的技术或科学复合词，包含 pluripotent、multipoint、multipole
patterns.domain: NIH 研究文本、专利背景、物理学摘要

patterns.name: HTML 标记/结构
patterns.context: 网页代码片段中出现 HTML 标签、属性和行布局结构

patterns.name: 医学缩写中的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 医学文本中缩写被拆成字母或子词片段；未见于所有生物医学样本

patterns.name: 拆分的专有名词
patterns.context: Indiana Hoosiers 被分词成多个片段，未显示明确代码或科学术语条件

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the Hungarian negation nem, and also on specific subword fragments in English words such as nematic, analog, and autoregulatory; fine is also activated in two contexts, legal fines and kinematic detail.

patterns.name: Hungarian “nem”
patterns.context: In Hungarian text, appears at the negation word “nem”; the following content is not fixed.

patterns.name: nem in nematic
patterns.context: In English technical text, the trigger is the initial subword nem in nematic, not the independent Hungarian negation.

patterns.name: analog
patterns.context: Collocations such as analog received signal and analog front-end appear in descriptions of received signals and front ends.

patterns.name: autoregulatory
patterns.context: Triggered when the medical term autoregulatory, referring to the regulatory capacity of renal afferent arterioles, is split.

patterns.name: legal fine
patterns.context: Repeated occurrences of restitution fine and the fine in legal texts, in contexts involving enforcement of fines and ability to pay.

patterns.name: kinematic fine
patterns.context: fine modifies kinematic details, referring to subtle details of a motion trajectory.

3_149.concept: nem 子词及 fine/术语片段
3_149.description: 激活主要落在匈牙利语否定词 nem，也落在英语 nematic、analog、autoregulatory 等词的特定子词片段；另有 fine 在法律罚金与运动学细节两种语境中的激活。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语「nem」
patterns.context: 匈牙利语正文中，出现在「nem」否定词处；该词后续内容不固定。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: nematic 词中的 nem
patterns.trigger: « nem»10，后接 «atic» 或 «atic» 的分词片段
patterns.context: 英语技术文本中，触发位置是 nematic 一词的词首子词 nem，而非独立匈牙利语否定词。
patterns.domain: 显示技术专利、活性物质物理学

patterns.name: analog
patterns.context: 接收信号及前端的描述中，出现 analog received signal、analog front-end 等搭配。

patterns.name: autoregulatory
patterns.context: 肾脏传入小动脉调节能力的医学术语 autoregulatory 被切分时触发。

patterns.name: 法律罚金 fine
patterns.context: 法律文本中反复出现 restitution fine、the fine，语境涉及罚金执行及支付能力。

patterns.name: 运动学 fine
patterns.context: fine 修饰 kinematic details，指运动轨迹的细微细节。

en.concept: Fine-grained or normal sense of fine and technical-discourse markers
en.description: Activations mainly fall on fine in the sense of “fine-grained, detailed” and works fine meaning “functions normally”; there are also responses to better in outcome comparisons and sentence-initial Just in technical advice.

patterns.name: fine compounds
patterns.context: fine is followed by a hyphen or noun, indicating granularity, fine structure, or detail; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Semantics, neuroscience, vision research, and StackExchange technical discussions

patterns.name: better in outcome evaluations
patterns.context: When comparing method performance, better appears in a results description with emphasis.

patterns.name: works fine
patterns.context: States that a website, method, or code works normally; activation is concentrated on fine, not the whole sentence.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial example introduction
patterns.context: Introduces an example to illustrate a preceding point; the token actually triggered is Just.

patterns.name: Imperative operation prompt
patterns.context: Directly advises readers to try an operation in technical Q&A.

3_149.concept: fine 的精细或正常义及技术话语标记
3_149.description: 激活主要落在 fine 的“精细、细粒度”用法及 works fine 的“运行正常”；另对 better 的结果比较和技术建议句首的 Just 有响应。

patterns.name: fine 复合词
patterns.context: fine 后接连字符或名词，表示细粒度、精细结构或细节；不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 语义学、神经科学、视觉研究，以及 StackExchange 技术讨论

patterns.name: 结果评价中的 better
patterns.context: 比较方法表现时，better 出现在结果描述中并带有强调。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉研究论文摘要

patterns.name: works fine
patterns.context: 说明网站、方法或代码运行正常；激活集中在 fine，而非整句。

patterns.name: 句首示例引入
patterns.context: 用一个例子说明前述观点，标记实际触发 token 是 Just。

patterns.name: 命令式操作引导
patterns.context: 在技术问答中直接建议读者尝试某项操作。

en.description: Strongly activates mainly when then introduces a subsequent step, result, or narrative across legal, patent, medical, and programming text; there are also legal remedies, SQL filtering, and isolated over and so substring activations.

patterns.name: then marking a subsequent step or result
patterns.context: Appears between preceding and following steps in an action, process, operation, or narrative, introducing a subsequent action, result, or stage.
patterns.domain: Legal text, patent descriptions, medical abstracts, programming Q&A, and general technical explanations

patterns.name: Judgment outcomes and remedy instructions
patterns.context: In legal decision narratives, a court reverses or remands a case and orders an amount to be determined or adjusted, or another subsequent measure to be taken.

patterns.name: Explanation of filtering results in SQL queries
patterns.context: Explains the difference between two query forms, describing how row combinations are generated first and then filtered.

patterns.name: Stepwise assembly or manufacturing process
patterns.context: Assembly, stacking, or similar steps are completed first, followed by further assembly or electrical connection.

patterns.name: Action transitions in procedural steps
patterns.context: First perform the preceding operation, then carry out the next step, such as lifting or observing.

patterns.name: Transition from code to narrative
patterns.context: After code or markup snippets, first-person narrative continues with a description of subsequent findings.

patterns.name: Local high activation in other legal clauses
patterns.context: A statute describes one type of claim as predominating over others; high activation falls on the repeated preposition over, not then.

patterns.name: Local high activation in other medical error descriptions
patterns.context: Describes increased error when a fetal head shape is more elliptical; high activation falls on a substring within a word.

3_149.description: 主要在 then 引出后续步骤、结果或叙述时强激活，跨法律、专利、医学与编程文本；另有判决补救、SQL 筛选及孤立的 over、so 子串激活。

patterns.name: then 标记后续步骤或结果
patterns.context: 出现在动作、流程、运算或叙述的前后步骤之间，引出后续动作、结果或阶段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、专利说明、医学摘要、编程问答及一般技术说明

patterns.name: 判决结果及补救指令
patterns.context: 法律判决叙述中，法院撤销或发回案件，并要求确定、调整金额或采取后续措施。

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的筛选结果说明
patterns.context: 解释两种查询写法的差异，描述先生成行组合再筛选。

patterns.name: 分步装配或制造流程
patterns.trigger: « then»9 the« sub»1assembly；« then»9« electrically»1 connecting
patterns.context: 先完成组装、堆叠等步骤，再进行后续装配或电气连接。

patterns.name: 操作步骤中的动作衔接
patterns.context: 先执行前述操作，再进行提起、观察等下一步动作。
patterns.domain: 专利说明、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 连接代码与叙述的转折推进
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言片段之后，以第一人称叙述继续说明后续发现。

patterns.name: 其他法律从句中的局部高激活
patterns.trigger: « over»10 the claim or claims« over»9 which
patterns.context: 法律条文描述某类请求相对于其他请求占主导；高激活落在重复介词 over，而非 then。

patterns.name: 其他医学误差描述中的局部高激活
patterns.context: 描述胎儿头部形状更椭圆时误差增加；高激活落在单词内部的子串。

en.description: Mainly responds to over expressing comparison against a baseline, often co-occurring with increase, growth, or changes in degree; also covers decreases and legal dominance. One narrative use of rolling is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: “over” comparison structures
patterns.context: Indicates increase, advantage, or excess relative to a baseline, prior count/period, or another object; also appears in the legal dominance structure “predominates over the claim(s)”.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, legal text, encyclopedias, and general explanations

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or degree
patterns.context: Nearby text discusses increases or changes in numbers, expression, popularity, cell growth, or degree; some examples also involve “over” comparison structures.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, institutional reports, general explanations

patterns.name: Decrease in quantity or opposite trend
patterns.context: A decrease or directional contrast relative to another process appears; there are only a few examples, which do not necessarily express numerical growth.

patterns.name: Rolling action in a non-trend narrative
patterns.context: A person rolls or tumbles in a narrative; there is no clear semantic connection to quantity-change or comparison vocabulary.

3_149.description: 主要响应表示相对基准比较的 over，常与增加、增长或程度变化共现；也涵盖下降及法律支配关系，另有一例叙事性 rolling，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: “over”比较结构
patterns.context: 表示相对于基准、先前计数/时期或另一对象的增加、优势或超出；也出现在法律文本中“predominates over the claim(s)”这一支配关系结构。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、法律文本、百科及一般说明

patterns.name: 数量或程度增加
patterns.context: 附近讨论数值、表达、流行度、细胞生长或程度的上升/变化；部分例子与“over”比较结构同时出现。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、机构报告、一般说明

patterns.name: 数量下降或相反趋势
patterns.context: 出现下降或相对于另一过程的方向性对比；仅有少数例子，未必表达数值增长。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、神经生理学摘要

patterns.name: 非趋势性叙事中的滚动动作
patterns.context: 人物在叙事中滚动或翻滚；与数量变化/比较词汇缺乏明显语义联系。

en.concept: Action verbs and local subword fragments
en.description: The clearest activations are on punch/punched: these refer both to hitting a person and to making holes. It also responds to bump(ed) into meaning an accidental encounter, and to bump meaning an upward numerical adjustment. Other highlights include local fragments of over, subsoil, and ellipsoid, with unclear semantic connections.

patterns.name: Boxing or hitting
patterns.context: Refers to punching or repeatedly hitting a person; often appears in sentences narrating conflicts, testimony, or physical attacks.

patterns.name: Punching holes
patterns.context: punch/punched refers to using a tool to punch holes in cards or materials, with the holes corresponding to months.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb meaning an accidental encounter
patterns.context: bumped into is followed by a person or thing and expresses an accidental encounter; the affix and preposition may be marked separately.

patterns.name: Numerical increase
patterns.context: bump combines with up and takes a percentage value as its object, indicating an increase in a metric.

patterns.name: Price increase
patterns.context: The activation falls on the word over; the sentence compares prices in recent years and says they are significantly higher than in previous years.

patterns.name: Subsoil word fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls within the segmented word subsoil (seabed soil); there is no clear meaning related to hitting or accidental encounters.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text on marine seismic data acquisition

patterns.name: Ellipsoid term fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls within the word ellipsoid, in a discussion of fetal head shape and measurement error.

3_149.description: 激活最明显的是 punch/punched：既指击打人，也指打孔；另对 bump(ed) into 偶遇及 bump 数值上调有反应。其余高亮包含 over、subsoil 与 ellipsoid 的局部词片，语义联系不明。

patterns.name: 拳击或击打
patterns.context: 表示对人实施拳击或连续击打；常出现在叙述冲突、证词或身体受攻击的句子中。

patterns.name: 穿孔、打孔
patterns.context: punch/punched 指用工具在卡片或材料上打孔，孔与月份对应。

patterns.name: 偶遇的短语动词
patterns.context: bumped into 后接人或事物，表达偶然遇到；词缀与介词可能分开标记。

patterns.name: 数值上调
patterns.context: bump 与 up 连用，宾语是百分比数值，表示提高指标。

patterns.name: 价格上涨
patterns.context: 激活落在 over 一词上；句子比较近年价格，表达价格显著高于往年。

patterns.name: 海底构词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 subsoil（海底土层）词内；没有明显的击打或偶遇含义。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本，海洋地震数据采集

patterns.name: 椭圆形术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 ellipsoid（椭球形）词内，讨论胎儿头部形状与测量误差。

en.description: Activations are scattered across substrings within English words, Bulgarian Cyrillic fragments, and code markers. English examples repeatedly include bumped/stoops, but show no unified semantics or stable context; the feature may primarily respond to local word fragments or tokenization forms.

patterns.name: “bump/sto” fragments within English words
patterns.context: Fragments occur within words or at word boundaries, as in “bumped into”, “stoops”, “stoops”, and “bump that … up”; they may respond to specific subword fragments rather than the meanings of whole words
patterns.domain: Emails, Q&A, fiction, public affairs text

patterns.name: Fragments within Cyrillic words
patterns.context: Markers fall within Bulgarian words, including legal and EU policy contexts

patterns.name: Miscellaneous fragments within English words
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a proper name, historical narrative, and code/string examples; there is no clear shared semantic condition

patterns.name: SQL and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near database update statements, including code formatting and username fields

3_149.description: 激活分散于英语词内子串、保加利亚语西里尔字母片段及代码标记；英语中反复见 bumped/stoops，但无统一语义或稳定上下文，可能主要响应局部字词或分词形式。

patterns.name: 英语词内的“bump/sto”片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在词内部或词边界处，如“bumped into”“stoops”“stoops”，以及“bump that … up”；可能对特定子词片段有反应，而非完整词义
patterns.domain: 邮件、问答、小说、公共事务文本

patterns.name: 西里尔文字内部片段
patterns.trigger: «з»«а»、«д»«о»、«п»«о»等被拆分标记的西里尔字母片段
patterns.context: 标记落在保加利亚语词内部，包含法律及欧盟政策语境

patterns.name: 杂项英语词内片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在人名、历史叙述及代码/字符串示例中；没有明显共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: SQL 与格式标记
patterns.context: 数据库更新语句附近，含代码格式及用户名字段

en.concept: Multiple syntactic uses of so, alongside word-fragment triggers
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on so and its syntactic combinations, covering commands, degree, purpose, result, and manner. There are also triggers on SQL UPDATE/SET code and a within-word fragment of Apostolic.

patterns.name: Syntactic connective uses of so / so far / so that
patterns.context: Connects or introduces subsequent constituents in different syntactic environments, expressing a command, degree, purpose, result, or manner; the meanings are not entirely the same across examples.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal texts, fiction, patents, argumentative prose, and religious commentary

patterns.name: UPDATE in an SQL update statement
patterns.context: In database code, UPDATE is followed by a table name and SET specifies field assignments.

patterns.name: Affix fragment within a religious term
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs at the beginning of the segmented word Apostolic; the context discusses church offices and institutions.

3_149.concept: so 的多种句法用法，兼有词片段触发
3_149.description: 主要激活集中在 so 及其句法搭配，涵盖命令、程度、目的、结果、方式等不同用法；另有 SQL 的 UPDATE/SET 代码触发，以及 Apostolic 的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: so / so far / so that 的句法连接用法
patterns.trigger: «so»10 order；«so»10 many；«so»10 as to；«so»9 far；«so»9 that；«so»9 abiding；«so»9 under its breath
patterns.context: 在不同句法环境中连接或引出后续成分：表示命令、程度、目的、结果或方式；各段的意义并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 法律、小说叙述、专利、议论及宗教评论等多种文体

patterns.name: SQL 更新语句中的 UPDATE
patterns.context: 数据库代码中，UPDATE 后接表名并以 SET 指定字段赋值。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／SQL 代码

patterns.name: 宗教词语内部的词缀片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在拆分后的 Apostolic 一词开头；上下文讨论教会官职与制度。

en.description: Responds mainly to the ending fragment of Bulgarian “относно”; it also activates on English “over to”, a subword fragment of the author name Fanutti, and a subword of Russian “вызовом”. These span languages and genres, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: The word “относно” and the following word
patterns.context: Bulgarian parliamentary sentences contain “относно” (regarding); activation is concentrated in the latter part of the word, followed by the topic under discussion.

patterns.name: English phrase “over to”
patterns.context: “over to” means going somewhere or sending something/someone somewhere; examples include going to pick someone up, going to someone’s home, and going to India.

patterns.name: “Fanutti” fragment in a reference
patterns.context: Appears in an author name in a microbiology paper citation; activation falls on a subword fragment of the name.
patterns.domain: Academic references in USPTO background materials

patterns.name: Subword in Russian “вызовом”
patterns.context: An Android programming explanation describes returning an address using setResult(); the Russian word “вызовом” (call/by calling) appears.

3_149.description: 主要响应保加利亚语“относно”的词尾片段；另在英语“over to”、作者名 Fanutti 的子词片段及俄语“вызовом”的子词处激活，跨语言与文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “относно”一词及其后续词
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会句子中出现“относно”（关于），激活集中在该词后半部，后接议题内容。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，保加利亚语政治/政策文本

patterns.name: 英语短语“over to”
patterns.context: “over to”表示前往某处或把某物/某人送往某处；包括去接人、去某人家、去印度等具体移动语境。
patterns.domain: 英语邮件与叙述性文字

patterns.name: 参考文献中的“Fanutti”片段
patterns.context: 出现在微生物学论文引文中的作者姓名，激活落在姓名的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景材料中的学术参考文献

patterns.name: 俄语“вызовом”中的子词
patterns.context: Android 编程说明中描述通过 setResult() 返回地址，出现俄语“вызовом”（调用/通过调用）一词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，俄语文本

en.description: The most prominent activations are on to in various syntactic environments (including introducing destinations), and on structures related to said/anything in legal Q&A. There are also expressions of degree and quantity, Bulgarian within-word fragments, and sporadic lexical activations; overall, there is no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Strong activation on to
patterns.context: Activation falls on infinitival to or prepositional to indicating movement/transfer; neighboring words vary with tokenization.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including emails, technical articles, historical accounts, and literary texts

patterns.name: Q&A structure with said anything
patterns.context: Occurs in questions within direct quotations, or in a narrator’s report of a question about whether anything was said; often adjacent to words such as said and did.

patterns.name: Expressions related to scale or quantity
patterns.context: Describes quantity, degree, or magnitude of growth; the specific meanings and syntactic environments are not all the same.

patterns.name: Fragments within Bulgarian words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on character fragments within Bulgarian word forms, especially words containing the sequence “вз”; more specific lexical or semantic regularities are uncertain.

patterns.name: to before a date
patterns.context: In an itinerary or timeline, to introduces a destination, but activation there is weak.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in ordinary vocabulary
patterns.context: These words are marked in their respective contexts, but no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition is evident; «things» recurs in the fragments.

3_149.description: 最突出的是多种句法环境中的 to（含目的地引介），以及法律问答里 said/anything 相关结构；另有程度、数量表达，保加利亚语词内片段和零散词汇激活，整体并无统一语义。

patterns.name: to 的强调激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不定式 to 或表示移动/转移的介词 to；紧邻词因分词方式不同而有所差异。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括邮件、技术文章、历史记述与文学文本

patterns.name: said anything 的问答结构
patterns.context: 出现在直接引语中的疑问句，或叙述者转述对“是否说了什么”的询问；常与 said、did 等词相邻。

patterns.name: 规模或数量相关表达
patterns.context: 描述数量、程度或增长规模；具体词义与句法环境不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 历史/医学散文、技术文章

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在保加利亚语词形内部的字符片段，尤其是含“вз”序列的词；更具体的词汇或语义规律不确定。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 日期前的 to
patterns.context: 行程或时间线中，to 引出目的地；但该处激活较弱。

patterns.name: 普通词汇中的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中被标记，但未见稳定的共同句法或语义条件；«things»在片段中重复出现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various structures: function words such as so, to, and that and their syntactic environments; the forms thing(s); category labels and email header fields; and line-break formatting. There are also biochemical terms and within-word segmentation fragments. The samples show no single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: “so that” result/purpose relation
patterns.context: “so” occurs in expressions of manner/requirement in legal provisions, expressions of causal result, or the “so that” construction; the word senses and syntax are not entirely the same.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, history books, patent texts

patterns.name: to expressing movement and direction
patterns.context: Occurs in directional, transfer, or purpose constructions; segment [1] also contains “as to which”, but with a different use.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, Wikipedia, legal and narrative texts

patterns.name: that and relative-clause/clause linking
patterns.context: Introduces a clause or connects a proposition; segment [1] marks “that”, and segment [8] also marks “that”.

patterns.name: Forms of Things / thing
patterns.context: In narrative dialogue, characters complain about or describe “things” that happen; segment [4] contains capitalized “Things” in a quotation.
patterns.domain: Fictional dialogue, quoted testimony in legal records

patterns.name: Category labels in category headings
patterns.context: Wikipedia entries list category headings consecutively at the end; highlights also cover fragments within category names.

patterns.name: Column names and email header fields
patterns.context: A forwarded email chain or email header contains a subject field, surrounded by recipient lists and multiple forwarding markers.

patterns.name: Fragment within a protein term
patterns.context: Highlights fall within segmented biochemical terms and methodological descriptions rather than at clear whole-word boundaries.

patterns.name: Text formatting or line-break markers
patterns.context: Fragments include line breaks, blank lines, or formatting such as Markdown code fences; the samples alone do not establish whether the markers themselves or nearby text trigger activation.

patterns.name: Subword fragments and unclassifiable fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subwords, proper names, or abbreviations, without consistent, verifiable semantic conditions across segments.

3_149.description: 激活分散于多种结构：so、to、that 等功能词及其句法环境，thing(s) 词形、分类与邮件头标签、换行格式；另有生化术语和词内切分片段。样本未显示单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: “so that”条件关系
patterns.trigger: «so»（段[1]的“he shall so state”、段[2]的“will so blunt”、段[8]的“so that”）
patterns.context: “so”处于法律规定中的方式/要求表达、因果结果表达，或“so that”结构中；触发词义和句法并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、历史书籍、专利文本

patterns.name: to 的跨越与方向表达
patterns.trigger: «to»（“to … AWS”“flow over to mops”“over to the Parliament”“to try it again”）
patterns.context: 出现在趋向、转移或目的结构中；段[1]也有“as to which”，但用途不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、维基百科、法律及叙事文本

patterns.name: that 及关系/从句连接
patterns.context: 用于引出从句或承接命题；段[1]标记的是“that”，段[8]也标记了“that”。

patterns.name: Things / thing 词形
patterns.context: 叙事对话中围绕“things”抱怨或描述发生之事；段[4]是引述中大写的“Things”。
patterns.domain: 小说对话、法律记录中的证词引述

patterns.name: 类别标题中的分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾连续列出分类标题；高亮同时涉及分类名中的片段。

patterns.name: 列名与邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件转发链或邮件头中出现主题字段，周围有收件人列表及多重转发标记。

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在被拆分的生化术语及方法描述内部，而非清晰的完整词边界。

patterns.name: 文本格式或换行标记
patterns.context: 片段含有换行、空行或 Markdown 代码围栏等格式化内容；仅凭样本难以确定是标记本身还是邻近文本触发。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、论坛帖子、邮件

patterns.name: 切分词片与无法归类片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在词内子词、专名或缩写周围，缺少跨段一致且可确认的语义条件。

en.description: Activation segments show varied local patterns: figure/image markers in academic texts, and figure descriptions in mathematics, physics, and astronomy. There are also specific strings in legal texts, patents, code, and Wikipedia categories. No unified semantics links the different contexts.

patterns.name: Figure markers and image-embedding syntax
patterns.context: Near figure references, captions, or image-embedding code, often in ArXiv text; also appears in structured markers in other documents.

patterns.name: Strong activation on the specific English word so
patterns.context: In [4], it occurs in “to soothe damaged skin”; in [8], in “so-called”; in [9], in “shall so order”. The meanings and syntactic functions differ, so these cannot be assigned to the same semantics.

patterns.name: Banks category terms and lists of places/institutions
patterns.context: Banks is connected to names of multiple countries or regions in consecutive Wikipedia category headings.

patterns.name: Path wildcard in ASP.NET route templates
patterns.context: A URL template in C# route-registration code, containing a resource placeholder, an extension, and a wildcard that captures the remaining path.

patterns.name: Graph theory and algebraic structure terms
patterns.context: Describes a partially ordered set and its lattice structure, accompanied by mathematical formulas and figure references.

patterns.name: Cross-examination and motive in legal testimony
patterns.context: A case text discusses cross-examining an adverse witness and the witness’s motive for testifying.

patterns.name: Semiconductor light-emitting structure
patterns.context: Patent background describes a semiconductor device and a window layer used to enhance light emission in a specific direction.

patterns.name: Astronomical image caption in a paper
patterns.context: An astronomy paper mentions an observing collaboration, cites an adapted figure, and embeds an image.

patterns.name: Particle-physics figure caption
patterns.context: Discusses particle-physics processes and Feynman diagrams, with accompanying image metadata.

patterns.name: Diagram caption for hyperbolic space
patterns.context: An illustration explaining properties of hyperbolic space, involving equal-area tilings and parallel lines.

3_149.description: 激活片段呈现多种局部模式：学术文本中的图表/图片标记，以及数学、物理、天文领域的图示说明；另有法律、专利、代码和维基分类中的特定词串。不同上下文之间缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 图表标记与图像嵌入语法
patterns.context: 图表引用、图注或图片嵌入代码附近，常见于 ArXiv 文本；也出现在其他文档中的结构化标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及结构化文档

patterns.name: 特定英文单词 so 的强激活
patterns.context: 在 [4] 中出现在“to soothe damaged skin”；在 [8] 中出现在“so-called”；在 [9] 中出现在“shall so order”。词义和句法功能不同，均不能据此归为同一种语义。

patterns.name: Banks 类别词及地名/机构列表
patterns.context: 连续的维基百科分类标题中，Banks 与多个国家或地区名称相连。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 路由模板中的路径通配符
patterns.context: C# 路由注册代码中的 URL 模板，包含资源占位符、扩展名及捕获剩余路径的通配符。

patterns.name: 图论与代数结构术语
patterns.context: 描述偏序集及其格结构，并伴随数学公式和图引用。

patterns.name: 法律证言盘问与动机
patterns.context: 判例文本讨论对不利证人的交叉询问及其作证动机。

patterns.name: 半导体发光结构
patterns.context: 专利背景描述半导体器件及用于提升特定方向出光的窗口层。

patterns.name: 论文中的天文图像说明
patterns.context: 天文论文提及观测合作组、改编图示来源，并嵌入图像。

patterns.name: 粒子物理图示说明
patterns.context: 讨论粒子物理过程及费曼图，并附带图像元数据。

patterns.name: 双曲空间示意图说明
patterns.trigger: “Illustrations of properties of hyperbolic space”“Tiles of constant area”
patterns.context: 说明双曲空间性质的插图，涉及等面积铺砌和平行线。

en.description: Activations span formulas, markup, code, and academic text: they often fall on parentheses, backslashes, LaTeX commands, and citation/label boundaries. There are also sporadic patterns involving English function words, patent boilerplate, and segmented proper names.

patterns.name: Special symbols adjacent to parentheses and punctuation
patterns.context: Activations are scattered around parentheses, square brackets, braces, and backslashes in formulas, markup, code, and prose; they usually reflect the symbols themselves or their boundary tokens, rather than any unified mathematical content.

patterns.name: LaTeX math commands and formula structures
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical formulas, especially near command boundaries, text labels in formulas, and structural symbols.

patterns.name: HTML/template markers
patterns.context: Near HTML/template attributes and tags for figures or images; activation covers attribute names, quotation marks, and marker boundaries.

patterns.name: Cross-reference and bibliography citation markers
patterns.context: At citations, table, lemma, or proposition labels and adjacent punctuation; some activations fall within label text or citation markers.

patterns.name: English function words and connectives
patterns.context: Near prepositions or connective phrases in ordinary English prose; activation shows no specific topic condition.

patterns.name: Method/object wording in patents
patterns.context: Occurs when patent text introduces the invention’s object or method with “The present invention relates to …”.

patterns.name: Code declarations and routing syntax
patterns.context: Near class declarations, method-name fragments, and resource-path strings in C# routing configuration code; parenthesis-like symbols also activate.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in physics/mathematics
patterns.context: Proper names or terms are segmented into subword tokens; activations fall on fragments of particle-diagram categories and geometry/quantum-state names.

patterns.name: Serialized academic citation keys
patterns.context: Near fragments of author names or keys segmented within BibTeX-style citation keys.

patterns.name: Table-border syntax
patterns.context: Near vertical bars and column-type characters in column formatting or border definitions in table environments.

3_149.description: 激活横跨公式、标记语言、代码和学术文本：常落在括号、反斜杠、LaTeX 命令及引用/标签边界；另有英文功能词、专利套语和被切分的专名等零散模式。

patterns.name: 括号与标点邻接的特殊符号
patterns.context: 激活分散在公式、标记语言、代码和正文中的括号、方括号、花括号及反斜杠附近；通常是符号本身或其边界 token，而非某个统一数学内容。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学命令与公式结构
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式中，尤其是命令边界、公式中的文字标签和结构性符号附近。

patterns.name: HTML/模板标记
patterns.context: 图表或图片的 HTML/模板属性及标签附近；激活覆盖属性名称、引号和标记边界。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档中的图表标记

patterns.name: 交叉引用与文献引用标记
patterns.context: 引用、表格、引理或命题标签及其相邻标点处；有些激活落在标签文本或引用标记内部。

patterns.name: 英文短功能词和衔接词
patterns.context: 普通英文叙述中介词或连接性短语附近；激活未显示出特定主题条件。

patterns.name: 专利中的方法/对象措辞
patterns.context: 专利文本以“The present invention relates to …”引入发明对象或方法时出现。

patterns.name: 代码声明与路由语法
patterns.context: C# 路由配置代码中，类声明、方法名片段和资源路径字符串附近；括号类符号也有激活。

patterns.name: 物理/数学专名片段
patterns.context: 专名或术语被切分成子词 token；激活落在粒子图类别及几何/量子态名称片段上。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、几何与量子信息

patterns.name: 序列化学术引用键
patterns.context: BibTeX 式引用键中，作者名或键名被分割的片段附近。

patterns.name: 表格边框语法
patterns.context: 表格环境的列格式或边框定义中，竖线与列类型字符附近。

en.description: Activations are scattered across email headers, line breaks and forwarding separators, LaTeX proposition/caption markers, and code commands, legal wording, and narrative prepositions. Some segments share formatting boundaries, but there is no unified word meaning or single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Structured content following formatting separators
patterns.context: Activations often fall after formatting markers, immediately before propositions, lemmas, captions, or forwarded email bodies; they can also fall on code commands or lexical verbs, so these different positions should not all be attributed to the same triggering string
patterns.domain: Mixed: paper typesetting, email, code, legal text

patterns.name: Email header fields and message boundaries
patterns.context: Email header fields, forwarding markers, or separators often occur alongside line breaks and fields such as recipient and subject; activation points include field values, line breaks, and forwarding separators

patterns.name: Proposition or lemma heading markers
patterns.context: In mathematics papers, the headings of formal statements are introduced by LaTeX square brackets and abbreviated labels; activation emphasizes the heading’s closing marker rather than being limited to mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Forwarded/subject chains in email subjects
patterns.context: The subject field in email headers contains repeated forwarding prefixes or forwarding markers; activation is distributed across Subject, the colon, prefixes, and the following separator region

patterns.name: Preposition into in narrative
patterns.context: In a narrative about a character flying a plane into a German warship, activation falls on the preposition indicating direction of movement; there are no clear typesetting or email-format cues here

patterns.name: Command insertion in code
patterns.context: JavaScript keyboard-event handling code calls execCommand to insert HTML; activation falls on the command name Insert

patterns.name: Dismissal phrase in legal text
patterns.context: In a legal account of a court case and a defendant, the text says the defendant moved to dismiss the complaint; activation is concentrated around to and dismiss

patterns.name: Figure-caption markers
patterns.context: LaTeX figure references and captions in a paper, where a figure number or subfigure is followed by a description of a crystal structure

3_149.concept: 结构边界与格式标记（宽泛）
3_149.description: 激活散布于邮件头、换行与转发分隔符，LaTeX命题/图注标记，以及代码命令、法律措辞和叙事介词；部分段落共享格式边界，但无统一词义或单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 格式分隔符后接结构化内容
patterns.trigger: 「\[」「Prop:」「Lem:」「!」「(a)」及其前后的换行、反斜线或长横线；尤其标记 token「\]」「(a)」「-----」
patterns.context: 激活常落在成段格式标记之后，紧接命题、引理、图注或转发邮件正文；也可落在代码命令或文字动词上，不能把这些不同位置都归为同一触发串
patterns.domain: 混合：论文排版、邮件、代码、法律文本

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与邮件边界
patterns.context: 邮件头字段、转发标记或分隔符出现时，常伴随换行及收件人、主题等字段；激活点包括字段值、换行和转发分隔符

patterns.name: 命题或引理标题标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中，形式化陈述的标题以 LaTeX 方括号及缩写标签引出；激活突出标题结束标记，而非仅限于数学公式

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的转发/主题链
patterns.trigger: 「Subject: FW: FW: FW: Yes Ossifer?」及「Subject: Fwd:」
patterns.context: 邮件头的主题字段含重复转发前缀或转发标记，激活分布在 Subject、冒号、前缀及其后的分隔区域

patterns.name: 叙述中的介词 into
patterns.context: 人物驾驶飞机撞向德国军舰的叙述中，激活落在表示运动方向的介词上；此处没有明显的排版或邮件格式线索

patterns.name: 代码中的命令插入
patterns.context: JavaScript 键盘事件处理代码中，调用 execCommand 插入 HTML；激活落在命令名 Insert 上

patterns.name: 法律文本中的驳回短语
patterns.context: 法院案件与被告的法律叙述中，说明被告请求驳回诉状；激活集中在 to 及 dismiss 附近

patterns.name: 图注标记
patterns.context: 论文中的 LaTeX 图引用和图注，标记图号或子图后接晶体结构说明

en.description: Activations are scattered across domains, tending toward structural boundaries, common function words, punctuation, and typesetting symbols. There are also several content-word peaks: legal “to dismiss”, code InsertHTML, historical into, and educational closer.

patterns.name: Small words in negative/conditional sentences
patterns.context: Serve as conditionals, prepositions, or pronouns in grammatical structures; occur across code, legal texts, and academic discussion

patterns.name: Colon and punctuation-delimited structures
patterns.context: Punctuation links email subjects, reference numbers, mathematical expressions, or formulas

patterns.name: Line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Occur near separators in quoted emails, paper formulas/reference material, or structured-text boundaries

patterns.name: Legal collocation “to dismiss”
patterns.context: In legal litigation narratives, describes a defendant’s motion to dismiss a case or complaint

patterns.name: Keyboard-event code
patterns.context: JavaScript checks keyCode, prevents the default behavior, and inserts HTML

patterns.name: Plane collides with warship
patterns.context: Historical narrative describes a wounded pilot flying a plane into a German warship

patterns.name: Position adjustment to improve vision
patterns.context: In an educational narrative, a student who struggles to see the blackboard is moved to the front of the classroom

patterns.name: Special symbols/typesetting in mathematical text
patterns.context: LaTeX typesetting in formulas, piecewise definitions, or tensor notation

patterns.name: Email recipients and forwarded subject
patterns.context: An email header lists recipients and a repeatedly forwarded subject, followed by the original email separator

patterns.name: Academic authors and proposition markers
patterns.context: Paper headers/author information or proposition labels in the main text

3_149.description: 激活分散在多领域，偏向结构边界与常见功能词、标点及排版符号；另有若干内容性高峰：法律“to dismiss”、代码 InsertHTML、历史 into、教育 closer。

patterns.name: 否定/条件句中的小词
patterns.context: 在语法结构中充当条件、介词或代词；分散出现在代码、法律文本和学术论述中

patterns.name: 冒号与标点分隔结构
patterns.context: 标点连接邮件主题、文献编号、数学表达式或公式
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在邮件引用分隔、论文公式/参考材料或结构化文本边界附近

patterns.name: “to dismiss”法律搭配
patterns.context: 法律诉讼叙述中，描述被告提出驳回案件或诉状的动议

patterns.name: 键盘事件代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 条件检查 keyCode 后阻止默认行为并插入 HTML

patterns.name: 飞机撞击军舰
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述受伤飞行员将飞机撞向德国军舰

patterns.name: 位置调整以改善视力
patterns.context: 教育叙述中因学生看黑板吃力而将其移到教室前方

patterns.name: 数学文本中的特殊符号/排版
patterns.context: 公式、分段定义或张量记号中的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 邮件收件人与主题转发
patterns.context: 邮件头部列出收件人并连续转发主题，随后进入原始邮件分隔

patterns.name: 学术作者与论文命题标记
patterns.context: 论文页眉/作者信息或正文中的命题标签

en.description: The dominant pattern is strong activation on surname fragments beginning with McN in personal names across multiple domains; subsequent tokens vary by spelling. The remaining sporadic highlights occur across different words and styles, with no stable shared trigger; segment 10 also shows no clear McN pattern.

patterns.name: McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Surname-initial fragments in proper names, followed by varying spellings; often at the end of a name or in a cited author name.
patterns.domain: News, legal, academic, encyclopedic, and web texts

patterns.name: Specific spelling continuation fragments
patterns.context: Subsequent tokens in surnames beginning with McN; activation is strongly concentrated on McN, while continuation fragments are weaker and not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Personal-name citations, bylines, or narrative text

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in a local word or phrase, with no stable shared context; beyond co-occurrence in fragments containing McN, no confirmed relationship is apparent.
patterns.domain: Album descriptions, energy news, military writing, papers, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: Person name in an FCC news quote
patterns.context: The name of U.S. politician Jerry McNerney, in a news quote about FCC transparency.

3_158.description: 主导模式是在多领域文本中对 McN 开头的人名姓氏片段强烈激活，后续 token 因拼写而异。其余零散高亮分布于不同词语和文体，未显示稳定共同触发条件；第10段也无明显 McN 模式。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 在专名中出现的姓氏开头片段，后续拼写各异；多为姓名末尾或引文作者名。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、学术、百科及网页文本

patterns.name: 特定拼写续接片段
patterns.context: 出现在 McN 开头姓氏的后续 token 中；激活显著集中于 McN，续接片段强度较弱且不完全一致。

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 各自处于局部词汇或短语中，没有稳定共同上下文；除共同出现在含 McN 的片段外，缺少可确认的关联。
patterns.domain: 专辑介绍、能源新闻、军事写作、论文、百科等

patterns.name: FCC 新闻引语中的人物名
patterns.context: 美国政界人物 Jerry McNerney 的姓名，处于有关 FCC 透明度的新闻引语中。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to surname prefixes beginning with McN- in personal names, across a range of domains and styles. The remainder of the surname varies, and activation strength differs.

patterns.name: McNamara surname fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names, especially surnames beginning with McN; activation centers on the surname prefix rather than nearby punctuation or syntax.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, email, scientific papers, promotional text

patterns.name: Other McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names or surnames beginning with McN; activation is slightly weaker than in the preceding group.

3_158.description: 神经元主要响应人名中 McN- 开头的姓氏前缀；覆盖多种领域与文体，后续姓氏余部不同，激活强度有差异。

patterns.name: McNamara姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名中，尤其是 McN 开头的姓氏；激活集中于姓氏前缀，而非附近标点或句法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、科学论文、宣传文本

patterns.name: 其他 McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在 McN 开头的人名或姓氏中；强度略低于前一组
patterns.domain: 法律、医学论文、新闻文本

en.description: All segments activate at the string “McN”, across various surnames, author names, statistical test names, and legal party references. Subsequent spellings and styles vary, with no other shared trigger evident.

patterns.name: McN string onset
patterns.context: Strings beginning with McN in proper names or surnames; the fragment activates whether followed by 9 or 10.
patterns.domain: Personal names, literature citations, and proper names

patterns.name: McNichols surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “ichols”, referring to a surname in a sports venue name.

patterns.name: McNamara surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “amara”, occurring in author bylines or news bylines.

patterns.name: McNerney surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “erney”, occurring in research-paper author names or the name of a political figure.

patterns.name: McNab citation surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “ab”, in a parenthetical literature citation.

patterns.name: McNamar(a) cited-author continuation
patterns.context: Occurs in a citation to prior work in an astrophysics paper, followed by a coauthor and year.

patterns.name: McNemar test name
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of statistical tests, followed by a possessive and coordinated with other test names.

patterns.name: McNally surname continuation
patterns.context: Refers to a party in a legal case; the name is repeated in the sentence.

3_158.description: 所有片段都在字符串“McN”处激活，覆盖多种姓氏、作者名、统计检验名及法律当事人称谓；后续拼写和文体各异，未见其他共同触发条件。

patterns.name: McN 字符串开头
patterns.context: 专名或姓氏中以 McN 开头的字符串；该片段无论后续是 9 还是 10 都有激活。

patterns.name: McNichols 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“ichols”，指体育场名称中的姓氏。
patterns.domain: 音乐发行介绍、场馆名称

patterns.name: McNamara 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“amara”，出现在作者署名或新闻报道署名中。

patterns.name: McNerney 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“erney”，出现在研究文献作者名或政治人物姓名中。

patterns.name: McNab 文献姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“ab”，位于括号内的文献引用。

patterns.name: McNamar(a) 文献作者续写
patterns.context: 出现在天体物理论文对既有研究的引用中，后接合著者与年份。

patterns.name: McNemar 检验名称
patterns.context: 出现在统计检验方法列表中，后接所有格并与其他检验名称并列。

patterns.name: McNally 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 指法律案件中的当事人，姓名在句中重复出现。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the letter fragment “McN” in proper names, including various personal and company names beginning with McN. It also activates on the “Hor…izon” spelling fragment in one record-catalog entry, possibly an isolated pattern.

patterns.name: McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Activation centers on the spelling fragment McN in proper names; subsequent letters and contexts vary, and the fragment may occur in citations, mid-sentence, or at the start of a proper name.
patterns.domain: Personal or company names in papers, legal texts, news, encyclopedias, and promotional writing

patterns.name: Musician surname spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a record-catalog entry, as part of an album title or parenthetical label content; this is a single instance, and its relation to the main pattern is uncertain.

3_158.description: 主要对专名中的字母片段“McN”强烈响应，涵盖多种以 McN 开头的人名、公司名；另在一处唱片目录的“Hor…izon”拼写片段中激活，可能是孤立模式。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名中 McN 这一拼写片段；后续字母和语境各异，片段也可能位于引用、句中或专名开头。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律文本、新闻、百科及宣传文字中的人名或公司名

patterns.name: 音乐家姓氏拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在唱片目录条目中，属于专辑名或厂牌/标签括号内容；仅此一例，是否与主模式相关不确定。

en.concept: Size and identifier fragments in code
en.description: Activation is concentrated on C/C++ size calculations, memory allocation/copying, and underscore-separated identifiers. Other sporadic activations occur on Horizon/Verizon string fragments, an R table, ACL code, and a motor-memory paper.

patterns.name: sizeof and size calculations
patterns.context: Calculating allocation sizes or array or struct-member lengths in C/C++ code; usually near malloc, memcpy, or pointer expressions.

patterns.name: Memory allocation and copy code
patterns.context: C code manipulating buffers or struct data; activation occurs across allocation, assignment, copying, and related expressions, not only sizeof.

patterns.name: Underscore-separated identifiers and struct fields
patterns.context: Code identifiers containing underscores, field access, or type names; often accompanied by structs, pointers, and member-size expressions.

patterns.name: Hor«izon»
patterns.context: The final portion of the word Horizon is highlighted in a common word or proper name; the contexts are financial legal text and a musician discography, respectively.

patterns.name: Verizon name
patterns.context: Employer name Verizon in a factual account of an unemployment-benefits lawsuit.

patterns.name: Table variables and sample data
patterns.context: A StackExchange example uses an R data.frame to illustrate data structure, with date, ID, indicator, and other column names and sample values.

patterns.name: ACL constants and CPU conversion identifiers
patterns.context: Linux-style code handling ACL groups and entry ID conversions and struct sizes.

patterns.name: Motor and memory research findings
patterns.context: Paper abstract comparing the effects of motor activity and rest before learning on memory performance.

3_158.concept: 代码中的尺寸与标识符片段
3_158.description: 激活最集中于 C/C++ 尺寸计算、内存分配/复制及下划线标识符；另有 Horizon/Verizon 字符串片段，以及 R 表格、ACL 代码和运动记忆论文中的零散激活。

patterns.name: sizeof 及尺寸计算

patterns.name: 内存分配与拷贝代码

patterns.name: 下划线分隔的标识符及结构体字段

patterns.name: Hor«izon»

patterns.name: 运动与记忆研究结果

en.concept: Multiple word strings and formatting features

patterns.name: 组织、结社或公共倡议
