patterns.trigger: «hist«ocompat»»（如“histocompatibility”）；常邻近 « complex»、« II» 或 « class»
patterns.context: 免疫学语境中出现 major histocompatibility complex（MHC）及其类别、表达或相关研究
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标点与类型标识符
patterns.context: C# 源码注释行和命名空间/类路径式标识符

patterns.name: 毒物摄入与治疗短语
patterns.trigger: «Current»；紧接“treatment of poisoning by ingestion of caust…”
patterns.context: 摘要开头以当前治疗某种摄入中毒为主题

patterns.name: 半化学物质及动物化学通信
patterns.context: 讨论动物通信所用化学物质，并提及 MHC 肽段和尿液
patterns.domain: 生物医学/动物行为研究

en.description: The most stable trigger is parametric, including forms such as non-parametric. Other activations include participle/past-tense endings across multiple domains, a few internal fragments in biomedical compounds, and words in recruitment descriptions.

patterns.name: parametric term
patterns.context: The word and its compound forms occur in contexts involving statistical analysis, estimation methods, or model uncertainty.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, statistics, research abstracts, or papers

patterns.name: Verb past-tense ending -ed
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of English past-tense or past-participle verbs, with the word split across multiple tokens; context and domain vary.
patterns.domain: Legal, research, web, and general English

patterns.name: -ic morphological fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs within multi-token words, involving adjectives or compound adjectives; this pattern appears in only a few segments.

patterns.name: -ed in words describing quality or ability
patterns.context: Describes candidates’ service orientation or skills in job advertisements.

patterns.name: Unexplained: isolated strong verb activation
patterns.context: Occurs in an account of police asking someone to remain at the scene; apart from the shared verb-ending phenomenon seen in other segments, no connection to the main pattern is apparent.

3_158.concept: 英语词形片段，尤以 parametric 为主
3_158.description: 最稳定的触发是 parametric（含 non-parametric 等形式）；另有多个领域中分词/过去式词尾激活，以及少数生物医学复合词内部片段和招聘描述词激活。

patterns.name: parametric 词项
patterns.context: 该词及其复合形式出现在统计分析、估计方法或模型不确定性语境中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、统计学、科研摘要或论文

patterns.name: 动词过去式词尾 -ed
patterns.context: 激活落在英语过去式或过去分词动词的词尾部分，词形被分成多个 token；上下文和领域不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、科研、网页及一般英语

patterns.name: -ic 形态片段
patterns.context: 激活位于多 token 词的内部片段，涉及形容词或复合形容词；此模式仅见于少数段。

patterns.name: 质量或能力描述词中的 -ed
patterns.context: 在招聘广告中描述候选人的服务态度或技能。

patterns.name: Unexplained：孤立的强动词激活
patterns.context: 出现在警方要求当事人留在现场的叙述中；除与其他段共有的动词词尾现象外，看不出与主要模式的联系。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple text types and subword fragments: quotations, detention, and charge wording in legal rulings; names, music, and charts in encyclopedias; lists of medical personnel; prison statistics; plot expressions; and isotope chemical formulas. There is no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Hyphens and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs around court ruling citations, case names, statutes, or page numbers, often with line breaks and citation formatting.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in proper names and personal names
patterns.context: A word's interior or beginning is split into subwords; occurs in proper names such as film crew members, actors, or historical figures.

patterns.name: Degree and contrast expressions in narratives
patterns.context: In a film plot description, after a character appears and reveals an affair, the narrative foreshadows a worsening situation.

patterns.name: Multidisciplinary medical personnel titles
patterns.context: Lists different specialists on a cardiovascular imaging team, with titles split into subwords.

patterns.name: Institutions, groups, and prison-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses statistical changes in attacks on staff and inmates in U.S. state and federal prisons.

patterns.name: Music and instrument categories
patterns.context: Describes a luthier making instruments for orchestral and jazz musicians and their endorsers.

patterns.name: Detention language in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes the conditions of a traffic case involving a stop, a vehicle being pulled over, and the defendant being detained by an officer.

patterns.name: Chemical-formula fragments for radioactive compounds
patterns.context: Experimental methods list isotope-labeled glucose and methyl glucoside compounds.

patterns.name: Popular song charts and rankings
patterns.context: Describes album tracks and songwriters, along with weeks on and rankings in the Billboard Hot 100.

patterns.name: Charges and ruling language in legal judgments
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence supports a jury's finding on a lesser charge and affirms the judgment at the end.

3_158.description: 激活分布在多类文本与词片段上：法律判决的引文、拘留和罪名措辞；百科中的人名、音乐与榜单；医学人员列举；监狱统计；剧情表达及同位素化学式。没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的连字符与标点
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决引文、案名、法条或页码周围，常伴随换行与引文格式

patterns.name: 专名及姓名的词内片段
patterns.context: 词的内部或开头被切分为子词；位于电影制作人员、演员或历史人物姓名等专名中

patterns.name: 叙事中的程度与转折表达
patterns.context: 电影剧情介绍中，人物出现并揭示婚外情后，叙述预示情势恶化

patterns.name: 多学科医疗人员称谓
patterns.context: 列举心血管影像团队中的不同专业人员，称谓以子词形式拆分

patterns.name: 机构、群体及监狱相关词
patterns.context: 讨论美国州和联邦监狱中工作人员与囚犯遭袭的统计变化

patterns.name: 音乐与乐器类别
patterns.context: 介绍制琴师为管弦乐和爵士乐演奏者制作乐器及其代言人

patterns.name: 法律程序中的拘留措辞
patterns.context: 道路交通案件中描述停车、拦截以及被告受警员拘留的条件

patterns.name: 放射性化合物的化学式片段
patterns.context: 实验方法中列出带同位素标记的葡萄糖及甲基葡萄糖苷化合物

patterns.name: 流行歌曲榜单与排名
patterns.context: 介绍专辑歌曲、创作者及其在 Billboard Hot 100 的上榜周数和名次

patterns.name: 法律判决中的罪名与裁决用语
patterns.context: 讨论证据是否支持陪审团认定较轻罪名，并在结尾维持原判

en.description: Activations cover U.S. population racial-composition statistics, the word peaking, and sporadic text in Java test code, HTML/XHTML markup, and legal bylines. No single stable semantic pattern explains all segments.

patterns.name: Racial-composition statistics
patterns.context: Population-statistics passages about U.S. counties, villages, or cities; activation is distributed across racial-composition phrases and nearby percentages, group names, and punctuation.

patterns.name: peaking participle
patterns.context: Progressive contexts describing an astronomical or musical event reaching a peak; activation occurs within peaking and does not require the same domain.

patterns.name: Java test code and line breaks
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks and code formatting around Java/JUnit import statements, class names, and package paths.

patterns.name: HTML document markup
patterns.context: HTML/XML fragments in web documents, including API-page navigation and XHTML document type declarations; activation covers several substrings in markup, entities, and declarations.
patterns.domain: GitHub HTML documents and source code

patterns.name: Personal names and titles in legal bylines
patterns.context: Bylines, attorney titles, and institutional addresses in legal documents or Department of Justice letters.

3_158.description: 激活覆盖美国人口种族构成统计、peaking 一词，以及 Java 测试代码、HTML/XHTML 标记和法律署名等零散文本；不存在能解释全部片段的单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 种族构成统计
patterns.trigger: “racial makeup”以及“% White”, “% Black or African American”, “% Native American”, “% Asian”
patterns.context: 美国县、村或城市的人口统计段落；激活分布在种族构成短语及其后的百分比、族群名称和标点附近。

patterns.name: peaking 分词
patterns.context: 描述天文或音乐事件达到峰值的进行式语境；激活落在 peaking 的词内，不要求相同领域。

patterns.name: Java 测试代码与换行
patterns.context: Java/JUnit 导入语句附近，连续换行和类名、包路径的代码格式共同出现。

patterns.name: HTML 文档标记
patterns.context: 网页文档的 HTML/XML 片段，包括 API 页面导航以及 XHTML 文档类型声明；激活覆盖标记、实体和声明中的若干子串。

patterns.name: 法律署名中的人名与职衔
patterns.context: 法律文件或司法部函件的署名、律师职衔及机构地址部分。

en.description: Most segments activate on call constructions used to name concepts or objects, across historical narratives, astronomy, mathematics, biology, music, and technical discussions. Other activations occur in Go path comments, mathematical formula symbols, and the name of a biomedical dye.

patterns.name: ‘call’ and its object
patterns.context: In academic or explanatory text, an author names a concept, structure, method, or thing; also includes a narrator reporting someone else's naming. The object may follow immediately or appear after an intervening phrase.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, reviews, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Path handling in Go code
patterns.context: A comment explains how to handle requested paths and nonexistent subpaths when recursively creating directories.

patterns.name: Plus/minus signs and differential terms in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: A formula fragment containing an expression made up of differential terms, plus/minus signs, and superscripts; context is incomplete, making the specific mathematical meaning difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Dye reagent name in experimental methods
patterns.context: After cell suspension is dropped onto a slide and air-dried, a reagent is described as being added; activation is concentrated on multiple subword fragments within the chemical name.

3_158.description: 多数段落激活于为概念或对象命名的 call 结构，涵盖历史叙述、天文、数学、生物学、音乐与技术讨论；另有 Go 路径注释、数学公式符号及生物医学染料名称中的激活。

patterns.name: ‘call’及其宾语
patterns.trigger: “we call”, “they call”, “which they call”, “which I call”，尤其是分隔标记 token «call»9/10
patterns.context: 在学术或说明性文字中，作者为某概念、结构、方法或事物命名；也包括叙述者转述他人的命名。宾语可紧随其后，也可跨短语出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、评论与技术讨论

patterns.name: Go 代码中的路径操作
patterns.trigger: «ch»1«own»2 the «requested»2 path + any «sub»3paths that «didn't exist»1；后文有 «MkdirAll»
patterns.context: 注释解释递归创建目录时如何处理请求路径及不存在的子路径。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的正负号与微分项
patterns.trigger: «1»1« +»1 d«^»1«2»3 - d«^»2r)；以及后续分式、期望符号和 LaTeX 标记
patterns.context: 公式片段中出现由微分项、正负号和上标构成的表达式；上下文残缺，难以确定具体数学含义。

patterns.name: 实验方法中的染色试剂名
patterns.context: 细胞悬液滴在玻片上并风干后，描述加入试剂；激活集中于化学名称内部多个子词片段。

en.description: Activations cover formula commands, Greek subword fragments, named expressions, and several words in legal, licensing, scientific, and web texts; beyond local word forms and formatting, no stable cross-domain semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formula symbols
patterns.context: Backslash commands, mathematical variables, and brackets in formulas; activations are scattered across commands and formula fragments

patterns.name: Substrings within Greek words
patterns.context: Fragments within words in continuous Greek text, with no clearly specific semantic condition

patterns.name: Forms of address and naming phrases
patterns.context: Expressions that name, introduce, or refer to objects, such as “call the southern loop” and “calling the circle’s radius”

patterns.name: Topic recommendations and traffic phrasing
patterns.context: Discussion of controversial-topic recommendations, autoplay, and organic traffic; it is difficult to determine whether these words form a stable phrase pattern

patterns.name: Names and court titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names and formal titles, such as those of judges, parties, and courts, on the first page of court rulings

patterns.name: Culture-medium ingredients and experimental procedure connectives
patterns.context: Lists of antibiotics and culture-medium ingredients, and descriptions of transfers or culture conditions in cell-culture methods; most trigger words are common and semantically nonspecific

patterns.name: Quoted sources and paraphrasing language
patterns.context: References to quotation, whether something is mentioned, and repetition of original words in discussions of transmission chains and a prophet’s original words

patterns.name: Software license rights list
patterns.context: Terms granting rights to use, modify, distribute, and sell software in license agreements

3_158.description: 激活涵盖公式命令、希腊语词片段、命名表达，以及法律、许可、科研和网络文本中的若干词语；除局部词形与格式外，未见跨领域稳定的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式符号
patterns.context: 公式中的反斜线命令、数学变量和括号；激活分散在命令与公式片段中

patterns.name: 希腊语词内子串
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中的词内部片段，没有明显特定语义条件

patterns.name: 称谓与命名短语
patterns.context: “call the southern loop”及“calling the circle’s radius”等命名、引入称呼或对象的表达

patterns.name: 话题推荐与流量措辞
patterns.context: 争议话题推荐、自动播放及有机流量的讨论；难以确定这些词是否构成稳定短语模式

patterns.name: 法律文书人名及法院头衔
patterns.context: 法院判决首页的法官、当事人和法院名称等专名及正式头衔
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 培养基成分与实验操作连接词
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法段落中列举抗生素、培养基成分并描述转移或培养条件；多数触发词常见且语义不特异

patterns.name: 引述来源与转述措辞
patterns.context: 关于传述链及先知原话的讨论中，涉及引用、是否提及和重复原话

patterns.name: 软件许可权利清单
patterns.context: 许可协议中授予软件使用、修改、分发和销售等权利的条款

en.concept: Cell culture methods vocabulary, with sporadic word-form triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to media, culture, and serum/antibiotic formulations in cell-culture methods; sporadic triggers also include Bulgarian “national responsibility,” the medical statistics term operating, and xerographic word forms.

patterns.name: Cell culture medium
patterns.context: Culture-medium names and formulation contexts appear when describing cell culture, culture conditions, or experimental treatment.

patterns.name: Culture-medium supplements and antibiotics
patterns.context: Serum and antibiotic supplements are listed in cell-culture medium formulations, typically with values and units.
patterns.domain: Cell culture methods in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Bulgarian expression of national responsibility
patterns.context: Discusses consular assistance and protection as a national responsibility; unrelated to laboratory culture contexts.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Bulgarian political or institutional phrasing

patterns.name: ROC term fragment
patterns.context: Patient outcomes and peak VO2 statistical analysis, with references to ROC curves or AUC.

patterns.name: Xerographic-distribution-related word forms
patterns.context: Discusses the combination of theory and xerographic distribution and its framework; not a cell-culture context.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics or related academic text

3_158.concept: 细胞培养方法词汇，兼有零散词形触发
3_158.description: 主要响应细胞培养方法中的培养基、培养及血清/抗生素配方；另有零散触发：保加利亚语“国家责任”、医学统计术语 operating 和 xerographic 词形。

patterns.name: 细胞培养基质
patterns.trigger: "cultured"、"grown" 与 "in"、"with" 或 "medium" 相邻，及培养基名称如 "Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium"、"DMEM"、"RPMI-1640"、"α-MEM"、"Leibovitz's L-15 medium"
patterns.context: 描述细胞培养、培养条件或实验处理时，出现培养基名称及其配制语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法部分

patterns.name: 培养基补充物与抗生素
patterns.trigger: "fetal bovine serum"、"FBS"、"FCS"、"penicillin"、"streptomycin"，常与百分比、浓度或 "supplemented with" 同现
patterns.context: 细胞培养基配方中列出血清及抗生素等补充成分，通常带数值和单位。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的细胞培养方法

patterns.name: 保加利亚语民族责任表述
patterns.context: 论述领事协助与保护是国家责任；与实验室培养语境无关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，保加利亚语政治或制度表述

patterns.name: ROC 术语片段
patterns.context: 患者结局与峰值 VO2 的统计分析语境，出现 ROC 曲线或 AUC。

patterns.name: xerographic 分布相关词形
patterns.context: 讨论理论与 xerographic distribution 的结合及其框架；不是细胞培养语境。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理或相关学术文本

en.concept: Specific word strings in probability problems and disclaimer clauses
en.description: Primarily responds to “without replacement” and lists of draw events in probability problems; another clear pattern is categories of loss and bases of liability in uppercase disclaimer clauses. Mathematical answers and fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Without-replacement sampling phrasing
patterns.context: Probability problems describe drawing several letters from a set of letters and their counts, typically followed by the set and the requested probability; activations cluster on “without replacement” and nearby words.

patterns.name: Listing draw events
patterns.context: The problem lists the letters and quantities to be drawn, often joined by commas and and; letters and quantities vary randomly by problem.

patterns.name: Legal liability and loss disclaimer clause
patterns.context: Disclaimer clauses list damages involving goods or services, loss of use, data, profits, and business interruption; text is presented in uppercase legal-document format.

patterns.name: Basis of liability and scope of negligence
patterns.context: Disclaimer clauses state that damages are covered regardless of how they are caused or the theory of liability, including contract, strict liability, tort, and negligence; uppercase legal text may contain line breaks or annotations.

patterns.name: Fragments and answer formatting
patterns.context: Isolated problem fragments or answer fractions appear in mathematical passages; these tokens do not form a trigger pattern as clear as that of the main problem and may be residual adjacent text or formatting.

3_158.concept: 概率题与免责条款中的特定词串
3_158.description: 主要响应不放回抽样概率题中的“without replacement”及抽取事件列举；另一明确模式是大写免责条款中的损失类别与责任依据。数学答案、残片亦伴随出现。

patterns.name: 不放回抽样表述
patterns.context: 概率题描述从字母及其数量组成的集合中抽取若干字母，通常后接集合和所求概率；激活集中落在“without replacement”及附近词语。

patterns.name: 抽取事件的列举
patterns.trigger: «picking»、各字母名及其前面的数量，如 «i»、«n»、«v»
patterns.context: 问题列出要抽到的字母及数量，常以逗号和 and 连接；字母与数量是题目随机变化的变量。

patterns.name: 法律责任与损失免责条款
patterns.context: 免责条款列举商品或服务、使用损失、数据、利润及业务中断等损害；文本以大写法律文书格式呈现。
patterns.domain: Github 法律条款／软件免责声明

patterns.name: 责任依据及过失范围
patterns.trigger: «HOWEVER» «CAUSED» AND ON ANY THEORY OF «LIABILITY», WHETHER IN «CONTRACT», «STRICT» «LIABILITY», OR «TORT» (INCLUDING «NEGLIGENCE» OR «OTHERWISE»)
patterns.context: 免责条款说明损害无论如何造成、基于何种责任理论，均包括合同、严格责任、侵权及过失；大写法律文本，局部可能有换行或注释。
patterns.domain: Github 法律条款／软件免责声明

patterns.name: 残片与答案格式
patterns.context: 数学段落中出现孤立题目残片或答案分数；这些 token 不构成与主问题同样清楚的触发规律，可能是相邻文本或格式残留。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 文本残片／答案

en.description: Activations are distributed across Greek characters, mathematical symbols and variables, introduction of academic terms, Go import paths, liability and damage terms in license disclaimers, and statistical phrasing in screening studies; apart from repeated disclaimer text, the instances have no evident common local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Greek text with a sigma token
patterns.context: Activations fall on Greek letters and fragments of Greek words; contexts include Greek parliamentary speech and mixed Latin- and Greek-letter text at the beginning
patterns.domain: EuroParl; the first passage is ArXiv mixed-symbol text

patterns.name: Numbers, variables, and probability-problem fragments
patterns.context: Draws letters from a set, gives counts, and asks for a probability; activations are scattered across variables, punctuation, and conjunctions

patterns.name: Large-parameter range phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses the two asymptotic ranges large-$n$ and large-$n,N$, and introduces a term

patterns.name: Go package paths and imports
patterns.context: Go source package/import declarations and GitHub path strings

patterns.name: Limitation of liability in software disclaimers
patterns.context: Uppercase license or software disclaimer text listing warranty disclaimers, liability exclusions, and types of damages

patterns.name: Screening studies and statistical analysis terminology
patterns.context: Describes invited populations for breast and bowel cancer screening and reports logistic regression, odds ratios, and relative risks

3_158.description: 激活分布在希腊语字符、数学符号与变量、学术术语引入、Go 导入路径、许可证免责声明的免责与损害词，以及筛查研究统计表述中；除免责文本重复外，各处没有显然共同的局部触发模式。

patterns.name: Greek text with a sigma token
patterns.trigger: «σ»、«ε»、«ό»、«ς»、«Π» 等希腊字母或其词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊字母及希腊语词的片段上；有希腊语议会发言上下文，也有开头的混合拉丁字母、希腊字母文本
patterns.domain: EuroParl；第1段为 ArXiv 混合符号文本

patterns.name: 数字、变量与概率题片段
patterns.context: 在集合中抽取字母、给出计数并询问概率；激活分散在变量、标点和连接词上

patterns.name: 大型参数区间表述
patterns.context: 讨论 large-$n$ 与 large-$n,N$ 两种渐近区间，并引入术语

patterns.name: Go 包路径与导入
patterns.context: Go 源码的 package/import 声明及 GitHub 路径字符串

patterns.name: 软件免责声明中的责任限制
patterns.context: 许可证或软件免责声明中，以大写格式列举保证免责、责任排除及损害类型

patterns.name: 筛查研究与统计分析用语
patterns.context: 描述乳腺癌和肠道筛查的受邀人群，并报告逻辑回归、优势比及相对风险
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to cell-culture methods, medium supplements, and cell-line conditions in biomedical papers; other independent patterns include reproductive research institutions, website disclaimers, mathematical formulas and expansion terminology, miRNA expression descriptions, and Portuguese text on clusters of cancer patients.

patterns.name: Medium and supplement formulations
patterns.context: Cell-culture methods list media, serum, and antibiotics; triggers are distributed across these formulation terms and nearby numbers and units.

patterns.name: Cell-line and culture-condition subsection
patterns.context: Introduces cell lines, cell sources, or culture conditions, often adjacent to descriptions of culture methods; a complete medium formulation need not appear.

patterns.name: Reproductive health, obstetrics, and institutional names
patterns.context: Studies the reproductive effects of pollutants and mentions academic institutions in pediatrics, obstetrics, and gynecology.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts or research plans

patterns.name: Trademark and website disclaimer phrasing
patterns.context: Disclaimer-like language concerning trademarks or other materials appears near a website comment form.

patterns.name: Mathematical expansion and terminology
patterns.context: A formula defines a vector indexed by a set and calls it an expansion of an object.

patterns.name: miRNA expression and normalization
patterns.context: Reports miRNA expression measurements and normalization using an internal reference.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper results or methods sections

patterns.name: Portuguese phrasing about cancer-patient clusters
patterns.context: Discusses clusters of cancer patients and their geographic distribution on both sides of the Gibraltar border.

3_158.concept: 生物医学方法文本及术语
3_158.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中细胞培养方法、培养基补充剂与细胞系条件；另有生殖研究机构、网站免责声明、数学公式与展开术语、miRNA表达描述及葡萄牙语癌症患者聚集区文本等独立模式。

patterns.name: 培养基及补充剂配方
patterns.trigger: “cultured in complete DMEM medium”, “supplemented with”, “fetal calf serum”, “penicillin”, “streptomycin”
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中列出培养基、血清及抗生素等成分；触发分布在这些配方词语及其附近的数字、单位上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 细胞系与培养条件小节
patterns.trigger: “Cell lines and culture conditions”, “cell lines”, “HEK 293 cells”, “CRC cell lines”
patterns.context: 介绍细胞系、细胞来源或培养条件，常紧邻培养方法描述；不一定出现完整培养基配方。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 生殖、妇产及机构名称
patterns.context: 研究污染物对生殖的影响，并提及儿科、产科与妇科学术机构。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要或研究计划

patterns.name: 商标及网站免责声明措辞
patterns.trigger: “trademark’s, or other material that might be found on the”
patterns.context: 网站评论表单附近出现对商标或其他材料的免责声明式表述。

patterns.name: 数学展开式与术语
patterns.context: 公式定义集合索引的向量，并将其称为某对象的展开。

patterns.name: miRNA表达与归一化
patterns.context: 报告miRNA表达测量及以内参进行归一化。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文结果或方法部分

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语肿瘤患者聚集区表述
patterns.context: 讨论癌症患者群体聚集区及直布罗陀边境两侧的地理分布。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

en.description: The strongest repeated clue is 100 µg/mL streptomycin in medium formulations; and at the end of author lists in multiple papers also strongly activates. Other activations occur sporadically in affiliation numbers, paper section headings, public-health table titles, legal contracts, and scientific text, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: Antibiotic dosage in cell-culture medium
patterns.context: Streptomycin concentration is written as 100 µg/mL in a list of medium ingredients; penicillin and other culture-medium ingredients are also listed

patterns.name: and after author names
patterns.context: and at the end of an author list is followed by the final author’s name; the preceding text contains multiple authors or an author-list format

patterns.name: Digit 1 in scientific notation or citation markers
patterns.context: The digit 1 appears as a marker in metadata such as superscript affiliation numbers and co-author markers; activation may be strongly affected by tokenization boundaries

patterns.name: References section heading
patterns.context: A bibliography label appears after the main text or citations

patterns.name: Acknowledgments section heading
patterns.context: An acknowledgments heading appears at the end of a paper, followed by thanks and the names of those acknowledged

patterns.name: Policy topic in table titles
patterns.context: A table title mentions public health practitioners and policy makers together, near a table reference marker
patterns.domain: Public health papers and table titles

patterns.name: Material terms in construction contracts
patterns.context: A legal contract describes ordering construction materials and uses hereinafter called to introduce a term for a contracting party

patterns.name: Prepositional phrases and specialized terms in scientific text
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across scientific prose on optical cloaking, gene-expression comparisons, and quantum hashing, with no stable common trigger condition
patterns.domain: Scientific paper body text across disciplines

3_158.concept: 链霉素剂量与论文格式片段
3_158.description: 最强而重复的线索是培养基配方中100 µg/mL链霉素；多篇论文作者名单末尾的and也强激活。其余激活零散见于署名编号、论文栏目标题、公共卫生表题、法律合同及科学正文，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 细胞培养液中的抗生素剂量
patterns.context: 培养基成分列表中，链霉素浓度写作100 µg/mL；同时列出青霉素及其他培养液成分

patterns.name: 作者姓名后的 and
patterns.trigger: « and»10 Axel Brandenburg；« and»10 Hagai Net；« and»9 Hongru Ma；« and»9 Marco Carmosino；« and»9 Joanna Garbulińska
patterns.context: 作者名单末尾的 and 后接最后一位作者姓名；前文有多位作者或作者署名格式
patterns.domain: 论文作者署名与元数据

patterns.name: 科学记数或引用标记中的数字1
patterns.context: 姓名后的上标机构编号、共同作者标记等元数据中，数字1以标记形式出现；激活受分词边界影响的可能性较大
patterns.domain: 论文作者署名与脚注格式

patterns.name: 参考文献栏标题
patterns.context: 正文或引文后出现 bibliography 标签

patterns.name: 致谢栏标题
patterns.context: 论文末尾的致谢标题，随后是感谢语和被感谢者姓名

patterns.name: 表格标题中的政策主题
patterns.context: 表格标题并列提及 public health practitioners 与 policy makers，附近含表格引用标记
patterns.domain: 公共卫生论文与表格标题

patterns.name: 建筑合同中的材料称呼
patterns.context: 法律合同描述施工材料订购，并以 hereinafter called 引入合同当事方称谓

patterns.name: 科学文本中的介词短语和特殊术语
patterns.context: 激活分散在光学隐身、基因表达比较及量子哈希等科学正文中，未见稳定共同触发条件

en.description: Primarily sensitive to table cross-references and their structured markers in scientific papers; it also occurs in table cells, footnotes, and author-list content. Nearby body-text topics vary.

patterns.name: Table cross-reference markers
patterns.context: The body text refers to a table, especially when the reference is adjacent to a link marker containing ref, type, and table; activations often fall on table numbers, marker fields, and nearby connectives.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central scientific paper body text

patterns.name: Table content and footnote structure
patterns.context: Near table rows, cell data, or footnote markers; a table cross-reference in the body text is not required.

patterns.name: Paper author-list formatting
patterns.context: The text transitions from the end of the body to the author-list section, presenting a formatted author list.

3_158.description: 主要对科学论文中表格交叉引用及其结构化标记敏感，也出现在表格单元格、脚注和作者署名等论文结构内容中；附近正文主题多样。

patterns.name: 表格交叉引用标记
patterns.trigger: 原文中的“[Table 2](#…{…ref…type…="table"})”、“[Tables 3](#…) and [4](#…)”及“Supplementary Table S1”等
patterns.context: 正文引用表格时，尤其是引用文本与包含 ref、type、table 的链接标记相邻；激活常落在表格编号、标记字段及附近连接词上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文正文

patterns.name: 表格内容与脚注结构
patterns.context: 表格行、单元格数据或脚注标记附近；不要求出现正文中的表格交叉引用。

patterns.name: 论文作者署名格式
patterns.trigger: “author:”“Huanyang Chen”“and Hongru Ma”及其间的引号、连字符和换行
patterns.context: 正文结束后转入作者署名区，呈现带格式符号的作者列表。

en.concept: Local language forms and function words
en.description: Activations are distributed across several corpora: common function words, numbers, and units in English academic text; formal forms of address stand out in Polish parliamentary text. Sporadic within-word subword and hyphenated fragments also occur, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: English function words and adjacent structures
patterns.context: In continuous English text, especially lists of parallel items, prepositional phrases, and explanatory sentences; triggers are not limited to a fixed topic.
patterns.domain: English academic papers, abstracts, and mathematical text

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and percentages
patterns.context: Numbers occur in funding identifiers, experimental conditions, statistical results, or mathematical expressions; some numbers stand out alongside nearby English function words.

patterns.name: Polish formal forms of address and inflected word forms
patterns.context: Forms of address to an audience recur in Polish parliamentary speech; prominent activations fall on subword fragments of the address terms.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual local subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur in English, Polish, and text mixing symbols or identifiers; the fragments alone do not constitute a stable semantic pattern.

3_158.concept: 语言局部形式与功能词
3_158.description: 激活分散于多种语料：英语学术文本中常见功能词、数字和单位；波兰语议会语料中突出正式称呼。另有零散词内子词及连字符片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及其邻接结构
patterns.context: 在英语连续文本中，尤其是并列项目、介词短语和说明性句子；触发并不局限于某个固定主题。
patterns.domain: 英语学术论文、摘要及数学文本

patterns.name: 数字及单位、百分数
patterns.context: 数字嵌于经费编号、实验条件、统计结果或数学表达式时；部分数字与附近英语功能词同时突出。

patterns.name: 波兰语正式称呼与屈折词形
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言或正式称呼中，反复出现对听众的称呼；突出部分落在称呼词的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 跨语种局部子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语、波兰语及符号或编号混合文本中，片段自身不足以构成稳定语义模式。
patterns.domain: 多语种及混合符号文本

en.description: Activations span several types of paper fragments: streptomycin dosage is especially prominent in cell-culture formulations, and other instances include funding acknowledgments, and+name in author lists, connectives in mathematical prose, and descriptions of miRNA/mimic reagents.

patterns.name: Biomedical medium ingredients and antibiotic formulations
patterns.context: Medium, serum, and penicillin/streptomycin formulations in cell-culture methods; strong triggers cluster near “mL…streptomycin,” often adjacent to “and 100”

patterns.name: Chinese funding agency names and grant identifiers
patterns.context: Chinese national or provincial research funding and project identifiers listed in the paper’s Funding information section

patterns.name: Names following and in author lists
patterns.context: ArXiv paper author line; typically appears in author metadata at the end of a body-text fragment

patterns.name: Conjunctions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Connects parallel propositions, objects, or inferences in mathematical or theoretical papers; not an author list

patterns.name: miRNA names and mimic reagents
patterns.context: Lists RNA mimics, miRNAs, and reagent sources in a molecular biology methods section

3_158.concept: 论文中的结构化并列表达
3_158.description: 激活覆盖多种论文片段：细胞培养配方中尤其突出链霉素用量，另见基金致谢、作者列表中的 and+姓名、数学正文连接词，以及 miRNA/mimic 试剂描述。

patterns.name: 生物医学培养基成分与抗生素配方
patterns.trigger: “100»2« µg»2«/»2«mL»8 strept«omycin»3”，以及“10»1%…serum”和培养基名称
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法段落中，培养基、血清及青霉素/链霉素的配方描述；强触发集中在“mL…streptomycin”附近，常与“and 100”相邻

patterns.name: 资助信息中的中国基金名称与编号
patterns.context: 论文 Funding information 段落，列举中国国家或省级科研资助及项目编号

patterns.name: 作者列表中 and 后的姓名
patterns.trigger: 作者列表里的“and”及其后的人名，如“and T.M. Fromhold”“and Yao Xiang”“and Hagai Netzer”
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文作者行；通常出现在正文片段末尾的作者元数据中

patterns.name: 数学论文中的并列连接词
patterns.trigger: “and”，包括“and for algebras”“and references therein”“and we recover”
patterns.context: 数学或理论论文正文中连接并列命题、对象或推论；并非作者列表

patterns.name: miRNA 名称与 mimic 试剂
patterns.trigger: “miRNA mimics (miR-149, miR-145, miR-155, and miR-183)”及“circ-CFH2 mimic”
patterns.context: 分子生物学方法段落中列出 RNA mimic、miRNA 和试剂来源

en.description: Activations are scattered across several corpora: and, serum, and antibiotic concentrations in cell-culture methods; mathematical symbols and Lie algebra text; and in paper citations/author sections; and word fragments in Polish, Greek, and Romanian parliamentary text. No unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Cell culture and antibiotic concentrations
patterns.context: Serum, penicillin, and streptomycin supplementation in a cell-culture methods sentence; high activations concentrate mainly around and and concentration units

patterns.name: Special LaTeX symbols and Pi notation
patterns.context: A math paper describes replacing Π¹ with Π when n=1; activations fall near instead of and formula symbols

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary forms-of-address fragments
patterns.context: Forms of address to the chair and the council president in Polish parliamentary speech; words are split into multiple subword tokens

patterns.name: Thin-film scattering and supplementary-material reference
patterns.context: Discussion of thin-film resistivity and a supplementary-material link, with activations across body text and reference markers

patterns.name: Syllables in Greek compound words
patterns.context: Greek parliamentary text, with activations on syllables within ordinary words split into subwords

patterns.name: Lie algebras and nilpotent structures
patterns.context: Enumerates Lie algebras and their complex-structure properties; stronger activations occur near and and algebra identifiers

patterns.name: and in author lists
patterns.context: A conjunction at the end of a paper author list, between author names

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary word-form fragments
patterns.context: Noun, suffix, or participle fragments in Romanian parliamentary speech, in contexts involving members of parliament and committee proposals

3_158.description: 激活分散于多种语料：细胞培养方法中的 and、血清及抗生素浓度，数学符号和 Lie 代数文本，论文引用/作者栏中的 and，以及波兰语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语议会文本的词片段。未见统一语义触发因素。

patterns.name: 细胞培养与抗生素浓度
patterns.trigger: « and»8、« 10»1%« fetal»4« calf»5« serum»5、« 100»3« »1«μg»2«/»1«mL»7« strept»1«omycin»3；另有相近的« 10»2«%»1« fetal»4« bovine»3« serum»5、« 100»2« µg»2«/»1«mL»8« strept»1«omycin»4
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法句中，培养基补充血清、青霉素和链霉素；高激活主要集中在 and 以及浓度单位附近

patterns.name: 特殊 LaTeX 符号与 Pi 记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中描述 n=1 时以 Π 代替 Π¹；激活落在 instead of 及公式符号附近

patterns.name: 波兰语议会称谓词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言中对主席及理事会主席的称呼；词语被分成多个子词 token

patterns.name: 薄膜散射与补充材料引用
patterns.trigger: « increased»2 contribution from the surface and grain boundaries «scattering»1；«Supplementary»1 Note
patterns.context: 薄层电阻率讨论及补充材料链接，激活分布在正文与引用标记上

patterns.name: 希腊语复合词中的音节
patterns.context: 希腊语议会文本，激活落在被子词切分的普通词内部音节

patterns.name: Lie 代数与幂零结构
patterns.context: 枚举 Lie 代数及其复结构性质；较强激活位于 and 和代数编号附近

patterns.name: 作者名单中的 and
patterns.context: 论文作者名单末尾的并列连接词，前后为作者姓名
patterns.domain: 天体物理学论文的作者栏

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会词形片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中的名词、词尾或分词片段，出现在议员与委员会提案语境
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（罗马尼亚语）

en.description: Activations are scattered across Portuguese possessives, the -ING fragment in English uppercase words, Hist in medical titles, and blank lines after email salutations; only local patterns are similar, with no single semantic feature accounting for them.

patterns.name: First-person plural possessive at the beginning or end of a sentence
patterns.context: Portuguese possessive forms in sentences expressing a shared stance, possession, or honorific; the same root triggers in different contexts
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speeches and editorial notes

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in English uppercase words
patterns.context: English words split into multiple subword tokens, especially words containing the -ING fragment; examples include shouting, screening, marketing, consulting
patterns.domain: Online text, business materials, research titles

patterns.name: Hist fragment in a title
patterns.context: At the beginning of a medical paper title, followed by “opathological”; activation is concentrated on the initial subword fragment

patterns.name: Informal email opening at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: A blank line follows the salutation “Mike:”, then the first-person expression “I am down to the last few”; the blank line itself is a strong trigger

3_277.description: 激活分散于葡萄牙语所有格、英语大写词中的 -ING 片段、医学标题的 Hist，以及邮件称呼后的空行；仅局部模式相似，无法由单一语义特征概括。

patterns.name: 句末或句中第一人称复数所有格
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中的所有格词形，位于表达共同立场、所属或敬称的句子中；相同词根在不同语境中触发
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会发言及编辑说明

patterns.name: 英语大写单词的内部子词片段
patterns.context: 英语词被切分成多个子词 token 时，包含 -ING 片段的词尤为突出；涉及 shouting、screening、marketing、consulting
patterns.domain: 网络文本、商业材料、科研标题

patterns.name: 标题中的 Hist 片段
patterns.context: 位于医学论文标题开头，后接“opathological”；激活集中在词首子词片段

patterns.name: 句末非正式邮件开场
patterns.context: 称呼“Mike:”之后空行，再接第一人称表达“I am down to the last few”；空行本身是强触发处

en.description: Visible activations favor several uppercase English subword fragments, Portuguese fragments within nossa/Vossa, and medical title terms; other activations are scattered across Mike, MARK, PROJECT, HBV, and similar strings, with limited overall regularity.

patterns.name: CRE/SCREENING character fragments in uppercase titles or emphasized text
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated in uppercase English strings that may be split into subwords; sometimes these are title-like terms, sometimes emphatic profanity.
patterns.domain: Email subject lines, project names, online conversations

patterns.name: Word-final fragments of Portuguese first-person plural possessive nossa/nossa
patterns.context: In Portuguese text, activation falls on fragments within nossa or Vossa; these occur respectively in political statements, editorial messages, and parliamentary forms of address.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary text and editorial prefaces

patterns.name: Research subject or pathological term in medical paper titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper-name/term fragments in English medical paper titles, involving population descriptions and histopathology; the shared context is title-style academic phrasing, but the meanings differ.

patterns.name: Scattered activations with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different word or word fragment and is difficult to group with the possessive-ending, title-term, or uppercase-substring patterns above.

3_277.concept: 词片段与标题术语检测
3_277.description: 可见激活偏向若干大写英文子词片段、葡语nossa/Vossa词内片段及医学标题术语；另有分散于Mike、MARK、PROJECT、HBV等处的激活，整体规律有限。

patterns.name: 大写标题或强调文本中的 CRE/SCREENING 字符片段
patterns.context: 触发集中在英文大写、可能按子词切分的字符串中；有时是标题式术语，有时是粗口强调语。
patterns.domain: 邮件标题、项目名称、网络对话

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称复数所有格 nossa/nossa 的词尾

patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本及编辑前言

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的研究对象或病理术语

patterns.name: 无明显共享触发的零散激活

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and registers, mostly falling on subword fragments within words; nossa and Portuguese word-form fragments recur in Portuguese, alongside Finnish segmentation, English uppercase invective, and scientific terms. No single semantic theme explains them.

patterns.name: Tokenized English root fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within English words or proper names; unmarked neighboring words may occur in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, phytochemistry papers, physics papers

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person plural possessive
patterns.context: Portuguese political speeches or editorial text contain nossa (“our”); Vossa Excelência is a polite form of address, similar in form but different in meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, Portuguese editorial notes

patterns.name: Fragments within Portuguese words and morphological segmentation
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments of Portuguese words or pieces created by subword segmentation; the same word need not occur in the sentence.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Portuguese editorial text

patterns.name: Finnish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on multiple subword fragments within Finnish words; there is not enough context to identify a specific triggering word sense.

patterns.name: English all-caps and spelling emphasis
patterns.context: An all-caps invective sentence splits colloquial words into multiple subword fragments; activation falls especially strongly on F-ING, LOCK, SCREAMING, and similar fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments of Portuguese political institutions or collective nouns
patterns.context: Portuguese political discourse contains vocabulary related to institutions and collectives, such as the EU, representatives, or committees; these words may overlap with general Portuguese segmentation patterns.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in English scientific terms
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts contain technical terms or descriptions of instruments/processes, with activation on terms or their subwords.

3_277.description: 激活分散于多种语言与语域，主要落在词内子词片段；葡语中反复出现nossa及葡语词形片段，另见芬兰语切分、英文大写怒斥和科学术语。无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 分词化的英文词根片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被单独标记的片段，如 «etic»（Genetic）、«analysis»、«Chinese»、«women»、«glycos»（glycosides）、«investigation»、«constituents»、«pulse»、«extent»
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词或专名内部的子词片段；同段也可能有未标记的邻近词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、植物化学论文、物理学论文

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称复数所有格
patterns.context: 葡语政治发言或编辑文字中出现 nossa（“我们的”）；Vossa Excelência 是礼貌称谓，形式相似但语义不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、葡语编辑说明

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段与形态切分
patterns.context: 激活分布在葡语词的内部片段或由子词切分形成的部分；不要求句中出现同一词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡语编辑文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于芬兰语词内部的多个子词片段；没有足够上下文确定触发的是某个特定词义。

patterns.name: 英语全大写与拼写强调
patterns.context: 全大写、将口语词拆成多个子词片段的怒斥句；激活特别强地落在 F-ING、LOCK、SCREAMING 等片段。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、带脏话的喊话

patterns.name: 葡语政治机构或集体名词片段
patterns.context: 葡语政治论述中出现欧盟、代表或委员会等机构与集体相关词汇；这些词可能与一般葡语分词模式重叠。

patterns.name: 英文科学术语中的子词切分
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现技术术语或仪器／过程描述，激活落在术语的词或子词上。

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on NS strings and their segmented fragments; they occur in contexts involving neutron stars, material compositions, disease names, code types, filenames, and data fields, with inconsistent meanings.

patterns.name: NS abbreviation or subword fragment
patterns.context: The abbreviation occurs in scientific text, code identifiers, or numeric fields; its meaning varies with context and may refer to neutron stars, glass composition, NS sector, a disease, or a variable field
patterns.domain: Primarily astrophysics and other scientific text; also Swift code and medical data

patterns.name: Neutron star in astrophysics
patterns.context: Occurs alongside terms such as spin frequency, accretion disk, magnetar/SGR, spectrum, astronomical names, or NS sector

patterns.name: NS in sodium silicate formulas
patterns.context: NS is followed by a number and appears in discussions of composition, simulation, or interatomic potential

patterns.name: NS substring in the virus abbreviation HBV
patterns.context: Appears in a list of disease names such as HIV and syphilis; activation falls on the character fragment in HBV

patterns.name: NS prefix in a Swift type name
patterns.context: NS is a prefix in a Swift function parameter type name

patterns.name: BV substring in a reference or filename
patterns.context: Appears in a list of bibliography filenames, with activation on the BV character fragment in a filename

patterns.name: NS nutrition data field
patterns.context: Immediately follows an equals sign and a microgram/milligram value, alongside fields such as Male/Female and LS

3_277.description: 激活最稳定地落在 NS 字符串及其切分片段上；它在中子星、材料组分、疾病名、代码类型、文件名和数据字段中均出现，语义并不一致。

patterns.name: NS 缩写或子词片段

patterns.domain: 主要为天体物理及其他科技文本；也包括 Swift 代码和医学数据

patterns.name: 天体物理中的 neutron star
patterns.context: 与旋转频率、吸积盘、磁星/SGR、光谱、天体名称或 NS sector 等术语共同出现
patterns.domain: 天体物理、弦论相关科技文本

patterns.name: 钠硅酸盐化学式中的 NS
patterns.context: NS 后接数字并处于组成、模拟或 interatomic potential 的讨论中

patterns.name: 病毒缩写 HBV 中的 NS 子串
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV、syphilis 等疾病名称列表中；激活落在 HBV 的字符片段上

patterns.name: Swift 类型名中的 NS 前缀
patterns.context: 作为 Swift 函数参数类型的一部分，NS 是类型名的前缀

patterns.name: 文献或文件名中的 BV 子串
patterns.context: 出现在 bibliography 文件名列表中，激活落在文件名的 BV 字符片段上

patterns.name: 营养数据字段 NS

patterns.name: Nonstationary ideal abbreviation
patterns.context: NS appears in mathematical notation for a nonstationary ideal

patterns.name: Neutron star abbreviation
patterns.context: NS refers to a neutron star, appearing in contexts involving binaries, astronomical sources, and their surfaces

patterns.name: Chemical sample label
patterns.context: NS is connected to numbers and chemical formulas, serving as a sodium silicate composition or sample label

patterns.name: NS in a grant number
patterns.context: NS is part of an NIH grant number

patterns.name: NS in biology
patterns.context: In an experimental description of IMPDH2 inhibition and ribosomal stress, NS refers to an unspecified quantity or term

patterns.name: Apple object-context class
patterns.context: The NS prefix appears in iOS/macOS object management class names and is related to thread access

patterns.name: Influenza nonstructural gene
patterns.context: NS refers to the nonstructural gene of influenza virus and appears in descriptions of viral RNA genes

patterns.name: Superstring theory sector
patterns.context: NS is the name of a sector in superstring theory and appears in discussions of spacetime actions

3_277.description: 激活都落在字母串“NS”上，但语境各异：数学缩写、中子星、化学编号、资助号、生物学术语、Apple 类名、流感基因及超弦扇区。

patterns.name: 非平稳理想缩写

patterns.context: NS 指中子星，出现在双星、天体来源及其表面等语境

patterns.name: 化学样品编号

patterns.name: 资助编号中的 NS

patterns.name: 生物学中的 NS

patterns.name: Apple 对象上下文类

en.description: The most consistent shared trigger is the tilde, especially when adjacent to numbers, letters, subscripts/superscripts, or units; other activated words are scattered across code, scientific terminology, tables, and equations, with no cross-passage semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tilde and adjacent numbers/symbols
patterns.context: Appears near subscripts/superscripts, ranges, approximations, or specialized scientific notation; sometimes occurs between numbers, letters, or units.
patterns.domain: Scientific notation, units, equations, and code across domains

patterns.name: Whitespace and comparison expressions in code
patterns.context: In Python-style code, whitespace indentation, comparison conditions, and output labels are adjacent; the tilde also appears before a string.

patterns.name: Time-of-death estimation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses entomological inference of time of death and PM​​I; these words have weaker activations and do not recur elsewhere.

patterns.name: Population strata and monetary values
patterns.context: Near stratum labels and income values expressed in CLP in a socioeconomic population description.

patterns.name: Biological terminology and Greek letters
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur on terms and Greek letters in academic descriptions of endonucleases and structural types.

patterns.name: Black-hole mass notation
patterns.context: Astrophysical introduction to black holes and their mass functions, including LaTeX mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Seafloor hydrothermal environment terminology
patterns.context: Describes hydrothermal vent ecosystems and their temperature, gases, and chemical environment.

patterns.name: Vitamin D metabolism notation
patterns.context: Near biochemical abbreviations and terminology for hydroxylases and vitamin D conversion.

patterns.name: Statistical/experimental labels in tables
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur in column names, experimental labels, and values in tables or extracted concatenated text.

patterns.name: Experimental protocols and measurement metrics
patterns.context: Near protocol names and metric headings in subsection titles and protocol descriptions.

3_277.description: 最稳定的共同触发是波浪号，尤其与数字、字母、上下标或单位相邻时；其余激活词分散于代码、科学术语、表格和公式，未形成跨段语义主题。

patterns.name: 波浪号及其邻接的数字/符号

patterns.name: 代码中的空白与比较表达式

patterns.name: 死亡时间估计术语
patterns.context: 讨论昆虫学推断死亡时间及 PM​​I；这些词的激活较弱，未见其他段重复。

patterns.name: 人口阶层与货币数值
patterns.context: 社会经济人口描述中，阶层标签和以 CLP 表示的收入数值附近。

patterns.name: 生物学术语与希腊字母

patterns.name: 黑洞质量记号
patterns.context: 天体物理介绍黑洞及其质量函数，包含 LaTeX 数学记号。

patterns.name: 海底热液环境术语
patterns.context: 描述热液喷口生态系统及其温度、气体和化学环境。

patterns.name: 维生素 D 代谢记号
patterns.context: 羟化酶及维生素 D 转化过程的生化缩写与术语附近。

patterns.name: 表格中的统计/实验标签

patterns.name: 实验方案与测量指标
patterns.context: 小节标题和方案描述中，协议名称及指标标题附近。

en.concept: Capitalized proper names and document-label fragments

patterns.name: Court proceedings and judge signature
patterns.context: At the end of a court decision or opinion, lists judges’ names and titles, panel membership, or opinion status; names are often split into multiple subword fragments

patterns.name: Eleventh Circuit header and case information
patterns.context: Heading of an Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals document, accompanied by a date, case number, and Judge Thomas K. Kahn’s name

patterns.name: Capitalized name fragments in legal documents

patterns.name: Book illustration credit and proper names

patterns.name: Regional and economic categories in news section titles

en.description: Primarily responds to statutory section numbers in legal documents, especially “chapter” and the following number; it also responds to chapter numbers in book tables of contents. Other activations are scattered across decimal points, fragments within specific words, and sentencing terminology.

patterns.name: Chapter and statutory section numbers in legal text
patterns.context: Near chapter numbers, code sections, or statutory numbers, especially when legal discussion cites regulations or litigation procedures; activation often falls on “chapter” and the immediately following number/identifier.
patterns.domain: Decisions, appellate opinions, and legal documents such as bankruptcy law

patterns.name: Roman numeral chapter numbering in headings and tables of contents
patterns.context: In a book’s table of contents or chapter heading, numbering is adjacent to chapter titles, page numbers, and other layout elements.
patterns.domain: Tables of contents and headings in history books

patterns.name: Internal fragments of specific English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of segmented words; the available examples occur in a book title and a name in a table of contents, with no established shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Literary history book titles, table-of-contents entries

patterns.name: Decimal points in measurement values
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, activation occurs on decimal points and neighboring numeric characters.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragment in legal terminology
patterns.context: When a criminal appellate opinion mentions a sentencing enhancement, activation falls on “level” in “two-level sentence enhancement”; it is unclear whether this relates to the statutory chapter-number pattern.

3_277.description: 主要响应法律文书中的法规章节编号，尤其是“chapter”及后续编号；也响应书籍目录的章节编号。另有小数点、特定词内片段和量刑术语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 章节标题和目录中的罗马数字编号
patterns.context: 书籍的目录或章节标题中，编号与章节标题、页码等排版元素相邻。
patterns.domain: 历史类书籍的目录与标题

patterns.name: 特定英文单词的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的单词内部片段；现有例子分别出现在书名和目录人名中，尚不能确定共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 测量数值中的小数点

patterns.name: 法律词语中的特定子词片段

en.description: Activation cues mainly involve segmented proper names and words, especially Tuscan; other examples include line breaks, whitespace, names, and capitalized fragments in legal decisions, book-title typography, Spanish names, and burrito fragments, with no unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: Tuscan place name
patterns.context: “Tuscan” is split into subword fragments and refers to Tuscany, Italy; it appears in architectural descriptions, child studies, and rural recollections.

patterns.name: Formatting and proper-name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Court decision headers, dates, judge signatures, party names, and page whitespace; activation falls on line breaks, formatting whitespace, common words, and segmented names.

patterns.name: Capitalized fragments in literary titles and typography
patterns.context: Book titles, headings, and military ranks are capitalized or line-broken, with activation on segmented capitalized words.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of names or words
patterns.context: In a Spanish-language acknowledgments section, activations are scattered across abbreviations, organization names, and internal name fragments; no clear connection to Tuscan or legal formatting.

patterns.name: Food-word fragment
patterns.context: “burrito” is segmented, with a trigger in an ordering and restaurant-review context; only one example.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments without a stable pattern

3_277.description: 激活线索以被拆分的专名、词语片段为主，尤其是 Tuscan；另见法律判决的换行、空白、姓名与大写片段，以及书名排版、西语人名和 burrito 片段，缺少统一语义特征。

patterns.context: COLONEL is split into multiple tokens; appears in a title or a name/rank
patterns.domain: Book titles, historical and biographical text

patterns.name: English title wording

patterns.name: Historical building title wording

patterns.name: Catholic-colony title wording

patterns.name: Securities litigation name

patterns.name: Legal-party name formatting
patterns.context: Names are segmented and appear beside litigation-role information such as petitioner-appellant and warden

patterns.name: Jurisdiction and state-name formatting
patterns.context: State names appear in all-caps segmented form in court case headers

patterns.name: Whitespace in court-stamp/filing headers
patterns.context: Large indented blank spaces in document headers occur alongside FILED and the court name

patterns.name: Technical patent citation format
patterns.context: Patent numbers and prior patent citations are embedded in technical descriptions

patterns.name: Bibliographic biographical information
patterns.context: Bibliographic titles appear alongside brief details such as author birth/death years, nationality, and occupation

3_277.concept: 排版化文档标题与标签
3_277.description: 激活集中于排版化的文档标题与标签：分词大写的书名/章节词、法律案件抬头及引注、分类列表和专利引用；也覆盖少数具体标题词、姓名与单位格式。

patterns.name: Colonel 字样的分词拼写
patterns.context: COLONEL 被分段切成多个 token；出现在标题或人名/军衔中
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、历史与传记文本

patterns.name: 法院名称与司法文书格式
patterns.trigger: «Court»、«Circuit»、«Appeals»，以及案号、当事人称谓周边的空格和标点
patterns.context: 法院名称、案号或诉讼当事人信息出现在排版式文书页眉或标题块中
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 美国历史地名与分类条目

patterns.name: 统计类章节标题
patterns.context: 统计词出现在全大写的章节或目录标题中，列出一般统计、作物统计等小节
patterns.domain: 历史/农业资料的目录式文本

patterns.name: 专利中的材料与温度单位
patterns.context: 营养物封装、明胶化淀粉及专利号的技术叙述中出现温度范围

patterns.name: 英文标题字样
patterns.context: BRITISH 被分段切分并置于全大写书名标题中

patterns.name: 历史建筑标题字样
patterns.context: 全大写标题提及北美古迹与历史堡垒

patterns.name: 天主教殖民地标题字样

patterns.name: 证券诉讼名称
patterns.context: 证券诉讼案名及法律引注中出现公司名和 litigation 一词

patterns.name: 法律当事人姓名排版
patterns.context: 人名被分段标记，处于 petitioner-appellant、warden 等诉讼身份信息旁

patterns.name: 司法辖区与州名排版
patterns.context: 州名以全大写分词形式出现在法院案件抬头

patterns.name: 法院盖章/提交页眉空白
patterns.context: 文书页眉中大段缩进空白与 FILED、法院名称并列

patterns.name: 技术专利引用格式
patterns.context: 专利号及先前专利引用嵌在技术说明中

patterns.name: 书目式传记信息
patterns.context: 书目标题和作者生卒年份、国籍/职业等简短资料并列

en.description: Activations concentrate on Court in U.S. legal documents and judge biographies, especially in the names of appellate, circuit, and district courts; title formatting, party listings, and FILED are common adjacent formats.

patterns.name: Court in court names
patterns.context: Court appears in a court name, especially adjacent to “United States,” “of,” “Appeals,” “Circuit,” or “District”; capitalization and tokenization vary
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, docket titles, and judge biographies

patterns.name: Appellate court title format
patterns.context: Court heading or appeal-from field on the first page of an opinion or docket; often accompanied by aligned spaces, line breaks, and FILED

patterns.name: Litigant listing
patterns.context: Case title or party-information field, usually separated by spacing, dashes, and line breaks

patterns.name: Tax court heading
patterns.context: Tax court memorandum title, with the court name set in uppercase

patterns.name: Court titles in judge biographies
patterns.context: Biographical sentence stating a judge’s court and position

3_277.concept: 美国法院名称中的 Court
3_277.description: 激活集中于美国法律文书与法官简介中法院名称的 Court，尤其上诉法院、巡回法院和地区法院；标题排版、当事人栏及 FILED 等是常见邻接格式。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 Court
patterns.trigger: “Court”或其分词片段，如«Court»10、«COURT»6；常见于“United States Court of Appeals”“Circuit Court”及“District Court”
patterns.context: 法院名称中出现 Court，尤其邻接“United States”“of”“Appeals”“Circuit”或“District”；大小写及分词形式不一
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、案卷标题及法官简介

patterns.name: 上诉法院标题格式
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Appeals”“Appeal from”“Circuit Court”
patterns.context: 判决或案卷首页的法院抬头、上诉来源栏；常伴随对齐空格、换行和 FILED
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人栏
patterns.trigger: “Plaintiff - Appellee”“Defendant - Appellant”，以及姓名与“Deceased”“Appeal from”相邻
patterns.context: 案件标题或当事人信息栏，通常以排版空格、横线和换行分隔

patterns.name: 税务法院抬头
patterns.context: 税务法院备忘录标题，法院名称以大写形式排版

patterns.name: 法官简介中的法院职衔
patterns.context: 人物传记句中说明法官任职法院及职位

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments inside tokenized words, particularly TIN and London; also seen in U.S. court headings, layout spacing, and sporadic name and title substrings. A stable shared mechanism across contexts is unclear.

patterns.name: “TIN” letter fragment
patterns.context: The target letter fragment occurs inside words split by tokenization; examples include “introduction,” text related to “Tennessee,” “tinsy,” and names such as “Tinney.”

patterns.name: London text
patterns.context: “London” is split into multiple tokens, often in book catalogs or publication information, and also in newspaper names.
patterns.domain: Book catalogs, publication information, newspaper forms

patterns.name: Court in court names
patterns.context: Fixed legal institution names in U.S. court opinion headings; “Court” as a whole or its token has high activation.

patterns.name: Layout spacing
patterns.context: Large spans of spaces in document headings or covers are marked individually, possibly related to layout alignment.

patterns.name: Other internally split word forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on several subword fragments inside uppercase words, with no shared semantics or stable word form apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal materials, book catalogs and covers, German academic titles

patterns.name: Names and case names in legal documents
patterns.context: Parties, companies, or personal names in court opinions; besides the separately listed Court and TIN fragments, some name substrings also activate.

3_277.description: 激活多落在被切分的词内片段，尤见 TIN、London；也见美国法院抬头、排版空格及零散姓名和标题子串。不同语境共享的稳定机制不明确。

patterns.name: “TIN”字母片段
patterns.context: 目标字母片段出现在被分词切开的单词内部；可见于“introduction”“Tennessee”相关文本、“tinsy”及人名“Tinney”等不同词形。

patterns.name: 伦敦字样
patterns.context: “London”被拆分为多个 token，常出现在书籍目录或出版信息中，也出现在报纸名称中。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、出版信息、报纸表单

patterns.name: 法庭名称中的 Court
patterns.context: 美国法院判决抬头中的固定法律机构名称；“Court”整体或其 token 获得高激活。

patterns.name: 排版空格
patterns.context: 文档抬头或封面中大段空格被单独标记，可能与版式对齐有关。

patterns.name: 其他内部拆分词形
patterns.context: 激活落在大写单词内部的若干子词片段，但未见统一语义或稳定词形。
patterns.domain: 法律材料、书籍目录与封面、德语学术标题

patterns.name: 法律文书姓名与案名
patterns.context: 法院判决中的当事人、公司或人名；除已单列的 Court 和 TIN 片段外，部分姓名子串也有激活。

en.description: Activations concentrate on the layout and set phrasing of U.S. federal appellate opinions: court, circuit, appeal origin, litigant status, FILED markers, and case citations; names also show sporadic activations.

patterns.name: Appellate court name format
patterns.context: Court name in a federal opinion header or docket information; sometimes immediately followed by a circuit name

patterns.name: District court appeal-origin format
patterns.context: Below the case title, identifies the federal district court from which the case is appealed, often followed by the district name
patterns.domain: First pages of U.S. federal judicial opinions

patterns.name: Plaintiff and defendant status labels
patterns.context: Labels the parties’ litigation status in case-title formatting, often alongside names, separators, and appeal origin
patterns.domain: First pages of U.S. federal judicial opinions

patterns.name: Circuit ordinal name
patterns.context: Circuit designation after the federal appellate court name; some examples are truncated or split across layout

patterns.name: Case citation numbers
patterns.context: Federal reporter volume and page citations before the court name, with numbers split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Docket punctuation and numbers
patterns.context: Case numbers after a case title or citation; activation falls on number punctuation and some digits

patterns.name: Filed stamp
patterns.context: FILED printed in spaced letters near the top of the page, with the appellate court name alongside or below

patterns.name: Individual party names and aliases
patterns.context: Party names in case titles that are split or include aliases; activation covers parts of names without showing a stable name-related trigger

patterns.name: Other name fragments in case names
patterns.context: Partial tokens from plaintiff or defendant names in citation lines; activations are sporadic

3_277.description: 激活集中于美国联邦上诉判决的版式与固定措辞：法院、巡回区、上诉来源、诉讼身份、FILED标记及引证案号；姓名局部也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 上诉法院名称格式
patterns.context: 联邦判决页眉或案号信息中的法院名称；有时紧接巡回区名称

patterns.name: 地区法院上诉来源格式
patterns.context: 案件标题下方说明上诉来自哪个联邦地区法院，常继续列出地区名称
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决首页

patterns.name: 原被告身份标签
patterns.context: 案件标题页排版中标注双方的诉讼身份，常与姓名、分隔线和上诉来源并列
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决首页

patterns.name: 巡回区序数名称
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院名称后标出巡回区；部分样本被截断或拆分排版
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决页眉

patterns.name: 判例引证数字
patterns.context: 法院名称前的联邦判例卷册与页码引证，数字被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: 案号标点与编号
patterns.context: 案件标题或引证之后出现案件编号；激活落在编号标点及部分数字上

patterns.name: 已归档印章
patterns.context: 页面上方以分隔字母排印的 FILED 字样，旁边或下方是上诉法院名称

patterns.name: 个别当事人姓名与别名
patterns.trigger: «Peter Terrell Redd»itt；«Jose Francisco Garza T»ov»ar；«-S«AL»«AS»；«Victor« Ort»iz»
patterns.context: 案件标题中出现被拆分或带别名的当事人姓名；激活覆盖姓名局部，未显示稳定的姓名语义触发

patterns.name: 其他案名姓名局部
patterns.context: 引证行中原告或被告姓名的局部 token，激活零散分布

en.description: Activations concentrate on court names and federal appellate opinion headings, and also respond to sporadic uppercase letter fragments (IN, CAN), blank-space formatting in legal documents, and diacritic letters in Turkish names; the patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: TIN strings in legal text
patterns.context: IN appears within uppercase letter strings, often inside words or separated by tokenization markers; the first segment is an abbreviation in parentheses after myosin-I, while another has «T»…«AX» forming TAX.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research text, U.S. Tax Court legal text

patterns.name: COURT in court names
patterns.context: Court appears in court names or opinion text, with varying capitalization; commonly in United States Court of Appeals, also in County Court.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and docket information

patterns.name: Federal jurisdiction format in opinion headings
patterns.context: Appears in court names on the first page of an opinion, usually with a circuit name; this pattern overlaps with the Court trigger.

patterns.name: CAN in a volcano alert title
patterns.context: In the title VOLCANO ALERT LEVELS, CAN is an internal letter fragment of VOLCAN(O), not an independent word.

patterns.name: Diacritic letters in Turkish names
patterns.context: Occurs in Turkish author names, involving the letters ü, ı and related name spellings.

patterns.name: Layout whitespace
patterns.context: Long runs of spaces in legal document titles are marked; no clear independent semantics, possibly reflecting layout or formatting.

3_277.description: 激活集中于法院名称及联邦上诉法院判决抬头，也响应零散的大写字母片段（IN、CAN）、法律文书空白排版，以及土耳其姓名中的变音字母；模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 TIN 字符串
patterns.context: 大写字母串中出现 IN，常位于单词内部或被分词标记拆开；第1段是 myosin-I 后的括号缩写，另有 «T»…«AX» 组成 TAX。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本、美国税务法院法律文本

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 COURT
patterns.context: 法院名称或判决正文中出现 Court，大小写不一；多见于 United States Court of Appeals，也见于 County Court。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及案头信息

patterns.name: 判决抬头中的联邦法院辖区格式
patterns.context: 出现在判决首页的法院名称中，通常带巡回区名称；该模式与 Court 触发重叠。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决抬头

patterns.name: 火山警报标题中的 CAN
patterns.context: 标题 VOLCANO ALERT LEVELS 中，CAN 是 VOLCAN(O) 的内部字母片段，而非独立单词。

patterns.name: 土耳其语姓名中的带变音字母
patterns.context: 出现在土耳其作者姓名中，涉及字母 ü、ı 及相关姓名拼写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文作者名单

patterns.name: 排版空白
patterns.context: 法律文书标题中的长串空格被标记；无明显独立语义，可能反映版式或格式。

en.concept: Local lexical and formatting features across corpora
en.description: Primarily responds to minutes and related questions in English time-arithmetic problems; also responds to court, party, and jurisdiction vocabulary in legal documents, as well as forms such as premier/première in French parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Minutes in English time calculations
patterns.context: Time-arithmetic problems asking for the number of minutes between two times, or for a number of minutes before or after a given time; “minutes” is followed by a value or appears in the question.

patterns.name: Court vocabulary in legal document format
patterns.context: Legal case titles, court jurisdiction sections, or party listings; often accompanied by uppercase text, indentation, and line breaks.

patterns.name: French words denoting precedence or first
patterns.context: References to a principle or the first agenda item in a French parliamentary context; activation falls on subword fragments within the word form.

3_277.concept: 多语料局部词汇与格式特征
3_277.description: 主要响应英语时间算术题中的分钟及相关问法；也响应法律文书的法院、当事人和管辖权词汇，以及法语议会文本中 premier/première 等词形。

patterns.name: 英文时间计算中的分钟
patterns.trigger: “minutes”及短语“how many minutes are there between”；也见“minutes after”“minutes before”
patterns.context: 时间算术题里询问两个时刻之间的分钟数，或在某时刻之前/之后若干分钟；“minutes”后接数值或出现在题干中。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式中的法庭词汇
patterns.context: 法律案件标题、法院管辖权段落或当事人列示；常伴随大写、缩进和换行排版。

patterns.name: 法语中表示先后或第一的词
patterns.context: 法语议会语境中提及原则或议程的第一项；激活落在词形内部的子词片段。

en.description: Most fragment activations fall on in/Tin letter strings with varying capitalization, appearing in proper nouns, common words, and the substance name “tin”; there are also sporadic activations on legal titles, names, and whitespace formatting, with unclear triggering relationships.

patterns.name: in/Tin substring within or at the start of a word
patterns.context: Activations often fall on differently capitalized in strings, especially word-initial Tin and word-internal chin; these examples alone do not establish whether a particular meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: legal documents, general text, encyclopedias, catalogs

patterns.name: Sporadic letter fragments in legal titles and names
patterns.context: Appears in formatted text such as court names, legal titles, or names; activations fall on punctuation, spaces, and split letter fragments, with no shared lexical trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Court jurisdiction heading fragment
patterns.context: Around jurisdiction headings and statute citations, activation falls on heading words and formatting fragments such as parentheses.

patterns.name: Tea party movement name
patterns.context: Activation occurs on Tin in a proper name; preceding text discusses rejecting tracking devices.

patterns.name: Formatting markers unexplained by shared word forms
patterns.context: Strong activations occur in long blank fields and legal case-title formatting, with no direct correspondence to the in/Tin word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw case titles or party listings

3_277.description: 多数片段激活落在大小写不一的 in/Tin 字母串上，见于专名、普通词和“tin”物质名；另有法律标题、姓名及空白排版片段的零散激活，触发关系不明。

patterns.name: 词内或词首的 in/Tin 子串
patterns.context: 激活常落在大小写不同的 in 字母串上，尤其是词首 Tin、词内 chin；单凭这些例子无法确定是否要求特定词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：法律文书、普通文本、百科、目录

patterns.name: 法律标题与姓名中的零散字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、法律标题或姓名等排版文本中；激活分布在标点、空格及被切分的字母片段，未见统一的词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法院管辖权标题片段
patterns.context: 围绕管辖权标题及法规引用，激活落在标题词和括号等格式片段上。

patterns.name: 茶壶帽运动名称
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名中的 Tin；前文讨论拒绝追踪设备。

patterns.name: 无法由共同词形解释的格式标记
patterns.context: 长空白字段及法律案件标题排版处出现强激活，无法与 in/Tin 词形模式直接对应。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 案件标题或当事人栏

en.description: Primarily sensitive to continuous in/IN substrings in English spellings, commonly in Chinook, Chinatown, Chin, TINNEY, UNITED, tins, and Tin, across capitalization and word boundaries. Examples span catalogs, encyclopedias, legal documents, forums, and papers; other triggers also occur alongside vocabulary or list formats specific to their domains.

patterns.name: Strings containing chin/Chin
patterns.context: The letter sequence in/IN appears in English words or proper nouns, especially across capitalization, word boundaries, or punctuation; sometimes occurs in spellings such as China, Chinook, Chinatown, Chin, Tinney, United, and tins.
patterns.domain: Bibliography, Wikipedia, legal documents, speech transcripts, forums, and academic texts

patterns.name: Proper nouns in title and entry lists
patterns.context: Titles in lists of books or series contain common words such as Star and Dragon; Chinatown, which triggers in, also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Place names and geographic entries
patterns.context: Consecutive listing of place names, geographic entities, and their locations; no in-string trigger is marked in this passage.

patterns.name: Legal document format and court jurisdiction terms
patterns.context: Court names, case titles, and jurisdiction rules, among other uppercase or title-case legal terms; TINNEY/INITED strings also occur.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions or litigation documents

patterns.name: Tear in descriptive speech
patterns.context: Uppercase spoken transcript describing vehicle damage, repeatedly mentioning a small tear on the left pillar; TIN also occurs.
patterns.domain: Testimony or oral records in legal materials

patterns.name: Tin foil hat/conspiracy expression
patterns.context: Forum post uses Tin Foil Hat Movement to refer to people who reject tracking devices.

patterns.name: German history and statistics discussion
patterns.context: Discusses German resistance to statistical measures and the census in the context of Nazi history; TIN may be a string trigger across capitalization and tokenization.

patterns.name: Atomic interactions in academic terminology
patterns.context: Discusses atomic interactions in Bose lattice gases and antiferromagnets; also contains the citation Ch«in»92010.

patterns.name: Chinook entry in a bibliography
patterns.context: A catalog entry title followed by author Ezra H…; activation concentrates on the in substring in Chinook.

3_277.concept: 英文 in 字符串模式
3_277.description: 主要对英文拼写中连续的 in/IN 子串敏感，常见于 Chinook、Chinatown、Chin、TINNEY、UNITED、tins、Tin 等词，跨大小写和词边界出现。实例分布于目录、百科、法律、论坛和论文；其余触发也伴随各自领域词汇或列表格式。

patterns.name: 含 chin／Chin 的字符串
patterns.context: 英文单词或专名中出现字母序列 in/IN，尤其是跨大小写、词边界或被标点切分；有时落在 China、Chinook、Chinatown、Chin、Tinney、United、tins 等拼写中。
patterns.domain: 书目、维基百科、法律文书、口语转写、论坛及学术文本

patterns.name: 标题与条目列表中的专名
patterns.trigger: «Star»6 Fisher series、The «Star»6 Fisher；Dragon of the Lost Sea、Dragon Steel 等
patterns.context: 书名或系列名列表中，标题含常见词 Star、Dragon；同一段还出现触发 in 的 Chinatown。

patterns.name: 地名与地理条目
patterns.context: 连续列举地名、地理实体及其所在区域；本段未标出 in 字符串触发。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与法院管辖词
patterns.context: 法院名称、案件标题和管辖规则等大写或标题式法律术语；另有 TINNEY/INITED 字样。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决或诉讼文书

patterns.name: 描述性口语中的 tear
patterns.context: 大写口语转录描述车辆损伤，重复提及左侧角柱上的小裂口；同时出现 TIN 字样。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的证词或口述记录

patterns.name: tin foil hat／阴谋论表达
patterns.context: 论坛发言以 Tin Foil Hat Movement 指称拒绝追踪设备的人。

patterns.name: 德国历史与统计讨论
patterns.context: 谈及纳粹历史背景下德国对统计措施及人口普查的抵触；TIN 可能是大小写切分后的字符串触发。

patterns.name: 学术术语中的 atomic interactions
patterns.context: 讨论玻色晶格气体与反铁磁体中的原子相互作用；另含 Ch«in»92010 引文。

patterns.name: 书目中的 Chinook 条目
patterns.context: 目录条目标题后接作者 Ezra H…；激活集中在 Chinook 的 in 子串。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the letter fragment IN within words, commonly in spellings such as TIN, UNITED, Tenth, and Chinatown, across legal documents, news, catalogs, and narrative text; there is also activation on in in the book title Chinook.

patterns.name: In-word substrings containing TIN
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous letter fragments inside uppercase or mixed-case words; they occur in UNITED, TIN, Ticor, and other words, with no independent semantic use apparent.
patterns.domain: Different genres, including legal documents, news discussion, bibliographies, and historical narrative

patterns.name: Ch-in fragment in a song title
patterns.context: An italicized title in a bibliography entry, with activation inside a title word.

3_277.description: 激活主要落在词内的字母片段 IN（常见于 TIN、UNITED、Tenth、Chinatown 等拼写），跨法律文书、新闻、目录与叙述；另在书目标题 Chinook 的 in 上激活。

patterns.name: 含 TIN 的词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在大写或大小写混合的词内部连续字母片段上；分别嵌在 UNITED、TIN、Ticor 等词中，未见独立的语义用法
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻讨论、书目及历史叙述等不同文体

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的 Ch-in 片段
patterns.context: 书目条目中的斜体标题，激活位于标题单词内部

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments with T followed by IN, especially in names, court headings, and body text in U.S. legal documents; there are also sporadic responses to title-format whitespace, tear, chin in book titles, a title insurance company name, and a telomer fragment in a chemical patent.

patterns.name: TIN letter fragment in legal document titles
patterns.context: Appears in legal document titles, court names, party names, or body text; activation falls on tokens whose spelling contains T followed by IN (or adjacent letter fragments), without requiring the string to be a standalone word.

patterns.name: Heading hierarchy and court-name formatting
patterns.context: Court headings, opinion titles, and surrounding indentation, whitespace, and uppercase formatting; space tokens also activate.

patterns.name: Tear in descriptions of damage
patterns.context: Describes a small tear or split at the left corner of an object, with tear repeated nearby.

patterns.name: chin in book titles
patterns.context: Appears in word-initial spelling fragments in book or series titles; no clear legal context.

patterns.name: Title Insurance in company names
patterns.context: Lists several title insurance companies in legal text; related words recur in company names, along with a company-name fragment containing icor.

patterns.name: Telomer chains in chemical patents
patterns.context: Technical description of fluorinated compounds and the number of repeating units, discussing telomer chains and their fluorination.

3_277.concept: 含特定字母片段的文本
3_277.description: 激活常落在 T 后接 IN 的字母片段，尤其见于美国法律文书中的人名、法院抬头和正文；另对标题排版空白、tear、书名中的 chin、产权保险公司名及化学专利中的 telomer 片段有零星响应。

patterns.name: 法律文件标题中的 TIN 字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书标题、法院名称、当事人姓名或正文中；激活落在拼写中含有 T 后接 IN（或相邻字母片段）的 token 上，不要求该串独立构成单词。

patterns.name: 标题层级与法院名称排版
patterns.context: 法院抬头、判决标题及其周围的缩进、空白和大写排版；空格 token 也有激活。

patterns.name: 撕裂描述中的 tear
patterns.context: 描述物品左侧角落有小裂口或撕痕，附近重复出现 tear。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 chin
patterns.context: 出现在书名或系列名称的词首拼写片段中；没有明显法律语境。

patterns.name: 公司名称中的 Title Insurance
patterns.context: 法律文本列举多家产权保险公司；相关词反复出现在公司名中，另有含 icor 的公司名片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的公司名单

patterns.name: 化学专利中的 telomer 链
patterns.context: 含氟化合物及重复单元数量的技术说明中，讨论 telomer 链及其氟化。

en.concept: Letter sequences and triggers from proper nouns and legal terms
en.description: Activations often fall on the T-I-N letter sequence across or within words (including TIN, TINEY, TINN… and similar CHIN); other patterns include court formatting and terminology, vehicle tear descriptions, chemical chains, and title insurance company lists, possibly reflecting different lexical triggers in the same batch.

patterns.name: TIN letter string
patterns.context: The T-I-N letter sequence, sometimes within a longer word, is marked as a fragment; it may cross word boundaries or occur in proper nouns and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Various text types, including legal documents, forum posts, encyclopedias, and bibliographies

patterns.name: Tax court title format
patterns.context: Formatting of court and case titles, especially the abbreviation T.C. and the text TAX COURT.

patterns.name: Court/jurisdiction terminology
patterns.context: Legal terms such as jurisdiction, court rules, and civil procedure rules; activations are distributed across heading and body words.

patterns.name: CHIN in court names and judge names
patterns.context: In appellate judge lists, the letter sequence in the name CHIN resembles the TIN pattern; also seen in the book title _Chinook_.

patterns.name: Vehicle parts and tear descriptions
patterns.context: Describes vehicle interiors and small tears on pillars; several vehicle-related words and short words are marked, with no unified legal semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Chemical repeat units and chains
patterns.context: Chemical description of fluorides/end-group polymers, describing molecule counts and chains of repeating units.

patterns.name: Title insurance company names
patterns.context: Lists title insurance companies consecutively; the words Title, Insurance, and Company appear repeatedly and are marked.

3_277.concept: 字母序列与专名、法律词项触发
3_277.description: 激活常落在跨词或词内的 T-I-N 字母序列（含 TIN、TINEY、TINN…及近似 CHIN）；另有法院格式与术语、汽车撕裂描述、化学链、产权保险公司名单等词项模式，可能是同一批次中不同的词汇触发。

patterns.name: TIN 字母串
patterns.context: 字母序列 T-I-N（有时位于更长单词内部）被分段标记；可能跨词边界或处于专名、缩写中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛文章、百科、书目等多种文本

patterns.name: 税务法院标题格式
patterns.context: 法院名称及案件标题的排版中，尤其是 T.C. 缩写与 TAX COURT 字样。
patterns.domain: 美国税务法院法律文书

patterns.name: 法院／司法管辖术语
patterns.trigger: 「Matter Jurisdiction」「Rules of the Court」「District Court Jurisdiction」「Fed. R. Civ. P.」
patterns.context: 司法管辖、法院规则及民事诉讼规则等法律术语；激活分散在标题与正文词语中。

patterns.name: 法院名称与法官姓名中的 CHIN
patterns.context: 上诉法院法官名单中，姓名 CHIN 的字母序列与 TIN 模式相近；也见书名 _Chinook_。

patterns.name: 汽车部件与撕裂描述
patterns.context: 描述车辆内饰及角柱上的小撕裂，多个汽车相关词与短词被标记；未见统一的法律语义。

patterns.name: 化学重复单元与链
patterns.context: 氟化物／端基聚合物的化学说明中，描述分子数及重复单元链。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、化学技术文本

patterns.name: 产权保险公司名称
patterns.context: 连续列举产权保险公司名称，Title、Insurance、Company 等词多次出现并被标记。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的公司名单

en.description: Activations are scattered across different text types: letter fragments in the name Michel, word fragments in terms or titles, numbers and units, and variables, fractions, and operators in mathematical expressions; no unified semantic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Michel strings and subsequent tokenization
patterns.context: Michel appears as a name or at the start of a string, followed immediately by different letter fragments; sometimes accompanied by a line break or another occurrence of Michel

patterns.name: Subword fragments in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Split word fragments appear within the term “prototypical G protein coupled receptors (GPCRs)”

patterns.name: Word fragments in technical names
patterns.context: Words such as Layer and Stack occur next to each other in the names of network protocols or technical mechanisms

patterns.name: Word fragments near numbers and units
patterns.context: In geographic descriptions, elevation is given as a number with units of meters; punctuation or characters occur between the number and unit

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables, numbers, slashes, and operators are interspersed in expressions involving complex powers, fractions, and parentheses; “assuming … is positive” or “Simplify” often appears

patterns.name: Word fragments in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Common English words or initial word fragments in book names and titles are embedded among authors, publication information, and punctuation

3_607.description: 激活分散在不同文本类型中：Michel 姓名的字母片段、术语或标题中的词片段、数字单位，以及数学式里的变量、分数和运算符；未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Michel 字符串及后续分词
patterns.context: Michel 作为姓名或字符串开头，后面紧跟不同字母片段；有时伴随换行或再次出现 Michel

patterns.name: 科学术语的子词片段
patterns.context: 术语“prototypical G protein coupled receptors (GPCRs)”内部出现被拆开的词片段

patterns.name: 技术名称中的词片段
patterns.trigger: «Layer»；附近为“Dual IP Layer Stack Transition Mechanism”
patterns.context: 网络协议或技术机制的名称中，Layer 与 Stack 等词相邻

patterns.name: 数字与单位附近的词片段
