patterns.context: 地理描述中以数字表示高度，单位为米；数字和单位之间夹有标点或字符

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 复杂幂、分数和括号构成的表达式中，变量、数字、斜杠与运算符交错；常出现“assuming … is positive”或“Simplify”

patterns.name: 书目标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 书名及标题中的常见英文词或词首片段，嵌在作者、出版信息和标点之间

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple text types: fragments of the name Michel, the number 460, Layer in technical terminology, and mathematical expressions; there are also sporadic responses to line breaks and other numbers. The contexts of these patterns differ substantially.

patterns.name: Michel in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in proper names or name fragments, followed by split name characters, a line break, or repeated names; the specific boundary condition is unclear

patterns.name: Number 460
patterns.context: Appears as a numeric string; may include a decimal and unit, or occur in a patent number, case citation, or mathematical expression
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, patents, legal texts, and mathematics

patterns.name: Layer
patterns.context: Appears in technical terminology: paragraph [3] contains «IP Layer Stack Transition», and paragraph [10] contains «Physical Layer Standard»
patterns.domain: Network protocol and communications standards patent text

patterns.name: Numerical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols, variables, and numbers form formulas or math problems; activations are scattered, with no single stable symbol evident

patterns.name: Unexplained formatting or number fragments
patterns.context: These local activations can be separately explained by line breaks, recurring numbers, or specific text formatting, but do not constitute an additional consistent trigger pattern

3_607.description: 激活分散在多类文本：Michel姓名片段、数字460、技术术语中的Layer，以及数学符号表达式；另有换行和其他数字的零散响应。各模式上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Michel
patterns.context: 出现在专名或姓名片段中，后接拆分的姓名字符、换行或重复的人名；具体是哪种边界条件不明确

patterns.name: 数字 460
patterns.context: 作为数字字符串出现；可带小数和单位，也可出现在专利号、判例引文或数学表达式中
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、法律、数学等不同文体

patterns.name: Layer
patterns.context: 出现在技术术语中：第[3]段为 «IP Layer Stack Transition»，第[10]段为 «Physical Layer Standard»
patterns.domain: 网络协议与通信标准专利文本

patterns.name: 数字运算表达式
patterns.trigger: 如 «**»、«/»、«=» 及 «-»；第[7]段有幂、除法和化简表达式，第[9]段有带符号的整数等式
patterns.context: 符号与变量、数字组合成公式或数学题；激活较分散，未见单一稳定符号

patterns.name: 未解释的格式或数字片段
patterns.context: 这些局部激活可分别由换行、数字复现或具体文本格式解释，但不足以构成额外且一致的触发模式

en.description: Activations occur on token fragments of various proper names or terms: Michel, Peggy, Pominville, Penicillium, Pelotas, as well as text related to TRP, CaP, equals, and Focal Adhesion; there is no unified semantic domain.

patterns.name: Michel character fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the beginning of the proper name Michel and its following characters, occurring in personal names or word forms; fragment boundaries depend on tokenization

patterns.name: P subword in TRP
patterns.context: A medical project abstract mentions a TRP channel; activation falls on the final P of the abbreviation

patterns.name: equals method and its definition
patterns.context: An explanation or definition of the equals method is discussed repeatedly in a Java Set collection question

patterns.name: Name character fragments in email signatures
patterns.context: A line-break signature and date follow a short email body

patterns.name: Subword fragments in the term focal adhesion
patterns.context: Biological descriptions of the cytoskeleton, extracellular matrix, and signaling pathways

patterns.name: Initial fragment of the surname Pominville
patterns.context: The player’s name occurs repeatedly in hockey news

patterns.name: Initial fragment of the Penicillium scientific name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia title and its repeated entry name

patterns.name: P in the abbreviation CaP
patterns.context: A project abstract describes obtaining patient tissue samples; activation occurs on the final character of the abbreviation

patterns.name: Initial fragment of the place name Pelotas
patterns.context: The name of a Brazilian city in an encyclopedia article title and body

3_607.description: 激活落在多种专名或术语的分词片段上：Michel、Peggy、Pominville、Penicillium、Pelotas，以及TRP、CaP、equals和Focal Adhesion相关文本；并无统一语义领域。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Michel 字符片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名 Michel 的开头及其后续字符，出现在人名或词形中，片段边界受分词影响

patterns.name: TRP 的 P 子词
patterns.context: 医学项目摘要提及 TRP channel；激活落在缩写末尾的 P

patterns.name: equals 方法及其定义
patterns.context: Java Set 集合问题中多次讨论或定义 equals 方法

patterns.name: 邮件签名中的姓名字符片段
patterns.context: 简短邮件正文后的换行签名和日期

patterns.name: focal adhesion 术语中的分词片段
patterns.context: 细胞骨架、细胞外基质与信号通路的生物学描述

patterns.name: 姓氏 Pominville 的开头片段
patterns.context: 冰球新闻中球员姓名重复出现

patterns.name: 青霉菌学名的开头片段
patterns.context: 百科标题及其重复词条名

patterns.name: CaP 缩写中的 P
patterns.context: 项目摘要描述获取患者组织样本；激活位于缩写末尾

patterns.name: Pelotas 地名的开头片段
patterns.context: 百科词条标题及正文中的巴西城市名

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: compiler, the mathematical symbol s, electrical component terminology, and descriptions of various receptors, cell signaling, and protein biology; only some fragments belong to the biomedical domain.

patterns.name: The word compiler
patterns.context: Appears in a bibliography/list as a role description (“compiler and editor”), or in software license text listing software components (“compiler, kernel, and so on”); both occurrences are adjacent to high activation.

patterns.name: GPCR receptor terminology
patterns.context: Molecular biology descriptions related to receptors and signaling complexes, subtype-specific signaling, or G protein coupled receptors.

patterns.name: s in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in symbolic simplification expressions involving powers, fractions, and parentheses; there are no clear natural-language trigger words.

patterns.name: Capacitance and load descriptions
patterns.context: Describes lumped coupling capacitance of a wire and output load impedance, in the form of a technical component definition.

patterns.name: TRP channel sensitization
patterns.context: Statement of research aims concerning pain and mitochondrial dysfunction in sensory neurons.

patterns.name: Glucocorticoid receptor characterization
patterns.context: Describes receptor purification, molecular weight, isoelectric point, subunit structure, and antiserum preparation.

patterns.name: Focal adhesions and non-receptor kinases
patterns.context: Describes connections between the actin cytoskeleton and extracellular matrix, as well as downstream signaling pathways.

patterns.name: Hemocyanin subunit cooperativity
patterns.context: Title-like phrase discussing cooperative interactions among horseshoe crab hemocyanin subunits.

patterns.name: Olfactory receptors and co-receptors
patterns.context: Compares mammalian olfactory receptor structures and describes ORs and co-receptors forming heterodimers.

3_607.description: 激活线索彼此分散：compiler、数学符号s、电气元件术语，以及多种受体、细胞信号和蛋白质生物学表述；仅部分片段同属生物医学。

patterns.name: compiler 一词
patterns.context: 在书目/名单中作为职责说明（“compiler and editor”），或在软件许可文本中列举软件组件（“compiler, kernel, and so on”）；两处均紧邻高激活。

patterns.name: GPCR 受体术语
patterns.context: 受体与信号复合体、亚型特异性信号或 G protein coupled receptors 相关的分子生物学叙述。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 s
patterns.context: 出现在幂、分数与括号构成的符号化简表达式中；没有明显的自然语言触发词。

patterns.name: 电容与负载描述
patterns.context: 描述导线的集总耦合电容及输出负载阻抗，句式为技术元件定义。

patterns.name: TRP 通道敏化
patterns.context: 疼痛及感觉神经元线粒体功能障碍的研究目标陈述。

patterns.name: 糖皮质激素受体表征
patterns.context: 说明受体纯化、分子量、等电点、亚基结构及抗血清制备。

patterns.name: 黏着斑与非受体激酶
patterns.context: 描述肌动蛋白骨架与细胞外基质的连接及下游信号通路。

patterns.name: 血蓝蛋白亚基协同
patterns.context: 标题式短语，讨论鲎血蓝蛋白亚基间的协同相互作用。

patterns.name: 嗅觉受体及共受体
patterns.context: 比较哺乳动物嗅觉受体结构，并描述 OR 与共受体形成异二聚体。

en.description: All examples activate on the substring Corp: it occurs both in the corporate abbreviation Corp. and at the start of Corpus; the pattern spans multiple genres and is primarily triggered by spelling in proper names, with both company and Corpus meanings.

patterns.name: Corp. in corporate names
patterns.context: Appears in organization or company proper names, often as a corporate designation at the end of a name; it can also be split by tokenization, as in «Corp»us
patterns.domain: News, legal, encyclopedia, email, and academic texts

patterns.name: Corpus Christi proper name
patterns.context: The trigger is the initial Corp substring of Corpus; it may be followed by Christi, Hippocraticum, or other continuations
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, school/sports profiles, medical history

patterns.name: Enron Corp. company designation
patterns.context: Corp. follows Enron as part of the company’s formal name

patterns.name: Corp. in other company names
patterns.context: Corp. appears within or at the end of a proper name, often alongside company-name elements such as Inc.

patterns.name: Isolated or boundary-positioned Corp substring
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the string Corp itself; the context still mostly supports either the corporate abbreviation or the initial substring of Corpus
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, emails, news, legal, and medical texts

3_607.description: 所有段均在 Corp 子串处激活：既包括企业简称 Corp.，也包括 Corpus 的词首 Corp-；跨多种文体，主要由专名中的拼写触发，语义上兼有公司与 Corpus 两类。

patterns.name: Corp. 法人名称片段
patterns.trigger: «Corp»9，常接«.», 且前面通常是公司或机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在组织/企业专名中，常作名称末尾的公司类型标记；也有被分词拆开的情形，如 «Corp»us
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、百科、邮件及学术文本

patterns.name: Corpus Christi 专名
patterns.context: 触发点是 Corpus 的词首 Corp 子串；后续可为 Christi、Hippocraticum 或其他搭配
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学校/体育介绍、医学史

patterns.name: Enron Corp. 公司称谓
patterns.context: Enron 后接 Corp.，作为公司正式名称的一部分

patterns.name: 其他企业名称中的 Corp.
patterns.context: Corp. 出现在专名内部或末尾，常与 Inc. 等公司名称成分共现

patterns.name: 孤立或边界处的 Corp 子串
patterns.trigger: «Corp»9«us»（词中子串）或 «Corp»9«.», 且上下文为机构/实体名称
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Corp 字符串本身；语境仍多支持公司简称或 Corpus 词首两种读法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、新闻、法律、医学文本

en.description: Activations concentrate on several stems or subword fragments: creat and initial Cr in proper names, take, and embark, proced, point, and commun; these fragments occur across multiple genres and are difficult to assign a single semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Word fragment “creat”
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on the shared initial character fragment creat/Cr, followed by highly varied word forms; in [1] it is split across a word boundary as “creat”+“ures”, and in [5] as “creat”+“es”.
patterns.domain: Narrative, commentary, legal texts, encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: take
patterns.context: Appears in different semantic contexts involving course requirements, religious beliefs, or personal decisions; an unmarked use of the same word also occurs, suggesting that take alone may not be sufficient and that position or context may matter.
patterns.domain: Academic introductions, philosophical discussion, encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Process verb stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on verb stem fragments denoting starting or proceeding; [10] contains the Italian form procedendo.

patterns.name: Cr in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of names in proper nouns or classification entries, followed by “Crater”, “Crouter”, or “Crane”; may also overlap character-wise with creat.

patterns.name: Multiple senses of take
patterns.context: Different senses include taking a course, holding a religious belief, and starting to farm; the semantics are not unified, suggesting that the word form itself rather than a single concept may be the trigger.

patterns.name: Other verb fragments
patterns.context: In [5], point is followed by ing and means to indicate; in [10], the commun fragment occurs in the Italian word comunque. Their relation to the other examples is unclear.

3_607.description: 激活集中在若干词干/子词片段：creat 与专名开头 Cr、take，以及 embark、proced、point、commun；这些片段分布于多种文体，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 词语片段“creat”
patterns.context: 强激活落在单词开头的共享字符片段 creat/Cr，后续词形差异很大；在[1]中跨词界拆为“creat”+“ures”，在[5]中为“creat”+“es”。
patterns.domain: 叙述、评论、法律文本、百科分类

patterns.name: take
patterns.context: 出现在课程要求、宗教信念、人物决定等不同语义上下文中；还出现同一词的未标记用法，表明不只要有 take，具体位置或上下文可能也重要。
patterns.domain: 学术介绍、哲学论述、百科叙事

patterns.name: 过程动词词干
patterns.context: 激活落在表示开始或推进的动词词干片段；[10]为意大利语形式 procedendo。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cr
patterns.context: 位于专名或分类条目中的名称开头，后续分别为“Crater”“Crouter”“Crane”；也可能与 creat 的字符片段重合。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、法律诉讼文书

patterns.name: take 的多义用法
patterns.context: 不同语义分别为修读课程、持有宗教信念、着手务农；语义不统一，可能是词形本身而非单一概念触发。

patterns.name: 其他动词片段
patterns.context: [5]中 point 后接 ing，表示指向；[10]中意大利语 comunque 的 commun 片段。二者与其他段的联系不明。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、意大利语议会文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to take and its complement structures, covering considering, choosing a path or position, participating in or using an opportunity, locations where something occurs, and taking various forms; there is also one anomalously high activation on the taxonomic name Mon.

patterns.name: take followed by an action or result
patterns.context: take is followed by an infinitive, noun phrase, or other complement, expressing taking action, choosing a destination, or taking a form; occurs in varied syntactic environments.
patterns.domain: Academic, administrative, medical, technical, and patent explanatory prose

patterns.name: Mon in a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs within a taxon name in a plant taxonomy citation; no clear take pattern is present.

3_607.description: 主要对 take 及其补足结构敏感，涵盖采取考虑、选择路径或职位、参与或利用机会、发生地点、采取多种形式等用法；另有一次对分类名 Mon 的异常高激活。

patterns.name: take 后接动作或结果
patterns.context: take 后接不定式、名词短语或其他补足语，表示采取行动、选择去向或呈现形式；出现于多种句法环境。
patterns.domain: 学术、行政、医学、技术及专利说明文

patterns.name: 专名中的 Mon
patterns.context: 植物分类学引文中的分类群名称内部；没有明显的 take 模式。
patterns.domain: 生物分类学论文及参考文献

en.description: Activations are scattered across tokenized word fragments in multiple languages: Cyrillic fragments, English mar, and fragments within Portuguese and Latvian words; there are also sporadic English fragments and activations on URL paths, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Specific characters in Cyrillic text
patterns.context: Activates in Cyrillic words; examples occur in Tatar interface text, Russian code comments, and Bulgarian body text.

patterns.name: mar in Latin-script tokenized words
patterns.context: Appears in words formed from adjacent subword fragments, such as «mar»«oon» (maroon), «mar»«athon» (marathon); also «mar»«in» (Silymarin).
patterns.domain: English forums, news URLs, medical texts

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in inflected or tokenized Portuguese words, such as volt«ava»« a» rep«et»«ir», and g«endar»«mer»«ie».

patterns.name: Long vowels and word endings within Latvian words
patterns.context: Activations occur inside tokenized Latvian words, such as anal«ī»zēs, gra«u»d«aug»«u», and «sn»iedza.

patterns.name: Words beginning with English mis-
patterns.context: Appears in English narrative or commentary; activation involves an internal fragment of a word meaning miscalculation, as well as subword fragments adjacent to missing, so the precise trigger is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Short fragments at English token boundaries
patterns.context: Ordinary words in English prose or forum dialogue are split into multiple tokens; no shared semantics or fixed context is evident.

patterns.name: London / l-marathon in paths and words
patterns.context: Appears in news URL paths and news headline link fragments; it also matches the «mar» substring pattern, but the London path has additional activation.

patterns.name: Unexplained local high activations
patterns.context: These fragments occur in the corresponding language or code contexts but cannot be consistently explained by the patterns above.
patterns.domain: Tatar, Latvian, English narrative, and code

3_607.description: 激活分散在多语种、切分后的词片段中：含西里尔字母片段、英语mar、葡语和拉脱维亚语词内片段；另有零散英语片段及网址路径激活，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母文本中的特定字符
patterns.context: 在西里尔字母词语中激活；可见于鞑靼语界面文本、俄语代码注释及保加利亚语正文。

patterns.name: 拉丁字母切分词中的 mar
patterns.context: 出现在相邻子词片段组成的词中，如«mar»«oon»（maroon）、«mar»«athon»（marathon）；另有«mar»«in»（Silymarin）。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、新闻网址、医学文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语屈折或切分词中，如 volt«ava»« a» rep«et»«ir»，以及 g«endar»«mer»«ie»。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内长元音及词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于拉脱维亚语切分词内部，如 anal«ī»zēs、gra«u»d«aug»«u»、«sn»iedza。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 英文 mis- 开头的词
patterns.context: 出现在英语叙事或评论中；激活涉及误算词内片段，也涉及 missing 词前后邻接的分词片段，具体触发不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 维基百科叙事、论坛评论

patterns.name: 英语中分词边界处的短片段
patterns.context: 英语散文或论坛对话里的普通词被切成多个 token；没有明显共同语义或固定上下文。

patterns.name: 路径和词语中的 London / l-marathon
patterns.context: 出现在新闻 URL 路径及新闻标题链接片段中；同时符合«mar»子串模式，但London路径本身另有激活。

patterns.name: Unexplained 的局部强激活
patterns.context: 这些片段处于相应语言或代码上下文，但无法由上述模式稳定解释。
patterns.domain: 鞑靼语、拉脱维亚语、英语叙事及代码

en.description: Activations mainly fall on intraword character or subword fragments, especially st and re-st forms; there are also names, technical terms, formula symbols, and Russian character fragments, spanning domains with weak semantic connections.

patterns.name: Subword fragments beginning with re-st
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the contiguous letter fragment st in English words; sometimes it occurs in re-st... word forms, and also in spelling fragments in proper names or quotations.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall within names or their spellings, with no shared semantics; they may be coincidental matches at the character or subword level.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Character fragments in complex chemical names or academic author names; the trigger has no clear relation to general semantics.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous letters, symbols, and formatting
patterns.context: Formula typesetting, legal document formatting, or discontinuous symbol strings; triggers may arise from glyphs or token fragments.

patterns.name: Chinese character fragments
patterns.context: Cyrillic substrings from words split into tokens in Russian sentences; ordinary English code contexts also occur.

patterns.name: Semantically scattered intraword fragments
patterns.context: Local subword activations occur in ordinary or domain-specific words, with no stable shared semantics or contextual condition.

3_607.description: 激活主要落在词内字母或子词片段，尤以 st 及 re-st 形式突出；另见姓名、专业术语、公式符号和俄语字符片段，跨领域且语义联系较弱。

patterns.name: re-st 开头的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于英文词中连续的字母片段 st；有时位于 re-st... 词形中，也出现在专名或引文中的拼写片段。

patterns.name: 人名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或姓名拼写内部，缺少共同语义；可能是字符/子词层面的偶然匹配。
patterns.domain: 新闻/司法叙述、医学文献

patterns.name: 专业词汇内部片段
patterns.context: 复杂化学名称或学术作者名中的字母片段，触发点与一般语义关系不明显。

patterns.name: 杂项字母、符号及格式
patterns.context: 公式排版、法律文书格式或非连续符号串；触发可能来自字形或分词片段。

patterns.name: 中文字符片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中词语被拆分后的西里尔字母子串；同时出现普通英文代码语境。

patterns.name: 语义上零散的词内片段
patterns.context: 普通词或领域词中出现局部子词激活，未见稳定共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 宗教/奇幻叙述、专利文本

en.concept: Mixed intraword fragments and phrase features
en.description: Activations mostly fall on internal fragments such as st in tokenized words; there are also the seems…to…be construction, rearview mirrors, Portuguese lhe, volleyball, and medical and botanical terms; a few ordinary-word activations and individual fragments lack a stable explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on marked internal fragments of split words, especially st; meanings and contexts vary greatly, and the marked boundaries split the word forms
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, legal, medical, and academic texts

patterns.name: seems to be construction
patterns.context: seems to be occurs in evaluative or argumentative text, with activations distributed across multiple words in the phrase

patterns.name: Words related to rearview mirrors
patterns.context: Discusses automatic dimming rearview mirrors and reflectance adjustment

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and function-word fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speech, the honorific pronoun lhe is used to address the listener, along with related verb forms; activations are distributed across internal word fragments

patterns.name: beach volleyball word forms
patterns.context: Discusses clothing choices of female beach volleyball players and related controversy

patterns.name: Internal fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical terms such as abdominal distension, constipation, and pseudo-obstruction occur in symptom descriptions

patterns.name: Internal fragments in plant and virus names
patterns.context: Names and terms in botany or plant virus research; activations fall on fragments within tokenized words

patterns.name: Opaque function words and ordinary-word activations
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in different syntactic positions and cannot be explained by the same stable local context

3_607.concept: 混合的词内片段与短语特征
3_607.description: 激活多落在被切分词的 st 等内部片段，另有 seems…to…be 构式、后视镜、葡语 lhe、排球及医学和植物术语；少数普通词激活及个别片段无稳定解释。

patterns.name: 英文词中部的断词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的词内部片段，尤其是 st；词义与语境差异很大，且标注边界切分了词形
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、医学、学术等多种文体

patterns.name: seems to be 构式
patterns.context: 评价或论证文本中出现 seems to be，激活分布在该短语的多个词上

patterns.name: rearview 镜相关词
patterns.context: 讨论自动防眩后视镜及反射率调节

patterns.name: 人称代词与虚词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中，对听者使用尊称代词 lhe，并出现相关动词形式；激活分布在词内片段

patterns.name: beach volleyball 词形
patterns.context: 讨论女子沙滩排球运动员的服装选择及相关争议

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的词内片段
patterns.context: 症状描述中出现腹胀、便秘及假性肠梗阻等医学术语

patterns.name: 植物与病毒名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 植物学或植物病毒研究中的名称与术语，激活落在拆分后的词内片段

patterns.name: 不透明的功能词及普通词激活
patterns.context: 零散出现在不同句法位置，无法由同一稳定局部语境解释
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、哲学论述

en.description: High activation often falls on the intra-word letter fragment 「st」, and also appears in French and Portuguese intra-word fragments, uppercase place-name spellings, and English close/closed; triggers are distributed across multilingual text, proper nouns, and common words.

patterns.name: Intra-word st sequences
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intra-word fragment beginning with st, or on an internal letter sequence in a name or proper noun; the preceding word-initial or stem portion is usually needed to form a complete word.

patterns.name: French intra-word syllables or letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal letters or syllabic fragments of French words, such as «disc«r»9«ét»4isation» and «inter«vall»4es»; the context is technical descriptions of variable classification.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Portuguese proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across intra-word fragments in the name of Italian politician 「Berlusconi」 and in Portuguese phrases.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter fragments in news place names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the chunked spelling of the uppercase place name 「BRISTOL」 in a news headline and lead.

patterns.name: The word close and related forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete English word close or its inflected forms; one instance concerns a closure question in platform rules, another a close question in a legal context.

3_607.description: 高激活常落在词内字母片段「st」，也分布于法语、葡语词内片段、全大写地名拼写，以及英语 close/closed；触发分散在多语种、专名和普通词中。

patterns.name: 词内 st 序列
patterns.context: 激活落在以 st 起始的词内片段，或姓名、专名的内部字母序列中；通常需要前面的词首或词干部分共同构成完整词。

patterns.name: 法语词内音节或字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在法语词的内部字母或音节片段，如 «disc«r»9«ét»4isation» 和 «inter«vall»4es»；上下文是变量分类的技术说明。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在意大利政治人物姓名「Berlusconi」及葡萄牙语词组中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 新闻地名中的大写字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在全大写地名「BRISTOL」的分块拼写中，段落是新闻标题与导语。

patterns.name: close 词及其相关形式
patterns.context: 激活落在英语 close 的完整词或词形中；一处是平台规则中的关闭问题，一处是法律语境的 close question。

en.concept: Intra-word fragment triggers, biased toward medical terminology
en.description: Activation mainly falls on medical word fragments split across tokens, especially mon-ocl-on terms related to monoclonality and myoclonus; it also appears in Spanish historical forms, colloid restabilization, legal reconsideration, and an intestinal obstruction fragment, with dispersed semantics.

patterns.name: mon-ocl-on fragments related to monoclonality
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur in medical terms related to monoclonality, antibodies, or treatment; however, the «on» in [1] is extremely strong, and near-spelling triggers in [3][5][8][9] are also strong, suggesting the response does not depend entirely on the full-word meaning.

patterns.name: Strong activation on the intra-word fragment on
patterns.context: Occurs inside words split across tokens, such as mon«ocl»«on»ality, mon«ocl»«on»als, and my«ocl»«on»us; it also appears in different forms such as trem«or». The shared fragment may be more direct than the specific terminology.

patterns.name: Lowercase initial on/ion-like fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside historical bibliography/Spanish word forms and chemical engineering terminology; these are not obviously semantically related to the medical monoclonal fragments.
patterns.domain: Historical bibliography; colloid chemistry in patents

patterns.name: Legal word consider-ation
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on a stem fragment of reconsideration in court opinions and legal filings requesting reconsideration.

patterns.name: st-obstruct in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the medical term intestinal pseudo-obstruction; its connection to the other patterns is unclear.

3_607.concept: 词内片段触发，偏医学术语
3_607.description: 激活主要落在跨 token 切分的医学词片，尤其 mon-ocl-on 单克隆相关词及 myoclonus；此外见于西语历史词形、胶体再稳定、法律 reconsideration 和肠梗阻词片，语义分散。

patterns.name: 单克隆性相关的 mon-ocl-on 词片
patterns.context: 触发词片出现在单克隆性、抗体或治疗相关医学术语中；但[1]的 «on» 极强，[3][5][8][9]的近似拼写触发也强，提示不完全依赖完整词义。

patterns.name: 词内片段 on 的强激活
patterns.context: 出现在跨 token 切分的单词内部，如 mon«ocl»«on»ality、mon«ocl»«on»als、my«ocl»«on»us；也出现在 trem«or»等不同词形中。共同片段可能比具体术语更直接。

patterns.name: 小写词首 on/ion 类片段
patterns.context: 激活落在历史书目/西班牙语词形和化学工程术语内部；与医学单克隆词片并非明显同一语义。
patterns.domain: 历史书目；专利中的胶体化学

patterns.name: 法律词语 consider-ation
patterns.context: 激活集中在 reconsideration 的词干片段，出现在法院意见及请求重新审议的法律文书中。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 st-obstruct
patterns.context: 激活落在肠道假性梗阻这一医学术语内部；与其余模式的联系不明确。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across many word forms and contexts: French reconnaître, close in legal contexts, the author surname Slonczewski, Portuguese distanciar-se, Reinforcing in a list of energy measures, and close to in sports contexts; there are also sporadic academic word fragments, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: recognize / recognizeable expressions
patterns.context: In French, the stem of the verb reconnaître is marked by tokenization; it is followed by a que-clause or a disease object.

patterns.name: close question / close examination
patterns.context: In English legal argument, discussing whether an issue is difficult to decide or closely examining testimony, affidavits, and similar material.

patterns.name: Slonczewski name spelling
patterns.context: A tokenized author surname appears in a physics paper citing their work on spin-transfer torque.

patterns.name: distanciar-se form
patterns.context: The Portuguese reflexive verb distanciar-se occurs in a discussion of EU affairs; the passage concerns the relationship between the African Union and the court.

patterns.name: Gerund list of added policy measures
patterns.context: Appears in a sequence of parallel items beginning with Adding, describing energy use and infrastructure policy measures.

patterns.name: Spatial-proximity use of close
patterns.context: A sports narrative describes a ball approaching a group of children; this differs from the close question/examination uses in legal texts.

patterns.name: Truncated or other word fragments
patterns.context: Materials and nanowire terminology, author names, and other items are tokenized in papers; paragraph 1 also contains word fragments related to pollution sources and raw materials, but no clear, consistent trigger condition emerges.
patterns.domain: Materials science papers, European Parliament texts

3_607.description: 激活分散在多种词形与场景：法语 reconnaître、法律语境的 close、作者姓氏 Slonczewski、葡语 distanciar-se、能源措施列表中的 Reinforcing，以及体育语境的 close to；另有零散学术词片段，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: recognize / recognizeable 表达
patterns.context: 法语中动词 reconnaître 的词干被切分标记；后接 que 从句或疾病宾语。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、医学论文

patterns.name: close question / close examination
patterns.context: 英语法律论证中，讨论问题是否难以判断，或对证言、宣誓等进行仔细审查。

patterns.name: Slonczewski 姓名拼写
patterns.context: 物理论文中出现被切分的作者姓氏，介绍自旋转移力矩时引用其工作。

patterns.name: distanciar-se 词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语反身动词 distanciar-se，处于欧盟事务讨论中；此处谈非洲联盟与法庭的关系。

patterns.name: 添加政策措施的动名词列表
patterns.context: 与 Adding 开头的并列条目连续出现，描述能源使用与基础设施政策措施。

patterns.name: close 的空间邻近用法
patterns.context: 体育叙述中描述球接近一群儿童；与法律文本的 close question/examination 用法不同。

patterns.name: 残缺或其他词片段
patterns.context: 论文中材料与纳米线术语、作者名等被切分；第1段另有污染来源和原料相关词片段，但没有形成清楚一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 材料科学论文、欧盟议会文本

en.description: Activation often falls on the string on after tokenization, including in monoclonal/monoclonality, Resonance, proper nouns, and email addresses, as well as the common preposition on; there is also an isolated activation on a French word fragment.

patterns.name: Monoclonal/monoclonal word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in terms related to monoclonality, antibodies, or immunoglobulins; the word itself may be split by tokenization.

patterns.name: on in magnetic resonance terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in “Resonance,” with surrounding text about MRI or magnetic resonance imaging/medicine.

patterns.name: The string on inside English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments in proper nouns or email addresses, rather than on an obviously independent semantic word.

patterns.name: on in continuous narrative text
patterns.context: Used as a preposition in descriptions of scenery, followed by a place or surface.

patterns.name: French word-final or intra-word fragment
patterns.context: In French sentences about unsupervised analysis and clustering, activation falls on tokenized fragments of words such as “découvrir”.

3_607.description: 激活常落在分词后的 on 字符串：包括 monoclonal/monoclonality、Resonance、专名和邮箱，也见普通介词 on；另有法语词片段的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 单克隆／monoclonal 词形
patterns.context: 出现在单克隆性、抗体或免疫球蛋白相关术语中；词本身可能被分词切开。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、肿瘤学与免疫学论文

patterns.name: 磁共振术语中的 on
patterns.context: 嵌在“Resonance”中，周围涉及 MRI 或磁共振成像／医学。

patterns.name: 英文词内 on 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或邮箱地址中的字母片段，并非明显的独立语义词。

patterns.name: on 与连续叙事文本
patterns.context: 作为介词出现在景物描写中，后接地点或表面。

patterns.name: 法语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 在法语关于无监督分析与聚类的句子中，激活落在“découvrir”等词的分词片段。

en.description: The most stable commonality is activation on intra-word character fragments such as on/clon, cl, and ar, especially alongside clone-related vocabulary; however, it also covers common French words and other sporadic token fragments, with limited semantic selectivity.

patterns.name: on/onal character fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on character fragments inside English or French words; examples include monocl«on»ality, Cl«on»tech, uncl«on»able, Mal«on» et, as well as unrelated forms such as dé«cl»«ar»ations and ex«cl»«ure». A complete word or fixed meaning is not required.
patterns.domain: Cross-corpus; medicine, biology, technology, patents, French parliamentary texts, and Q&A

patterns.name: Molecular cloning and monoclonal antibody vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in words describing monoclonality, monoclonal antibodies, clone-derived reagents, or unclonable devices; trigger locations vary, but the shared strings on/clon are common.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, laboratory equipment, and computer security

patterns.name: Intra-word letter fragments in French
patterns.context: Activation is embedded inside common French words; paragraph 2 is in a parliamentary-procedure context, and paragraph 3 in an economic commentary context.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary texts and European economic commentary

patterns.name: Local spelling or tokenization-boundary patterns
patterns.context: Besides the main character fragments, activation also occurs at word beginnings, hyphens, or inter-word token fragments; no stable semantic condition can be identified from the fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research project texts, French parliamentary texts

3_607.description: 最稳定的共同点是激活落在 on/clon、cl、ar 等词内字符片段，尤其与克隆词汇相伴；但也覆盖普通法语词及其他零散分词片段，语义选择性有限。

patterns.name: on/onal 字符片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在英语或法语词中间的字符片段；可见于 monocl«on»ality、Cl«on»tech、uncl«on»able、Mal«on» et，也落在 dé«cl»«ar»ations 和 ex«cl»«ure» 等不相关词形中。并不要求完整单词或固定语义。
patterns.domain: 跨语料；医学、生物、科技、专利、法语议会文本及问答

patterns.name: 分子克隆与单克隆抗体词汇
patterns.context: 出现在描述单克隆性、单克隆抗体、克隆来源试剂或不可克隆设备的词中；触发位置各异，但常见共享字串 on/clon。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、实验设备与计算机安全

patterns.name: 法语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在普通法语词的内部；段2为议会程序语境，段3为经济评论语境。
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本与欧洲经济评论

patterns.name: 局部拼写或分词边界模式
patterns.context: 除主要字符片段外，激活也出现在词首、连字符或词间分词片段上，无法从片段中确认稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目文本、法语议会文本

en.concept: Letter strings containing ar and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated in character fragments ar in proper nouns or inside words: Clonidine, Clontech, Clarice, Clarke, Cloutier, cited author Clarke, and French déclarations; trigger boundaries and semantics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: clonidine / Clontech strings
patterns.context: The consecutive character fragment Cl-on occurs in proper nouns, mainly drug names or biotechnology company names.

patterns.name: Clar in English names Clarke/Clarice
patterns.context: Proper nouns in personal names or book titles; activation is concentrated on the initial Clar string.
patterns.domain: Bibliography, sports reporting, academic citations, email, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in French déclarations
patterns.context: In formal French parliamentary procedure texts, the complete word déclarations is tokenized, and activation falls on the intra-word ar segment.

patterns.name: Clout in the name Cloutier
patterns.context: The name Cloutier in Canadian hockey coverage; the trigger fragment differs from English Clar/Clarke.

3_607.concept: 含 ar 的字母串及专名片段
3_607.description: 激活多集中于专名或词内的字符片段 ar：Clonidine、Clontech、Clarice、Clarke、Cloutier、引文作者 Clarke，以及法语 déclarations；触发边界和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: clonidine / Clontech 字符串
patterns.context: 专名中出现连续字符片段 Cl-on，主要涉及药名或生物技术公司名
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研设备描述

patterns.name: 英文 Clarke/Clarice 名称中的 Clar
patterns.trigger: «Cl»«ar»；后续常接«ke»，形成 Clarke；另见 Clarice
patterns.context: 人名或书名中的专名，激活集中在名称开头的 Clar 字符串
patterns.domain: 书目、体育报道、学术引文、邮件及百科条目

patterns.name: 法语 déclarations 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 法语正式议会程序文本中，完整词 déclarations 被分段标记，激活落在词内 ar 部分

patterns.name: Cloutier 人名中的 Clout
patterns.context: 加拿大冰球报道中的人名 Cloutier；触发片段与英文 Clar/Clarke 不同

en.description: Activation is concentrated on strings containing the letter fragment “on”: clonidine, monoclonality/monoclonals, Clontech, and unclonable, as well as an initial fragment in Karageorgiou; it spans domains and favors local word forms rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: clonidine and related drug names
patterns.context: The “clon” or “clonidine” fragment inside a drug name; appears in titles or medication lists.

patterns.name: Monoclonal-related words
patterns.context: In words such as “monoclonality” or “monoclonals,” activation falls on the intra-word “on” fragment.

patterns.name: Clontech brand name
patterns.context: Occurs in the brand name Clontech in descriptions of reagents, expression systems, or laboratory services.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology methods and equipment descriptions

patterns.name: Word fragment in unclonable
patterns.context: Occurs in a cryptography context, referring to an unclonable trusted device; not a biomedical meaning.

patterns.name: Name fragment in Karageorgiou
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a name in a narrative about a football coach’s career.

3_607.description: 激活集中于包含字母片段“on”的字符串：clonidine、monoclonality/monoclonals、Clontech、unclonable，另有 Karageorgiou 的词首片段；跨领域，偏向局部词形而非统一语义。

patterns.name: clonidine及相关药名
patterns.context: 药名内部的“clon”或“clonidine”片段；出现在标题或药品清单中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、化学试剂记录

patterns.name: 单克隆相关词
patterns.context: “monoclonality”或“monoclonals”等词中，激活落在词内的“on”片段
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学、免疫学及研究计划

patterns.name: Clontech 品牌名
patterns.context: 出现在试剂、表达系统或实验服务的品牌名称 Clontech 中
patterns.domain: 分子生物学方法与设备描述

patterns.name: unclonable 中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在密码学语境中，指无法克隆的可信设备；并非生物医学含义

patterns.name: Karageorgiou 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在足球教练生涯叙述中的人名开头

en.concept: Word forms and citation fragments in academic texts
en.description: Activation mainly falls on the discuss/discutir stem and on citation abbreviations, punctuation, and number formats in biomedical literature; there is also an isolated response to on in the name Fenclonine. The passages span philosophy, law, parliamentary, medical, and patent corpora.

patterns.name: Stem of the English verb discuss
patterns.context: Occurs in verb forms expressing discussion or argument, or stating that an issue is discussed; the stem may be split across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, European Parliament texts; also legal texts discussing semantics

patterns.name: Biomedical paper citation format
patterns.context: Abbreviations, punctuation, and number combinations in references or journal publication details, especially journal names, volume/page numbers, and copyright lines.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, patent background sections, and academic citations

patterns.name: Chemical name Fenclonine
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment of the compound name Fenclonine, adjacent to experimental material purity, batch numbers, and chemical names.

3_607.concept: 学术文本中的词形与引文片段
3_607.description: 激活主要落在 discuss/discutir 词干，以及生物医学文献的引文缩写、标点和数字格式；另对 Fenclonine 名称中的 on 有孤立响应。各段分布于哲学、法律、议会、医学和专利语料。

patterns.name: 英语动词 discuss 的词干
patterns.context: 出现在句中表达讨论、争辩或某事项被讨论的动词形式中；词干会跨分词边界拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、欧盟议会文本；也见于法律文本中讨论语义的语境

patterns.name: 生物医学论文引文格式
patterns.trigger: «J»、«.»、«et»、«al»、«Inc»及期刊/卷页/年份附近的标记，如 «;»、«10»、«14»
patterns.context: 参考文献或期刊出版信息的缩写、标点和数字组合，尤其是期刊名、卷页码与版权行。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、专利背景及学术文献引文

patterns.name: Fenclonine 化学名称
patterns.context: 化合物名称 Fenclonine 的词内片段，紧邻实验材料纯度、批号和化学名称。
patterns.domain: 生化实验材料/方法文本

en.concept: Formatting and judgment expressions in formal documents
en.description: Activation is most clearly concentrated on journal copyright attributions and reference formatting, and also occurs in the “seems to be” inference expression in legal opinions. Other sporadic patterns include German “diskutiert,” scientific terminology, and formatting boundaries, which do not form a single semantic class.

patterns.name: Journal publisher copyright attribution
patterns.context: Occurs in citations or copyright information at the end of PubMed abstracts, with activation concentrated on “Inc.” and often accompanied by words such as “Periodicals”; years vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical journal abstracts and paper footnotes

patterns.name: Author initials and journal information in reference entries
patterns.context: Bibliographic formatting such as references, volume/issue numbers, and page numbers after the main text or at the end of an abstract; appears across disciplines.
patterns.domain: Medical and life science papers, citations in patent background sections

patterns.name: Inference statements in legal argument
patterns.context: Court opinions make judgments based on evidence, defenses, or legal classifications; activation is especially strong near “seems to be”.

patterns.name: Sentence-final grammar and punctuation boundaries in publications
patterns.context: Across different corpora, activation falls near abbreviations, sentence-final punctuation, and citation formatting; this may overlap with bibliographic/copyright formatting but does not explain all examples.

patterns.name: Discussion verb in German policy texts
patterns.context: After a European security strategy report is submitted, the text describes how it will be discussed in national parliaments and the European Parliament.

patterns.name: Specific term fragments in scientific texts
patterns.context: Occur respectively in discussion of AGN X-ray emission and comparison of non-covalent bond types; there is no clear shared local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Residual activation near paragraph starts or special formatting markers
patterns.context: Occurs where the main text transitions to references or in scientific texts with special typesetting markers; it is unclear whether these formatting markers themselves trigger activation.

3_607.concept: 正式文献中的格式与判断表达
3_607.description: 激活最明显地聚集于期刊版权署名和参考文献格式，也出现在法律意见中的“seems to be”推断表达。另有德语“diskutiert”、科学术语及格式边界等零散模式，不能归入单一语义类。

patterns.name: 期刊出版商版权署名
patterns.trigger: “© 2016 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”、“© 2018 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”及变体“© 2017 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”
patterns.context: 出现在 PubMed 摘要末尾的引文或版权信息中，激活集中在“Inc.”，并常伴随“Periodicals”等词；年份不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学期刊摘要与论文尾注

patterns.name: 参考文献条目中的作者缩写与期刊信息
patterns.trigger: 如“Diagn. Cytopathol.”、“J. Surg. Oncol.”、“Mol Psychiatry”、“J Biol Chem.”及作者名后的“et al.”
patterns.context: 论文正文后或摘要末尾的参考文献、卷期页码等书目格式；不同学科均有出现。
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学论文、专利背景技术中的引文

patterns.name: 法律论证中的推断语句
patterns.trigger: “seems to be”（段4、7），以及段4的“fails to cite to the record”“difference between a feud and a ‘falling out’”
patterns.context: 法院意见书以证据、抗辩或法律分类为依据作判断；“seems to be”附近激活尤强。

patterns.name: 出版物中句末语法及标点边界
patterns.trigger: “Inc.”、“et al.”、“…”之后的句号、逗号或分号等相邻标记
patterns.context: 在不同语料中，激活落在缩写、句末标点及引文格式附近；可能与书目／版权格式重叠，但不能解释所有例子。

patterns.name: 德语政策文本中的讨论动词
patterns.context: 欧盟安全战略报告提交后，文本描述其将在各国议会及欧洲议会被讨论。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的特定术语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 AGN X 射线辐射讨论和非共价键类型比较中；没有明显共同的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 段首或特殊格式标记附近的残余激活
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文转参考文献处或带有特殊排版标记的科学文本中，无法确定这些格式标记本身是否触发。
patterns.domain: 科学论文及其语料格式

en.description: Primarily responds to the digit 2 in 「2d」 in the case citation 「L.Ed.2d」; it also responds to to in the legal expression 「seems to be」 and to several sporadic citation-number markers.

patterns.name: Ed. 2d in federal case citations
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of a legal reporter in U.S. federal case citations, usually adjacent to a page number and before the year in parentheses; activation is concentrated on the digit 2 in 「2d」.

patterns.name: The semantic expression 「seems to be」
patterns.context: Used in ordinary legal discussion to introduce a judgment about something; the strongest activation falls on to.

patterns.name: Other possible low-level responses to numbers/citation formatting
patterns.context: Occurs on volume numbers, page numbers, years, or citation-number strings in case citations; these markers are sporadic compared with the recurring 「2d」, so it is unclear whether they form an independent pattern.

3_607.description: 主要响应判例引注中「L.Ed.2d」的「2d」数字2；另有法律论述「seems to be」中的to及若干零散引注数字标记。

patterns.name: 联邦判例引注中的 Ed. 2d
patterns.context: 出现在美国联邦判例引注的法律汇编名称中，通常紧邻页码，并位于年份括号之前；激活集中在「2d」中的数字 2。

patterns.name: 语义表达「seems to be」
patterns.context: 普通法律论述中以「seems to be」引出对某事的判断；最强激活落在 to。

patterns.name: 其他可能的低层数字/引注格式响应
patterns.context: 出现在判例引注中的卷号、页码、年份或引注数字串；相较于反复出现的「2d」，这些标记零散，无法确定是否为独立模式。

en.concept: Mixed responses to the word forms sacrificed and homomorphism
en.description: Strong responses concentrate on sacrificed (the killing of an animal, also used to mean “sacrifice”) and the mathematical term homomorphism; formula symbols, title fragments, and several isolated words and punctuation marks also activate, with no unified condition apparent.

patterns.name: English word sacrificed
patterns.context: The word occurs in a sentence, usually describing an animal or research subject being killed; it also has nonliteral uses.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods, news commentary, literary narrative

patterns.name: homomorphism in mathematics
patterns.context: Appears in abstract algebra or category-theory contexts involving groups, objects, or mappings, often paired with modifiers such as injective or bijective.

patterns.name: Unmarked word endings/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on split words or title fragments; no clear semantic trigger condition shared with the other high-activation patterns is evident.
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, names, or labeled text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in mathematical formulas involving manifolds, gradient flows of energy, and conjugacy classes; the high-activation word homomorphism is assigned to the homonymous pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated high-frequency words and punctuation
patterns.context: Local activation falls on common words, word fragments, or punctuation; the available context is insufficient to identify a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, literary texts, biomedical texts

3_612.concept: 词形 sacrificed 与 homomorphism 的混合响应
3_612.description: 强响应集中在 sacrificed（动物处死，也用于“牺牲”）和数学术语 homomorphism；另有公式符号、标题碎片及若干孤立词标点激活，未显示统一条件。

patterns.name: 英文词 sacrificed
patterns.context: 该词出现在句子中，通常是动物或研究对象被处死；也有非字面用法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、新闻评论、文学叙述

patterns.name: 数学中的 homomorphism
patterns.context: 出现在群、对象、映射等抽象代数或范畴论语境中，常与 injective 或 bijective 等修饰语搭配。

patterns.name: 未标记的词尾/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的单词或标题片段上；未见与其他高激活模式相同的明确语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、姓名或标记文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 符号嵌在流形、能量梯度流和共轭类等数学公式中；高激活词 homomorphism 另归入同名模式。

patterns.name: 孤立的高频词与标点
patterns.context: 局部激活落在普通词、词片段或标点上；现有上下文不足以确定稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、文学文本、生物医学文本

en.concept: Triggers for killing and homomorphism terms
en.description: Most segments describe animals being killed in biomedical experimental methods, with “sacrificed” as the strongest trigger; “homomorphism” also activates strongly in two mathematical texts. Several other scattered terms are highlighted, with no shared pattern identified so far.

patterns.name: Killing experimental animals
patterns.context: Experimental procedures or sampling time points describe animals (mice, rats, animals) being killed, often followed by a time, method, or subsequent tissue collection.

patterns.name: Mathematical homomorphism term
patterns.context: homomorphism appears in mathematical texts, especially in Lie group representations or mappings between objects; this is not a biomedical killing context.

patterns.name: Other highly activated common words
patterns.context: Appear respectively in database promotion, a liver-sampling title, and mathematical discussion; they lack shared local or semantic trigger conditions.
patterns.domain: Technology forums, medical titles, mathematical texts

3_612.concept: 处死／同态词项触发
3_612.description: 多数段在生物医学实验方法中描述动物被处死，且“sacrificed”是最强触发词；两段数学文本中“homomorphism”也强激活。另有若干分散词项高亮，暂无共同模式。

patterns.name: 实验动物处死
patterns.context: 实验过程或取样时间点中，描述动物（mice、rats、animals）被处死，常接时间、方法或后续取材。

patterns.name: 数学同态术语
patterns.context: 数学文本中出现 homomorphism，尤其是 Lie 群表示或对象间映射；不是生物医学处死语境。

patterns.name: 其他高激活的普通词
patterns.context: 分别出现在数据库宣传、肝脏取样标题及数学论述中，缺乏共同的局部或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科技论坛、医学标题、数学文本

en.concept: Mixed patterns, not reducible to a single summary
en.description: Responses primarily involve EGFR and tumor-related biomedical terms, as well as killing experimental animals, tissue sampling, and clinical sample collection; literal or metaphorical uses of sacrificed, Russian interface text, and Romanian military descriptions also occur, making it difficult to identify a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: EGFR/cancer biomedical terms
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of receptors, mutations, inhibitors, cancer types, or risk studies; related terms may be split into multiple token fragments.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and PMC tumor studies

patterns.name: Experimental animal sampling and tissue examination
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe killing animals, group time points, sampling, or tissue examination.

patterns.name: Clinical research resources and sample collection
patterns.context: Describes how research support facilities recruit participants, collect samples, and reduce the burden on researchers.

patterns.name: Metaphorical use of sacrifice in promotional copy
patterns.context: “sacrificed” is used metaphorically to describe product development that did not diminish promotional buzz; this is not the biomedical sense.

patterns.name: Russian interface strings
patterns.context: Russian program interface or configuration text containing interface labels such as opening logs or registration records.

patterns.name: Romanian description of military aggression
patterns.context: A Romanian sentence describes Palestine experiencing violent military aggression; it has no obvious lexical connection to the other patterns.

3_612.concept: 混合模式，无法单一概括
3_612.description: 主要响应EGFR及肿瘤相关生物医学术语，也覆盖实验动物处死、组织取样和临床样本采集；另有字面或比喻的sacrificed、俄语界面文本及罗马尼亚语军事表述，难以归入统一语义模式。

patterns.name: EGFR/癌症生物医学术语
patterns.trigger: “epidermal growth factor receptor”“EGFR”“mutant”“tyrosine kinase”“glioma”“lung cancers”“lung adenocarcinoma”
patterns.context: 出现在受体、突变、抑制剂、癌症类型或风险研究等医学表述中；相关术语可被分词标记为多个片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 PMC 肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 实验动物取材与组织检查
patterns.trigger: “groups were sacrificed”“mice were sacrificed”“Liver Sampling and Microscopical Examination”“liver tissue”
patterns.context: 实验方法叙述中，涉及处死动物、分组时间点、取样或组织检查。

patterns.name: 临床研究资源与样本采集
patterns.context: 说明研究支持设施如何招募受试者、采集样本并减轻研究者负担。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的牺牲表达
patterns.context: “sacrificed”作比喻，描述产品开发没有削弱宣传热度；不是生物医学意义。

patterns.name: 俄语界面字符串
patterns.context: 俄语程序界面或配置文本，包含打开日志/注册记录等界面标签。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语军事侵略描述
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子描述巴勒斯坦遭受暴力军事侵略；与其他模式没有明显词汇联系。

en.description: Activation strongly targets “EGFR,” a tumor-related target name; another pattern involves indentation and structural boundaries after line breaks in code and HTML. The code subpattern covers C#, C++, JavaScript, and page templates, with Russian-mixed text also present.

patterns.name: EGFR target/receptor name
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of receptors, EGFR-driven tumors, or anti-EGFR antibodies; this token activates prominently, often surrounded by cancer, cell, or experimental contexts.

patterns.name: Indentation and structural boundaries in code
patterns.context: In code or structured text, activation occurs at tab/indentation positions after line breaks; visible near statement, block, or member boundaries in multiple languages.

patterns.name: C# DataSourceSelecting type name
patterns.context: Appears in .NET type declarations, especially the event-argument class for the SqlDataSource Selecting event and its base class.

patterns.name: C++ template access and move
patterns.context: Appears in C++ code snippets involving template access to a return value or string and move assignment.

patterns.name: JavaScript script state and edit path
patterns.context: Browser-side code checks window.scripted and extracts the file path to edit from location.search.

patterns.name: C# collection class constructor region
patterns.context: A class declaration inherits from DictionaryBase, followed by the constructor region.

patterns.name: HTML content-area markers
patterns.context: A Wikipedia page template uses div id to mark content areas such as siteSub and contentSub.

patterns.name: Atypical Russian garbled text
patterns.context: Text mixes Latin characters, Cyrillic letters, and encoding or splitting artifacts; activation falls on multiple Russian fragments and surrounding whitespace.

3_612.concept: EGFR与结构边界的混合特征
3_612.description: 激活强烈落在“EGFR”这一肿瘤学靶点名；另有代码和 HTML 中换行后的缩进/结构边界模式。代码子模式覆盖 C#、C++、JavaScript 与页面模板，另见俄文混杂文本。

patterns.name: EGFR 靶点/受体名称
patterns.context: 出现于受体、EGFR 驱动肿瘤或抗 EGFR 抗体等医学表述中；该 token 激活突出，周边常见癌症、细胞或实验语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的缩进与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中，换行后的制表符/缩进位置激活；不同语言的语句、块或成员边界附近均可见。

patterns.name: C# DataSourceSelecting 类型名
patterns.context: 出现在 .NET 类型声明中，尤其是 SqlDataSource 的 Selecting 事件参数类及其基类。

patterns.name: C++ 模板访问与 move
patterns.context: 出现在对返回值或字符串进行模板访问、移动赋值的 C++ 代码片段中。

patterns.name: JavaScript 脚本状态与编辑路径
patterns.context: 浏览器端代码检查 window.scripted，并从 location.search 截取待编辑文件路径。

patterns.name: C# 集合类构造区域
patterns.context: 类声明继承 DictionaryBase，随后进入构造函数区域。

patterns.name: HTML 内容区标记
patterns.context: Wikipedia 页面模板中，用 div id 标记 siteSub、contentSub 等内容区。

patterns.name: 非典型俄文混淆文本
patterns.context: 混有拉丁字符、俄文字母和编码/拆分痕迹的文本；激活落在多个俄文片段及其周围空白。

en.concept: Specific letter strings and affix fragments
en.description: Activation often falls on AT and subsequent characters, and also occurs on OLOG in a philosophical term; triggers are scattered across model names, proper nouns, titles, and terminology, spanning domains and depending on local spelling.

patterns.name: AT string and following letters
patterns.context: Upper- or lowercase AT is followed by different letters or numbers, often within a split word, model name, or other name; it is not always a standalone word.
patterns.domain: Lists, news, book layouts, legal documents, life-science papers

patterns.name: -ological in philosophical terms
patterns.context: Appears within words such as theological, chronologia, and ontology, surrounded by philosophical titles or academic book titles.

patterns.name: Jack in chapter titles
patterns.context: The name Jack repeatedly appears in uppercase chapter titles.

patterns.name: Model and product name lists
patterns.context: Various motorcycle and all-terrain vehicle models appear in lists; activation falls on ATC here.

patterns.name: AT&T news context
patterns.context: A news post discusses competition involving a US telecommunications company.

patterns.name: Book and periodical title formatting
patterns.context: Uppercase periodical titles in scanned books, with letters split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Transaction terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Rule numbers appear next to transaction settlement terms.

patterns.name: Gene/protein name ATX
patterns.context: Discusses substrate specificity and local LPA signaling.

patterns.name: Intraocular lens model containing AT
patterns.context: Part of an intraocular lens model in cataract surgery research.

3_612.concept: 特定字母串与词缀片段
3_612.description: 激活常落在 AT 及其后续字符上，也见于哲学词中的 OLOG；具体触发分散在型号、专名、标题和术语中，跨领域且依赖局部拼写。

patterns.name: AT 字符串及后续字母
patterns.context: 大小写 AT 后紧接不同字母或数字，常处在被切分的词、型号或名称中；并非总是独立词。
patterns.domain: 列表、新闻、书籍版式、法律文件、生命科学论文

patterns.name: 哲学术语中的 -ological
patterns.context: 出现在 theological、chronologia、ontology 等词内，周围是哲学标题或学术书名。

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 Jack
patterns.context: 大写章节标题中反复出现人物名 Jack。

patterns.name: 型号与产品名列表
patterns.context: 多种摩托车、全地形车型号以列表形式排列；此处激活落在 ATC。

patterns.name: AT&T 新闻语境
patterns.context: 新闻帖子谈及美国电信公司的竞争。

patterns.name: 书刊刊名排版
patterns.context: 扫描书籍中的大写刊名，字母被分割成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的交易术语
patterns.context: 规则编号与交易结算条款相邻。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白名称 ATX
patterns.context: 讨论底物特异性及局部 LPA 信号传导。

patterns.name: 人工晶体型号含 AT
patterns.context: 白内障手术研究中作为人工晶体型号的一部分。

en.description: All segments contain strong “OLOG” activation, usually at the ending of an -ology discipline term or proper noun; domains include philosophy, medicine, geology, theology, news, and directory text. Titles and line breaks may co-occur, but there is insufficient evidence to identify them as separate patterns.

patterns.name: ology suffix
patterns.context: The trigger string occurs at a word ending or within a suffix; the beginning and remainder of the word are often split into multiple subword tokens. It corresponds to -ology in disciplines, academic topics, or proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Philosophical bibliographies, academic papers, medical titles, directories, news headlines, and related text

patterns.name: Layout and title structure
patterns.context: Appears in the same segment as “OLOG”; layout in directories, bibliographies, or newspaper clippings may be a secondary cue, but there is no evidence of a stable independent trigger.
patterns.domain: Book directories, newspaper text, web or paper section headings

3_612.concept: -ology词尾
3_612.description: 所有段都含“OLOG”强激活，通常是 -ology 学科或专名词尾；跨哲学、医学、地质、神学、新闻及目录文本。标题和换行等版式可能伴随，但不足以判定为独立模式。

patterns.name: ology 词尾
patterns.context: 触发串位于词尾或词内后缀，词首及其余部分常分成多个子词 token；对应学科、学术主题或专名中的 -ology。
patterns.domain: 哲学书目、学术论文、医学标题、目录与新闻标题等

patterns.name: 版面与标题结构
patterns.trigger: 换行、空白、页码、“CONTENTS”“PAGE”及大写标题
patterns.context: 与“OLOG”同段出现；目录、书目或报刊剪贴中的排版结构可能是伴随线索，但本身未见稳定独立触发证据。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、报刊文本、网页或论文分节标题

en.description: Activation prominently involves Unix environment variables and path syntax, as well as the ambiguous abbreviation DSL: domain-specific language, digital single-lens reflex camera, and broadband access; the dollar sign in Excel absolute cell-reference strings also appears.

patterns.name: PATH environment variable and Unix directory paths
patterns.context: Shell or container configuration sets or expands environment variables, often with colon-separated paths, variable expansion, or Docker RUN instructions.
patterns.domain: Software development, Unix shell, Docker configuration

patterns.name: DSL abbreviation (domain-specific language)
patterns.context: Discusses language design, expressing a problem domain with a DSL, or writing, using, or reverse-engineering a DSL.

patterns.name: DSL abbreviation (digital single-lens reflex camera)
patterns.context: Discusses cameras, lenses, photos, or image quality; the abbreviation refers to a DSLR camera, and tokenization may split DSL from R/s.

patterns.name: DSL broadband access
patterns.context: Used as a type of network access, co-occurring with contexts such as Comcast, cable networks, internet speed, or distance from the central office.

patterns.name: Excel cell addresses and range strings
patterns.context: Runtime errors and Excel Range string examples; activation falls on dollar signs and tokens related to column names or addresses.

3_612.concept: 技术缩写与路径语法
3_612.description: 激活突出 Unix 环境变量与路径语法，以及 DSL 这一多义缩写：领域特定语言、数码单反相机和宽带接入；另见 Excel 绝对单元格引用字符串中的美元符号。

patterns.name: PATH 环境变量与 Unix 目录路径
patterns.context: Shell 或容器配置中设置、扩展环境变量，常出现冒号分隔的路径、变量展开或 Docker RUN 指令。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、Unix shell、Docker 配置

patterns.name: DSL 缩写（领域特定语言）
patterns.context: 讨论语言设计、用 DSL 表达问题领域，或编写、使用、反向工程 DSL。

patterns.name: DSL 缩写（数码单反相机）
patterns.context: 讨论相机、镜头、照片或图像质量；缩写指 DSLR 相机，分词标记可能将 DSL 与 R/s 拆开。

patterns.name: DSL 宽带接入
patterns.context: 作为网络接入类型，与 Comcast、有线网络、网速或距中心局距离等语境共现。

patterns.name: Excel 单元格地址与范围字符串
patterns.context: 运行时错误及 Excel Range 字符串示例；激活落在美元符号和列名/地址相关 token 上。

en.description: Most segments are structured markup or configuration in code repositories; activation often accompanies angle-bracket tags, attribute assignments, and quoted values. Other patterns include interface controls, build/test configurations, Shell and JavaScript discussions, and Objective-C identifiers.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup boundaries and attributes
patterns.context: In structured markup composed of tags, attributes, and values, activation often falls on angle brackets, tag fragments, and nearby attribute names and values; some segments also contain entities or template interpolation.
patterns.domain: HTML/XML, build configurations, and markup text in code repositories

patterns.name: Key-value/index fields in code and configuration
patterns.context: In structured data or configuration, a field name is followed by a quoted string, number, index, or template value; especially apparent when accompanied by markup structure.
patterns.domain: XML query fragments, map/table data, build configurations

patterns.name: Test and build configuration
patterns.context: Configuration elements for test filtering, test execution, or build targets; marker names such as `test`, `target`, and `fileset` appear.

patterns.name: Interface controls and option settings
patterns.context: In form controls or application settings interfaces, control types, option identifiers, and label text occur near one another.

patterns.name: Commands, attributes, and technical identifiers in code
patterns.context: Commands, boolean configuration values, or programming language/API names appear in technical discussions or code configuration; an XML context is not required.
patterns.domain: Android build configuration, JavaScript technical discussions

patterns.name: Shell conditions and filename patterns
patterns.context: Shell scripts organize filenames by time conditions and control branches using range comparisons.

patterns.name: Objective-C methods and logging identifiers
patterns.context: Method names, class names, and session-token parameters occur in Objective-C asynchronous task code.

3_612.concept: 代码与结构化配置标记
3_612.description: 多数片段是代码仓库中的结构化标记或配置，激活常伴随尖括号标签、属性赋值及引号值；另有界面控件、构建测试配置，以及 Shell、JavaScript 讨论和 Objective-C 标识符等代码模式。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记边界与属性
patterns.trigger: `<`、`>`、`</`、标签名及属性赋值，如 `input type="hidden"`、`<target name="isInstalled">`
patterns.context: 在标签、属性和值构成的结构化标记中，激活常落在尖括号、标签片段及属性名和值附近；部分片段还包含实体或模板插值。
patterns.domain: HTML/XML、构建配置及代码仓库中的标记文本

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的键值/索引字段
patterns.context: 结构化数据或配置中，字段名后跟引号包围的字符串、数字、索引或模板值；与标记结构相伴时尤其明显。
patterns.domain: XML 查询片段、地图/表格数据、构建配置

patterns.name: 测试与构建配置
patterns.context: 测试筛选、测试执行或构建目标等配置元素；出现 `test`、`target`、`fileset` 等标记名。

patterns.name: 界面控件与选项设置
patterns.context: 表单控件或应用设置界面中，控件类型、选项标识与标签文本相邻。

patterns.name: 代码中的命令、属性与技术标识符
patterns.context: 技术讨论或代码配置中出现命令属性、布尔配置或编程语言/API 名称；不要求 XML 语境。
patterns.domain: Android 构建配置、JavaScript 技术讨论

patterns.name: Shell 条件与文件名模式
patterns.context: Shell 脚本按时间条件组织文件名，并以范围比较控制分支。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法与日志标识符
patterns.context: 方法名、类名和会话令牌参数出现在 Objective-C 异步任务代码中。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to angle brackets/greater-than signs in text and code, covering quotation markers, command prompts, comparison operators, and closing tags; also activates on code-structure punctuation and a few numbers, units, and chat symbols.

patterns.name: Angle brackets/greater-than sign
patterns.context: The greater-than sign and adjacent characters, punctuation, or code symbols; sometimes a quotation marker, sometimes part of a comparison operator or command prompt.
patterns.domain: Forum text, chat, code, HTML, and Q&A

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Syntax symbols, prompts, and structural boundaries in code or command-line snippets; co-occurs with the greater-than pattern, but may not be semantically related.
patterns.domain: PowerShell, program code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Markup languages and attribute syntax
patterns.context: HTML attributes and closing-tag symbols, or percent signs in financial contexts; activation concentrates on special characters and nearby text.
patterns.domain: StackExchange web code; HackerNews financial discussions

patterns.name: Forum quoting and formatting
patterns.context: A leading > is used as a quotation marker in HN, and asterisks surround quotations; activation covers the symbols used in this formatting.

patterns.name: Unusual token fragments
patterns.context: Local token combinations such as numbers, units, slashes, chat usernames, and emoji, without an obvious unified semantics.

patterns.name: Commas and argument separators in code
patterns.context: Function calls use commas to separate arguments, with activation near argument boundaries; the cause may be code punctuation rather than a specific algorithm.

3_612.concept: 尖括号与结构标点
3_612.description: 主要对文本与代码中的尖括号/大于号敏感，涵盖引用符、命令提示符、比较符及标签闭合；也对代码结构标点和少数数字、单位、聊天符号产生激活。

patterns.name: 尖括号/大于号
patterns.trigger: «>»（包括独立的 >、命令提示符中的 >、HTML 标签闭合处及比较运算符）
patterns.context: 大于号及其相邻字符、标点或代码符号；有时是引用标记，有时是比较符号或命令提示符的一部分。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、聊天、代码、HTML 与问答

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或命令行片段中的语法符号、提示符和结构边界；与大于号模式同现，但未必语义相关。

patterns.name: 标记语言与属性语法
patterns.context: HTML 属性和标签闭合符号，或金融语境中的百分号；激活集中在特殊字符及其邻近文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页代码；HackerNews 金融讨论

patterns.name: 论坛引用与排版
patterns.context: HN 中行首的 > 用作引用标记，星号用于包裹引用；激活覆盖引用排版的符号。

patterns.name: 奇异 token 片段
patterns.context: 数字、单位、斜线、聊天用户名及表情符号等局部 token 组合，没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 代码中的逗号与参数分隔
patterns.context: 函数调用中以逗号分隔参数，激活落在参数边界附近；原因可能是代码标点，而非特定算法。

en.description: Activation is distributed across HTML/XML tags and attributes, LaTeX mathematical symbols, and key-value and range strings in code; racing proper-name abbreviations and proper nouns and symbols in email also occur. The commonality may be punctuation, delimiters, and local markers in structured text rather than a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: HTML/XML attributes and tag fragments
patterns.context: Triggers occur in HTML/XML tags, attributes, or closing tags, especially in structured markup composed of attribute names and values, angle brackets, and quotation marks; no particular attribute value appears necessary.
patterns.domain: Web markup, code, and web forms

patterns.name: Local symbols and delimiters in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Triggers occur in LaTeX mathematical expressions, often adjacent to backslash commands, braces, commas, or equations; the specific symbols triggering activation vary across segments.

patterns.name: Ranges, key-value pairs, and identifiers in code or tables
patterns.context: Appears in code, configuration, or form snippets containing quoted values, range strings, indices, or identifiers; partly overlaps with the HTML attribute pattern.
patterns.domain: Web/code text and spreadsheet programming Q&A

patterns.name: Proper nouns and sports event abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation appears in racing reports, concentrated near names, event or organization abbreviations, and team names; observed in only one segment.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, abbreviations, and special symbols in email
patterns.context: Appears in business email text involving company abbreviations, place names, or proper nouns, with activation concentrated near symbols such as `&`; its connection to the other patterns is unclear.

3_612.concept: 结构化文本标记与分隔符
3_612.description: 激活分布在HTML/XML标签与属性、LaTeX数学符号、代码中的键值和范围字符串；另见赛车专名缩写及邮件中的专名与符号。共同点可能是结构化文本中的标点、分隔符和局部标记，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 属性与标签片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于 HTML/XML 标签、属性或闭合标签中，尤其是属性名和值、尖括号与引号构成的结构化标记；未见某个特定属性值是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、代码及网页表单

patterns.name: 数学公式中的局部符号与分隔符
patterns.context: 触发于 LaTeX 数学表达式中，常邻接反斜杠命令、花括号、逗号或等式关系；不同片段触发的具体符号并不一致。

patterns.name: 代码或表格中的范围、键值及标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码、配置或表单片段中，包含带引号的值、范围字符串、索引或标识符；与 HTML 属性模式有部分重叠。
patterns.domain: 网页/代码文本及电子表格编程问答

patterns.name: 专名及体育赛事缩写
patterns.context: 激活出现在赛车报道中，集中于人名、赛事或组织缩写及车队名称附近；只见于单段。
patterns.domain: 维基百科赛车赛事条目

patterns.name: 邮件中的专名、缩写与特殊符号
patterns.context: 出现在商务邮件正文中，涉及公司缩写、地名或专名，且激活集中在 `&` 等符号附近；与其他模式联系不明确。

en.concept: Angle brackets and technical text symbols
en.description: Activations are broadly distributed. A prominent shared cue is angle brackets/comparison and arrow symbols, especially in code, markup, or quantity thresholds. Other examples span unrelated contexts such as SQL, data structures, statistics, comments, technical planning, mathematics, and record websites, and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Greater-than/angle-bracket symbols
patterns.context: A greater-than sign or arrow appears in ordinary text, code, pseudo-markup, or near numeric thresholds; it usually serves as an expression, comparison, or direction symbol
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technical discussions, code, and data descriptions

patterns.name: Code operators in angle brackets
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in program code or serial-command examples, alongside variables, method calls, or assignments

patterns.name: SQL UNION query keyword
patterns.context: UNION ALL is used in an SQL query to combine SELECT result sets

patterns.name: Code structure delimiters and punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation is adjacent to code, configuration, or hierarchical descriptions and may separate fields, types, or statements

patterns.name: List/hierarchy terms and fields
patterns.context: Describes the hierarchy and fields of a Q&A data structure, with numbers or code markers beside terms

patterns.name: Statistical distributions and classification evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses positive and negative class distributions, class proportions, and simulation results

patterns.name: Rebuttal or disagreement
patterns.context: A commenter apologizes and then disputes the credibility of a video or claim

patterns.name: Discussion and failure-scenario planning
patterns.context: Discusses observer configuration and emphasizes understanding, planning, and handling failure scenarios in advance

patterns.name: Date and database update code
patterns.context: Python-style code constructs a date string and updates a database field

patterns.name: Geometric theorem and grade conditions
patterns.context: A geometry theorem demonstration mentions grade conditions for variables a and b; the specific relationship is truncated or malformed

patterns.name: Scale of a record-auction website
patterns.context: Introduces a website that collects vinyl record auction and sales data daily and indicates its scale with a greater-than sign

3_612.concept: 尖括号及技术文本符号
3_612.description: 激活分布很散，较突出的共同线索是尖括号/比较与箭头符号，尤其出现在代码、标记或数量阈值中；另覆盖 SQL、数据结构、统计、评论、技术规划、数学及唱片网站等各自不同语境，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 大于/尖括号符号
patterns.context: 大于号或箭头出现在普通文本、代码、伪标记或数字阈值附近；通常属于表达式、比较或方向符号
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、技术讨论、代码与数据描述

patterns.name: 尖括号中的代码运算符
patterns.context: 符号嵌在程序代码或串口命令示例中，周围有变量、方法调用或赋值

patterns.name: SQL 联合查询关键字
patterns.context: SQL 查询中用 UNION ALL 拼接 SELECT 结果集

patterns.name: 代码结构分隔符与标点
patterns.context: 标点紧邻代码、配置或层级说明，可能用于分隔字段、类型或语句

patterns.name: 列表/层级术语及字段
patterns.context: 说明问答数据结构的层级与字段，词语旁有编号或代码标记

patterns.name: 统计分布与分类评估
patterns.context: 讨论正负类别分布、类别比例及模拟结果

patterns.name: 反驳或不认同表达
patterns.context: 评论者表示歉意后否定某视频或说法的可信度

patterns.name: 讨论与失败场景规划
patterns.context: 谈观察器配置，强调预先理解、规划和处理故障情形

patterns.name: 日期与数据库更新代码
patterns.context: Python 风格代码构造日期字符串并更新数据库字段

patterns.name: 几何定理与成绩条件
patterns.context: 几何定理演示中提及变量 a、b 的成绩条件；具体关系被截断或格式异常

patterns.name: 唱片拍卖网站规模
patterns.context: 介绍每日收集黑胶唱片拍卖与销售数据的网站，并用大于号给出规模

en.description: Activations occur on punctuation, syntax boundaries, strings, and path fragments in various code, SQL, HTML, and URL contexts. There are also email address/forwarding formats and sporadic words in a technical prose passage, with no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, SQL, HTML, or URLs, often at statement separators, assignments, parameter separators, concatenations, and tag boundaries; the specific punctuation trigger varies by fragment.

patterns.name: URL and path fragments
patterns.context: In URLs, API endpoints, short links, or request paths assembled from variables, activations fall on URL components and their delimiters.

patterns.name: Email addresses and forwarding formats
patterns.context: Addresses, mailto markers, and encoded recipient information in email headers or forwarded messages.

patterns.name: String literals and field names in code
patterns.context: Quoted strings, identifiers, and configuration names in code or HTML attributes; activations occur across these literals and surrounding punctuation.

patterns.name: Ordinary English phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary English sentences in technical explanatory prose, with only sporadic words marked and no clear trigger condition consistent with code punctuation.

patterns.name: SQL query structure
patterns.context: Table names, clause keywords, conditions, and grouping structure in SQL queries; activations span different elements, including keywords, identifiers, and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Names/recipient encoding in email addresses
patterns.context: Names embedded in email addresses and forwarding/routing encodings; whether the names themselves trigger activations is uncertain because the entire span contains several email-format components.

patterns.name: Numbers, variables, and assignment fragments in code
patterns.context: Variable declarations, initialization, and function calls in C-style example code; markers are concentrated around assignment symbols, variables, and delimiters.

patterns.name: Query parameter concatenation
patterns.context: URL query parameters are constructed by string concatenation, with parameter names and values joined by an encoding function.

patterns.name: HTML attributes and control text
patterns.context: In HTML form control tags, attribute names, values, and closing-tag symbols are all marked.

3_612.concept: 代码与结构化文本片段
3_612.description: 激活出现在多种代码、SQL、HTML及URL中的标点、语法边界、字符串和路径片段；另有邮件地址/转发格式与一段技术散文中的零星词语，未呈现统一而稳定的单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 出现在代码、SQL、HTML 或 URL 中，常位于语句分隔、赋值、参数分隔、拼接及标签边界处；具体触发标点随片段而异。

patterns.name: URL 与路径片段
patterns.context: 网址、API 端点、短链接或由变量拼接的请求路径中，激活落在 URL 组成部分及其分隔符上。
patterns.domain: 网页/API 与超链接文本

patterns.name: 邮件地址和转发格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件中的地址、mailto 标记及编码后的收件人信息。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串字面量与字段名
patterns.context: 代码或 HTML 属性中的带引号字符串、标识符及配置项名称；激活分布在这些字面量及其周边标点。

patterns.name: 普通英语短语
patterns.context: 技术说明性散文中的普通英语句子，只有零星词语被标记，未见与代码标点一致的明确触发条件。

patterns.name: SQL 查询结构
patterns.context: SQL 查询中表名、子句关键字、条件及分组结构；激活覆盖关键字、标识符和引号等不同成分。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的姓名/收件人编码
patterns.trigger: « Timothy»、«M»及地址中«smith»«tm»等姓名与本地部分
patterns.context: 姓名嵌入邮件地址及转发/路由编码中；是否由姓名本身触发不确定，因整段包含多种邮箱格式成分。

patterns.name: 代码中数字、变量及赋值片段
patterns.context: C 风格示例代码的变量声明、初始化与函数调用；标记主要集中在赋值符号、变量和分隔符。

patterns.name: 查询参数拼接
patterns.context: 通过字符串连接构造 URL 查询参数，参数名和值由编码函数拼接。

patterns.name: HTML 属性与控件文本
patterns.context: HTML 表单控件标签中，属性名、属性值和标签闭合符号均有标记。

en.description: Primarily responds to punctuation and strings used to concatenate URL query parameters in code and links. It also activates on a pointer-alignment warning, two encoded email names, and colon concatenation in a time display.

patterns.name: URL query parameter concatenation and encoding
patterns.context: Code constructs URLs or query strings, often joining variables with parameter names and values using &, =, and +; some parameter values are URL-encoded.
patterns.domain: Programming code, web/API requests, and links with tracking parameters

patterns.name: Pointer type-cast safety text
patterns.context: A warning about pointer conversion and memory alignment appears in a safety rule or technical document; activations are concentrated on multiple words in the English rule sentence.

patterns.name: Formatting and encoding names and email addresses
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, or email header information are represented in a format resembling printable encoding, with punctuation and spaces encoded or replaced by plus signs.

patterns.name: Colon concatenation in time display
patterns.context: Code combines minutes and seconds into a time-display string; activations fall especially on the colon and adjacent string-concatenation symbols.

3_612.concept: 字符串拼接与编码标点
3_612.description: 主要响应代码和链接中拼接 URL 查询参数的标点与字符串；另对一段指针对齐警告、两段邮件姓名编码，以及时间显示中的冒号拼接激活。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数拼接与编码
patterns.context: 代码中构造 URL 或查询字符串，常把变量与参数名、参数值用 &、=、+ 拼接；部分参数值经过 URL 编码。
patterns.domain: 编程代码、网页/API 请求及带追踪参数的链接

patterns.name: 指针类型转换安全性文字
patterns.trigger: «Do not cast pointers into more strictly aligned pointer types»
patterns.context: 安全规则或技术文档中出现关于指针转换和内存对齐的警告；激活集中在英文规则句的多个词上。

patterns.name: 姓名与邮箱地址的格式化编码
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱或邮件头信息以类似可打印编码的格式表示，标点和空格被编码或由加号替代。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件数据与邮件头

patterns.name: 时间显示的冒号拼接
patterns.context: 代码将分钟和秒拼成时间显示字符串；激活尤其落在冒号及其相邻的字符串拼接符号上。

en.description: Activations occur on formula markers and technical terms in several types of academic text, as well as author-name fragments and JavaScript search-suggestion code; no shared triggering pattern is clear.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formulas in body text
patterns.context: Near mathematical expressions or formula formatting, activations often fall on LaTeX markers, set symbols, and formula interiors rather than a single mathematical concept; contexts include inline formulas, definitions, and tensor expressions.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and other academic papers

patterns.name: Technical terms or noun phrases in academic text
patterns.context: In scientific paper prose, markers fall on technical terms or noun phrases; the topics vary across passages, with no consistent field-specific semantics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and instrument-physics papers, among other academic texts

patterns.name: Syllable fragment in an author name
patterns.context: Occurs in the author list name Jaramillo; the activation covers only part of the name and may reflect the name or a subword fragment.

patterns.name: Search-suggestion-related identifiers in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript function and URL query-parameter concatenation code, activations involve identifiers related to search suggestions and string-concatenation operators.

3_612.concept: none
3_612.description: 激活分布于多类学术文本的公式标记与专业术语，也出现在作者姓名片段和 JavaScript 搜索建议代码中；共同触发规律不明确。

patterns.name: 正文中的数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学表达式或公式排版附近，激活常落在 LaTeX 标记、集合符号及公式内部，而非单一数学概念；覆盖含行内公式、定义和张量表达式的上下文。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及其他学术论文

patterns.name: 学术文本中的专业术语或名词搭配
patterns.context: 科学论文正文叙述中，标记落在专业名词或名词短语上；各段所涉主题不同，未见统一领域语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、仪器物理等学术论文

patterns.name: 作者姓名的音节片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者名单中的姓名 Jaramillo 内；激活只覆盖姓名的一部分，可能反映姓名或子词片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的搜索建议相关标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数及 URL 查询参数拼接代码中，激活涉及建议搜索功能的标识符和字符串连接符。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting symbols
en.description: Activations are distributed across formulas and scientific typography, code/markup syntax, and ordinary word fragments. They often fall on punctuation, LaTeX/HTML tokens, and substrings within words; the examples lack stable semantic or stylistic conditions.

patterns.name: Numbers, exponents, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Near mathematical expressions, physical quantities, subscripts/superscripts, or parameter ranges; activations sometimes concentrate on punctuation and formatting tokens rather than ordinary word meaning

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: In technical or academic text, the triggering fragment is embedded in a full term or name; these fragments have no obvious shared meaning

patterns.name: Code, markup languages, and entities
patterns.context: Near LaTeX, HTML entities, or code syntax
patterns.domain: Web pages, code, and typesetting source

patterns.name: Ordinary English word fragments
patterns.context: English words or intra-word fragments in different contexts; no stable semantic or syntactic condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, forums, and code documentation

patterns.name: Lowercase Greek letters and formula variables
patterns.context: Occurs in formula variables, parameters, or angle notation

patterns.name: Line breaks and document-structure boundaries
patterns.context: Near text line breaks or document-environment boundaries

3_612.concept: 异质文本片段及格式符号
3_612.description: 激活分布于公式与科学排版、代码/标记语法及普通词片段，常落在标点、LaTeX/HTML token 和词内子串上；各例缺乏稳定的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 数字、指数及数学符号
patterns.trigger: «,»、«$»、«|»、«>»，以及数字或公式中的相邻标记
