patterns.context: 数学表达式、物理量、上下标或参数范围附近；有时激活集中在标点和格式 token 上，而非普通词义

patterns.name: 技术术语中的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 技术或学术文本中，触发片段嵌在完整术语或人名里；这些片段并无明显共同词义

patterns.name: 代码、标记语言与实体
patterns.context: LaTeX、HTML 实体或代码语法附近

patterns.name: 普通英语词语片段
patterns.context: 不同语境中的英语词语或词内片段；未见稳定的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 科学论文、论坛及代码说明

patterns.name: 小写希腊字母及公式变量
patterns.context: 出现在公式变量、参数或角度记号中
patterns.domain: 科学论文及 LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 换行与文档结构边界
patterns.context: 文本换行或文档环境边界附近

en.description: Activations occur on operators, connectors, and SQL syntax in code; formula symbols and units in scientific papers; and a few business-text examples involving Electric electricity-market titles, a Python city property, and schedule room information.

patterns.name: Symbols and concatenation operators in code
patterns.context: Operators or SQL keywords occur in expressions, URL parameters, string concatenations, or queries, often adjacent to variables, punctuation, and quotation marks

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and units in technical documents
patterns.context: Near numbers, formulas, measurement units, or variable expressions in scientific papers

patterns.name: Electric in proper names
patterns.context: Electric Market(s) appears in a title or phrase describing electricity markets and their forecasting

patterns.name: Location field city
patterns.context: A Python object property assignment that combines a place field with splitting a location string

patterns.name: Time and room information
patterns.context: An event schedule gives a meeting room, time, and fee information

3_612.concept: 技术文本中的结构性符号
3_612.description: 激活分布于代码中的运算符、连接符与 SQL 语法，科学论文的公式符号和单位，以及少数商务文本里的 Electric 电力市场标题、Python city 属性和日程 room 信息。

patterns.name: 代码中的符号与连接运算
patterns.trigger: 代码或类代码文本中的 «+»、«=»、«&»、«on»、«where» 等
patterns.context: 运算符或 SQL 关键字处于表达式、URL 参数、字符串拼接或查询语句中；常邻接变量、标点及引号

patterns.name: 技术文档中的数学符号与单位
patterns.trigger: 公式或科学记号中的 «$»、«,»，以及 «	heta»、«^{\circ}»、«K» 等
patterns.context: 科学论文中数字、公式、测量单位或变量表达式附近

patterns.name: 专名中的 Electric
patterns.context: 标题或短语中出现 Electric Market(s)，描述电力市场及其预测

patterns.name: 地点字段 city
patterns.context: Python 对象属性赋值，结合 place 字段拆分地点字符串

patterns.name: 时间与房间信息
patterns.context: 活动日程中给出会议室、时间和费用信息

en.description: Activations are scattered across Polish word fragments, English phrases, technical URLs and code, Reddit links, and sports text. They recur around URL punctuation, path fragments, and “looks as though,” but the triggering conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment pos
patterns.context: Occurs inside Polish words such as “posła” and “posiedzeniu”; adjacent word fragments also activate, but the primary trigger falls on this word segment.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment of
patterns.context: Embedded in words such as “Ecofin” and “ecofriendly,” with adjacent word fragments also activating.

patterns.name: Web and code markup
patterns.context: Multiple punctuation and proper-name fragments activate in URLs, HTML tags, or API paths.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, program code, and web links

patterns.name: English phrase fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in the English expressions “looks as though” or “seem as if,” but activation is inconsistent across tokens.

patterns.name: Technical intra-word fragment sender
patterns.context: Located in the phrase “power or sender wire.”

patterns.name: File and parameter fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in the path, file extension, and query parameters of a Microsoft download URL.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A and software installation instructions

patterns.name: Separator lines and adjacent text
patterns.context: Activations occur near usernames or random strings after forum separator lines; no stable lexical condition can be identified.

patterns.name: Reddit link fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in Reddit URL paths and their substrings; path separators and some site and path tokens activate.

patterns.name: Basketball proper names and date markers
patterns.context: In NBA player/team news and date or statistics fields; some activations overlap with English phrases, and «OR» may also be an intra-name fragment.
patterns.domain: Sports news or forwarded email content

3_612.concept: 文本片段与标点模式
3_612.description: 激活分散于波兰语词片段、英语短语、技术网址与代码、Reddit链接及体育文本。多次出现在网址标点、路径片段和“looks as though”附近，但触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内片段 pos
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语词内部，如“posła”“posiedzeniu”；后续紧邻词片段也有激活，但触发主要落在该词段。

patterns.name: 词内片段 of
patterns.context: 嵌在“Ecofin”“ecofriendly”等词中，并伴随相邻词片段激活。

patterns.name: 网页与代码标记
patterns.context: 网址、HTML 标签或 API 路径中，多个标点和专名片段连续激活。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、程序代码、网页链接

patterns.name: 英语短语片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语“looks as though”或“seem as if”表达中；但各 token 的激活并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术词内片段 sender
patterns.context: 位于“power or sender wire”短语中。

patterns.name: 文件与参数片段
patterns.context: 出现在微软下载网址的路径、文件后缀及查询参数中。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、软件安装说明

patterns.name: 分隔线及紧邻文本
patterns.context: 论坛分隔线后、用户名或随机字符串附近出现激活；难以确定稳定的词汇条件。

patterns.name: Reddit 链接片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 Reddit URL 路径及其子串中，路径分隔符和部分站点、路径 token 激活。

patterns.name: 篮球专名与日期标记
patterns.context: NBA 球员／球队新闻及日期、统计字段中；部分激活与英语短语重合，«OR» 也可能是专名内部片段。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或邮件转发内容

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on URLs, query strings, encoded delimiters, and parameters, spanning news-tracking links, search/API requests, bug reports, technical documentation, and e-commerce links. Some body-text words activate weakly as well, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: URL query parameters and encoded delimiters
patterns.context: Occurs in URL query strings, often adjacent to parameter names, values, encoded spaces, or special characters.
patterns.domain: Web links, news aggregation, and tracking parameters

patterns.name: Feedburner source-tracking string
patterns.context: A tracking parameter in news article links, commonly found in HackerNews posts citing Ars Technica, Laughing Squid, or TechCrunch links.
patterns.domain: News aggregation, web analytics, and URL encoding

patterns.name: Plus-encoded article titles or paths
patterns.context: A plus sign serves as the URL encoding for a space, joining article titles, site names, or search terms.

patterns.name: Search and pagination parameters
patterns.context: Parameters submit search terms, specify result formats, or control page/result pagination.

patterns.name: External resource and bug-report links
patterns.context: Activations fall near link paths or hostnames; links point to bug reports, API queries, and technical documentation.
patterns.domain: Ubuntu collaboration, Q&A, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Article slugs and hyphens in links
patterns.context: Hyphens separate multiple title words or filename fragments in URL paths.
patterns.domain: News article links and earnings-call transcript links

patterns.name: ref parameter in e-commerce links
patterns.context: Located at the end of product-detail links, containing parameters such as referral sources and search/request identifiers.

patterns.name: Discussion text around links
patterns.context: Adjacent to links or their target content, but not clearly sharing the same URL structure; activations may reflect a mixture of URL fragments and ordinary body text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions, Q&A, and technical materials

3_612.concept: URL结构与参数
3_612.description: 激活主要集中在 URL 及其查询串、编码分隔符和参数；覆盖新闻追踪链接、搜索/API 请求、缺陷报告、技术文档和电商链接。部分正文词也有弱激活，未见统一解释。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数与编码分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在网址的查询串中，常与参数名、参数值、编码后的空格或特殊字符相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻聚合与追踪参数

patterns.name: Feedburner 来源追踪串
patterns.context: 作为新闻文章链接的追踪参数，常见于 HackerNews 帖子引用的 Ars Technica、Laughing Squid 或 TechCrunch 链接。
patterns.domain: 新闻聚合、网页分析与 URL 编码

patterns.name: 加号编码的文章标题或路径
patterns.context: 加号充当 URL 中空格的编码形式，连接文章标题、站点名或搜索词。

patterns.name: 搜索及分页参数
patterns.context: 参数用于提交搜索词、指定结果格式或控制页面/结果分页。

patterns.name: 外部资源与缺陷报告链接
patterns.context: 激活落在链接路径或主机名附近；链接分别指向缺陷报告、API 查询和技术文档。
patterns.domain: Ubuntu 协作、问答及技术文档

patterns.name: 链接中的文章 slug 与连字符
patterns.context: 连字符分隔 URL 路径中的多个标题词或文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 新闻文章链接与财报文字记录链接

patterns.name: 电商链接的 ref 参数
patterns.context: 位于商品详情链接尾部，包含引用来源和搜索/请求标识等参数。

patterns.name: 链接周边的讨论文本
patterns.context: 与链接或链接所指内容相邻，但并非明显共享同一 URL 结构；可能是 URL 片段和普通正文混合导致的激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、问答和技术材料

en.description: Primarily responds to web links and URL structure: domains, paths, query parameters, assignment signs, and parameter values. Common in forums, Q&A, API examples, and HTML/Markdown. Activations on a few ordinary words remain unexplained.

patterns.name: URL query parameters and delimiters
patterns.context: When URLs, links, or URL paths/query strings appear, activations concentrate near parameter boundaries, assignment signs, and parameter values; common in web text containing links.
patterns.domain: Web links, search, and API examples

patterns.name: URL domains and path structure
patterns.context: A URL is embedded in body text, a Markdown link, or an HTML script tag; domain and path components can also trigger activations.

patterns.name: Structured URL-encoded parameter values
patterns.context: Parameter names and values appear adjacent in a URL query string; activations may fall on parameter values, numbers, or Boolean values.
patterns.domain: Search links, APIs, web configuration, and data charts

patterns.name: Web-text fragments with links
patterns.context: The context is an embedded link, separator line, or link tail in a forum or Q&A page, often accompanied by Markdown/HTML markup; isolated incomplete links also occur.

patterns.name: Unexplained ordinary words and proper names
patterns.context: Web- or link-related content is nearby, but these words themselves have no clear connection to URL structure; the trigger cannot be determined from the fragment.

3_612.concept: 网页 URL 结构
3_612.description: 主要响应网页链接及 URL 的结构：域名、路径、查询参数、赋值符和参数值；常见于论坛、问答、API 示例及 HTML/Markdown。少数普通词语的激活无法解释。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数与分隔符
patterns.trigger: URL 中的 «=», «&», «?», «/» 及参数值，如 «q=Bootstrap», «format=json», «controls=0»
patterns.context: 出现网址、链接或 URL 路径/查询串时，激活集中在参数边界、赋值符和参数值附近；常见于带链接的网页文本。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、搜索和 API 示例

patterns.name: 网址域名及路径结构
patterns.context: 网址被内嵌在正文、Markdown 链接或 HTML 脚本标签中，域名及路径组成部分也会触发。

patterns.name: URL 编码的结构化参数值
patterns.context: 参数名和值以 URL 查询串形式相邻出现；激活可落在参数值、数字或布尔值上。
patterns.domain: 搜索链接、API、网页配置与数据图表

patterns.name: 带链接的网页文本残片
patterns.context: 上下文是论坛或问答页面中嵌入的链接、分隔线或链接尾部，常伴随 Markdown/HTML 标记；单独的残缺链接也出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 与 StackExchange 网页语料

patterns.name: 未解释的普通词语与专名
patterns.context: 在附近存在网页或链接相关内容，但这些词本身与 URL 结构并无明显联系；触发原因不能由片段确定。

en.description: The most consistent cue is URLs and their query parameters, path separators, and domain markers. Activations also occur in scientific prose, detector terminology, table formatting, and sporadic page text, which are difficult to explain through the URL pattern.

patterns.name: Equals signs in URL query parameters
patterns.context: The strongest shared cue among activations is the equals sign in URLs, especially at the start of parameter values; nearby text often includes parameter names, search terms, or pagination options.
patterns.domain: Web links, search links, API/form URLs

patterns.name: Slashes and path fragments in URL paths
patterns.context: URL path separators and adjacent path text, often occurring alongside query parameters, file paths, or web links.
patterns.domain: Web links, document links, and product links

patterns.name: Domain names and web-link markers
patterns.context: Activated within recognizable hostnames or protocol strings; some activations fall on domain fragments or periods in domains.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, StackExchange, and other web links

patterns.name: URL encoding and structured punctuation
patterns.context: These symbols occur in URL parameters, template paths, anchors, or filenames; activations also fall on several number and punctuation tokens, which may not all reduce to the same URL feature.
patterns.domain: URLs, web templates, and structured text

patterns.name: Facts and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in HackerNews text in a sentence about online information; unlike URL structure features, it is unclear whether this belongs to the same triggering pattern.

patterns.name: Scientific terms and measurements
patterns.context: Occurs in a paper sentence about SIS junction fabrication, insulating layers, and energy sensitivity; markers cover technical word fragments and locations near values/units.

patterns.name: Particle detectors and geometric quantities
patterns.context: In a description of the KLOE detector, activations occur on words and symbols related to position, calorimeters, polar-angle coverage, and formula boundaries.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in tabular data
patterns.context: Activations are concentrated on printed data-frame rows, column indices, whitespace alignment, and variable notation; the relationship to the URL pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, R data tables

patterns.name: Web page titles, paths, or content fragments
patterns.context: A few activations fall on titles, web content, or interface text near link targets; these words do not show a consistent semantic category.
patterns.domain: HackerNews link text and StackExchange forms/pages

3_612.concept: 网址结构与标点
3_612.description: 最一致的线索是网址及其查询参数、路径分隔符和域名标记；此外，科研正文、探测器术语、表格格式和零散页面文字也有激活，难以由网址模式解释。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数中的等号
patterns.trigger: «=»10，常出现在 «&»3 之后或查询字段赋值处
patterns.context: 激活集中最强的共同线索是 URL 中的等号，尤其是参数值开始处；周围常有参数名、查询词或分页选项。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、搜索链接、API/表单 URL

patterns.name: URL 路径中的斜杠与路径片段
patterns.context: 网址中的路径分隔符及其相邻路径文字；常与查询参数、文件路径或网页链接共同出现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、文档链接、商品链接

patterns.name: 域名与网页链接标记
patterns.context: 在可识别的主机名或协议字符串中被激活；部分激活落在域名片段或域名点号上。

patterns.name: URL 编码及结构化标点
patterns.context: 这些符号出现在网址参数、模板路径、锚点或文件名中；激活也落在若干数字和标点 token 上，未必都能归结为同一个 URL 特征。
patterns.domain: 网址、网页模板与结构化文本

patterns.name: 事实与数量表达
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 文本中关于网上信息的句子里；与 URL 结构特征不同，是否同属一个触发模式不明。

patterns.name: 科研术语与测量结果
patterns.context: 出现在关于 SIS 结工艺、绝缘层和能量灵敏度的论文句子中，标记覆盖专业词片段及数值/单位附近。

patterns.name: 粒子探测器与几何量
patterns.context: 在 KLOE 探测器描述中，激活落于位置、量热器、极角覆盖及公式边界相关词和符号上。

patterns.name: 表格数据中的格式标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在数据框打印出的表格行、列编号、空白对齐和变量记号上；与网址模式的关系不清楚。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、R 数据表

patterns.name: 网页标题、路径或内容片段
patterns.context: 少数激活落在链接目标附近的标题、网页内容或界面文本上；这些词本身并未显现一致的语义类别。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 链接文本及 StackExchange 表单/页面

en.description: Primarily responds to surgery in medical contexts, covering different procedures, surgical care, and related specialties; also activates on the ect letter fragment and on fragments within several medical headings and terms, and appears in germ-layer and protistology texts.

patterns.name: Surgery in medical contexts
patterns.context: About surgery, surgical treatment, or postoperative care in medical questions, abstracts, or patent backgrounds; sometimes preceded by a specific disease or procedure type
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, medical device patents

patterns.name: The ect fragment in biological words
patterns.context: Activation falls within biomedical or biological terms containing the letter fragment ect, relating respectively to ectropion, germ layers, and the endoplasmic reticulum

patterns.name: Title-like labels for diseases or classifications
patterns.context: Appears in titles or classification labels at the start of abstracts, where words are split into multiple tokens; activation is distributed across different word fragments
patterns.domain: PubMed titles and disease classification texts

patterns.name: Surgery-related modifiers
patterns.context: Localized activation occurs in specialties, procedure names, or patient-group terms adjacent to surgery or medical care

patterns.name: Germ-layer contrast with no clear dominant pattern
patterns.context: Contrasts germ-layer lineages in a mouse embryonic development study; this passage also contains an ect trigger

3_704.description: 主要响应医学语境中的 surgery，覆盖不同手术、手术护理及相关专科；另对 ect 字母片段及若干医学标题、术语内部片段有激活，亦见于胚层和原生生物学文本。

patterns.name: 医学语境中的 surgery
patterns.context: 在医学题目、摘要或专利背景中，围绕手术、手术治疗或术后护理；有时前接具体疾病或手术类型
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要、医疗器械专利

patterns.name: 生物学词中的 ect 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在包含 ect 字母片段的生物医学或生物学术语内部，分别涉及眼睑外翻、胚层和细胞质网
patterns.domain: 医学分类、发育生物学、原生生物学

patterns.name: 疾病或分类词的专名式标题
patterns.context: 出现在摘要开头的标题或分类标签中，词被拆分成多个 token；激活分布在词内不同片段
patterns.domain: PubMed 标题及疾病分类文本

patterns.name: 外科相关修饰语
patterns.context: 与手术或医疗照护相邻的专科、手术名称或患者群体词中出现局部激活
patterns.domain: 耳科、眼科、老年医学、妇科

patterns.name: 无明显主模式的胚层对举
patterns.context: 小鼠胚胎发育研究中对胚层谱系作对比；本段同时包含 ect 触发
patterns.domain: NIH 发育生物学研究摘要

en.description: Activation is scattered across surgery (especially ophthalmology), ect- terms in medicine and biology, and fragments in headings and proper names; a paragraph-initial marker in one developmental biology text is also difficult to explain. No clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Otolaryngologic surgery phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a title-like medical phrase preceded by “relates to” and accompanied by the section number “IV.”

patterns.name: Ophthalmic surgery wording
patterns.context: Adjacent to ophthalmology or ophthalmic treatment contexts, such as “vitrectomy,” “diabetic retinopathy,” and “refractive eye”; the sentence asks about surgical efficacy or explains a treatment purpose

patterns.name: ectropion and ecto- spelling fragments
patterns.context: Appears in medical/biological terms; the complete words have different meanings, while the activation marker falls on the token fragment “ect”
patterns.domain: Medical and biological abstracts and research texts

patterns.name: Geriatrics and surgical prognosis
patterns.context: Discusses prognosis and preoperative cognitive status in patients with dementia and hip fractures

patterns.name: Organizational classification phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the glossary entry title “Glossary Term – Organization”

patterns.name: AutoZone name fragment
patterns.context: At the beginning of the proper name “AutoZone Park,” repeated on the next line

patterns.name: Not sufficiently explained by current trigger clues
patterns.context: The activation marker is at the beginning of a biological development research paragraph, which later mentions germ-layer lineages; the relation between the marker and the later content is uncertain

3_704.description: 激活分散于手术（尤其眼科）、医学/生物学中的 ect- 术语，以及组织标题和专名片段；另有一段发育生物学文本的段首标记难以解释。共同触发规律不明确。

patterns.name: 耳科手术短语
patterns.context: 出现在标题式医学短语中，前有“relates to”，并带章节编号“IV.”

patterns.name: 眼科手术表述
patterns.context: 与眼科或眼科治疗语境相邻，如“vitrectomy”“diabetic retinopathy”“refractive eye”；句中询问手术疗效或说明治疗目的

patterns.name: ectropion 及 ecto- 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学/生物学术语中；完整词义并不相同，激活标记落在分词片段“ect”
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学摘要及研究文本

patterns.name: geriatrics 与手术预后
patterns.context: 讨论痴呆、髋部骨折患者的预后及手术前认知状态

patterns.name: 组织分类词组
patterns.context: 出现在词汇表条目标题“Glossary Term – Organization”中

patterns.name: AutoZone 名称片段
patterns.context: 作为专名“AutoZone Park”的开头，并在下一行重复

patterns.name: 无法由当前触发线索充分解释
patterns.context: 激活标记位于生物发育研究段落开头，后文提及胚层谱系；标记与后续内容的关系不确定

en.description: The most consistent signal is the hyphen, appearing in compound words, numerical ranges, and technical terms; there is also activation on fragments within proper names, line breaks, and heading/code boundaries. Symbol activation in formula passages may be a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the hyphen itself; the elements on either side form compounds or ranges and often adjoin proper names, technical terms, or template fields.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: encyclopedias, medicine, code, mathematics, news, literature

patterns.name: Subword boundaries within proper names and words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments at the start of or within words, commonly in proper names, surnames, or non-English names; tokenization boundaries do not always align with conventional word boundaries.

patterns.name: Structural markers and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Markers near line breaks, headings, or code declarations also activate, but their strength and distribution differ from the hyphen pattern.

patterns.name: Backslashes and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, variables, and interval notation in formulas; activation may relate to formula-formatting symbols or may be an independent tokenization effect.

3_704.description: 最一致的信号是连字符，出现在复合词、数值范围和技术术语中；此外，对专名内部片段、换行及标题/代码边界也有激活。公式段的符号激活可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: 带连字符的复合词
patterns.context: 激活集中在连字符本身；两侧组成复合词或范围，常邻接专名、技术术语或模板字段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：百科、医学、代码、数学、新闻、文学

patterns.name: 专名与词语内部的子词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词首或词内片段，常见于专名、姓氏或非英语名称；分词边界并不总与常规词边界一致。

patterns.name: 结构标记与格式边界
patterns.context: 换行、标题或代码声明附近的标记也有激活，但强度和分布与连字符模式不同。
patterns.domain: 问答、代码模板、科研摘要

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的反斜线与符号
patterns.context: 公式中的 LaTeX 命令、变量及区间记号；激活可能与公式排版符号有关，亦可能是独立的分词效应。

en.description: Activation is scattered across word-initial/in-word fragments, hyphens, colons, line breaks, and a few ordinary words; some clusters around Ne-initial neurological terms or hyphenated structures, but patterns span domains and cannot be unified.

patterns.name: Ne at the start of English proper terms
patterns.context: In specialized terms beginning with Ne, activation falls on the initial fragment; examples concern neurofilaments, neuropathology, or neurodegenerative diseases.

patterns.name: Hyphens and following fragments within words
patterns.context: Tokens after or near hyphens are activated across different word classes, including disease modifiers, receptor subtypes, surname origins, and package names; this is not a single semantic domain.
patterns.domain: Medicine, molecular biology, proper names, and software texts

patterns.name: Separator after a colon
patterns.context: A colon activates when it follows a Q&A label or a phrase introducing a list; however, other ordinary colons in list text are not clearly marked.

patterns.name: Word-initial Curtis and line breaks
patterns.context: The first or last name Curtis appears at the start of a sentence, immediately followed by consecutive line breaks; the word-initial and in-word fragments and the line breaks all activate.

patterns.name: Project summary opening
patterns.context: A research project abstract opens with the heading Project Summary; the same passage also contains the words elevated frequency and self-renew, but activation is scattered.

patterns.name: Numerical and ordering text
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, punctuation, and ordering instructions are mixed; strong activation is concentrated on increasing, without a stable numerical trigger rule.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on multiple boundaries and word fragments
patterns.context: Many common words and word fragments in the same passage are marked, including content about NIH funding and infectious pregnancy complications; it is difficult to summarize with a clear semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Receptor name fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs near insulin receptors or the abbreviation IRB, but marking of different uses of IR in the same passage is inconsistent and does not explain the other activations in the passage.

patterns.name: Sporadic ordinary words and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across ordinary words or word fragments in texts about neurofilaments, influenza, administration, and immunology, with no clear, consistent trigger across passages.

3_704.concept: 混杂的词片段与边界模式
3_704.description: 激活分散于词首/词内片段、连字符、冒号、换行和少量普通词；有些集中在 Ne 开头的神经术语或连字符结构，但跨领域且无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 英语专名首部的 Ne
patterns.context: 以 Ne 开头的专业术语中，激活落在词首片段；涉及神经丝蛋白、神经病理学或神经退行性疾病。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 词内的连字符及后续片段
patterns.context: 连字符后或连字符附近的 token 受激活，跨疾病修饰语、受体亚型、姓氏来源和软件包名称等不同词类；不是单一语义领域。
patterns.domain: 医学、分子生物学、专名及软件文本

patterns.name: 冒号后的分隔符
patterns.context: 在问答标签或引出清单的短语后出现冒号时，冒号激活；但另有清单文本中的普通冒号没有明确标记。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Curtis 的词首与换行
patterns.context: 名字或姓氏 Curtis 在句首，紧接连续换行；词首、词中片段及换行均有激活。

patterns.name: 项目摘要开头
patterns.context: 科研项目摘要以 Project Summary 标题开篇；同段还出现 elevated frequency、self-renew 等词，但激活分布较散。

patterns.name: 数值和排序文本
patterns.context: 数字、负号、标点及排序指令混杂；显著激活集中于 increasing，未形成稳定的数值触发规则。

patterns.name: 多种边界与词片段的零散激活
patterns.trigger: « studies»、« are»、« a»、« continuation»、« our»、« laboratory»、« IR»
patterns.context: 同一段内许多常见词及词片段均被标记，包含 NIH 资助、感染妊娠并发症等内容，难以归纳为清楚的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 受体名称片段
patterns.context: 胰岛素受体或 IRB 缩写附近激活，但同段不同 IR 用法的标记不一致，且不能解释该段其他激活。

patterns.name: 零散普通词及专名片段
patterns.trigger: «Ne»、« influenza»、« vaccine»、« remains»、« Core»、« frequency»、« effector»
patterns.context: 激活分散在神经丝、流感、行政事务和免疫学文本中的普通词或词片段，缺少跨段一致的明确触发条件。

en.description: Activation often falls on internal substring boundaries in code or text: angle-bracket syntax, words and identifiers with capitalization boundaries, and a few hyphens, arrows, and affix fragments; trigger types are not uniform.

patterns.name: Angle-bracket template/type syntax in code
patterns.context: Angle brackets appear in generic-like type annotations in PHP documentation comments, C++ template calls, or command placeholders; specific uses differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Github code and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Subword boundaries within words
patterns.context: Activation fragments are embedded within longer identifiers or ordinary words, often at capitalization transitions; also includes segmentation within proper names or legal terms.
patterns.domain: Code identifiers, Wikipedia, and legal texts

patterns.name: Name interpolation and underscore separation
patterns.context: A service name is formed from variable fragments in a template string, joined by “_”; this combination occurs in only one code passage.

patterns.name: Unicode arrow symbol
patterns.context: An HTML-style arrow symbol appears in a code comment.

patterns.name: Numbers after range hyphens
patterns.context: A hyphen links years or decades in numerical ranges, and the activation is on the hyphen.

patterns.name: Hyphen in road names
patterns.context: A hyphen links place names in a compound road name; activation falls on the hyphen.

patterns.name: Affix fragment within a legal term
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial substring of the ordinary legal term substantial.

3_704.description: 激活多落在代码或文本的内部子串边界：尖括号语法、大小写切分的词与标识符，以及少量连字符、箭头和词缀片段；触发类型并不统一。

patterns.name: 代码中的尖括号模板/类型语法
patterns.context: 尖括号出现在 PHP 文档注释的泛型式类型、C++ 模板调用或命令占位符等代码语法中；不同段里的具体用法不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Github 代码与 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 单词内部的子词边界
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在较长标识符或普通词内部，常位于大小写转换处；也包括专名或法律词语中的切分。
patterns.domain: 代码标识符、维基百科及法律文本

patterns.name: 名称插值与下划线分隔
patterns.context: 模板字符串中由变量片段组成服务名称，并以「_」连接；只有一个代码段呈现此组合。

patterns.name: Unicode箭头符号
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释中的 HTML 风格箭头符号。

patterns.name: 范围连接号后的数字
patterns.context: 数字范围中连接年份或年代，激活标在连接号处。
patterns.domain: 维基百科历史及体育条目

patterns.name: 道路名称中的连字符
patterns.context: 复合道路名称中连接地名，连字符处激活。

patterns.name: 法律术语内的词缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通法律术语 substantial 的开头子串。

en.concept: Inline code markers and technical syntax boundaries
en.description: Primarily sensitive to code, identifiers, or attribute values enclosed in backticks, often alongside code-structure boundaries; a mathematical formula and tiling statement also appears, with no clear connection to the code pattern.

patterns.name: Code or identifier inside backticks
patterns.context: Near inline code, strings, attribute values, or identifiers marked by backticks; activation mainly falls on the backticks and following content and occurs across languages.
patterns.domain: Code, technical documentation, and code comments; passages 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Braces and code-structure boundaries
patterns.context: At the beginning or end of code blocks, functions or class definitions, structs, and callbacks; in several passages the braces, line breaks, or indentation themselves are also marked.
patterns.domain: Source code and code examples in multiple programming languages; passages 1, 2, 5, 8

patterns.name: Go struct field tags and ignored fields
patterns.context: In Go test code, a struct field uses a TOML tag to mark the field as ignored, alongside decoder input.
patterns.domain: Go unit tests and serialization/decoding code; passage 2

patterns.name: Integer lattice and tiling statement in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: In a formula context, discusses integer conditions and whether a set can be tiled by an object; activation also includes formula symbols and adjacent text.

patterns.name: Copy semantics and TODO in code comments
patterns.context: A comment describes avoiding copies and plans to delete a copy constructor, followed by assertion code.

patterns.name: Document heading and prefetch explanation
patterns.context: A Markdown document organizes topics with a heading, then introduces browser prefetching and HTML tags.

patterns.name: Comments and preprocessor conditions in an assembly instruction name table
patterns.context: A conditional compilation directive is adjacent to a comment explaining the purpose of an instruction-name table.
patterns.domain: C/C++ assembly-tool library source code; passage 6

patterns.name: HTML attribute values and statistics text
patterns.context: Describes HTML attribute nodes and instance counts, with attribute names and values presented as inline code.
patterns.domain: HTML analysis or accessibility-related technical documentation; passage 7

patterns.name: Complexity explanation and precalculation
patterns.context: An algorithm description first gives time complexity, then explains precalculation and the cost of subsequent calls.

patterns.name: Interpolated string in template attributes and event checks
patterns.context: A conditional branch constructs an attribute string with template interpolation and passes it to a checking function.

patterns.name: Command-name resolution and host-environment fallback comment
patterns.context: A one-time initialization looks up an external command, with a comment explaining that the command is missing on the host.

3_704.concept: 代码行内标记及技术语法边界
3_704.description: 主要对反引号包围的代码、标识符或属性值敏感，常伴随代码结构边界；另有数学公式铺砌语句，未见与代码模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 反引号内的代码或标识符
patterns.context: 反引号标记的行内代码、字符串、属性值或标识符附近；主要激活落在反引号及其后的内容，不同语言中均可见。

patterns.name: 开闭花括号与代码结构边界
patterns.context: 代码块、函数或类定义、结构体和回调等语法结构的开始或结束处；在若干段中花括号、换行或缩进本身也被标记。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源码及代码示例；段1、2、5、8

patterns.name: Go 结构体字段标签与忽略字段
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中，结构体字段使用 TOML 标签将字段标记为忽略，并配有解码输入。
patterns.domain: Go 单元测试及序列化/解码代码；段2

patterns.name: 数学公式中的整数格与铺砌陈述
patterns.context: 公式上下文中讨论整数条件以及集合是否能被某对象铺砌；激活还包括公式符号和相邻文字。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的复制语义与待办
patterns.trigger: `// TODO: Find a way to avoid copying`、`copy` constructor
patterns.context: 注释描述避免复制、删除拷贝构造函数的计划，随后出现断言代码。

patterns.name: 文档标题及预取说明
patterns.context: Markdown 文档先以标题组织主题，再介绍浏览器中的预取方式和 HTML 标签。

patterns.name: 汇编指令名称表的注释与预处理条件
patterns.context: 条件编译指令和说明内部指令名称表用途的注释相邻。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 汇编工具库源码；段6

patterns.name: HTML 属性值及统计文本
patterns.context: 说明 HTML 属性的节点及实例数量，属性名和值以行内代码形式呈现。
patterns.domain: HTML 分析或无障碍相关技术文档；段7

patterns.name: 复杂度说明与预计算
patterns.context: 算法说明先写时间复杂度，再对预计算和后续调用成本作解释。

patterns.name: 模板属性与事件检查中的插值字符串
patterns.context: 条件分支中构造带模板插值的属性字符串，并将其传给检查函数。

patterns.name: 命令名解析与主机环境回退注释
patterns.context: 通过一次性初始化查找外部命令，并注释说明主机上缺少该命令的情况。

en.concept: Specific word forms and symbol fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across the chemical term poly, human in medical contexts, several in-word fragments ch, the section symbol §, English, and the Wikipedia category label Category; overall, it spans domains and shows no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation in poly(amidoamine)
patterns.context: Appears in the chemical term “poly(amidoamine) dendrimers”; activation is concentrated on poly and subsequent in-word fragments

patterns.name: Letter combinations in place names or proper names
patterns.context: Embedded within proper names or words such as château and chieftain; there are also several segmented place names, personal names, and category terms, but no stable recurring activation substring

patterns.name: human
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, human is a species/patient-related modifier; a lower-intensity marking also appears on human immunodeficiency in the same passage

patterns.name: English in an English compound context
patterns.context: In a description of the English-speaking world in the Duhem–Quine thesis, activation falls on English

patterns.name: Section and statutory numbering
patterns.context: The § symbol is followed by a section or statutory number; appears in academic chapter references and legal citations

patterns.name: Category label
patterns.context: Each category item in a Wikipedia category list begins with Category:; the word activates repeatedly

patterns.name: Possible word-final ch
patterns.context: Occurs within château and chieftain, with different surrounding characters and meanings; it is uncertain whether these share the same character-trigger pattern

3_704.description: 激活分散于化学术语 poly、医学语境的 human、若干词内片段 ch、章节符号 §、English 和维基分类标签 Category；整体跨领域，未见单一语义模式。

patterns.name: poly(amidoamine)词内分段
patterns.context: 出现在“poly(amidoamine) dendrimers”的化学术语中；激活集中于 poly 及其后续词内片段

patterns.name: 地名或专名中的字母组合
patterns.context: 嵌在 château、chieftain 等专名或词语内部；另有若干拆分的地名、人名及类别词，但未见相同的稳定激活子串

patterns.name: human
patterns.context: 医学摘要中 human 作为物种／患者相关修饰语；另有同段 human immunodeficiency 的低强度标记

patterns.name: 英语复合语境中的 English
patterns.context: Duhem–Quine thesis 的 English-speaking world 描述中，激活落在 English

patterns.name: 章节与法条编号
patterns.context: § 符号后接章节或法条编号；分别出现在学术章节指引和法律引文中

patterns.name: 类别标签
patterns.context: 维基百科分类列表中，每条分类项以 Category: 起始；该词重复激活

patterns.name: 可能的词尾 ch
patterns.context: 分别出现在 château 与 chieftain 的词内，周围字符及语义不同；是否属于同一字形触发无法确认

en.concept: Multiple-topic proper names and domain terms
en.description: Activation is scattered across contexts involving Indian cinema, ethnic identity, place names and art, legal litigation, Scottish politics, Catholic appointments, and Bangladeshi political violence; there is no stable shared trigger across passages, and responses seem localized to multiple topic words and proper names.

patterns.name: Indian cinema and South Indian languages/film industries
patterns.context: In film introductions or accounts of the film industry, words related to India, South Indian languages, or the film industry appear; includes in-word split markers such as «Tel»«ugu».

patterns.name: Armenian and Iranian identity
patterns.context: In introductions to people or television programs, nationality/ethnicity adjectives occur near descriptions of identity or occupation.

patterns.name: New Jersey artworks and place names
patterns.context: Appears in lists of public artworks, their locations, or titles; activation includes place names as well as words in artwork titles.

patterns.name: Litigants in legal opinions
patterns.context: Near procedural statements, lists of parties, and names in court opinions; not all legal passages trigger equally.

patterns.name: Scottish politics and party discussions
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of Scottish voters, political figures, or group responsibility.

patterns.name: Catholic offices and dioceses
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of bishop appointments, dioceses, and church positions.

patterns.name: Political violence in Bangladesh
patterns.context: Describes punishment, murder plots, and related people targeting political workers in colonial or political contexts.

3_704.description: 激活分散于印度电影、族裔身份、地名与艺术、法律诉讼、苏格兰政治、天主教任命及孟加拉政治暴力等语境；没有跨段稳定的共同触发词，更多像多个主题词与专名的局部响应。

patterns.name: 印度电影与南印度语言／影业
patterns.context: 在电影介绍或影业叙述中，出现印度、南印度语言或电影产业相关词；包括词内拆分标记，如 «Tel»«ugu»。

patterns.name: 亚美尼亚及伊朗身份
patterns.context: 人物或电视节目介绍中，国籍／族裔形容词出现在身份或职业描述附近。

patterns.name: 新泽西艺术作品与地名
patterns.context: 公共艺术作品及其地点、作品名称的列举中出现；激活包含地名，也包含作品名中的词。

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的诉讼参与者
patterns.context: 法院意见书的程序性表述、当事人列举及姓名附近；并非所有法律段落都同样触发。

patterns.name: 苏格兰政治与党派讨论
patterns.context: 讨论苏格兰选民、政治人物或群体责任时出现。

patterns.name: 天主教教职与教区
patterns.context: 叙述任命主教、教区及教会职位时出现。

patterns.name: 孟加拉政治暴力
patterns.context: 殖民或政治背景下描述对政治工作者的惩罚、谋杀策划及相关人物。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on U.S. judicial opinion formatting: designations of appellate parties, court and docket headings, judge signatures, attorney listings, and the body of the decision; also appears on criminal pleas, family/estate case facts, case names, filing dates, and other legal vocabulary.

patterns.name: Party designations in appellate cases
patterns.context: Appears in appellate case titles, the opening of case facts, or the reasoning, often near party names, state names, or descriptions of case procedure.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Court opinion headings and procedural information
patterns.context: Case headings list the court, level of review, county/state, docket number, or decision status; sometimes includes dates and judge information.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinion titles and docket headings

patterns.name: Opinion and judge-signature format
patterns.context: The opinion title or opening body identifies the presiding/panel judge, opinion type, or author of the opinion.

patterns.name: Attorney and counsel listings
patterns.context: Lists counsel, an attorney general, or a public defender after a party name or in the opinion heading.
patterns.domain: Legal document headings and attorney signature blocks

patterns.name: Defendant and plea wording in criminal cases
patterns.context: The defendant’s identity or criminal proceedings appear in the case title or factual narrative.

patterns.name: Civil cases and family relationship narratives
patterns.context: The body mentions a decedent and relatives as petitioners, or explains the parties’ divorce relationship.
patterns.domain: Estate/civil litigation and family dispute opinions

patterns.name: Decision outcome and opinion section headings
patterns.context: The opinion body states that the lower court’s judgment is affirmed, indicates the outcome, or uses an uppercase heading to divide the facts section.

patterns.name: Case names and document-specific formatting
patterns.context: An older case-law heading gives the case name in party-versus-party format, or the case record contains a specific filing date; difficult to classify under the common heading features above.
patterns.domain: Legal case law and court records

3_704.description: 激活主要集中在美国判决文书格式：上诉双方称谓、法院与案号抬头、法官署名、律师列示及裁判正文；另见刑事认罪、家庭/遗产案情和案名、归档日期等法律语汇。

patterns.name: 上诉案件当事人称谓
patterns.context: 出现在上诉案件标题、案情开头或裁判理由中，常与当事人姓名、州名或案件程序描述相邻。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 法院判决标题与程序信息
patterns.trigger: «On Appeal»、«Appeal from»、«Supreme Court»、«District Court»、«Superior Court»、«Trial Court Case No»
patterns.context: 案件抬头列出法院、审级、县/州、案号或判决状态；有时含日期及法官信息。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决标题及案卷抬头

patterns.name: 判决意见及法官署名格式
patterns.context: 判决标题或正文开端标示主审/合议法官、意见类型或意见由谁撰写。

patterns.name: 律师及代理人列示
patterns.context: 当事人姓名后或判决抬头列出代表律师、总检察长或公设辩护人。
patterns.domain: 法律文书抬头、律师署名栏

patterns.name: 刑事案件的被告与认罪表述
patterns.context: 被告身份或刑事程序出现在案件标题或案情叙述中。

patterns.name: 民事案件及家庭关系叙述
patterns.context: 正文提及死者及其亲属作为请愿人，或交代当事人离婚关系。
patterns.domain: 遗产/民事诉讼及家庭纠纷判决

patterns.name: 案件裁判结果与意见段落标题
patterns.context: 意见正文说明维持下级法院判决、标注裁判结果，或用大写标题划分事实部分。

patterns.name: 案件专名及文书特定格式
patterns.context: 旧式判例抬头以当事人对阵格式列案名，或案件记录出现具体归档日期；难以归入前述常见抬头特征。

en.concept: U.S. legal opinion format and litigation roles
en.description: Primarily responds to words and formatting that identify litigating parties, judges, and judicial procedure in U.S. opinions; also reacts to case names and legal narrative words in the body. One passage also activates on an encyclopedia biography category.

patterns.name: Party designations in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Appears in appellate case titles, factual narratives, or court opinions, often near names, litigation actions, or the opposing party designation; indicates a litigation role.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and appellate documents

patterns.name: Opinion format and standard court-procedure language
patterns.context: Appears in fixed-format locations such as judge signatures, opinion openings, or rulings.

patterns.name: Legal case titles and citation formatting
patterns.context: Near case party titles, docket numbers, or line breaks and formatting symbols in court documents.

patterns.name: Names and party-identity narratives
patterns.context: Names and legal identities or case actions occur in opinion narratives; strong activation sometimes falls on part of a name.

patterns.name: Pronouns and argumentative terms in legal procedural narratives
patterns.context: Appears when the opinion body recounts litigation, party capacity, or the court’s assessment; not a fixed heading field.

patterns.name: Proper-name categories in encyclopedia classifications
patterns.context: Appears in category labels at the end of biography articles, outside the legal-document context.

3_704.concept: 美国法律判决书格式与诉讼角色
3_704.description: 主要响应美国判决书中标示诉讼双方、法官与裁判程序的词语和版式；也对案件姓名及正文中的法律叙事词有反应。另有一段百科人物分类激活。

patterns.name: 上诉意见书中的当事人称谓
patterns.context: 出现在上诉案件标题、案情叙述或法院意见中，常与姓名、诉讼行为或另一方称谓相邻；指示诉讼角色。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与上诉文书

patterns.name: 判决格式与法院程序套语
patterns.context: 出现在法官署名、意见开头或裁判结论等固定格式位置。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与引证排版
patterns.context: 案件当事人标题、案号或法院文书换行与排版符号附近。

patterns.name: 姓名与当事人身份叙述
patterns.context: 姓名和法律身份或案件行为出现在判决叙述中；强激活有时落在姓名组成部分。

patterns.name: 法律程序叙事中的代词与论证词
patterns.context: 判决正文叙述诉讼过程、当事人能力或法院评价时出现；并非固定标题字段。

patterns.name: 百科分类中的专名类别
patterns.context: 出现在人物条目末尾的分类标签中，而不是法律文书语境。

en.concept: Reflexive expressions and local word forms
en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the reflexive pronouns itself/themselves across multiple domains, often after copular verbs; sporadic activations also occur on own, legal case-title party designations, and name fragments.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns itself/themselves
patterns.context: Reflexive pronouns used as subjects or emphatic complements, often following copular verbs such as is/was/are or immediately after related nouns; activation is concentrated on the reflexive pronoun.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal, mathematical, medical, encyclopedic, and patent texts

patterns.name: Possessive emphasis with own
patterns.context: own modifies defense and is preceded by himself; the context emphasizes that the party personally defended himself.

patterns.name: Appellants/Plaintiffs in legal titles
patterns.context: Appears in case titles, with party designations listed in parallel using a slash.

patterns.name: Personal names and name fragments
patterns.context: The personal name George Seay is split into subwords; activation is distributed across name fragments, in a biographical context.

3_704.description: 主要对反身代词 itself/themselves 强烈响应，跨多领域、常处于系动词后；另有 own、法律案名身份称谓及人名片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 反身代词 itself/themselves
patterns.context: 反身代词作主语或强调性补语，常接系动词 is/was/are，或紧跟相关名词；激活主要落在反身代词上。
patterns.domain: 法律、数学、医学、百科、专利等多种文体

patterns.name: 所有格强调 own
patterns.context: own 修饰 defense，前有 himself，语境强调当事人亲自为自己辩护。

patterns.name: 法律标题中的 Appellants/Plaintiffs
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题中，以斜线并列诉讼身份称谓。

patterns.name: 人物姓名及姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名 George Seay 被分词切开；激活分散在姓名各片段，背景为人物简介。

en.concept: Word forms and local formatting fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across various parts of speech and formats: reflexive/emphatic pronouns, co-compounds, proper names and in-word fragments, conjunctions, and articles; additional local phenomena include legal plaintiff designations, all-caps docket segmentation, and Scottish football category terms.

patterns.name: Emphatic/reflexive use of `itself`
patterns.context: The pronoun itself and its surrounding context are highlighted; often used reflexively or emphatically, as in “was itself fraudulent” and “is itself an R&B number”.

patterns.name: `co-` compounds
patterns.context: Hyphenated co-compounds; activation is concentrated near the hyphen or root fragments.

patterns.name: Proper names and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Proper names, name-forming elements, or local fragments within capitalized words are marked; there is no consistent syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic titles and body text, legal docket formatting

patterns.name: Coordinating conjunctions
patterns.context: Appears in coordination of nouns or phrases; some snippets also contain and without notable activation, so triggering is inconsistent.

patterns.name: Plaintiffs in legal proceedings
patterns.context: In legal narrative, refers to litigants in uppercase, followed by a comma and a contrastive word.

patterns.name: Articles and introductory constructions
patterns.context: Function words in articles or introductory phrases; positions vary, with no consistent local condition established.

patterns.name: Legal docket layout fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized words are segmented in all-caps names, titles, and party lists, possibly relating to docket formatting or in-word segmentation.

patterns.name: Scottish football word forms
patterns.context: In an encyclopedia category label, activation falls on a subword fragment of “Scottish”; “Scotland” in the body text is also weakly marked.

patterns.name: Local markers in dates and organization names
patterns.context: In title entries and alternative-name introductions, activation is distributed across proper names and common phrases.

patterns.name: Name and title suffix fragments
patterns.context: Local word fragments in names or job titles; evidence is insufficient to confirm an independent rule.

3_704.description: 激活分散在多种词类和格式：反身/强调代词、co-复合词、专名与词内片段、并列词及冠词；另有法律原告称谓、全大写案卷切分和苏格兰足球分类词等局部现象。

patterns.name: `itself`强调/反身用法
patterns.context: 代词本身及其前后语境被突出；常用于反身或强调式表述，如“was itself fraudulent”“is itself an R&B number”。

patterns.name: `co-`复合词
patterns.context: 连字符连接的 co- 复合词；激活集中在连字符或词根片段附近。
patterns.domain: 百科人物/学校介绍、新闻政治

patterns.name: 专名及词内片段
patterns.context: 专名、专名构词成分或大写词内部的局部片段被标记；没有统一的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科标题与正文、法律案卷格式

patterns.name: 并列连接词
patterns.trigger: 多处 «and»，如“Rhythm and Blues”“Town and Country”
patterns.context: 出现在名词或短语并列中；片段中也有不带显著激活的 and，触发并不稳定。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的原告
patterns.context: 法律叙述中以大写形式指称诉讼当事人，后接逗号及转折词。

patterns.name: 冠词与引介结构
patterns.context: 冠词或引介短语中的功能词；出现位置各异，无法确立一致局部条件。

patterns.name: 法院案卷版式片段
patterns.context: 大写词在全大写姓名、职务及当事方名单中被分段标记，可能与案卷排版或词内切分有关。
patterns.domain: 法律文件标题/当事人名单

patterns.name: 苏格兰足球词形
patterns.context: 百科分类标签中，激活落在“Scottish”的词内片段；正文中“Scotland”也有较弱标记。

patterns.name: 日期与机构名称中的局部标记
patterns.trigger: «1923»不带标记；激活片段为“«Italo»-«Yemeni»”及附近“«also» known as”
patterns.context: 条目标题和替代名称引介语境，激活分布于专名和常见短语多个位置。

patterns.name: 人名及头衔词尾片段
patterns.context: 人名或职务名词中的局部词片段；证据不足以确认独立规则。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on party designations, punctuation, statutory references, and opinion boilerplate in legal documents. They also occur in hyphenated compounds and proper names segmented across tokens, as well as word-initial and word-final fragments; encyclopedia lists and a few common words show sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Hyphens within segmented words
patterns.context: Activation falls on a hyphen or an adjacent word fragment; most often in compounds or derived words split across tokens.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, music encyclopedias, and news

patterns.name: Party designations in legal pleadings
patterns.context: Formal designations of plaintiffs, defendants, and appellants in legal pleadings, usually in factual or argument sections.

patterns.name: Commas in legal documents
patterns.context: Commas in legal text, often immediately after a party designation or name; activation strength is not necessarily triggered by a specific meaning.

patterns.name: Proper names and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Names, organization names, or words in capitalized titles are split into multiple tokens, with activation on in-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal titles, proper names, and organization names

patterns.name: Regulation and statutory markers
patterns.context: In legal citations, activation appears at section symbols, letter suffixes, or segmentation points in regulation numbers.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or title-initial words
patterns.context: When a word at the start of a sentence, title, or quotation is segmented, activation appears on the initial fragment; evidence is limited, and it is unclear whether there is a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Opinions, encyclopedia entries, and song titles

patterns.name: Proper-name possessives and plural endings
patterns.context: Activation occurs at proper-name possessives, plural endings, or similar apostrophe markers, possibly related to suffix segmentation.

patterns.name: Listing punctuation in name entries
patterns.context: In encyclopedia disambiguation entries, a name is followed by “or”, “refer to”, a colon, and newline-separated items.

patterns.name: Incidental activation in common words
patterns.context: Common adverbs, pronouns, or verbs appear in paragraphs, without sufficient evidence of a stable local trigger.

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate and opinion formatting
patterns.context: Formatting words or boilerplate in court opinions, judgment titles, and legal argument; activation is distributed across multiple tokens.

3_704.description: 激活主要集中于法律文书中的当事人称谓、标点、法条和意见套语，也见于连字符复合词及跨 token 切分的专名、词首词尾片段；百科列项和少数普通词激活较零散。

patterns.name: 切分词内部的连字符
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符上，或紧邻连字符的词片段上；多见于跨 token 切分的复合词或派生词
patterns.domain: 法律文书、音乐百科与新闻

patterns.name: 法律诉讼文书中的当事人称谓
patterns.context: 诉讼文书中对原告、被告及上诉方的正式称谓，通常出现在案情或论证段落

patterns.name: 法律文书中的逗号
patterns.context: 法律文本中的逗号，常紧跟当事人称谓或姓名；激活强度不一定由特定语义触发

patterns.name: 专名及词内片段
patterns.context: 姓名、机构名或大写标题中的词被拆成多个 token，激活落在词内片段
patterns.domain: 法律标题、专名与机构名称

patterns.name: 条例与法条标记
patterns.context: 法律引文中，激活出现在法条符号、字母后缀或法规编号的分段处

patterns.name: 句首或标题首词
patterns.context: 句首、标题或引文开头的词被拆分时，激活出现在词首片段；证据较少，触发是否有稳定语义条件不明
patterns.domain: 判决意见、百科条目与歌曲标题

patterns.name: 专名所有格及复数词尾
patterns.context: 专名所有格、复数词尾或类似撇号标记处出现激活，可能与词尾切分有关

patterns.name: 名称条目中的列举标点
patterns.context: 百科消歧义条目中，名称后接“or”“refer to”、冒号及换行列项

patterns.name: 普通词中的偶发激活
patterns.context: 段落中出现常见副词、代词或动词，缺乏足够证据表明存在稳定局部触发条件

patterns.name: 法律文书套语与意见格式
patterns.trigger: « delivered the judgment of»；«OPINION»；« ORDER GRANTING»；« cont»ends
patterns.context: 法院意见、判决标题及诉讼论述的格式性词语或套语；激活分散在多个 token 上

en.description: Responds mainly to hyphens in English compounds, compound names, and titles, especially in editor-in-chief, man-made, and sister-in-law; also occurs on in-word fragments of Italian words and sporadically on punctuation and conjunctions. No clear correspondence in segment 5.

patterns.name: Hyphens in compounds
patterns.context: Hyphens within compounds or proper names, including word-internal forms, titles, and kinship expressions; often adjacent to letters or word fragments.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, legal and parliamentary texts, and general narrative

patterns.name: Editor-in-chief title
patterns.context: Forms the title editor-in-chief, which may be followed or preceded by a person, organization, or position information; hyphen-related tokens show the clearest activation.
patterns.domain: News biographies, encyclopedic biographies, Q&A texts

patterns.name: Hyphens in names such as Pierre-Joseph
patterns.context: A hyphen connects double names or compound personal names in biographical or citation material.

patterns.name: man-apes compound expression
patterns.context: A hyphen connects man and apes, referring to prehistoric apes or ape-like figures.

patterns.name: man-made compound
patterns.context: man-made modifies disaster to indicate that it is human-caused; activation is concentrated near man and the hyphen.

patterns.name: Compound form in a brother-in-law designation
patterns.context: A hyphen forms the kinship term sister-in-law, appearing near personal narrative and direct quotation.

patterns.name: In-word letter fragments in Italian
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of Italian words, specifically mancato and patrimonio; this differs from the English hyphenated-compound pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on punctuation or conjunctions
patterns.context: In a few paragraphs, activation appears adjacent to the hyphen pattern or in ordinary syntactic positions, without a stable independent semantic condition.

3_704.description: 主要响应英语复合词、复合人名和称谓中的连字符，尤以 editor-in-chief、man-made、sister-in-law 等为例；另有意大利语词内片段及零星标点、连接词激活。第5段无清晰对应。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 出现在复合词或专名内部的连字符处，包括词内、称谓和亲属关系表达；常邻接字母或词片段。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、法律、议会及一般叙述文本

patterns.name: editor-in-chief 职称
patterns.context: 构成 editor-in-chief 职称，前后可接人物、机构或任职信息；连字符相关 token 激活最明显。
patterns.domain: 新闻人物简介、百科传记、问答文本

patterns.name: Pierre-Joseph 等人名中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接双名或复合人名，出现在传记或引文资料中。

patterns.name: man-apes 复合表达
patterns.context: 连字符连接 man 与 apes，指涉史前类人猿或人猿形象。
patterns.domain: 科幻作品介绍或历史叙述

patterns.name: man-made 复合词
patterns.context: man-made 修饰灾难，表示人为造成；激活标记集中在 man 与连字符附近。

patterns.name: 妹夫称谓中的复合形式
patterns.context: 连字符构成 sister-in-law 亲属称谓，出现在人物叙事和直接引语附近。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语词的内部片段上，分别属于 mancato、patrimonio；与英语复合词连字符模式不同。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语文本

patterns.name: 标点或连接词的零星激活
patterns.context: 少数段落中邻接连字符模式或出现在普通句法位置，缺少稳定的独立语义条件。

en.concept: Sporadic word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are distributed across different word fragments, common function words, punctuation, and legal formatting markers; a clearer local recurrence is the Become word form (1, 2, 6). The rest are mostly sporadic triggers in specific genres, and legal passages do not share a single lexical item.

patterns.name: BecomeActive method name
patterns.context: Appears in the iOS application lifecycle callback `applicationDidBecomeActive`; two code comments are adjacent to the method declaration.
patterns.domain: Github / Objective-C API documentation and code

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: In Portuguese academic texts, activation falls within or near the boundaries of multiple words, such as `instituição`, `ensino`, `áreas`, `formação`, `apesar`, `serem`, and `espaço`; there is no clear shared word meaning.

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical substance names
patterns.context: Occurs in names of radioactive-labeled transition metals and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, parentheses, and conjunctions, involving chemical substances and experimental descriptions.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter / Soil and environmental chemistry research

patterns.name: Common function words and list punctuation in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of city council hearings and public comments, especially articles, prepositions, numerals, and parenthetical dashes.

patterns.name: Become word form
patterns.context: Appears in the imperative `Become a new land...`; the initial fragment is unmarked. Shares a word-form fragment with Become in the application callback, but the contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / Tourism or wine promotional prose

patterns.name: Coordination and editor-in-chief phrases
patterns.context: One instance is a coordinating conjunction and adverb in a spoken quotation; another falls in the title phrase `editor-in-chief of`; local triggers are sporadic.

patterns.name: Judgment formatting, people, and list markers
patterns.context: Appears in court judgment declarations, explanations of the judicial panel, and case body text, including court formatting, articles, conjunctions, punctuation, and party designations.

patterns.name: Temporal prepositional phrases and lists in legal provisions
patterns.context: Involves term start dates and legal explanations preceding elections; activation is distributed across time expressions, articles, proper names, and punctuation in lists of officials.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / Election and public-office tenure legal texts

patterns.name: Titles and role markers in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Appears in case numbers, judge lists, and party designations in federal appellate cases; activation involves formatting punctuation, titles, and legal role terms.

3_704.description: 激活分散于不同词片、常见功能词、标点及法律格式标记；较明确的局部重复是 Become 词形（1、2、6）。其余多为特定文体中的零散触发，法律段落内部也不共享单一词项。

patterns.name: BecomeActive 方法名
patterns.context: 出现在 iOS 应用生命周期回调 `applicationDidBecomeActive` 中；两段代码注释和方法声明相邻。
patterns.domain: Github / Objective-C API 文档与代码

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语学术文本中，激活落在多个词的内部或词边界附近，如 `instituição`、`ensino`、`áreas`、`formação`、`apesar`、`serem`、`espaço`；没有明显共同词义。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers / 葡萄牙语学术摘要

patterns.name: 化学物质名称中的片段
patterns.context: 位于放射性标记过渡金属和多环芳烃名称、括号及连接词中，涉及化学物质与实验描述。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter / 土壤与环境化学研究

patterns.name: 法律文本中的常见功能词及列表标点
patterns.context: 出现在市议会听证与公众意见叙述中，尤其是冠词、介词、数量词及插入语破折号。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 项目规划法律材料

patterns.name: Become 词形
patterns.context: 出现在祈使句 `Become a new land...` 中，词首未标记；与应用回调中的 Become 共享词形片段，但语境不同。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / 旅游或葡萄酒宣传 prose

patterns.name: 并列与编辑职衔短语
patterns.context: 一处为口语引语中的并列连词和副词，另一处落在 `editor-in-chief of` 职衔短语；局部触发较零散。

patterns.name: 判决书格式、人物与列举标记
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决书的判决宣告、合议法官说明和案件正文中，包含法庭格式、冠词、连接词、标点及当事人称谓。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的时间介词短语与列举
patterns.context: 涉及任期起始时间及选举前的法律说明，激活分布在时间表达、冠词、专名和官员列举标点上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 选举与公职任期法律文本

patterns.name: 上诉判决的标题与角色标记
patterns.context: 出现在联邦上诉案件的案号、法官名单和诉讼当事人称谓中，激活涉及排版标点、职衔及法律角色词。

en.description: Mainly sensitive to reflexive pronouns itself/themselves near copular verbs and relative structures in English expository text; also activates on in-word fragments in French and Portuguese, and on local substrings in code identifiers and abbreviations. The latter categories are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns itself/themselves
patterns.context: In English sentences, the reflexive pronoun itself or emphatic reflexive forms often appear after copular verbs or relative clauses; they can also occur in the structure “which itself comprises”.
patterns.domain: English explanatory texts, including medical, patent, healthcare-insurance, and technical materials

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments in French
patterns.context: French words are split into subwords; activation falls on in-word fragments. Segment 2 particularly involves apostrophe, word-final, and hyphenated segmentation.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: Fragments within Portuguese words are marked, distributed across fragments resulting from word-form or affix segmentation.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal substring of the camel-case identifier “applicationDidBecomeActive”, rather than on a complete word.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in abbreviations
patterns.context: A middle-letter fragment of the uppercase abbreviation “UBER” is marked; nearby is an IRS case description in a court document.

3_704.description: 主要对英语说明文中系动词、关系结构附近的反身代词 itself/themselves 敏感；另对法语、葡语词内片段及代码标识符、缩写中的局部子串有激活，后几类与主模式难以统一。

patterns.name: 反身代词 itself/themselves
patterns.trigger: “the patients are themselves infertile” [1]；“rollers are themselves” [3]；“which itself comprises” [8]；“capsules are themselves held” [8]；“authorities are themselves responsible” [6]；“which are themselves already far lower” [5]
patterns.context: 英语句中，反身代词自身或带有反身强调意味的形式，常位于系动词或关系从句之后；也可出现在“which itself comprises”结构中。
patterns.domain: 医学、专利、医保、技术说明等英语说明性文本

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语词被分词标注拆开，激活落在词内片段；第2段尤其涉及撇号、词尾及连字符拆分。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词内部片段被标记，分布于词形或词缀拆分后的片段中。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在驼峰式标识符“applicationDidBecomeActive”中的内部子串，而非完整单词。

patterns.name: 缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 大写缩写“UBER”中间的字母片段被标记；附近是法庭文书中的 IRS 案件描述。

en.description: Activations are distributed across in-word fragments in multiple languages, English become, common conjunctions, and fixed phrases, proper names, and layout in legal documents; there are also sporadic word fragments in medical sentences. No unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in English become
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within become/becomes in an Objective-C lifecycle method, prose, and philosophical discussion; there is no single word sense or syntactic environment.

patterns.name: English function-word fragments
patterns.context: Between party designations in legal documents; only two instances, with activation on fragments within common conjunctions.

patterns.name: Fragments in a specific English phrase
patterns.context: The fixed legal expression “hereinafter referred to as” introduces an abbreviated party designation; markers are distributed across multiple words in the phrase.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in French
patterns.context: In the same French passage, multiple in-word subword fragments are marked, including devoir, primait, tiens, ému, ont; no consistent lexical or syntactic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Spanish
patterns.context: In a Spanish legal/trade passage, in-word fragments in multiple words are marked, such as mercados, noviembre, Europeo, eran, Derecho; there is no single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Proper names and layout fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized proper names, numbers, punctuation, and formatted legal designations in court headings or party sections; some triggers overlap with the “and” pattern in [6] and [9].
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and formatted case files

patterns.name: Word fragments in reproductive medicine sentences
patterns.context: Institutional abbreviation fragments and common words are marked in medical sentences about IVF, embryo transfer, and patient outcomes; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

3_704.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段、英语 become、常见连接词，以及法律文书的固定短语、专名和版式；另有医学句中的零散词片段。没有统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语 become 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 become/becomes 的词内，见于 Objective-C 生命周期方法、散文及哲学论述；不是单一词义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、葡萄酒宣传散文、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词片段
patterns.context: 法律文书中的当事人称谓之间；仅两例，激活落在常见连接词内部。

patterns.name: 英语特定短语片段
patterns.context: 法律文本用固定表达“hereinafter referred to as”引入当事人的简称；各标记分布在短语中的多个词。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 同一法语句段中多个词内子词片段被标记，包括 devoir、primait、tiens、ému、ont；未见一致的词义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语法律/贸易句段中，多个词的词内片段被标记，如 mercados、noviembre、Europeo、eran、Derecho；未见单一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 专名与排版片段
patterns.context: 法院抬头或诉讼当事人栏中的大写专名、数字、标点及格式化法律称谓；部分触发与[6]、[9]中的“and”模式重合。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决书及版式化案卷

patterns.name: 生殖医学句内词片段
patterns.context: 关于 IVF、胚胎移植及患者结局的医学句子中，机构缩写片段和普通词均被标记；没有明显统一的语义触发条件。

en.concept: English state or transition expressions and multilingual word fragments
en.description: The main pattern is English was now, describing a new state of a person or institution; there are also multilingual in-word fragments, comes within becomes, and mean in patent definition sentences, none of which can be grouped under the same clear trigger condition.

patterns.name: now after an English be-verb
patterns.context: In English sentences, now usually follows was and describes a change in a person's identity or an institution's state; now may be followed by an identity, state, or judgment.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in inflected forms
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are often word endings, affixes, or internal portions of Spanish, French, or Romanian words; there is no clear shared meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in English comes
patterns.context: English comes is embedded in becomes; both instances describe a result or change of identity, but activation falls on an in-word fragment.
patterns.domain: Religious book introductions, business news headlines

patterns.name: mean in patent definitions
patterns.context: Patent text uses shall mean to introduce a term's definition.

3_704.concept: 英语状态或转变表达及多语词片段
3_704.description: 主要模式是英语 was now，描述人物或机构的新状态；另有跨语种词内片段、becomes 中的 comes，以及专利定义句中的 mean，均无法归为同一明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语 be 动词后的 now
patterns.context: 英文句子中，通常在 was 后接 now，叙述人物身份或机构状态的变化；now 后可接身份、状态或判断。

patterns.name: 屈折形式中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发片段常是西班牙语、法语或罗马尼亚语词语的词尾、词缀或词内部分；没有明显统一的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 英语 comes 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «comes»，出现在“Be«comes» F«lesh»”和“As Former State Health Official Be«comes» CEO”
patterns.context: 英语 comes 嵌在 becomes 中；两处都描述某种结果或身份转变，但激活落在词内片段上。
patterns.domain: 宗教书籍介绍、商业新闻标题

patterns.name: 专利定义语中的 mean
patterns.context: 专利文本以 shall mean 引出术语的定义。

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and high-frequency words
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual in-word subwords, inflectional suffixes, and high-frequency small words; a few English commas and phrases also activate. Although many occur in Romance-language texts, trigger positions and functions vary considerably, making it difficult to assign a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish progressive/continuous forms
patterns.context: Spanish verbs ending in -iendo/-endo express continuity or progression; they appear respectively in «Siendo, como fue» and «se puede ... lo siguió siendo».

patterns.name: Romanian verb inflection fragments
patterns.context: In Romanian sentences, the stem is adjacent to verb inflection or in-word spelling fragments; example sentences discuss taking measures and having to do something.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation fragments in Romance languages
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous subword fragments within different Romance-language words or inflected forms; these examples do not share a clear meaning or grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Spanish, Romanian, Italian, and French, including Romanian parliamentary texts

patterns.name: English function words and common-word fragments
patterns.context: In English sentences, activation falls on common function words, prepositions, or phrase fragments; appears in discussions of particle transitions and legal insurance texts.

patterns.name: Short fragments in non-English political texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments in Italian parliamentary speech, with no clear semantic trigger shared with other fragments.

patterns.name: English parenthetical punctuation and phrases
patterns.context: Commas and phrase fragments activate in English sentences; appears in a discussion of cognitive uncertainty and may be unrelated to other in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Punctuation and continuation of proper names in legal names
patterns.context: In legal cases, the current name follows an insurance company name; activation is concentrated on the comma and the name-introduction phrase.

patterns.name: Cross-language high-frequency small words or suffix fragments
patterns.context: In several Spanish, Romanian, Italian, and French contexts, high-frequency conjunctions, articles, or short-word fragments are marked; they are distributed across languages, with no stable shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual philosophy, parliamentary, and legal texts

3_704.concept: 多语种子词片段与高频词
3_704.description: 激活分散在多语种词内子词、屈折尾缀及高频小词上；少量英语逗号和短语也激活。虽多见于罗曼语文本，但触发位置和功能差异很大，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 西班牙语持续体/进行形式
patterns.context: 西班牙语动词以 -iendo/-endo 结尾，表示持续或进行；分别出现在「Siendo, como fue」和「se puede ... lo siguió siendo」。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语动词屈折片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句中，词干与动词屈折或词内部分拼写片段相邻；例句谈论采取措施、必须去做。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语发言

patterns.name: 罗曼语系词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同罗曼语词汇或屈折形式内部的连续子词片段；这些例子并不共享一个明确的词义或语法功能。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语、法语及罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词与常用词片段
patterns.trigger: 「« is»」「« are»」「to« a»」「« by»」「« now»」「known« as»」
patterns.context: 英语句子中，激活落在常见功能词、介词或短语片段；出现于粒子转变论述和法律保险文本。
patterns.domain: 英语哲学论述、法律判例

patterns.name: 非英语政治文本中的短片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语议会发言的词内片段，缺少与其他片段共有的明显语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 英语插入语标点及短语
patterns.context: 英语句中逗号和短语片段激活；出现在对认知不确定性的论述中，可能与其他词内片段无关。

patterns.name: 法律名称中的标点与专名续接
patterns.context: 法律判例中保险公司名称之后接续其现用名称，激活集中于逗号及名称介绍短语。

patterns.name: 跨语言高频小词或词尾片段
patterns.context: 若干西班牙语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语和法语语境中，高频连接词、冠词或短词片段被标记；跨语言分布广，未见稳定共同语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种哲学、议会及法律文本

en.description: The strongest shared clues are the ending of Spanish siendo and English now; the remaining activations are distributed across multilingual word endings, in-word fragments, and punctuation, including a possibly corrupted escape string in a patent. They are difficult to group into a single semantic or genre pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix of siendo
patterns.context: The Spanish gerund of ser, «siendo», appears at the beginning of a sentence in «Siendo, como fue», in descriptions of a continuing state in «siguió siéndo», and in «continúa siendo».

patterns.name: Word boundary of now
patterns.context: In English, now appears after noun or verb phrases to indicate a current state or identity: «now known as» and «was now officially reckoned».

patterns.name: Portuguese verb endings
patterns.context: One token covers the ending of «tendo»; another covers the Romanian reflexive-pronoun structure «să-și folosească».
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Portuguese and Romanian

patterns.name: French future-tense ending
patterns.context: ser-ont after mercure forms the future tense in «seront applicables»; high activation falls on the ending ont.

patterns.name: Escaped angle-bracket characters
patterns.context: A byte string resembling UTF-8/HTML escaping or corruption appears in patent text, embedded around the term crude ketone.

patterns.name: Comma and following text
patterns.context: In a philosophical English sentence, a comma is followed by by no means; in a legal sentence, a comma precedes a company name and now known as.

patterns.name: In-word character fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments in Romanian, Turkish, or words with special characters; no shared meaning or stable syntactic position is evident.

patterns.name: Residual activations without a clear common trigger
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across different languages and in-word positions; the available fragments are insufficient to determine a more specific shared condition.

3_704.description: 最强共同线索是西语 siendo 的词尾和英语 now；其余激活分散于多语种词尾、词内片段及标点，包含专利中的疑似损坏转义串，难以归为单一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: siendo 的后缀
patterns.context: 西班牙语中动词 ser 的 gerundio「siendo」，分别出现在句首「Siendo, como fue」、描述持续状态「siguió siéndo」及「continúa siendo」中。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学或学术论述

patterns.name: now 的词界
patterns.context: 英语中 now 出现在名词或动词短语之后，表示当前状态或身份：「now known as」「was now officially reckoned」。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词尾
patterns.context: 一个 token 覆盖「tendo」的结尾；另一个覆盖罗马尼亚语反身代词结构「să-și folosească」。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本，葡萄牙语及罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 法语未来时词尾
patterns.context: mercure 后的 ser-ont 构成将来时「seront applicables」，高激活落在词尾 ont。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会法语政策文本

patterns.name: 被转义的尖括号字符
patterns.context: 专利文本中出现类似 UTF-8/HTML 转义或损坏的字节串，嵌在 crude ketone 术语周围。

patterns.name: 逗号及后续语流
patterns.context: 哲学英语句中逗号后接 by no means；法律句中逗号位于公司名称和 now known as 之前。

patterns.name: 词内字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语、土耳其语或含特殊字符的词内片段，未见共同词义或稳定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: 缺乏明显统一触发的残余
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在不同语言及词内位置；现有片段不足以确定更具体的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、英语、葡萄牙语、罗马尼亚语、法语

en.description: The most stable trigger is the string “2002”, across biographical dates, literature citations, patent/copyright/experiment identifiers, and body text. A few numbers and King also show strong activation, but often co-occur with the year, so whether they are independent triggers is unclear.

patterns.name: Year 2002
patterns.context: The year string 2002 appears in dates, citations, identifiers, or body text; no fixed domain or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Hyphenated date ranges with 2002
patterns.context: 2002 is the starting year of a year range, followed by a hyphen and another year.

patterns.name: 2002 as a year in a date
patterns.context: The year appears in a person’s birth/death dates or in a date composed of year, month, and day.

patterns.name: 2002 as a publication year
patterns.context: The year is embedded in bibliographic or technical identifiers such as references, patent document numbers, URLs, or experiment labels.
patterns.domain: Academic literature, patents, software licenses, biomedical papers

patterns.name: 2002 as a point in time in body text
patterns.context: The year appears as a standalone time marker within or at the end of a sentence, rather than solely as a bibliographic identifier.

patterns.name: Year in a category heading
patterns.context: The year immediately follows an encyclopedia category label and marks a year of death.

patterns.name: King co-occurring with the year
patterns.context: The proper name King (including a person’s name or a category name) appears near 2002; it is unclear whether King is an independent trigger or merely co-occurs.

patterns.name: Year in a patent document number
patterns.context: The year field appears in a patent number; other numeric fragments in patent numbers containing 2002 also activate.

3_915.description: 最稳定的触发是字符串“2002”，横跨传记日期、文献引用、专利/版权/实验编号及正文时间。少数数字和 King 也有较强激活，但多与年份共现，是否独立触发不明。

patterns.name: 年份 2002
patterns.context: 年份字符串 2002 出现在日期、引用、标识符或正文中；无需固定领域或句法位置。

patterns.name: 2002 的连字符日期范围
patterns.context: 2002 作为年份区间的起始年份，后接连接号和另一年份。

patterns.name: 2002 作为日期中的年份
patterns.context: 年份处于人物生卒日期或年、月、日构成的日期中。

patterns.name: 2002 作为文献年份
patterns.trigger: «2002»10 出现在文献卷期、专利号、版权路径或研究编号中
patterns.context: 年份嵌在参考文献、专利文档编号、URL 或实验标记等书目/技术标识中。
patterns.domain: 学术文献、专利、软件许可、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 2002 作为正文时间点
patterns.context: 年份作为句中或句末的独立时间标记，而非纯书目编号。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的年份
patterns.context: 年份紧接百科分类标签，标记去世年份。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 King 与年份共现
patterns.context: 专名 King（包括人名或分类名）附近同时出现 2002；无法判断 King 是独立触发条件还是仅共现。

patterns.name: 专利文档编号中的年份
patterns.context: 专利号中年份字段出现，2002 所在专利号也有其他数字片段激活。

en.description: The clearest shared trigger is the numeric year 2002, appearing in biographical dates, references, emails, patent numbers, license URLs, probability problems, and legal citations. Other date or numeric structures may be related, but the evidence is weaker; this pattern is not seen in PubMed excerpts.

patterns.name: Occurrences of the year 2002
patterns.context: The year appears as a number in dates, eras, references, or legal citations; other years or identifiers often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including biographies, email, patents, software licenses, math problems, and legal texts

patterns.name: Variants of the year 2002 or adjacent date numbers
patterns.context: 2002 appears in a year range, a parenthesized era, a category label, or a date/number sequence; other excerpts highlight date numbers such as 1951 and 2003.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, references, patents, and legal texts

3_915.description: 最明确的共同触发是数字年份 2002，出现在传记日期、参考文献、邮件、专利号、许可网址、概率题和法规引文中。其他日期或数字结构可能相关，但证据较弱；PubMed 片段未见该模式。

patterns.name: 年份 2002 的出现
patterns.context: 年份作为日期、年代、参考文献或法规引文中的数字出现；周围常有其他年份或编号。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括传记、邮件、专利、软件许可、数学题和法律文本

patterns.name: 年份 2002 的变体或相邻日期数字
patterns.context: 2002 位于年份范围、括号中的年代、类别标签或日期／编号序列中；另有片段突出年份 1951、2003 等日期数字。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、参考文献、专利及法律文本

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and structural markers
en.description: Activation often falls on subword fragments of particular words and also appears in document structures such as headings, sections, notes, and definitions. Domains and semantics vary widely, so no single topic explains the pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names
patterns.context: Character or subword fragments in the names Devinen and Nehru are split into multiple tokens, with activation on the fragments; the fragments recur.

patterns.name: Fragments in censored profanity
patterns.context: In uppercase colloquial sentences, profanity and words related to “CAPS LOCK” are split into multiple tokens; activation concentrates on these fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in place names
patterns.context: In “Montenegrins” and its repeated forms, activation concentrates on tokenized fragments of the place name or demonym.

patterns.name: Medical terms and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In medical abstracts or papers, activation falls on technical terms, intraword fragments, or the beginning of section text; the sentences concern surgery, inflammation, or obesity.

patterns.name: Text structure and section markers
patterns.context: A newline and separator follow an Introduction heading and numbering in a paper; activation covers the structural markers and nearby section-opening text.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in headings and narrative text
patterns.context: English words and foreign words/proper names in headings or body text are split into subwords; activation is distributed across the fragments.

patterns.name: Code comments and license text
patterns.context: In asterisk-delimited comments at the beginning of code files, activation falls on uppercase notices or license names.

patterns.name: Punctuation and term fragments in definitions
patterns.context: In dictionary-style or database-style definitions, tokenized field labels and abbreviations/terms in parentheses activate.

patterns.name: Fragments of psychology construct terms
patterns.context: In an academic title developing an account of novelty and pleasure evaluation, activation falls on construct nouns.

3_915.description: 激活常落在特定词语的子词切分片段上，也见于标题、章节、注释和定义等文档结构；领域与语义差异很大，无法由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 人名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 名字 Devinen、Nehru 的字符或子词片段被切成多个 token，激活落在片段上；片段重复出现。

patterns.name: 被遮掩的粗俗词中的片段
patterns.context: 大写口语句中，粗俗词与“CAPS LOCK”相关词被拆分成多个 token；激活集中在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 地名中的子词片段
patterns.context: “Montenegrins”及其重复形式中，激活集中在地名或国民称谓的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 医学术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要或论文中，激活落在专业词、词内切分片段或章节正文起始处；所处句子涉及手术、炎症或肥胖。

patterns.name: 文本结构与章节标记
patterns.context: 论文的 Introduction 标题和编号之后出现换行、分隔线；激活覆盖结构标记及附近章节起始内容。

patterns.name: 标题及叙事文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标题或正文中的英语词及外来语/专名被拆成子词；激活分布在片段上。

patterns.name: 代码注释和许可证文本
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的星号分隔注释中，激活落在全大写提示语或许可证名称上。

patterns.name: 定义文本中的标点和术语片段
patterns.context: 词典式或数据库式定义中，字段标签和括号内缩写/术语的切分 token 激活。

patterns.name: 心理学构念词的片段
patterns.context: 关于新奇性与愉悦评价逐步展开的学术标题中，激活落在构念名词上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical sets and cardinality statements, code elements/fields and event callbacks, paper structure and citations, uppercase angry statements, and botanical garden event descriptions. There is insufficient evidence to group these triggers into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sets and object cardinality in mathematical text
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions or discussion describe finite sets, numbers of elements, roots, or subsets; set and root contexts also appear in unmarked portions.

patterns.name: Structured fields or members in code and technical documents
patterns.context: Code or markup languages contain elements, fields, object members, or type definitions; activation is distributed over identifiers and nearby tokens.
