patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and technical documents

patterns.name: Interactive events and callbacks in code examples
patterns.context: Code or Q&A examples involve click events, callback functions, or element selection; activation falls on local code structures and adjacent markers.

patterns.name: Uppercase emphasis
patterns.context: An entire sentence uses uppercase letters to express a strong command or complaint; activation is distributed over uppercase word fragments.

patterns.name: Botanical garden event description
patterns.context: Describes summer talks or events about plants in Houston, mentioning whether plants can survive and grow.

patterns.name: Paper structure and literature citations
patterns.context: Introduces related work or paper structure in an academic paper.

3_915.description: 激活分散于数学集合与基数表述、代码中的元素/字段和事件回调、论文结构与引用、大写怒斥及植物园活动介绍；没有足够证据将这些触发归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的集合与对象基数
patterns.context: 数学定义或论述中，描述有限集合、元素数量、根或子集；未标记部分也出现集合与根的语境。

patterns.name: 代码与技术文档中的结构化字段或成员
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中出现 element、字段、对象成员或类型定义；激活分布在标识符及其附近。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与技术文档

patterns.name: 代码示例中的交互事件与回调
patterns.context: 代码或问答示例涉及点击事件、回调函数或元素选择；激活落在局部代码结构及相邻标记上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、JavaScript 示例

patterns.name: 大写强调语气
patterns.context: 整句以大写字母表达强烈命令或抱怨；激活分布在大写词语片段。

patterns.name: 植物园活动介绍
patterns.context: 介绍休斯敦夏季植物相关讲座或活动，提及植物能否存活及生长。

patterns.name: 论文结构与文献引用
patterns.context: 学术论文中介绍相关研究或论文结构。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the “depos” subword fragment within “depositing”, across patent, forum, and paper contexts, often involving films, materials, or surface fabrication. Weaker or separate activation also appears in capacitance terminology and LaTeX formula environments.

patterns.name: Split stem in “depositing”
patterns.context: Activation is adjacent to the subword fragment “depos”, occurring within the word “depositing”; an object or prepositional phrase often follows.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, materials and device fabrication; also forum discussions and paper abstracts

patterns.name: Capacitance-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions of capacitive sensing, pressure-change measurement, and membrane structures; activation here is weaker than in the “depos” pattern.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, sensors and measurement electronics

patterns.name: Formula formatting and conditional probability notation
patterns.context: Occurs in a LaTeX math environment, with activation distributed around formula commands, brackets, and symbols; the substring “depos” is absent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math or machine learning papers

3_915.description: 主要对单词“depositing”内部的“depos”子词片段强烈响应，跨专利、论坛及论文语境，常与薄膜、材料或表面制造有关；另有电容术语和LaTeX公式环境中的较弱或独立激活。

patterns.name: “depositing”的拆分词干
patterns.context: 激活紧邻子词片段“depos”，出现在“depositing”这一词的内部；周围常接宾语或介词短语。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、材料与器件制造，也见于论坛讨论和论文摘要

patterns.name: 电容相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现在描述电容传感、压力变化测量及膜结构的技术说明中；此处激活弱于“depos”模式。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，传感器与测量电子学

patterns.name: 公式排版与条件概率记号
patterns.context: 处于 LaTeX 数学公式环境中，触发分布在公式命令、括号和符号附近；未见“depos”子串。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或机器学习论文

en.concept: Frequent structures and phrasing in academic text
en.description: Activation is distributed across English function words and academic sentence patterns, formula symbols, medical paper title phrasing, and patent terminology, project text, and philosophical discussion. No single stable content-word topic is apparent.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase frames
patterns.context: Frequent function words in common English grammatical frames; sometimes adjacent to specific academic nouns.

patterns.name: Numerical values, formulas, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions or symbolic discussion, activation falls on formula symbols or short tokens in mathematical contexts.
patterns.domain: StackExchange math Q&A, math papers, and mathematical discussion

patterns.name: Medical terminology and title-style phrasing
patterns.context: Medical topic nouns or paper title/abstract-style phrases; some activation concentrates on prepositions and title phrasing.

patterns.name: Research and public institution phrasing
patterns.context: Describes cutting-edge research or the purpose of strengthening institutional capacity or projects.

patterns.name: Specific rare proper names or compound terms
patterns.context: In patent background sentences, activation falls on uncommon shape descriptions and engineering material nouns; triggers are difficult to reconcile with those in other passages.

patterns.name: Philosophical discussion and explanatory asides
patterns.context: Discussion compares theoretical superiority and introduces an explanation with “i.e.”; activation is distributed across comparative phrases, asides, and ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Generic academic definition phrasing
patterns.context: Introduces a mathematical object by defining it or describing its origin or theoretical use; the specific terms themselves are not consistent strong triggers.

3_915.concept: 学术文本中的高频结构与措辞
3_915.description: 激活分布在英语功能词和学术句式、公式符号、医学论文标题措辞，以及专利术语、项目文本和哲学论述等处；未见单一稳定的内容词主题。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语框架
patterns.context: 常见英语语法框架中的高频功能词；有时与具体学术名词相邻

patterns.name: 数值、公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或符号化论述中，激活落在公式组成符号或数学语境中的简短词元
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、数学论文及数学论述

patterns.name: 医学论文术语与标题式短语
patterns.context: 医学主题名词或论文标题、摘要式短语；部分激活集中在介词和标题措辞
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、医学相关材料

patterns.name: 研究与公共机构措辞
patterns.context: 描述发展前沿研究、提升机构能力的目的或项目表述

patterns.name: 具体罕见专名或复合术语
patterns.context: 专利背景句中，激活落在不常见的形状描述及工程材料名词；与其他段的触发难以归并

patterns.name: 哲学论述及解释性插入语
patterns.context: 比较理论优越性并以“i.e.”引出解释的论述；激活分布在比较短语、插入语及普通功能词上

patterns.name: 通用学术定义措辞
patterns.context: 以定义、来源或理论用途介绍数学对象；具体术语本身并非一致的强触发项

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and numbering patterns
en.description: Activation is scattered across English function words and intraword fragments, Portuguese/French word fragments, and numbers, identifiers, and citation markers in scientific text. A few i fragments occur in words expressing unease or research mechanisms, but cross-language and cross-domain evidence is insufficient to treat them as a unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: “i” in words related to questions or anxiety
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword letter fragment; the word often expresses unease, worry, or inquiry, but also occurs in technical terms, so semantics alone cannot explain it.
patterns.domain: Portuguese opinion and political texts, English scientific/medical texts

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings in technical text
patterns.context: Appears in sequence coordinates, reference numbers, measurement ranges, or quantified patent units in scientific papers; the marker covers part of a mixed alphanumeric string.

patterns.name: English function words and their tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Appears as a function word or phrase component in English sentences; activation within the same passage is not restricted to a particular semantic role and may reflect an independent high-frequency word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, forum, and scientific text

patterns.name: Tokenized English intraword and word-final fragments
patterns.context: The marker crosses or falls at subword boundaries, with inconsistent morphological positions; no shared semantic condition explains all examples.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, patents, forums, and scientific text

patterns.name: Citation or reference markers attached to numbers
patterns.context: Activation is embedded in bracketed citation markers or similar reference numbers in papers, often mixing digits, hyphens, and letters.

patterns.name: A fragment expressing concern in a French word
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses the precarious situation of Portuguese workers; multiple markers fall within different words, and only inquiétante is clearly related to the meaning of worry.
patterns.domain: French speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Intraword letter fragments in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Appears in a Portuguese passage about young philosophers wanting to be heard; markers are scattered across multiple words, some related to unease, but there is no unified word-form or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Unclassified local word-form activations
patterns.context: The words belong to different syntactic and thematic contexts; beyond English word forms or scientific contexts, there is insufficient evidence for a more specific shared trigger pattern.

3_915.concept: 混合词片段与编号模式
3_915.description: 激活散布于英语功能词与词内片段、葡萄牙语/法语词片段，以及科学文本中的数字、编号和引文标记。少数 i 片段落在表示不安或研究机制的词中，但跨语种、跨领域证据不足以将其视为统一语义特征。

patterns.name: 疑问、焦虑相关词中的「i」
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的字母片段；所在词常表达不安、担忧或探究，但也见于技术术语，不能只归结为词义
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议论与政治文本、英语科学/医学文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的数字与字母串
patterns.context: 出现在科学论文的序列坐标、参考文献编号、测量范围或专利量化单位中；标记覆盖的是混合数字与字母串的一部分

patterns.name: 英语功能词及其分词片段
patterns.trigger: « to»、« of»、« the»、« for»、« from»、« absolutely»、« nothing» 等
patterns.context: 在英语句子中作为虚词或短语组成部分出现；同一段内激活并不局限于特定语义角色，可能是独立的高频词形模式
patterns.domain: 英语百科、论坛与科学文本

patterns.name: 英语词内分词与词尾片段
patterns.context: 标记跨越或落在词的子词边界处，形态位置不一致；未见能解释全部词例的共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 英语百科、专利、论坛及科学文本

patterns.name: 数字附带的引文或参考标记
patterns.context: 激活嵌在论文的方括号引文标识或类似文献编号中，常与数字、连字符及字母混排

patterns.name: 法语词中表示忧虑的片段
patterns.trigger: «i»«ét»«5» 位于 «inquiétante»；另有 «milli»、«travaille» 等词片段
patterns.context: 法语句子谈及葡萄牙工人的不稳定处境；多个标记落在不同词内，只有 inquiétante 与忧虑语义较明确相关

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语关于年轻哲学家渴望被倾听的段落；标记分散于多个词，部分词涉及不安，但没有统一词形或语义触发条件

patterns.name: 未能归入的局部词形激活
patterns.context: 词项分属不同句法和主题；除了英语词形或科学语境外，没有足够证据支持更具体的共同触发模式

en.description: Activation covers olfaction-related words, gut/gastrointestinal words, and fragments related to wood texture, fatty acid oxidation, and a protein family; these signals span multiple biomedical topics and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Olfaction-related words
patterns.context: The word appears in contexts involving olfactory input, olfactory perception, or the name of an olfaction-related tumor; the trigger does not depend on a single context.

patterns.name: Gut and gastrointestinal terms
patterns.context: Describes gut homeostasis, defense, microbes, or gastrointestinal tissue; also includes contexts involving stomach lesions.

patterns.name: Touch and wood stimuli
patterns.context: Co-occurs with touching wood, tactile stimulation, and its physiological effects on the human body.

patterns.name: Fatty acids and β-oxidation
patterns.context: Involves fatty acid composition, isomer degradation, or β-oxidation; the strong trigger may be a tokenized string fragment.

patterns.name: Fragment with unclear trigger
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a protein family signature pattern; the local context provided shows no stable connection to the other strong triggers.

3_915.description: 激活覆盖嗅觉相关词、肠道/胃肠道词，以及木材触觉、脂肪酸氧化和一个蛋白质家族词片段；这些信号跨多个生物医学主题，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 嗅觉相关词
patterns.context: 该词出现在嗅觉输入、嗅觉感知或嗅觉相关肿瘤名称中；触发不依赖单一语境。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、嗅觉生理、肿瘤医学

patterns.name: 肠道与胃肠道
patterns.context: 描述肠道稳态、防御、微生物或胃肠道组织；也包括胃部病变语境。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、胃肠病学、肿瘤病理

patterns.name: 触觉与木材刺激
patterns.context: 与触摸木材、触觉刺激及其对人体的生理效应同现。

patterns.name: 脂肪酸及β-氧化
patterns.context: 涉及脂肪酸组成、异构体降解或β-氧化；强触发词可能是分词后的字符串片段。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、昆虫嗅觉生理

patterns.name: 触发依据不明的片段
patterns.context: 在蛋白质家族签名模式描述中出现；给出的局部上下文未显示与其他强触发词的稳定联系。

en.concept: Medical terms and specific word-form fragments
en.description: Activation concentrates on medical terms and their intraword fragments: gut/intestinal mucosa, hyaluronidase, and punctal atresia; it also responds to fragments in obfuscation and sporadic forum text. The triggers do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: “intestinal mucosa” terminology
patterns.context: “intestinal” is adjacent to “mucosa” in descriptions of intestinal mucosa and its inflammation or TNFα levels; activation falls on intestinal.

patterns.name: Intestinal and digestive system terminology
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of intestinal disease symptoms, complications, or anatomy; includes intestinal stenosis and ileus.

patterns.name: Hyaluronidase-related word form
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of hyaluronidase, in descriptions of enzyme purification and allergic reactions.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in obfuscation
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of obfuscation or obfuscated, in contexts involving code obfuscation or information concealment.

patterns.name: Punctal atresia term fragment
patterns.context: An intraword fragment forms part of punctal atresia, in descriptions of eyelid- and tarsus-related disorders.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in DiThi
patterns.context: Appears in a username or identifier in a HackerNews post; the surrounding content discusses plant protein and health.

patterns.name: Local activation on initial this
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a HackerNews excerpt, followed by a period and newline separator; the subsequent content has a different topic.

patterns.name: Developmental timing word
patterns.context: Describes enzyme activity or a biological developmental process continuing over time; activation falls on throughout.

3_915.concept: 医学术语与特定词形片段
3_915.description: 激活集中于医学术语及其词内片段：肠道/肠黏膜、透明质酸酶、泪点闭锁；另对 obfuscation 及零散论坛文本片段响应。触发机制并非单一语义类别。

patterns.name: intestinal mucosa 术语
patterns.context: “intestinal”紧邻“mucosa”，描述肠黏膜及其炎症或 TNFα 水平；激活落在 intestinal 上
patterns.domain: 生物医学、消化道疾病与免疫学

patterns.name: 肠道及消化系统术语
patterns.context: 出现在肠病症状、并发症或解剖描述中；包括 intestinal stenosis、ileus 等

patterns.name: 透明质酸酶相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 hyaluronidase 的词内片段，分别处于酶纯化和过敏反应描述中
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医疗案例

patterns.name: obfuscation 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 obfuscation 或 obfuscated 的词内片段，语境涉及代码混淆或信息遮蔽

patterns.name: 泪点闭锁术语片段
patterns.context: 词内片段构成 punctal atresia，位于眼睑及睑板相关病变描述中

patterns.name: DiThi 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 帖子的用户名或标识符中，周围内容谈及植物蛋白及健康

patterns.name: 开头 this 的局部激活
patterns.context: 位于 HackerNews 片段开头，后接句点与换行分隔符；其后内容主题不同

patterns.name: 发育时序词
patterns.context: 描述酶活性或生物发育过程持续发生；激活落在 throughout

en.description: Primarily responds to the obfuscate word family and its split spellings, covering code obfuscation, information concealment, and concealed intent; activation also occurs on ic in silicone and f in roman à clef, possibly reflecting weak orthographic associations.

patterns.name: The obfuscate word family
patterns.context: The word describes code, intent, or information being concealed or confused; includes obfuscated code, obfuscate code, and government information obfuscation in a legal context.
patterns.domain: Programming discussions, comments, legal texts, and general online articles

patterns.name: Local trigger on the letter f
patterns.context: In excerpt 8, activation falls on ic within “silicone”; in excerpt 10, it falls on f in “clef”. Neither has a clear obfuscate-related meaning, so these may be secondary orthographic or tokenization triggers.

3_915.description: 主要响应 obfuscate 词族及其分片拼写，涵盖代码混淆、信息遮掩和隐瞒意图；另在 silicone 的 ic 与 roman à clef 的 f 处激活，可能是字形层面的弱关联。

patterns.name: obfuscate 词族
patterns.context: 词语用于描述代码、意图或信息被遮掩、混淆；包括被 obfuscated 的代码、obfuscate code，以及法律语境中的政府信息混淆。
patterns.domain: 编程讨论、评论、法律文本及一般网络文章

patterns.name: 字母 f 的局部触发
patterns.trigger: “polyamides”中的“f”并未出现；可见触发为“sil«ic»9one”中的 ic 片段及“roman a cle«f»9”中的 f
patterns.context: 第8段激活落在“silicone”内部的 ic；第10段落在“clef”中的 f，均没有明确的 obfuscate 词义语境，可能是次要的字形或分词触发。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本；文学评论

en.concept: Specialized word-internal fragments and sporadic word forms
en.description: Most activations occur on the ic fragment within medical, materials, and chemical terminology; others occur on local forms such as tarsus, terbinafine, bacterial names, and neuronal, as well as sporadic activations in villain-related commentary and entertainment narratives.

patterns.name: Word-internal ic fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur on the letter sequence ic inside English words, commonly in specialized terms containing ic; the word need not appear sentence-initially or in a particular syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Medical, materials science, and chemical terminology

patterns.name: ars/us fragments in medical words
patterns.context: Occur in subword fragments of “tarsus”; the context concerns the eyelid and eyelid margin.

patterns.name: Word fragments in negative-evaluation contexts
patterns.context: Warnings about playing villainous roles include negative evaluative terms such as bloody and vulgar; activations are distributed across multiple word fragments and adjacent function words.

patterns.name: is at the end of a plural or proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in a word fragment of the bacterial name “Capnocytophaga gingivalis”; there is insufficient evidence to identify an independent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of terbinafine
patterns.context: Activates in both occurrences of terbinafine; surrounding text discusses oral antifungal drugs and treatment of athlete’s foot.

patterns.name: you and say in colloquial phrasing
patterns.context: An entertainment narrative discusses actors’ commitment to a story and uses “Suffice it to say” to introduce a summary; this does not clearly match the other activation patterns.

patterns.name: neuronal in neuroscience
patterns.context: Describes coordination of upper- and lower-limb muscles and neural control; activations concentrate on fragments of terms such as neuronal and interlimb.

patterns.name: Common sentence-initial function words and research phrasing
patterns.context: Activates in the academic formula “the best of our knowledge” and the following text; this may be a phrase-specific phenomenon.

patterns.name: Local fragments not assignable to the patterns above
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of “dihedral angle”; the available fragment is insufficient to determine whether it represents an independent lexical or semantic pattern.

3_915.concept: 专业词内部片段与零散词形
3_915.description: 激活多数落在医学、材料与化学术语内部的 ic 片段；另有 tarsus、terbinafine、细菌名、neuronal 等局部词形，以及反派评论和娱乐叙述中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内碎片 ic
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词内部的 ic 字母片段，常见于含 ic 的专业术语；不要求该词出现在句首或特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 医学、材料科学及化学术语

patterns.name: 医学词中的 ars/us 片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 “tarsus” 一词跨 token 的片段中，语境涉及眼睑和睑缘。

patterns.name: 负面评价语境中的词片段
patterns.context: 围绕扮演反派角色的警告，出现血腥、粗俗等负面评价词；激活分布在多个词片段及相邻功能词上。

patterns.name: 复数或专名末尾的 is
patterns.context: 出现在细菌名称 “Capnocytophaga gingivalis” 的词内片段，未见足够证据确定其独立触发条件。

patterns.name: terbinafine 词内片段
patterns.context: 在两次出现的 terbinafine 中激活，周边讨论口服抗真菌药及足癣治疗。

patterns.name: 口语句式中的 you 与 say
patterns.context: 娱乐性叙述中谈演员对故事的投入，并以 “Suffice it to say” 引出总结；与其他激活模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 神经科学中的 neuronal
patterns.context: 描述上下肢肌肉协调及神经控制，激活集中在 neuronal 和 interlimb 等术语片段。

patterns.name: 句首常见功能词及研究措辞
patterns.context: 在 “the best of our knowledge” 这一论文惯用语及其后续表述中激活；可能是短语特定现象。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “dihedral angle” 一词开头，当前片段不足以确认是否为独立词汇或语义模式。

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments inside segmented words, across domains and without a unified semantics. More prominent local clusters include silic-, terbinafine, recipe words, laboratory instrument terms, and ophthalmic terminology, alongside sporadic function words.

patterns.name: b or following word fragments in words containing b
patterns.context: Activations usually fall on annotated fragments within segmented words rather than stable complete words; fragments may occur at the beginning, middle, or end of a word, with no consistent syntactic or semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Mixed domains: architecture, medicine, chemistry, cooking, software, neuroscience, etc.

patterns.name: silic-related word fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments “Sil” and “ic” are marked in words referring to silicone, silica, or containing silicon; they occur across different word forms, word boundaries, and contexts.
patterns.domain: Patent materials, medical research, chemistry and materials science

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of terbinafine
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments of the drug name terbinafine are marked consecutively, especially b and ina, in the context of research on oral antifungal drugs.

patterns.name: Fragments of cooking steps and ingredient words
patterns.context: In imperative recipe text, fragments of action words and herb and spice names are marked; activations are not limited to any one ingredient.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to discrete analyzers
patterns.context: Fragments of instrument names or terms activate in descriptions of assay range and analyzer performance.

patterns.name: Eyelid and lacrimal-duct terminology fragments
patterns.context: In ophthalmic case discussions, word-internal fragments of anatomical terms and punctal atresia are marked.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of pain
patterns.context: In a discussion of software tools, pain and the nearby line break activate in the phrase “figuring out the magic combination 很麻烦”.

patterns.name: General function-word fragments
patterns.context: These common words occur sporadically in different syntactic positions. Their intensity is usually lower than the peaks of word-internal fragments, and they show no stable domain or semantic condition.

3_915.description: 激活多落在被切分词内部的字母片段，跨领域且缺少统一语义；较明显的局部聚类包括 silic-、terbinafine、食谱词、检验仪器词及眼科术语，另有零散功能词。

patterns.name: 含 b 的词中 b 或其后续词片段
patterns.context: 激活通常落在被拆分标注的词内片段，而非稳定的完整词；片段可能处于词首、词中或词尾，未见一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域混合：建筑、医学、化学、烹饪、软件、神经科学等

patterns.name: silic-相关词片段
patterns.context: 在硅酮、二氧化硅或含 silicon 的词中，词内片段“Sil”“ic”被标记；不同词形、词界和上下文均出现。
patterns.domain: 专利材料、医学研究、化学与材料科学

patterns.name: terbinafine 词内片段
patterns.context: 药物名称 terbinafine 的词内片段被连续标记，尤其是 b 与 ina；处于口服抗真菌药研究语境。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤及食材词片段
patterns.context: 祈使式食谱文字中，动作词及香草、香料名称的部分词片段被标记；激活并不局限于单一食材。

patterns.name: 离散分析仪相关词片段
patterns.context: 围绕 assay range 与分析仪性能描述时，仪器名称或术语的片段激活。

patterns.name: 眼睑与泪道术语片段
patterns.context: 眼科病例讨论中，解剖部位及术语 punctal atresia 的词内片段被标记。

patterns.name: pain 的词内片段
patterns.context: 软件工具讨论中，表达“figuring out the magic combination 很麻烦”时，pain 及邻近换行处激活。

patterns.name: 通用功能词片段
patterns.context: 这些常见词在不同句法位置零散出现，强度通常低于词内片段的峰值，未显示稳定的领域或语义条件。

en.description: The most stable pattern is to following pain/painful, covering tasks that are troublesome, difficult to handle, or painful. Other isolated activations occur on word-internal substrings in a drug name, an insect species name, the architectural term corbelled, and the physics term corbino, with no evidence of shared semantics.

patterns.name: pain to + verb
patterns.context: A noun pain is followed by a to-infinitive, expressing that doing something is difficult, annoying, or painful; following verbs vary, including figure out, manage, do, and get.
patterns.domain: Colloquial or informal expressions in forums, chats, and Q&A

patterns.name: Subword fragment in the drug name terbinafine
patterns.context: The drug name terbinafine is split into multiple subwords; activation concentrates on internal fragments such as b and ina. The context discusses oral antifungal drugs and their study.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in an entomological name
patterns.context: An insect’s Latin name appears in italics, with activation on an internal substring; the context lists the most-studied insect species.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of corbelled
patterns.context: Activation falls on b in corbelled, describing the form of an architectural element that projects outward.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of corbino
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word-internal fragment of the term corbino; it occurs in physics text following a figure caption.

patterns.name: Form variant painful to
patterns.context: The adjective painful is followed by to, expressing the speaker’s distress while watching a child fail; it resembles pain to + verb but differs in part of speech and syntactic structure.

3_915.concept: to 附近及特定词内子串
3_915.description: 最稳定的模式是 pain/painful 后出现 to：涵盖做事麻烦、难以处理或感到痛苦。另有若干孤立激活落在药名、昆虫学名、建筑词 corbelled 和物理术语 corbino 的词内子串，缺少共同语义证据。

patterns.name: pain to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «pain»« to»，以及「pain« to»10« figure»」「pain« to»9« manage»」「pain« to»9« do»」「pain« to»9« me»」「pain« to»9 get」
patterns.context: 名词 pain 后接 to 不定式，表达做某事困难、令人厌烦或痛苦；其中 figure out、manage、do、get 等后续动词不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛、聊天、问答等口语或非正式表达

patterns.name: 药名 terbinafine 的子词片段
patterns.context: 药名 terbinafine 被分成多个子词，激活集中在 b、ina 等内部片段；语境谈口服抗真菌药及其研究。

patterns.name: 昆虫学名内部片段
patterns.context: 昆虫拉丁学名以斜体呈现，激活落在词内子串；语境列举研究最多的昆虫物种。

patterns.name: corbelled 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 corbelled 词中的 b；描述建筑构件向外挑出的形态。
patterns.domain: 维基百科建筑史或建筑描述

patterns.name: corbino 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 corbino 这一术语的词内片段；出现在图示说明之后的物理学文本中。

patterns.name: painful to 的形态变体
patterns.context: 形容词 painful 后接 to，表达说话者看着孩子失败时感到痛苦；与 pain to + 动词形式相似，但词性和句法结构不同。
patterns.domain: 个人经历或育儿类非正式写作

en.description: Most strong activations fall on the infinitive marker to, often followed by a verb; they also occur in expressions such as little to no and pain to. A few activations fall on sporadic subwords in technical terms, proper names, or common words, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: The English infinitive marker to is followed by a verb or verb phrase; in some examples, to and the following word form a fixed expression.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including HackerNews, news, and discussion posts

patterns.name: to followed by an expression of degree or quantity
patterns.context: to occurs between little and no, forming an expression meaning very little or none; this differs from the infinitive use.

patterns.name: Fixed expression with pain
patterns.context: pain means trouble or difficulty and is followed by an infinitive describing what is troublesome.

patterns.name: Token subwords in technical corpora
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within technical nouns or units, without clear consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Subwords within proper names or terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords of Latin names, surrounded by insect species names.

patterns.name: Word-final or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on short character fragments in misspelled words or proper names, with no stable syntactic function evident.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall only on short subwords in individual words, with no obvious shared context or semantics.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to 及邻近短语
3_915.description: 多数强激活落在不定式 to 上，常接动词，也包括 little to no、pain to 等表达；另有少数激活落在技术术语、专名或普通词的零散子词上，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤见 «to»« figure»« out»、«to»« be»、«to»« no»、«to»« cure»、«to»« finish»、«to»« get»
patterns.context: 英文中的不定式 to 后接动词或动词短语；有些例子中 to 与后续词共同构成固定表达。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括 HackerNews、新闻、讨论帖

patterns.name: to 后接程度或数量表达
patterns.context: to 位于 little 与 no 之间，构成表示极少或没有的表达；与不定式用法不同。

patterns.name: pain 固定表达
patterns.context: pain 表示麻烦或费劲，后接不定式说明令人费劲的事情。

patterns.name: 技术语料中的 token 子词
patterns.context: 激活落在技术名词或单位内部的子词片段，缺乏明显一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名或术语内部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在拉丁学名的内部子词，周围是昆虫物种名称。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在拼写不规范或专名中的短字符片段，未见稳定句法功能。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活仅落在各自词中的短子词，彼此没有明显共同上下文或语义。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on the infinitive marker to, especially after have yet to. It may be followed by find, hear, finish, and other verbs, and also occurs in figure out, to be sure, and various expressions of purpose, operation, and result.

patterns.name: yet to construction
patterns.context: In negative, interrogative, or first-person contexts, expresses that something has not yet been done; the clearest form is “have yet to + verb”.

patterns.name: Infinitive to followed by a verb
patterns.context: to introduces an infinitive followed by an action or state verb; it is not limited to the “yet to” construction.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, encyclopedia text, political commentary, and Q&A

patterns.name: Difficulty explaining/figuring out complex things
patterns.context: Expresses difficulty figuring out or finding a complex configuration; activations concentrate on to, with figure out nearby.

patterns.name: Purpose infinitives and interface instructions
patterns.context: to introduces a specific operation or action, possibly embedded in advice, purpose, or task descriptions.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase to be sure
patterns.context: to be sure expresses a cautious judgment or reservation, followed by a conjecture about the situation.

patterns.name: to meaning inclusion in to incorporate
patterns.context: A quantity of too many makes it impossible to incorporate ads into a page; to introduces an action related to the result.

patterns.name: to indicating persuasion in to convince
patterns.context: to introduces the purpose or action of convincing someone, in a sentence with contentious political argumentation.

patterns.name: to hear and serious use
patterns.context: have yet to hear is followed by discussion of whether a product has been used seriously in production.

patterns.name: to find and alternatives or outcomes
patterns.context: have yet to find is followed by an alternative or suitable option that the speaker wants to find.

patterns.name: Infinitive to finish
patterns.context: have yet to finish is followed by a book, expressing that it has not yet been completed.

3_915.description: 激活主要落在不定式标记 to，尤其是 have yet to 后；其后可接 find、hear、finish 等，也出现在 figure out、to be sure 及多种目的、操作和结果表达中。

patterns.name: yet to 搭配
patterns.context: 否定、疑问或第一人称语境中，表示尚未做某事；最明显的是“have yet to + 动词”。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后接动词
patterns.context: to 引出不定式，后接动作或状态动词；并非只限于“yet to”结构。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、百科文本、政治评论及问答

patterns.name: 解释/弄清复杂事物的困难
patterns.trigger: « to»10« figure»3« out»2；« to»10« the»1 magic combination
patterns.context: 表达难以弄清或找出复杂配置；激活集中在 to，且附近出现 figure out。

patterns.name: 目的性不定式及界面操作说明
patterns.trigger: « to»3« operate»；« to»2 go；« to»3« invite»
patterns.context: to 引出具体操作或行动，可能嵌在建议、目的或任务描述中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 操作说明、HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 固定短语 to be sure
patterns.context: to be sure 表示谨慎判断、保留意见，后接对情况的推测。

patterns.name: 表示纳入的 to incorporate
patterns.context: too many 的数量造成无法将广告纳入页面，to 引出结果相关动作。

patterns.name: 表示说服的 to convince
patterns.context: to 引出说服某人的目的或动作，处于带有争议性政治论述的句子中。

patterns.name: to hear 与严重使用
patterns.context: have yet to hear 后接有关产品是否被认真用于生产环境的内容。

patterns.name: to find 与替代品或结果
patterns.context: have yet to find 后接想找到的替代品或合适对象。

patterns.name: 不定式 to finish
patterns.context: have yet to finish 后接书籍，表示尚未完成。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the infinitive marker “to”, especially in structures such as “have yet to”; two other activations are on word-internal fragments, one from a bacterial term and one from a place name, with no shared context.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive before a verb or expression; often occurs in structures such as “have yet to…” and “can’t wait to…”, and also in uses expressing purpose or result.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news, and general text

patterns.name: Bacteriological word ending
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “Bacteriophages”, marking an affix fragment in terminology related to bacteriophages.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “Coral” in the place name “Coral Gables”.
patterns.domain: Lawyers’ addresses or listings in legal documents

3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记“to”强烈响应，尤其是“have yet to”等结构；另有两处词内片段响应，分别来自细菌学术语和地名，缺少共同语境。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在动词或表达式前引出不定式；多出现在“have yet to…”，“can’t wait to…”等结构，也有表示目的或结果的用法。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻及一般文本

patterns.name: 细菌学词尾
patterns.context: 位于“Bacteriophages”一词内部，标记细菌噬菌体相关术语的词缀片段。

patterns.name: 地名词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名“Coral Gables”中的“Coral”一词内部。
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的律师地址或名单

en.concept: to introducing unrealized or constrained actions
en.description: Primarily responds to to introducing a following verb in “yet to” and “too…to” constructions. It also responds to the subword ni in funniest, co in Disco, the conjunction But, and a small number of punctuation-boundary activations.

patterns.name: Negative “yet to” construction
patterns.context: Occurs in “I have yet to …” or “I’ve yet to …”, followed by a verb and expressing something not yet completed, occurred, or found; the strongest marker is often “to”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews forums, personal comments, and other informal writing

patterns.name: “too … to” result construction
patterns.context: “too” indicates an excessive degree, followed by “to” introducing an action that is consequently impossible or difficult; activation concentrates on “to”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic text, news, and personal comments

patterns.name: Superlative fragment
patterns.context: In a few examples, the superlative “funniest” is split into subword fragments and “ni” activates; “co” in “Disco” is another isolated case, with no confirmed connection to the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Email subjects, diaries, and general narratives; “Disco” comes from an encyclopedia

patterns.name: Punctuation and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: These markers occasionally show weak activation near sentence endings, paragraph breaks, or forum text formatting; there is no stable independent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations not otherwise classified
patterns.context: A sentence-initial contrastive word in paragraph 6 activates strongly, but the paragraph also contains “too late to start”, so it is unclear whether the contrastive word forms an independent pattern.

3_915.concept: to 引导的未然或受限动作
3_915.description: 主要响应“yet to”与“too…to”结构中引出后续动词的 to；另对 funniest 的子词 ni 有响应，并见 Disco 中 co、转折词 But 及少量标点边界激活。

patterns.name: 否定式“yet to”结构
patterns.context: 出现在“I have yet to …”或“I’ve yet to …”中，后接动词，表达尚未完成、尚未发生或尚未找到；最强标记常落在“to”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛、个人评论及其他非正式文字

patterns.name: “too … to”结果结构
patterns.context: “too”引出程度过高，随后“to”引出因此无法或难以完成的动作；激活集中在“to”。

patterns.name: 趣味最高级词尾
patterns.context: 少数例子中最高级“funniest”被拆分为子词片段并激活“ni”；另有“Disco”中的“co”孤例，不能确认与其他模式有关。
patterns.domain: 邮件主题、日记与一般叙述；“Disco”出自百科

patterns.name: 标点与换行边界
patterns.context: 这些标记偶尔有弱激活，出现在句末、段落分隔或论坛文本格式附近；没有稳定的独立语义条件。

patterns.name: 无法归入的零散激活
patterns.context: 第6段句首转折词有较强激活，但该段同时含“too late to start”，无法判断转折词是否构成独立模式。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on to, especially in yet to, too…to, and to + bare verb constructions. A few anomalous triggers come from segmented strings or word endings. These patterns occur in every segment, but the structures are so common that a unified syntactic feature is difficult to establish.

patterns.name: yet to followed by a verb
patterns.context: The common structure “I have yet to + bare verb” makes to a strong trigger; the context expresses that something has not yet been completed, discovered, or heard about.
patterns.domain: Forums and technical discussions, colloquial English

patterns.name: to followed by a verb
patterns.context: The infinitive to is followed by a bare verb, especially in “too…to…” or constructions describing a need, or reaching a condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, medical papers, and comments

patterns.name: it in a segmented word
patterns.context: Occurs in isolation inside a username or string, without a verifiable syntactic context.

patterns.name: Incomplete gun-related word ending
patterns.context: The fragment is truncated and tokenization is abnormal; it may belong to an expression such as gun-toting, but context alone cannot confirm a connection to the other patterns.

3_915.description: 激活主要落在 to 上，尤见 yet to、too…to 及 to+动词原形结构；少数异常触发来自拆分字符串或词尾。覆盖所有段，但这些结构过于常见，难以确认统一句法特征。

patterns.name: yet to 后接动词
patterns.context: 常见结构“I have yet to + 动词原形”，其中 to 是强触发点；上下文表达尚未完成、发现或听说某事。
patterns.domain: 论坛与技术讨论，口语化英文

patterns.name: to 后接动词
patterns.context: 不定式 to 后接动词原形，尤其在“too…to…”或需要说明、达到某条件的结构中。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、医学论文及评论

patterns.name: 被拆分词中的 it
patterns.context: 孤立出现于用户名或字符串内部，缺乏可确认的句法语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛用户名或文本噪声

patterns.name: 不完整的枪支相关词尾
patterns.context: 片段截断且 token 切分异常；可能属于 gun-toting 一类表达，但无法仅凭上下文确认其与其他模式相关。

en.description: Primarily responds to the infinitive marker to: one class occurs in result constructions of the form too + degree description + to, and another occurs in yet to + verb constructions expressing that something has not yet happened or been completed.

patterns.name: too + adjective + to
patterns.context: The preceding text describes an excessively high or low degree, followed by to introducing an action that is consequently difficult or impossible to complete; activation is primarily on the infinitive marker “to”.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including forums, legal texts, patents, encyclopedias, and academic papers

patterns.name: yet to + verb
patterns.context: yet indicates that something has not yet occurred or been completed, followed by to and a verb; activation concentrates on “to”.

3_915.description: 主要响应不定式标记 to：一类出现在 too + 程度描述 + to 的结果结构中，另一类出现在 yet to + 动词、表示尚未发生或完成的结构中。

patterns.name: too + 形容词 + to
patterns.trigger: “too much of a pain to figure out”[2]、“too weak to justify”[3]、“too large to secure”[4]、“too much information to summarise”[5]、“too weak to identify”[6]、“too many to incorporate”[7]、“too low to be generally detected”[9]
patterns.context: 前文描述程度过高或过低，随后用 to 引出因此难以或无法完成的动作；主要激活在不定式标记“to”。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、专利、百科及学术论文等多种文体

patterns.name: yet to + 动词
patterns.trigger: “yet to finish”[1]、“yet to hear”[8]、“yet to be created”[10]
patterns.context: yet 表示某事截至当前尚未发生或完成，紧接 to 加动词；激活集中在“to”。

en.description: Primarily activates on the infinitive marker to and nearby verbs, covering purpose, ability, result, incompletion, and legal argumentation. It also occurs in common collocations such as little to no and yet to, across forum, technical, academic, and legal texts.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive after a verb or adjective, or expresses purpose, result, or requirement; activation sometimes falls on to and sometimes on the verb immediately following it.
patterns.domain: Forum, legal, academic, and technical texts

patterns.name: Negative quantity phrase to no
patterns.context: Combines with little to express “almost none”; activation may fall on to or no.

patterns.name: yet to construction
patterns.context: In perfect-tense or similar constructions, expresses that something has not yet been done; the activation peak falls on to.

patterns.name: Passive/incomplete construction yet to be
patterns.context: Describes an instance that has not yet been created in a noun phrase; to be introduces a passive infinitive.

patterns.name: to in reporting, adding, and resetting relations
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, to indicates an object being added; a subsequent to indicates purpose.

patterns.name: Legal argumentative use of to justify
patterns.context: An adjective in a too + adjective + to infinitive construction indicates that the evidence is insufficient to justify jury acceptance.

patterns.name: Purpose or result in to achieve
patterns.context: The infinitive expresses a condition that is needed or an action to take in order to reach a goal.

patterns.name: to in other phrase combinations
patterns.context: to occurs in different fixed or semi-fixed combinations, expressing a relation, an action goal, or support for a conclusion; the commonality remains that to introduces an infinitive or complement structure.

3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记 to 及其邻近动词激活，涵盖目的、能力、结果、未完成与法律论证；另见 little to no、yet to 等常见搭配，跨论坛、技术、学术和法律文本。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在动词或形容词后引出不定式，或表示目的、结果、要求；有时激活落在 to，有时落在紧随其后的动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、学术及技术文本

patterns.name: 否定数量短语 to no
patterns.context: 与 little 连用，表达“几乎没有”；激活可落在 to 或 no。

patterns.name: yet to 结构
patterns.context: 完成时或类似结构中表示“尚未做某事”；激活峰值落在 to。

patterns.name: yet to be 的被动/未完成结构
patterns.context: 名词短语中描述尚未创建的实例，to be 引出被动不定式。

patterns.name: 报告、添加及重置关系中的 to
patterns.context: 技术描述中，to 表示添加对象，随后另一个 to 表示目的。

patterns.name: to justify 的法律论证用法
patterns.context: too + 形容词 + to 不定式，说明证据不足以支持陪审团采信。

patterns.name: to achieve 的目的或结果
patterns.trigger: “require additional features «to» «achieve» good classification performance”及“conditions «to» «achieve» this”
patterns.context: 不定式表示需要某条件或采取某做法以达到目标。

patterns.name: to 与其他短语搭配
patterns.trigger: “«to» do with technology”“«to» figure out”“«to» support a conviction”
patterns.context: to 位于不同固定或半固定搭配中，分别表示关联、行动目标或支持某结论；共同点仍是 to 引出的不定式/补足结构。

en.description: Activation spans multiple domains, often occurring around structured layout, field boundaries, numbers, or split proper names/technical strings; “verify” recurs across several technical styles. The remaining vocabulary and domain cues do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Special tokenization and formatting markers with spaces
patterns.context: Special symbols, spaces, and formatting boundaries in alignment, indentation, line breaks, or mathematical typesetting; several activations occur near these structures, but no single punctuation mark consistently triggers every passage.

patterns.name: Dates, numbers, and table fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, years, identifiers, or table values appear in structured records; sometimes adjacent to whitespace, slashes, or field boundaries.
patterns.domain: Email, financial headers, and structured records

patterns.name: Email headers and field labels
patterns.context: Email headers contain separators and fields such as recipient, CC, and subject.

patterns.name: Letter segmentation in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names or place names are split into multiple subword fragments; Baghdad also reaches a very strong activation in this passage.

patterns.name: Terminology or technical strings
patterns.context: Uppercase abbreviations or coded/technical markers in patents are split into subword fragments; the trigger is not limited to one domain.
patterns.domain: Email memos and patent technical text

patterns.name: Verification language in research writing
patterns.context: Academic or technical narratives describe verifying or checking results; the same word strongly activates in both NIH abstracts and mathematics papers.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patents, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Special letter within Swedish words
patterns.context: A special letter occurs inside Swedish words; activation concentrates on the subword fragment “öppnats”.

patterns.name: Institution names and title layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Court dockets or legal document headers display uppercase institution names with line breaks and indentation; some words are split.

patterns.name: Uppercase words in administrative or business headings
patterns.context: Heading-style uppercase words describe quarterly, annual, or financial performance, followed by portfolios and numbers.

patterns.name: Unexplained content and domain triggers
patterns.context: The available samples show no stable shared condition, so these fragments cannot be assigned to a more specific trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Email, medicine, parliament, mathematical physics, and law

3_1236.concept: 结构化文本与分词边界
3_1236.description: 激活横跨多领域，常落在结构化排版、字段边界、数字或被切分的专名/技术字符串；“verify”在多种技术文体重复出现。其余词汇与领域线索不构成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 带空格的特殊分词与格式标记
patterns.context: 对齐、缩进、换行或公式排版中的特殊符号、空格和格式边界；多处激活落在这些结构附近，但并非每段都有一致的单一标点触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本格式与排版

patterns.name: 日期、数字与表格字段
patterns.context: 日期、时间、年份、编号或表格数值出现在结构化记录中；有时与空白、斜杠或字段边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 邮件、财务标题与结构化记录

patterns.name: 邮件标题与字段标签
patterns.context: 邮件头部中出现分隔线及收件人、抄送、主题等字段。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母分段
patterns.context: 专名或地名被切成多个子词片段；该段中 Baghdad 也达到很强激活。

patterns.name: 术语或技术字符串
patterns.context: 大写缩写或专利中的编码/技术标记被拆成子词片段；触发不局限于一种领域。
patterns.domain: 邮件备忘录与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 科研文体中的验证表述
patterns.context: 学术或技术叙述中出现验证、核实结果的表述；同词在 NIH 摘要和数学论文中均有强激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利与数学论文

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内的特殊字母
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，特殊字母出现在词内；激活集中于“öppnats”一词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的机构名称与标题布局
patterns.context: 法院案卷或法律文书标题，以大写机构名称和分行、缩进的版式呈现；部分词被拆分。

patterns.name: 行政或业务标题中的大写词
patterns.context: 标题式大写词描述季度、年度或业绩，后接投资组合和数值。

patterns.name: 解释不了的内容与领域触发
patterns.context: 在现有样本中找不到稳定的共同条件，不能仅凭这些片段归入更具体的触发模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学、议会、物理数学与法律

en.description: The response pattern is scattered: dates and layout in email, historical proper names, legal institutional formatting, biomedical terminology and abstract phrasing, code disclaimer separators, Swedish economic word forms, and financial headings and portfolios; no single trigger feature explains all samples.

patterns.name: Date fields and whitespace separators in tables or email
patterns.context: Line breaks, tabs, and alignment whitespace occur around dates, times, or schedule content; not all dates trigger with equal strength

patterns.name: Proper names and historical event narratives
patterns.context: Encyclopedic paragraphs introduce event names, etymologies, places, and dates, with proper names appearing in continuous narrative

patterns.name: Institutional and case layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Headings, parties, dates, and institution names are arranged in uppercase or fixed indentation

patterns.name: Biomedical receptor terminology
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts mention biological entities and their abbreviations, followed by functional or definitional statements

patterns.name: Verification or confirmation wording in research abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract describes technical capabilities and their limitations, emphasizing the inability to verify actual medication or intake

patterns.name: Software license disclaimers and code boundaries
patterns.context: A copyright or liability disclaimer ends with an asterisk separator line, immediately followed by a preprocessing directive or package declaration
patterns.domain: Source code and software license text

patterns.name: In-word character fragments in Swedish economic policy language
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary text discusses imports, production, or market opening; activation falls on words containing diacritics

patterns.name: Financial report headings and portfolios
patterns.context: A quarterly or annual performance heading is followed by a description of model portfolio returns

3_1236.description: 响应模式分散：邮件中的日期与排版、历史专名、法律机构格式、生物医学术语及摘要措辞、代码免责声明分隔线、瑞典语经济词形、财务标题与投资组合；没有一个触发特征能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 表格或邮件中的日期字段与空白分隔
patterns.context: 日期、时间或日程内容周围出现换行、制表符和对齐空白；并非所有日期都触发同等强度
patterns.domain: 邮件、日程或结构化记录

patterns.name: 专名与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 百科式段落介绍事件名称、词源、地点和时间，专名在连续叙述中出现

patterns.name: 法律文书的机构与案件版式
patterns.trigger: 「SECRETARY OF HEALTH AND」「Special Processing Unit」「Filed: March 10, 2020」
patterns.context: 标题、当事方、日期和机构名称以大写或固定缩进排布

patterns.name: 生物医学受体术语
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现生物学实体及其缩写，后接功能或定义性陈述

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的验证或确认措辞
patterns.context: 摘要描述技术能力及其局限，强调无法核实实际服药或摄入

patterns.name: 软件许可免责声明与代码边界
patterns.context: 版权或责任免责声明以星号分隔线结束，随后紧接预处理指令或包声明
patterns.domain: 源代码及软件许可文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语经济政策表述中的词内字符片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本讨论进口、生产或市场开放；激活落在带变音符号的词内

patterns.name: 财务报告标题与投资组合
patterns.context: 季度或年度业绩标题后描述模型投资组合收益

en.description: The main pattern is recognition of the letter ö in Swedish, German, and Hungarian words, across different word forms in each context; a separate email date table activates at a tab after a line break, possibly due to formatting.

patterns.name: The grapheme “ö” in Swedish words
patterns.context: Activation consistently falls on ö in Swedish words; words may be split into multiple tokens, with hit locations including “öppnats”, “ökande”, “öppning”, “övergripande”, “ögat”, “översynen”, and “öppenheten”.

patterns.name: The German grapheme “öff”
patterns.context: In German “öffentliche”, ö is followed by ff; it is the same grapheme as the ö in Swedish, but occurs in a German sentence.

patterns.name: The Hungarian grapheme “öss”
patterns.context: In Hungarian “összehangolt”, ö is followed by ss; it is the same grapheme as the ö in other passages, but occurs in a Hungarian sentence.

patterns.name: Table whitespace/tab
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the date-schedule formatting of an email, immediately after a line break and in whitespace separated by a tab; this is not an obvious lexical-semantic trigger.

3_1236.description: 主要模式是在瑞典语、德语和匈牙利语词中识别字母 ö，命中各语境中不同的词形；另有一段邮件日期表在换行后的制表符处激活，可能是格式触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词中「ö」字素
patterns.context: 激活稳定落在瑞典语单词里的 ö；词可被切分成多个 token，命中位置包括「öppnats」「ökande」「öppning」「övergripande」「ögat」「översynen」「öppenheten」等。
patterns.domain: 以瑞典语为主的欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 德语「öff」字素
patterns.context: 德语「öffentliche」中 ö 后接 ff；与瑞典语中的 ö 同字素，但语境是德语句子。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会社会政策文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语「öss」字素
patterns.context: 匈牙利语「összehangolt」中 ö 后接 ss；与其他段的 ö 同字素，但语境是匈牙利语句子。

patterns.name: 表格空白/制表符
patterns.context: 激活出现在邮件里的日期安排格式，紧跟换行并位于制表符分隔的空白处；并非明显的词汇语义触发。

en.concept: Contrast and verification words, and code formatting
en.description: The most prominent recurring words in activation are rather (contrast, correction) and verify (verification); there are also local patterns involving line breaks in email date lists, shell script paths, and function code.

patterns.name: The contrastive word rather
patterns.context: rather corrects, contrasts with, or redefines preceding text; in [1] it occurs in rather any, and in [7] and [10] it marks contrast
patterns.domain: Academic papers, email, and legal text

patterns.name: The word form verify
patterns.context: verify occurs in sentences describing checking, verifying, or proving a result
patterns.domain: Code, patents, academic papers, and patent-related email text

patterns.name: Line breaks and numbers in date lists
patterns.context: Holiday date lists with blank lines and indentation before dates

patterns.name: Shell script paths and code blocks
patterns.context: Shell script snippets contain paths, commands, and function definitions

3_1236.concept: 转折与验证词及代码格式
3_1236.description: 激活最突出的重复词是 rather（转折、纠正）和 verify（验证）；另有邮件日期列表换行及 shell 脚本路径、函数代码等局部模式。

patterns.name: rather 转折词
patterns.context: rather 与前文形成纠正、对照或重新界定；在 [1] 中出现在 rather any，在 [7]、[10] 中转折对照
patterns.domain: 学术论文、邮件及法律文本

patterns.name: verify 词形
patterns.context: verify 出现在描述检查、验证或证明某项结果的句子中
patterns.domain: 代码、专利、学术论文及专利邮件文本

patterns.name: 日期列表中的换行与数字
patterns.context: 假期日期列表，日期前有空行和缩进

patterns.name: shell 脚本路径及代码块
patterns.context: shell 脚本片段中出现路径、命令及函数定义

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the verb “verify” used predicatively to mean checking or confirming, across academic, patent, medical, and code contexts; there is also a weaker isolated response to “rewritten” meaning reformulated equations in a mathematics paper.

patterns.name: Explicit verification action
patterns.context: The word is used predicatively to mean checking or confirming whether a result, property, relationship, or implementation holds; it often takes a that-clause or a noun object.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: scientific papers, patents, medical research, code

patterns.name: Rewriting mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Describes a mathematical relationship being rewritten in another form in the passive voice.

3_1236.description: 主要对动词“verify”作为谓语、表示检查或确认的用法强烈响应，跨学术、专利、医学与代码语境；另对数学论文中“rewritten”表示公式改写有较弱的孤立响应。

patterns.name: 显式验证动作
patterns.trigger: “verify”；尤其是 “verify and compare”“verify expression”“verify the association”
patterns.context: 该词作为谓语，表示检查或确认某项结果、性质、关联或实现是否成立；常接 that 从句或名词宾语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：科学论文、专利、医学研究、代码

patterns.name: 数学表达式改写
patterns.trigger: “rewritten”；“inequalities … can be rewritten”“equation can be rewritten”
patterns.context: 被动语态中描述将数学关系改写为另一种形式。

en.concept: Common local function words and formatting fragments
en.description: Activation concentrates on think used to express opinions or suggestions in email and Q&A, and also covers email address/name fields, sentence-initial As, SQL conditional words, and several style-specific fragments; no single word-sense pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: think and opinion/suggestion clauses
patterns.context: A first-person speaker or email author expresses an opinion or asks for advice, often followed by a that-clause, with or without that; also appears in suggestions in answers.

patterns.name: Address or signature fields in email
patterns.context: Names appear alongside Enron departments and email/address formats, or service addresses are mentioned in the email body.
patterns.domain: Enron email and its contact-list/email-header formats

patterns.name: Sentence- or paragraph-initial As
patterns.context: Appears in a heading or at the beginning of a sentence; one instance is the technical heading “Aspect-Oriented”, and the other begins the sentence “As e-book war rages”.

patterns.name: SQL conditional and branching keywords
patterns.context: In code, WHEN/THEN form conditional branches, and WHERE introduces a filtering condition.

patterns.name: Time commitments in email
patterns.context: An email author reports preparing files and promises to finish by a future time.

patterns.name: Conditional sentences with If
patterns.context: A reported statement or comment introduces a hypothetical condition with If.

patterns.name: Worth judgments in Q&A
patterns.context: A respondent assesses whether a repair is worth doing, then gives a recommendation.

patterns.name: Japanese katakana and spelling segmentation
patterns.context: A narrative contains the Japanese spelling of Amazon and segmented spelling, embedded in English and Japanese name text.

3_1236.concept: 局部常见功能词与格式片段
3_1236.description: 激活集中在邮件、问答中表达判断或建议的 think，也覆盖邮件地址/姓名字段、句首 As、SQL 条件词及若干文体特有片段；不存在能解释所有例子的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: think 及意见/建议从句
patterns.context: 第一人称或邮件作者表达判断、询问建议，常接 that/省略 that 的从句；也见于回答中的建议。

patterns.name: 邮件中的地址或签名字段
patterns.context: 姓名与 Enron 部门、邮箱/地址格式并列，或在邮件正文提及服务地址。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及其通讯录/邮件头格式

patterns.name: 段落或句子起始的 As
patterns.context: 位于标题或句首；一个是技术标题“Aspect-Oriented”，另一个是句子开头“As e-book war rages”。

patterns.name: SQL 条件及分支关键字
patterns.context: 代码中以 WHEN/THEN 构成条件分支，并以 WHERE 引出筛选条件。

patterns.name: 邮件中的时间承诺
patterns.context: 邮件作者报告正在准备文件，并承诺在未来时间点前完成。

patterns.name: 带有 If 的条件句
patterns.context: 转述或评论中以 If 引出假设条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件转发内容、幽默评论

patterns.name: 问答中的 worth 评价
patterns.context: 回答者评估某项维修是否值得，随后给出行动建议。

patterns.name: 日文片假名及拼读拆分
patterns.context: 叙事中出现 Amazon 的日文写法及分段拼读，夹在英文与日文姓名文本中。
patterns.domain: 小说/叙事文本，多语言文本

en.concept: Primarily navigation-bar markers, plus miscellaneous items
en.description: Activation occurs mainly on HTML/Bootstrap navigation-bar tags and class names; it also appears in Python code that catches ImportError. Additional in-word fragments of English nav, trading-rule wording, and Latvian administrative text cannot be unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: HTML navigation-bar markers
patterns.context: The nav element, navbar class name, and their combinations in HTML; often adjacent to Bootstrap styles, navigation menus, or button code.

patterns.name: Python import exception handling
patterns.context: An except branch catches ImportError after a Python import statement; the snippet includes compatibility imports or CLI code.

patterns.name: nav as a substring within an English word
patterns.context: nav appears inside ordinary English words rather than in an HTML tag or class name; the examples refer to a navigator and a small transport vehicle.

patterns.name: Trading-rule wording
patterns.context: Describes NYMEX trading price fluctuation limits and actual quotes; token activation is scattered across related financial wording.
patterns.domain: Energy futures trading rules or legal text

patterns.name: Latvian administrative terminology
patterns.context: Latvian sentences contain terms related to administration, control systems, and agreement of opinions; no clear connection to nav usage in code.

3_1236.concept: 导航栏标记为主，另有杂项
3_1236.description: 主要激活于 HTML/Bootstrap 导航栏标签与类名；也见于 Python 捕获 ImportError 的代码。另有英文 nav 词内片段、交易规则措辞及拉脱维亚语行政文本，无法统一归入主模式。

patterns.name: HTML导航栏标记
patterns.context: HTML 中的 nav 元素、navbar 类名及其组合；常与 Bootstrap 样式、导航菜单或按钮代码相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/CSS/前端模板代码

patterns.name: Python 导入异常处理
patterns.context: Python 的导入语句之后，用于捕获 ImportError 的 except 分支；片段中伴随兼容导入或 CLI 代码。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Python 源码

patterns.name: nav 作为英文词内子串
patterns.context: nav 出现在普通英文单词内部，而非 HTML 标签或类名；分别指航海员和小型交通车。

patterns.name: 交易规则措辞
patterns.trigger: « bona»« fide»、« high»« price»、« low»、« limit»
patterns.context: 描述 NYMEX 交易价格波动限制与真实报价，token 激活分散在相关金融措辞中。
patterns.domain: 能源期货交易规则或法律文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语行政术语
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子中出现行政管理、控制系统及意见一致性相关词语；与代码中的 nav 用法无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种行政文本

en.description: The most stable pattern is activation on basis, covering usages meaning grounds, classification, frequency, and basis points. There are also isolated activations on of, PER, Lack, and or, each in a different context and difficult to assign to a shared trigger pattern from these fragments.

patterns.name: basis phrases
patterns.context: “basis” means grounds, a classification standard, frequency, or a financial unit of measurement; it usually occurs in fixed collocations
patterns.domain: Academic papers, encyclopedias, energy email, financial email

patterns.name: Isolated activation on of
patterns.context: The preposition occurs in a noun phrase; there is no clear basis collocation here

patterns.name: PER financial metric
patterns.context: A financial or valuation metric is followed by a numeric threshold

patterns.name: Lack of control
patterns.context: Indicates a lack of some degree of control, followed by an of phrase

patterns.name: or as a disjunction
patterns.context: Lists two alternative food-processing tools

3_1236.description: 最稳定的模式是激活 basis，涵盖依据、分类、频率和 basis points 等用法。另有 of、PER、Lack、or 的单例激活，分属不同语境，难以从这些片段归入同一触发模式。

patterns.name: basis 短语
patterns.trigger: «basis»，包括“on the basis of”“on this basis”“on a … basis”“basis points”
patterns.context: “basis”用于表示依据、分类标准、频率或金融计量单位；通常出现在固定搭配中
patterns.domain: 学术论文、百科、能源邮件、金融邮件

patterns.name: of 的孤立激活
patterns.context: 介词出现在名词短语中；此处没有明显的 basis 搭配

patterns.name: PER 财务指标
patterns.context: 财务或估值指标后接数值阈值

patterns.name: Lack of 控制
patterns.context: 表示缺乏某种控制程度，后接 of 短语

patterns.name: or 选择连接词
patterns.context: 列举两种可选的食物加工工具

en.description: Activation is mainly on scattered word fragments; more stable recurring cues are premise/on-premise and the letter sequence ator, alongside scattered hits in names, numbers, sports, and architectural text. Overall, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The substring “premise” within a sentence/word
patterns.context: Hits premise at an in-word tokenization position, or the compound on-premise; the first two instances are in argumentative/philosophical contexts, and the latter is in a cloud-computing context.
patterns.domain: Forum discussion, philosophy paper, cloud-computing article

patterns.name: The word-final fragment “ator”
patterns.context: Occurs inside the name Alatorre and at the end of the drug-class term vasodilator; the shared feature is the letter fragment ator, not a clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in names
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments of names or proper nouns, but there is no stable, consistent name type or spelling pattern.
patterns.domain: Game descriptions, football categories, sports reporting

patterns.name: Scattered fragments in words/phrases
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common words, proper nouns, and phrase components, with no stable semantic or syntactic trigger across passages.
patterns.domain: Email, encyclopedias, philosophy, sports, and web text

patterns.name: Quantity and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Occasional activation occurs near numbers, dates, or years, but the forms vary across examples.

patterns.name: Fragments in place names/category names
patterns.context: Local fragments in sports categories, clubs, or school names; no clear shared trigger condition with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Architectural description fragments
patterns.context: Multiple scattered word fragments activate within the same historical architectural description, without forming a specific, consistent architectural term.

3_1236.description: 激活以零散词片段为主；较稳定的重复线索是 premise/on-premise 与 ator 字母串，另有姓名、数字、体育及建筑文本中的分散命中，整体缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句中/词内子串“premise”
patterns.context: 在词内分词位置命中 premise，或复合词 on-premise；前两处为论证/哲学语境，后一处为云计算语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、哲学论文、云计算文章

patterns.name: 词尾片段“ator”
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Alatorre 的词内，以及药物类别词 vasodilator 的词尾；共同的是字母片段 ator，并非明显的共同词义。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、专利/药理文本

patterns.name: 人名词内片段
patterns.trigger: [4] Pas«cal»2« Michael»4 St«ief»1el；[7] «C»«aud»al« Dep»«ort»«ivo»；[8] «J»«ake»« Waters»、Tyler« Lock»«ett»
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或专名的分词片段中，但没有稳定一致的姓名类型或拼写模式。
patterns.domain: 游戏介绍、足球分类、体育报道

patterns.name: 词语/短语中的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在普通词、专名及短语成分上，未见跨段稳定的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、哲学、体育及网页文本

patterns.name: 数量与格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、日期或年代附近偶有激活，但不同例子形式不一致。

patterns.name: 地名/类别名称片段
patterns.context: 体育类别、俱乐部或学校名称中的局部片段；与其他模式没有清楚的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 足球分类、大学橄榄球报道

patterns.name: 建筑描述片段
patterns.context: 同一段历史建筑描述中多个分散词片段激活，未能归纳为具体一致的建筑术语。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly on the substring containing Greek «λο» in Greek words, across forms related to simplification and membership; there are also English biographical geographic phrasing, season-year numbers, and a single Japanese bibliographic kanji, with no unified explanation yet.

patterns.name: Greek word forms related to «απλο-»
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the Greek-letter substring «λο» and its continuation; it occurs in words such as «απλοποιηθεί», «απλούστευσης», and «αναλογη», possibly responding to a shared subword fragment rather than the complete word meaning.

patterns.name: Greek membership word form
patterns.context: «μέλος» means member and occurs in statements about membership in an institution or organization; its triggering fragment overlaps with the «λο» found above, but the full word meaning differs.

patterns.name: Number and place-name fragments in English/Spanish biographies
patterns.context: Activation falls on «of» in a location description and the following place-name fragment in an English biography; similar pages also contain birth information and football career details, but it is unclear whether these contexts form a trigger condition.

patterns.name: Kanji fragment in a foreign-language bibliography
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Japanese book-title text embedded in an English Wikipedia passage, especially around the kanji «上» and adjacent characters; seen only once.

patterns.name: Number fragments in year and season headings
patterns.context: Months, years, and numbers in a person's birth date or sports-season heading; no clear semantic connection to the Greek main pattern or adjacent English words.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia biographies and sports entries

3_1236.concept: 多语言局部子词/字符片段响应
3_1236.description: 主要激活于希腊语词中含「λο」的子串，跨简化、类似词形和成员身份词；另见英文人名地理表述、赛季年份数字及一次日文书目汉字，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 希腊语「απλο-」相关词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在希腊字母子串「λο」及其后续部分；出现在「απλοποιηθεί」「απλούστευσης」「αναλογη」等词中，可能对共享的子词片段而非完整词义响应。

patterns.name: 希腊语成员身份词形
patterns.context: 「μέλος」表示成员，出现在机构或组织成员身份的陈述中；触发片段与上面出现的「λο」重合，但完整词义不同。

patterns.name: 英西语人物传记中的数字与地名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文人物简介中地点描述的「of」及后续地名片段；同类页面还含出生信息和足球履历，但这些上下文是否构成触发条件不确定。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物传记

patterns.name: 异语种参考书目中的汉字片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英文维基百科片段内嵌的日文书名文字中，尤其集中于汉字「上」及其邻近字符；仅见一次。

patterns.name: 年份与赛季标题中的数字片段
patterns.context: 人物出生日期或体育赛事赛季标题中的月份、年份和数字；与希腊语主模式及相邻英语词无明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物传记及体育条目

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on say (especially to say in negative or concessive constructions) and way, which expresses manner; one instance also occurs on Hz in the display specification “60 Hz”.

patterns.name: “to say” inferential construction
patterns.context: Activation falls on say in negative, concessive, or reported-speech constructions; common forms include “isn’t/not to say…” and “called…to say”.

patterns.name: Manner expression “way”
patterns.context: way denotes a manner of doing something, often preceded by such a or a normal; it modifies an action or relationship.

patterns.name: Hz in numbers and units
patterns.context: Occurs in the display specification “60 Hz”; activation seems related to technical units or frequency notation.

3_1236.description: 激活主要集中在 say（尤其否定/让步句式中的 to say），以及表示方式的 way；另有一次出现在显示器规格“60 Hz”的 Hz。

patterns.name: “to say”推论框架
patterns.trigger: «to»…«say»（段1、2、7、8、10中为«to»«say»，段6为“in a normal way”中的«way»）
patterns.context: 否定、让步或引述框架中，激活落在 say；常见形式为“isn’t/not to say…”，也有“called…to say”。

patterns.name: 方式表达“way”
patterns.trigger: «way»，多见于“in such a way”或“in a normal way”
patterns.context: way 表示做事的方式，前面常接 such a 或 a normal；修饰动作或关系。

patterns.name: 数字与单位中的 Hz
patterns.context: 出现在“60 Hz”显示器规格中，激活似与技术单位或频率标注相关。

en.concept: “to say” phrase and local word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the English sequence “to say”, especially the concessive sentence “That’s not to say (that)…”, and also occurs in other infinitive constructions; sporadic activations involve a place-name fragment, such way, no way, and a French phrase, which are difficult to explain with one clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: “to say” followed by “that”
patterns.context: English phrases expressing concession, elaboration, or reported speech, commonly “That’s not to say that …”; [4] has “to say that they …”.
patterns.domain: Spoken English, commentary, forum discussions, and business email

patterns.name: say in English speech
patterns.context: Only covers [8]; the context is “begging me to never say anything critical”, namely the infinitive “to never say”. It does not have the “to say that” construction common in [1–5].

patterns.name: Place-name fragment in Rio Grande do Norte
patterns.context: Occurs in the place name “state of Rio Grande do Norte”; activation falls on a subword fragment after a word split.

patterns.name: Fixed expression in code documentation
patterns.context: Occurs in a code-fix description, “I fixed it in such way”; activation is concentrated on the expression itself, though the grammatical form is usually “in such a way”.

patterns.name: way in a negative context
patterns.context: In “They have no way of knowing …”, it denotes a method or possibility; unlike the “such way” usage in [7].

patterns.name: French phrase fragment
patterns.context: In French parliamentary text, activation falls on word or phrase fragments such as “tout-à-fait judicieux”, “au plus tard”, and “façon”; there is no obvious English construction.

3_1236.description: 主要响应英语中“to say”这一串，尤其是让步句“That’s not to say (that)…”，也见于其他不定式用法；另有零散激活涉及地名分词、such way、no way及法语短语，彼此难由同一明确语义解释。

patterns.name: “to say”后接“that”
patterns.context: 英语中表示让步、补充或转述的短语，常见形式是 “That’s not to say that …”；[4]则是 “to say that they …”。
patterns.domain: 英语口语、评论、论坛讨论及商务邮件

patterns.name: 英语语流中的 say
patterns.context: 只覆盖[8]；上下文是 “begging me to never say anything critical”，即不定式 “to never say”。不具备[1–5]常见的 “to say that”结构。

patterns.name: Rio Grande do Norte 地名片段
patterns.context: 位于地名 “state of Rio Grande do Norte” 中；激活落在分词后的词片段上。

patterns.name: 代码说明中的固定表达
patterns.context: 出现在 “I fixed it in such way” 的代码修复说明中；激活集中于表达本身，语法上通常会说 “in such a way”。

patterns.name: 否定语境中的 way
patterns.context: 在 “They have no way of knowing …” 中表示方法或可能性；与[7]的 “such way”用法不同。

patterns.name: 法语短语片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中，激活落在 “tout-à-fait judicieux”“au plus tard”“façon”等分词或短语片段上；没有明显英语句式。

en.description: Responds primarily to say in the concessive clarification structure “not to say” and to constructions where almost is followed by a degree, state, or time complement; other activations involve names, email dates and times, formatting markers, and several one-off lexical triggers.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “to say”
patterns.context: Introduces a qualification, clarification, or elaboration in a negative or concessive context; activation falls mainly on say

patterns.name: almost followed by a degree or time complement
patterns.context: almost denotes approaching a degree, state, or time; activation falls on almost
patterns.domain: Online discussions, legal texts, news narratives

patterns.name: Nominal elements in names
patterns.context: Common titles, name fragments, or initials appear in names or email signatures; activation strength varies

patterns.name: Date and email header fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, and sender/address fields in forwarded email headers, interspersed with numbers and delimiters

patterns.name: near/nearly meaning close to or almost
patterns.context: Describes coming close to an event or degree; almost may be the same lexical trigger as almost in other passages

patterns.name: Other local lexical triggers
patterns.context: The passages do not contain enough repeated context to confirm a shared semantic pattern; these may be local collocations or incidental high activations
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, music reviews, forums, fiction

patterns.name: Email forwarding separator
patterns.context: Email forwarding format and line-break boundaries co-occur with date and name fields

3_1236.description: 主要对“not to say”让步澄清结构中的 say，以及 almost 后接程度、状态或时间补语的结构响应；另有姓名、邮件日期时间与格式标记，以及若干仅单次出现的词汇触发。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“to say”
patterns.trigger: «to»« say»，尤其 “That’s not to say” / “that’s not to say”
patterns.context: 在否定或让步语境中，引出限定、澄清或补充说明；激活集中落在 say 上
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛讨论、叙述性文章

patterns.name: almost 后接程度或时间性补语
patterns.context: almost 表示接近某种程度、状态或时间；激活落在 almost 上
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、法律文本、新闻叙述

patterns.name: 人名中的名词成分
patterns.context: 人名或邮件署名中出现常见称谓、姓名片段或首字母；激活强度不一

patterns.name: 日期及邮件头字段
patterns.context: 转发邮件头中的日期、时间及发件人/地址字段，数字和分隔符交错

patterns.name: near/ nearly 接近或险些
patterns.context: 描述接近发生某事、接近某种程度；其中 almost 与其他语段中的 almost 可能是同一词汇触发

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇触发
patterns.trigger: « Premier»« League»；« Motion»；« over»；« lack»；« sign»；« reluctant»；« zero»
patterns.context: 片段中没有足够重复的上下文来确认共同语义模式，可能是局部搭配或偶然高激活
patterns.domain: 体育报道、音乐评论、论坛、小说

patterns.name: 邮件转发分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件转发格式及换行边界与日期、姓名字段共同出现

en.description: The most prominent pattern is way, especially no way and no way of knowing; other isolated triggers include Japanese 一番, French premier, the genus name Naucoria, and the phrase to say, spanning different languages and contexts.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions with way
patterns.context: way denotes a method, possibility, or ability, often following no; it also appears in exclamations «no way!» and «no other way». In passages 1 and 2, «way» is also accompanied by word splits or punctuation, with different meanings and syntax.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, Q&A, and general narrative

patterns.name: Ordinal first
patterns.context: The French ordinal premier follows a definite article and modifies point.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament speeches in French

patterns.name: Japanese positional expression with a numeral
patterns.context: In Japanese URL instructions, it follows 「上記URLの」 and means the most… or first; the surrounding text describes an item on a webpage.

patterns.name: Fungal taxonomic name
patterns.context: Embedded in the genus name Naucoria; the same sentence lists other fungal genera and discusses fungal classification.

patterns.name: say in a lyric phrase
patterns.context: An infinitive phrase introduces an elaboration, followed by «the girls are wrong»; occurs in an account about music charts.

3_1236.concept: 弱相关的局部词形触发
3_1236.description: 最显著模式是 way，尤其 no way 及 no way of knowing；另有日语一番、法语 premier、属名 Naucoria 和短语 to say 等孤立触发，分属不同语言与语境。

patterns.name: way 固定表达
patterns.trigger: «way»，尤其是 «no way», «no way of knowing», «there is no way»
patterns.context: way 用于表示方法、可能性或是否能够做到，常处于 no 后；也出现在感叹句 «no way!» 和 «no other way» 中。第1、2段的 «way» 前后还伴随分词或标点，词义和句法各异。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答及一般叙述

patterns.name: 序数 first
patterns.context: 法语定冠词后接序数 premier，修饰 point。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法语正式发言

patterns.name: 日语数字位置表达
patterns.context: 日语 URL 指引中，位于「上記URLの」之后，表示最……或第一；周边文字在说明网页上的项目。

patterns.name: 菌类分类名称
patterns.context: 嵌在属名 Naucoria 内；同句列举其他真菌属名，讨论菌类分类。

patterns.name: 歌词短语 say
patterns.context: 不定式短语引出补充说明，后接 «the girls are wrong»；位于关于音乐榜单的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或流行音乐讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: they commonly occur in Virginia proper names split across tokens, and also respond to Japanese 「即時」, French 「plusieurs」, English 「no way」, and local strings such as Velocette and Spanish 「aún」; no unified semantic or grammatical function is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-split fragment in the string Virginia
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the place name or proper name Virginia split across tokens; capitalization, word boundaries, and neighboring letters vary.
patterns.domain: Book titles, author names, legal texts, television program descriptions

patterns.name: Japanese 「即時」 in an instant-payment expression
patterns.context: The Japanese sentence discusses a PayPal account, updates, and payment notifications.

patterns.name: Fragment in French 「plusieurs」
patterns.context: Occurs in 「de plusieurs États membres」, meaning multiple member states.

patterns.name: English negative idiom “no way”
patterns.context: Occurs as a fixed expression; one instance emphasizes that something does not imply another, and another expresses surprise or a negative response.

patterns.name: Motorcycle name in a racing biography
patterns.context: Occurs in a motorcycle-racing biography and refers to the Velocette motorcycle brand.

patterns.name: Spanish 「aún」
patterns.context: Occurs in a Spanish sentence discussing visits to a running page.

3_1236.description: 激活分散在多种语言和文体中：常见于跨 token 切分的 Virginia 专名，也响应日语「即時」、法语「plusieurs」、英语「no way」，以及 Velocette 和西语「aún」等局部字符串；未见统一语义或语法功能。

patterns.name: Virginia 字符串中的分词片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于跨 token 切分的地名或专名 Virginia 中；大小写、词边界及前后字母不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、人物署名、法律文本、电视节目介绍

patterns.name: 日语「即時」的即时支付表述
patterns.context: 日文句子谈及 PayPal 账户、更新及支付通知。
patterns.domain: 日语问答或技术支持文本

patterns.name: 法语「plusieurs」中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在「de plusieurs États membres」中，表示多个成员国。
patterns.domain: 法语欧洲议会政策文本

patterns.name: 英语否定习语「no way」
patterns.context: 作为固定表达出现；一处用于强调不代表某事，另一处用于惊讶或否定回应。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件免责声明、网络论坛对话

patterns.name: 赛车手传记中的车名
patterns.context: 出现在摩托车竞赛传记中，指 Velocette 摩托车品牌。

patterns.name: 西班牙语「aún」
patterns.context: 出现在谈论 running 页面访问量的西班牙语句子中。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语网页或社交文本

en.description: Activations occur on intra-word fragments in French, Russian, Greek, and English, often splitting stems, suffixes, or proper names; they also appear in paths and numbers. They occur across languages and genres, with sensitivity to local subword fragments as their main commonality.

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on one or more internal subword fragments of French words, often involving stems or affixes; ordinary French syntax surrounds them.

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on contiguous or split fragments inside Cyrillic Russian words, especially endings or internal syllables; embedded in Russian sentences.

patterns.name: Fragments within Greek words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Greek-script words, including initial, medial, and final positions; surrounded by Greek syntax.

patterns.name: English intra-word fragments and proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal fragments of English words or proper names, often involving mixed capitalization, word boundaries, or proper-name spelling; also occurs in paths, names, and legal entity names.
patterns.domain: English news, encyclopedias, forums, code errors, and legal texts

patterns.name: Numeric or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs when numbers are embedded in file paths or citations; the available context is insufficient to determine a specific numeric-format condition.

3_1236.description: 激活散布于法语、俄语、希腊语及英语的词内片段，常切分词干、词尾或专名；也出现在路径和编号中。跨语言、跨文体均见，主要共同点是对局部子词片段敏感。

patterns.name: 法语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词的一个或多个内部子词片段上，常涉及词干或词缀；周围有普通法语句法。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西里尔字母俄语词内部的连续或分段片段上，尤其是词尾或词内音节；嵌在俄语句子中。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊字母词语内部的片段上，包含词首、词中和词尾；周围是希腊语句法。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段及专名
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语词或专名的内部片段上，常与大小写混合、词界或专名拼写有关；也见于路径、姓名和法律实体名称。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、百科、论坛、代码错误和法律文本

patterns.name: 数字或编号片段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在文件路径或引用信息中时出现；现有上下文不足以确定具体数字格式条件。
patterns.domain: 代码错误信息及参考文献

en.description: Activations occur in French parliamentary text, build configurations and source code, system/hardware terminology, medical abstracts, and event announcements; rare proper names also appear, with no obvious common semantic signal.

patterns.name: Rare place names and proper names
patterns.context: Narrates an Italian concert promoter’s expansion and jokes about the North Korean capital and Dennis Rodman

patterns.name: Configuration script options
patterns.context: Environment variables and GNU configure argument lists

patterns.name: French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Formal French speech and agenda descriptions, including split French word forms

patterns.name: Build command in a Ruby recipe
patterns.context: A Homebrew-style recipe defines dependencies and runs a configuration command

patterns.name: Event dates and ordinal years
patterns.context: Dates and years of event editions in an event update

patterns.name: Linux CPU performance fields
patterns.context: Comments explain differences between target and actual frequency and refer to processor registers

patterns.name: Auditory research terminology
patterns.context: Studies cochlear nerve responses after noise exposure and mentions 500 Hz

patterns.name: Android C graphics code
patterns.context: C-style function declarations, comment separators, and Android graphics device identifiers

3_1236.description: 激活分布于法语议会文字、构建配置与源码、系统/硬件术语、医学摘要及活动公告，也见罕见专名；共同语义线索不明显。

patterns.name: 罕见地名与专名
patterns.context: 叙述意大利演出经纪人扩张，并以朝鲜首都和 Dennis Rodman 作笑谈

patterns.name: 配置脚本选项
patterns.context: 环境变量及 GNU configure 参数列表

patterns.name: 法语议会发言
patterns.context: 法语正式发言及议程叙述，包含拆分的法语词形

patterns.name: Ruby 配方中的构建命令
patterns.context: Homebrew 风格配方定义依赖并运行配置命令

patterns.name: 活动日期与序数年份
patterns.context: 活动更新中的日期和活动举办年数
patterns.domain: 能源行业邮件/活动公告

patterns.name: Linux CPU 性能字段
patterns.context: 注释解释目标与实际频率差异及处理器寄存器

patterns.name: 听觉研究术语
patterns.context: 研究噪声暴露后耳蜗神经反应，提及 500 Hz

patterns.name: Android C 图形代码
patterns.context: C 风格函数声明、注释分隔线及 Android 图形设备标识符

en.description: Activations are scattered across several formats: first of series expressions, encyclopedia name-and-birth details, legal expressions of doubt, code structures, and music and sports entry titles.
