Some co-occurrences may arise from text formatting or tokenization and cannot be reduced to one semantic category.

patterns.name: English ordinal first/of collocation
patterns.context: When describing a series of articles, a monthly survey, or a competition, first is followed by of to indicate the first in a series; activation falls on first, of, and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: English names and split intra-word fragments
patterns.context: At the beginning of an encyclopedia biography, a name is split into multiple tokens, then typically repeated after a line break with a birth date. The name forms and marked fragments vary, so a shared triggering substring cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Expression of caution or doubt
patterns.context: In legal argument, state of dubiety expresses doubt; activation falls on state, of, and an intra-word fragment of dubiety.

patterns.name: Structures and numeric literals in code
patterns.context: Closing braces, declaration keywords, and register-information identifiers in C-style code; triggers are scattered, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Album-entry title format
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry begins with a work title, followed by an introduction to the debut studio album and its release information; both the title and descriptive words may be relevant.

patterns.name: Numeric names or identifiers in text
patterns.context: The title and competition year of a sports encyclopedia entry; the other activations in the passage do not show a clear pattern independent of numbers.

3_1236.description: 激活分散于多种格式：first of 系列表达、百科人物名与出生信息、法律疑虑措辞、代码结构，以及音乐和体育条目标题。部分共现可能来自文本格式或分词，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 英语序数 first/of 搭配
patterns.context: 描述系列文章、每月调查或赛事时，first 后接 of，表示系列中的首个；激活落在 first、of 及附近 token 上。

patterns.name: 英文人名及分词式词内片段
patterns.context: 百科人物条目开头，姓名被分成多个 token，通常换行后重述姓名并附出生日期。姓名字形和所标记片段不完全一致，无法确定共同触发子串。

patterns.name: 审慎或疑虑表达
patterns.context: 法律论述中，state of dubiety 表示产生疑虑；激活落在 state、of 及 dubiety 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构与数字字面量
patterns.context: C 风格代码中的闭合花括号、声明关键词和寄存器信息标识符；触发点分散，缺少明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 专辑条目标题格式
patterns.context: 百科条目以作品名标题开头，随后介绍首张录音室专辑及发行信息；标题和描述词均可能相关。

patterns.name: 文中数字化名称或编号
patterns.context: 赛事百科条目的标题及赛事年份；该段的其余激活未显示清晰、独立于数字的模式。

en.description: Across code, encyclopedias, papers, chat, email, and medical abstracts, activations often fall on internal fragments of mixed-case or compound words, and also occur in names, place names, dates, and formatting markers; there is no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Mixed-case identifiers in code
patterns.context: In Objective-C code, camel-case identifiers and type names are split into fragments with different capitalization; activation falls inside or adjacent to identifiers.

patterns.name: Dates and comment formatting in C++ file headers
patterns.context: File-header comments contain fixed-format text such as author, creation date, and copyright year; activation concentrates on date numbers, punctuation, and name fragments.

patterns.name: Mixed-case fragments within place names or proper names
patterns.context: In encyclopedic geography text, place names, organization names, and other proper names are split into mixed-case or intra-word fragments; descriptive terms about places also occur.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments and title formatting in technical text
patterns.context: Academic text contains citation markers, footnotes, Markdown-style section headings, and technical terms; activations are scattered across word fragments and ordinary words.

patterns.name: Username fragments in IRC conversations
patterns.context: Chat logs contain angle-bracketed usernames, informal technical discussion, and URLs; activation falls on fragments within usernames.

patterns.name: Email signatures, forwarding headers, and dates/times
patterns.context: At the boundary between email body text and forwarding/quoted headers, formatted fields include polite expressions, names, dates, and times.

patterns.name: Compound-term tokenization in medical titles
patterns.context: Abstract titles or bodies contain medical or experimental terms made up of multiple morphemes; activation falls on word beginnings or compound fragments.

3_1236.description: 跨代码、百科、论文、聊天、邮件和医学摘要，激活常落在大小写混合或复合词的内部片段，也见于姓名、地名、日期及格式标记；没有单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码中的大小写混合标识符
patterns.context: Objective-C 代码中，驼峰式标识符及类型名被拆成不同大小写片段；激活落在标识符内部或相邻位置。

patterns.name: C++ 文件头中的日期与注释格式
patterns.context: 文件头注释中出现作者、创建日期、版权年份等固定格式文本，激活集中在日期数字、标点和名字片段。

patterns.name: 地名或专名内部的大小写片段
patterns.context: 百科地理文字中，地名、机构名等专名被拆成大小写或词内片段；同时出现地点描述词。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的词内片段及标题格式
patterns.context: 学术文本含引用标记、脚注、Markdown 式章节标题及专业术语，激活分散在词片段和普通词上。

patterns.name: IRC 对话中的用户名片段
patterns.context: 聊天记录中有尖括号用户名、口语化技术讨论及 URL；激活落在用户名内部片段。

patterns.name: 邮件署名、转发头及日期时间
patterns.context: 邮件正文与转发/引用头交界处，出现礼貌用语、姓名、日期和时间等格式化字段。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的复合术语分词
patterns.context: 摘要标题或正文中出现由多个词素构成的医学/实验术语，激活落在词首或复合词片段。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, common short words, names, numbers, and code markers; “ave” recurs in both acoustic terminology and a personal name, while “of” recurs in two academic passages. Most other triggers are sporadic.

patterns.name: “ave” substring
patterns.context: The substring occurs inside words; there is no obvious shared syntactic or semantic condition
patterns.domain: Acoustic terminology in PubMed abstracts, and a name/code discussion in IRC

patterns.name: “o” fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the Italian word “quello” and the English fragment “prem-oistened”; the languages and contexts differ

patterns.name: “of” and following words
patterns.context: Both occur in English noun phrases, commonly in the structure “first of …”; however, the other activated words differ

patterns.name: Local fragments in names
patterns.context: A list of judges’ names in a legal document; activation falls on capitalized name fragments

patterns.name: XML/numbers and markup fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in Android XML code and attribute values

patterns.name: Date and time number fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in email header timestamps

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one passage; no stable shared lexical, syntactic, or formatting condition is evident

3_1236.description: 强激活分散于词内片段、常见短词、姓名、数字及代码标记；“ave”跨声学术语与人名重复出现，“of”也在两段学术叙述中重复，其余多为零散触发。

patterns.name: “ave”子串
patterns.context: 该子串出现在词内部；没有明显统一的句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的声学术语，以及 IRC 中的人名/代码讨论

patterns.name: “o”片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“quello”及英语片段“prem-oistened”中；两处语言和上下文不同
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学文本、清洁产品讨论

patterns.name: “of”及其后续词
patterns.context: 均处于英语名词短语中，常见结构为“first of …”；但其他激活词并不相同

patterns.name: 姓名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 法律文书的法官姓名列表；激活落在大写姓名片段

patterns.name: XML/数字与标记片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Android XML 代码和属性值中

patterns.name: 日期与时间数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的日期时间戳中

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各自只在单段中出现，未见稳定共同的词义、句法或格式条件

en.concept: Dialysis subword fragments and common-word responses
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the dialysis fragment in medical contexts related to dialysis; also responds to often, adverbs, and high-frequency function words across different genres, as well as XML tags and several isolated domain-specific words. Local triggers vary across segments, with no single semantic pattern covering all activations.

patterns.name: Dialysis- and kidney-disease-related terms
patterns.context: Dialysis, kidney disease, and related treatments or patient descriptions appear in medical text; several prominent activations fall on the suffix fragment in hemodialysis

patterns.name: Contextual use of often
patterns.context: Often is followed by a verb or participle to describe something common or frequent; not limited to a single topic

patterns.name: Adverbial use of primarily
patterns.context: Placed before a verb to indicate that an intervention is mainly aimed at early use

patterns.name: XML string resource tags
patterns.context: Android-style XML string resource entries, with attributes and values tokenized

patterns.name: High-frequency function words and local collocations
patterns.context: Function words such as prepositions and conjunctions in cross-topic text; responses may depend on local collocations or common phrases

patterns.name: Other sporadic domain-specific vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving poisoning symptoms, theoretical modeling, and espionage, respectively; apart from highlighted words, no stable shared trigger is evident

3_1742.concept: 透析词片段及常见词响应
3_1742.description: 主要对透析相关医学语境中的 dialysis 片段强烈响应；另在不同文体中响应 often、副词及高频功能词，并出现 XML 标记和若干孤立领域词。各段局部触发多样，未见单一语义模式覆盖全部激活。

patterns.name: 透析及肾病相关术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现透析、肾病及相关治疗或患者描述；多处显著激活落在 hemodialysis 的后缀片段

patterns.name: often 的上下文用法
patterns.context: often 后接动词或分词，描述某事常见或经常发生；不受单一主题限制

patterns.name: primarily 的副词用法
patterns.context: 置于动词前，说明干预措施主要针对早期使用

patterns.name: XML 字符串资源标记
patterns.context: Android 风格 XML 字符串资源条目，属性和值被分词标记

patterns.name: 高频功能词及其局部搭配
patterns.context: 跨主题文本中的介词、连词等功能词，似乎依赖局部搭配或常见短语

patterns.name: 其他零散领域词汇
patterns.context: 分别处于中毒症状、理论建模和间谍活动语境；除高亮词外未见稳定共同触发条件

en.description: The most prominent pattern is dialysis-related words in medical contexts, especially the word-final fragment “ialysis”; also, “often” repeatedly produces strong activation across multiple genres. The remaining highlighted words are scattered and difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Hemodialysis-related terms
patterns.context: Medical text contains descriptions related to dialysis, kidney disease, treatment, or research; the strongest activation is concentrated on the “ialysis” fragment.
patterns.domain: Nephrology, clinical medicine, and medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in often
patterns.context: When stating that something usually happens, is common, or occurs frequently; examples appear in espionage between companies, ineffective interventions, and modeling descriptions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, public health research, physics papers

patterns.name: Descriptions of symptom onset time
patterns.context: Describes the time from exposure to the onset of poisoning symptoms.

patterns.name: Other highlighted words with no shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: These highlights occur in contexts with no obvious connection, and some are common function words or different word-internal fragments.
patterns.domain: Public health, software strings, medicine, physics, encyclopedias, etc.

3_1742.description: 最突出的模式是医学语境中的透析相关词，尤其词尾片段“ialysis”；另在多种文体中，“often”也反复强激活。其余高亮词分散，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 血液透析相关术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现透析及肾病、治疗或研究相关描述；最强激活集中在“ialysis”片段。
patterns.domain: 肾脏病学、临床医学及医学研究摘要

patterns.name: often 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在陈述通常发生、常见或经常出现的情况时；分别见于公司间谍活动、干预措施失效和建模描述。
patterns.domain: 百科、公共卫生研究、物理学论文

patterns.name: 症状起始时间表述
patterns.trigger: «often»10，附近为“onset of symptoms is often within …”
patterns.context: 描述中毒症状从暴露到出现的时间。

patterns.name: 其他高亮词，未见共同触发模式
patterns.context: 这些高亮分布于彼此无明显联系的语境，且部分为常见功能词或不同词内片段。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、软件字符串、医学、物理、百科等

en.concept: Into constructions expressing entry or transformation
en.description: The most stable pattern is high activation on «into», especially when followed by an article or noun, in constructions expressing entry, transformation, or inclusion; a few additional activations fall on dates, God, and plant names, for unknown reasons.

patterns.name: Entering or incorporating into an object/set
patterns.context: Into is immediately followed by an article or noun, expressing transformation, inclusion, insertion, or entry into an object; «into» is a recurring high-activation trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: religious narratives, research abstracts, emails, patents, web descriptions, and encyclopedias; spans passages [1]-[10]

patterns.name: Sporadic activations without marked into
patterns.context: These activations have no obvious shared local semantic or grammatical condition; they may be coincidental co-occurrences or other cues not identifiable from the excerpts.
patterns.domain: Dates and religious narratives, botanical encyclopedias; spans passages [1], [7]

3_1742.concept: into 引出的进入或转化结构
3_1742.description: 最稳定的模式是高激活«into»，尤其后接冠词或名词，出现在进入、转化、归入等结构中；少数额外激活落在日期、God 和植物名称等词上，原因不明。

patterns.name: 进入或纳入某个对象/集合
patterns.context: into 后紧接冠词或名词，表示转化、归入、插入或进入某对象；其中«into»是反复出现的高激活触发词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：宗教叙述、科研摘要、邮件、专利、网页说明及百科；覆盖段落 [1]-[10]

patterns.name: 未标记 into 的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些激活没有明显共享的局部语义或语法条件；可能是偶然共现或其他未能从片段辨认的线索。
patterns.domain: 日期与宗教叙述、植物百科；覆盖段落 [1]、[7]

en.description: All excerpts show the strongest activation on the contiguous substring “into the”; following nouns and semantic domains vary, with no stable topic or genre restriction.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation into the
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the preposition into immediately followed by the definite article the; following nouns and sentence meanings vary, and the preceding text may involve relationships, technical descriptions, suggestions, actions, or broadcasting.

3_1742.description: 所有片段都在连续子串“into the”处出现最强激活，后接的名词及语义领域多样，未见稳定的主题或文体限制。

patterns.name: 固定搭配 into the
patterns.context: 激活集中在连续出现的介词 into 后接定冠词 the；其后的名词和句义各不相同，前文可为关系、技术说明、建议、行动或广播语境。

en.description: Several passages activate when claiming is followed by the content of an accusation, assertion, or right; other isolated triggers include Canadi-, legal uses of into, Halloween Treating, and commas in dates, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Claiming followed by an assertion or right
patterns.context: In several contexts, activation falls on claiming, followed by an assertion, accusation, identity, or right asserted by someone; these examples alone do not establish whether it responds only to this word.
patterns.domain: News, law, commentary, and general narrative

patterns.name: Canadi- string within a proper name
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the tokenized Canadiens substring in the team name Montreal Canadiens, especially Can; the rest of the same word in the same passage activates weakly.

patterns.name: Prepositional use of into
patterns.context: Occurs in the legal expression “passed into the possession of...”, meaning that property passes into the possession of a third party.

patterns.name: Treating used as an activity name
patterns.context: Appears in “Trick or Treating” in a Halloween activity list, as the name of a holiday activity; activation falls on the subword Treat.

patterns.name: Weekday format in date headings
patterns.context: A date heading lists the weekday, comma, month, and date-year; the high-activation token is the comma, with no clear lexical trigger shared with other passages.

3_1742.description: 多段在 claiming 后接指控、主张或权利内容时激活；另有 Canadi-、法律语境 into、万圣节 Treating 和日期逗号等孤立触发，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: claiming 后接主张或权利内容
patterns.context: 在若干语境中，激活落在 claiming，后面跟随某人提出的主张、指控、身份或权利；单凭这些例子不能确定它是否只响应该词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、评论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Canadi- 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Montreal Canadiens 队名中被分词的 Canadiens 子串，尤其是 Can 部分；同段同词其余部分激活弱。

patterns.name: into 的介词用法
patterns.context: 处于“passed into the possession of...”这一法律表达中，表示财产进入第三方占有。

patterns.name: Treating 的活动名称用法
patterns.context: 出现在万圣节活动清单的 “Trick or Treating” 中，作为节庆活动名称；激活落在 Treat 子词。
patterns.domain: 社区活动宣传、节庆日程

patterns.name: 日期标题中的星期格式
patterns.context: 日期标题以星期、逗号、月份和日期年份排列；高激活 token 是逗号，未见与其他段共享的明确词汇触发。

en.concept: Entry or transformation relations introduced by into
en.description: Strong activations are generally concentrated on objects or outcomes introduced by into: case investigations, contracts, court records, evidence, artistic forms, and presidential office; they also occur in legal rulings, citations, searches, and litigation facts.

patterns.name: Entry, incorporation, or formal inclusion
patterns.context: The trigger is usually in a prepositional phrase followed by an object such as an investigation, contract, record, evidence, work, or office; no single topic is required, but there is a tendency toward contexts involving entry into a state, document, or institution
patterns.domain: Primarily legal decisions, litigation facts, and quotations; also art descriptions and biographical entries

patterns.name: Court rulings and litigation-procedure language
patterns.context: Appears when a court discusses evidence, motions, standards of review, or party arguments; this is procedural and adjudicative language in continuous legal prose

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-search information
patterns.context: Includes case names, reporter volume and page numbers, footnotes, or decision search information; some occur in citation text and some in decision download instructions
patterns.domain: Legal citations, legal documents, and decision search services

patterns.name: Legal fact records, reports, and testimony
patterns.context: Describes witness testimony, presentence investigation reports, and materials admitted in court; the triggers also fit expressions about formal documents entering the case record

patterns.name: Legal issues and contract claims
patterns.context: Concerns disputes over answers, pleadings, party denials, and whether a contract was formed

patterns.name: Formal lists of people or offices
patterns.context: In an overview listing presidents and their inaugurated offices, “into” connects the oath to the office; it shares the syntax of entering a state with legal examples, but not the legal domain

patterns.name: Evolution of an artistic form
patterns.context: An art description explains how an initial concept developed into another performance form; “into” expresses transformation into a form

patterns.name: Phrases related to news investigations
patterns.context: Reports that an officer or judge was accused of leaking investigation details to the media; activation falls on the investigation object introduced by “into”

3_1742.concept: into 引出的进入或转变关系
3_1742.description: 强激活总体集中在 into 引出的对象或结果：案件调查、合同、法庭记录、证据、作品形式、总统职位；同时出现在法律裁判措辞、引证、检索和诉讼事实中。

patterns.name: 进入、纳入或正式收录
patterns.trigger: “into”后接对象，如“into the police investigation”“into the alleged contract”“into the record”“into evidence”“into a”“into the office”；也包括“under the theory”这类引出依据的结构
patterns.context: 触发词通常位于介词短语中，后接调查、合同、记录、证据、作品或职位等对象；不要求同一主题，但有进入某一状态、文书或机构语境的倾向
patterns.domain: 以法律判决、诉讼事实和引文为主；另有艺术介绍与人物条目

patterns.name: 法院裁定与诉讼程序措辞
patterns.trigger: “Overruling appellant's motion in limine”“permitted”“admitted into evidence”“plainly erroneous”“accept the state's concession”“reviews questions of law”“clearly erroneous”“appear to accept”
patterns.context: 出现在法院对证据、动议、审查标准或当事方主张作出说明时；这是连续法律文体中的程序性与裁判措辞

patterns.name: 法律引证与案件检索信息
patterns.trigger: “App. 364, 102 P.3d 7305”“Savelle v. Southern Railway Company”“A Treatise on the Conflict of Laws”“docket numbers”“case citations or footnotes”
patterns.context: 出现案件名、报告集卷页、脚注或判决检索信息；部分是引证正文，部分是判决下载说明
patterns.domain: 法律引证、法律文献与判决检索服务

patterns.name: 法律事实记录、报告及证词
patterns.trigger: “testified that she prepared the Presentence Investigation Report”“admitted the Presentence Report into the record”
patterns.context: 叙述证人证词、刑事判决前调查报告及法庭接纳材料；触发也符合正式文书进入案件记录的表达

patterns.name: 法律争点与合同主张
patterns.trigger: “plead alternative claims”“existence of the contract in dispute”“denied that the parties had entered into the alleged contract”
patterns.context: 围绕答辩、诉状、当事方否认及合同是否成立的争议展开

patterns.name: 正式人物或职位名录
patterns.trigger: “persons sworn into the office as President”
patterns.context: 在列举总统及其就职身份的概述中，“into”连接宣誓与职位；与法律用例共享进入状态的句法，不共享法律领域
patterns.domain: 百科全书式政治人物列表

patterns.name: 作品形式的演变
patterns.context: 艺术作品介绍中说明最初构想如何发展为另一种表演形式；“into”表示转变为某种形式
patterns.domain: 百科全书式戏剧与艺术介绍

patterns.name: 新闻调查相关短语
patterns.trigger: “leaked details to the press of the police investigation into Chris Huhne and Vicky Pry”
patterns.context: 报道警员或法官被指向媒体泄露调查细节；激活落在“into”引出的调查对象上

en.concept: Open-source license statements in source code
en.description: Responds mainly to fixed license wording in source code, especially “distributed under” in Apache 2.0 headers; it also responds to LGPL warranty disclaimers and Apache AS IS disclaimers and license restrictions.

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 license statements
patterns.context: Apache license file headers or license comments in source code; often accompanied by URLs, line breaks, indentation, or // and -- comment prefixes, with activation peaks concentrated on “under”
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license text

patterns.name: Open-source license disclaimers and warranty terms
patterns.context: License or copyright comments for a library or program, with capitalized warranty disclaimer language referring to LGPL; this is not the same fixed passage as the Apache license header
patterns.domain: GitHub source code comments, LGPL license statements

patterns.name: License grants and restrictions
patterns.context: Subsequent clauses in Apache license disclaimers, often appearing as // comments
patterns.domain: Apache license text in GitHub source code

3_1742.concept: 源码中的开源许可证声明
3_1742.description: 主要响应源码中许可证文本的固定措辞，尤其 Apache 2.0 头部“distributed under”；也响应 LGPL 无担保声明及 Apache 的 AS IS 免责声明、权限限制说明。

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 许可声明
patterns.trigger: “http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0”及“Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing”
patterns.context: Apache 许可证文件头部或源码中的许可证注释；常伴随 URL、换行、缩进或 //、-- 注释前缀，激活峰值集中在“under”
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码与许可证文本

patterns.name: 开源许可证免责声明与无担保条款
patterns.trigger: “WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY”“MERCHANTABILITY”“FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”“See the GNU Lesser General Public License”
patterns.context: 库或程序的许可证/版权注释中，以大写强调无担保措辞，并指向 LGPL；并非 Apache 许可头部的同一固定段落
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码注释、LGPL 许可声明

patterns.name: 许可证授予与限制说明
patterns.trigger: “distributed on an ‘AS IS’ BASIS”“WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”“See the License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License”
patterns.context: Apache 许可证免责声明后续条款，常以 // 注释形式出现
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码中的 Apache 许可文本

en.concept: Priv/Privacy and several word forms and formatting features
en.description: Mixed pattern: several passages activate on Priv/Privacy or privately held, but there are also independent triggers involving publishing standards, the applic stem, Scientific, and Wikipedia link headings, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Privately held category term
patterns.context: Wikipedia category entries describing privately held companies in a place or country; activation falls mainly on Priv, with weaker activation on ately and held.

patterns.name: Privacy-related words
patterns.context: Words such as Privacy or Privacy Policy; may appear in website links, policy headings, or body text discussing privacy, with activation often concentrated on Priv.
patterns.domain: Website policies, emails, online comments, and software documentation

patterns.name: Local trigger on the Priv prefix
patterns.context: In hotel promotional text, Priv is followed by acy to form Privacy and Comfort; Comfort also activates prominently, suggesting that the phrase or layout may contribute jointly to the response.

patterns.name: Publishing and journal standards
patterns.context: Discusses predatory journals, publication fees, and whether journals adhere to accepted standards; activation is distributed across publication-related words and adhere.

patterns.name: Electrostatic applicators
patterns.context: Technical description of industrial coating applications; activation is concentrated on the applic stem in applicators.

patterns.name: Applicant word form in legal contexts
patterns.context: Applicant occurs in U.S. statutes or judicial opinions; activation is concentrated on the applic stem and the suffix ant.

patterns.name: Scient-split word
patterns.context: Scientific calculator in a list of calculator entries; activation is distributed across subword fragments of Scientific.

patterns.name: External links heading
patterns.context: External links used as the heading for a link section on a Wikipedia page.

3_1742.concept: Priv/Privacy 与若干词形及格式特征
3_1742.description: 模式混杂：多段激活于 Priv/Privacy 或 privately held，但也有发表规范、applic 词干、Scientific 和维基链接标题等独立触发，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: Privately held 分类词
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类条目中，描述某地或某国的私人持有公司；激活主要落在 Priv，ately 和 held 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Privacy 相关词
patterns.context: Privacy 或 Privacy Policy 一类词语；可出现在网站链接、政策标题或讨论隐私的正文中，激活常集中在 Priv。
patterns.domain: 网站政策、邮件、网络评论及软件文档

patterns.name: Priv 前缀的局部触发
patterns.context: 酒店宣传语中，Priv 后接 acy，组成 Privacy and Comfort；同时 Comfort 也显著激活，说明该例可能由短语或版式共同触发。

patterns.name: 发表与期刊规范
patterns.context: 讨论掠夺性期刊、发表费用及期刊是否遵守公认标准；激活分布在发表相关词及 adhere。

patterns.name: Electrostatic applicators
patterns.context: 工业涂层应用的技术描述；激活集中在 applicators 的词干 applic。

patterns.name: 法律中的申请人词形
patterns.context: 美国法条或司法意见中出现 applicant；激活集中于 applic 词干及后缀 ant。

patterns.name: Scient 前缀的切分词
patterns.context: 计算器条目列表中的 Scientific calculator；激活分布在 Scientific 的子词片段。

patterns.name: External links 标题
patterns.context: Wikipedia 页面中作为链接区标题的 External links。

en.description: The most stable pattern is word-internal subword activation in entire/entirely; there is also substring activation across different amb- words and local activation on aren’t. The remaining marked words are scattered and lack a shared context, making them difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: entire/entirely
patterns.context: The word forms entire or entirely; activation is concentrated on the word-internal ent and ire subwords, especially ire.
patterns.domain: News, genetic testing, open-source licenses, and legal text; passages use the sense “whole/all.”

patterns.name: amb- word-initial substring
patterns.context: amb occurs inside different words, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Medical information, historical narratives, public health reports.

patterns.name: Negative contraction ending
patterns.context: Occurs in aren’t, with activation covering the stem and negative suffix; the sentence means that someone is not a partner.

patterns.name: Other sporadic words
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one context, so no stable shared trigger can be inferred from these examples; they may be incidental co-activations.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain emails, forums, code licenses, legal, medical, and encyclopedic text.

3_1742.description: 最稳定的模式是 entire/entirely 的词内子词激活；另有跨不同 amb-词的子串激活及 aren’t 的局部激活。其余标记词分散且缺少共同语境，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: entire/entirely
patterns.context: 词形 entire 或 entirely；激活集中在词内切分的 ent、ire 子词上，尤其 ire。
patterns.domain: 新闻、基因检测、开源许可证、法律文本；段落叙述中出现“整个/全部”之意。

patterns.name: amb-词首子串
patterns.context: amb 出现在不同单词内部，未见一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医疗信息、历史叙述、公共卫生报告。

patterns.name: 否定缩写词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 aren’t 中，激活覆盖词干与否定词尾；句意为不属于合作伙伴的人。
patterns.domain: 创业公司/商业说明，讨论订购渠道。

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 各自只在单个上下文出现，无法从这些例子归纳出稳定的共同触发条件；可能是偶发共激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的邮件、论坛、代码许可、法律、医学与百科文本。

en.concept: amb- word beginnings and related forms
en.description: Activates mainly at amb- word beginnings: ambulatory (patients, subjects, outpatient care, or activity) and ambulance; also seen in the legal abbreviation Am. and ambassadors. Passage 2 has no obvious corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: ambulatory medical or research subjects
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of ambulatory; refers to ambulatory patients, subjects, men, or physical activity in outpatient or community settings. The context is explicitly medical or research-related.

patterns.name: Ambulance
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of ambulances; refers to ambulances in contexts involving emergency care, medical transport, disasters, or rescue.
patterns.domain: Medical transport, disaster reports, robotic rescue research, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Abbreviation Am. in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in legal cases or citations to legal literature as an abbreviation for American Jurisprudence; unrelated to ambulatory/ambulance.

patterns.name: Word-initial amb in ambassadors
patterns.context: Occurs within ambassadors, referring to envoys; unrelated to medical semantics.

3_1742.description: 主要在 amb-词首激活：ambulatory（患者、受试者、门诊或活动）及 ambulance（救护车）；另见法律缩写 Am. 和 ambassadors。第2段无明显对应触发。

patterns.name: ambulatory 医疗或研究对象
patterns.context: 出现在 ambulatory 一词开头；指可行走或门诊/社区环境中的患者、受试者、男性或身体活动。上下文明确医疗或研究语境。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究、公共卫生

patterns.name: 救护车
patterns.context: 出现在 ambulances 一词开头；指救护车，涉及急救、医疗运输、灾害或救援。
patterns.domain: 医疗运输、灾害报告、机器人救援研究、百科

patterns.name: 法律引文中的缩写 Am.
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例或法律文献引注中，是 American Jurisprudence 的缩写；与 ambulatory/ambulance 无关。

patterns.name: ambassadors 词首
patterns.context: 出现在 ambassadors 一词内部，指被派出的使节；与医疗语义无关。

en.description: Primarily responds to the intra-word fragment amb, covering ambulatory (outpatient, able to walk, etc.) and ambulance; also responds to the communic/ic/ative fragments of communicative, with one isolated ARE activation.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments of communicative
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments of communicative: in legal contexts discussing whether evidence is testimonial or communicative, and in a research plan discussing the non-communicative function of vocalization.

patterns.name: Initial fragment of ambulatory
patterns.context: Often describes outpatient or non-hospitalized patients, or mobility: e.g., ambulatory subjects/patients, ambulatory care/PA/men; also occurs in ambulance.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, public health, gerontology; multi-agent task descriptions

patterns.name: Isolated highlighted ARE
patterns.context: Seen only as an isolated uppercase string at the beginning of a fragment; surrounding semantics are insufficient to determine its function.

3_1742.description: 主要对词内片段 amb 起反应，涵盖 ambulatory（门诊、可行走等）及 ambulance；另对 communicative 的片段 communic/ic/ative 有反应，并有一次孤立的 ARE 激活。

patterns.name: communicative 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 communicative 的分词片段上；在法律语境中谈证据是否具有 testimonial 或 communicative 性质，在研究计划中谈 vocalization 的 non-communicative function。

patterns.name: ambulatory 的词首片段
patterns.context: 多见于描述门诊、非住院患者或活动能力：如 ambulatory subjects/patients、ambulatory care/PA/men；另有 ambulance 一词。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、公共卫生、老年研究；多智能体任务描述

patterns.name: 独立高亮的 ARE
patterns.context: 仅见于片段开头的孤立大写字母串，周边语义不足以判断其功能。

en.concept: Mixed word forms and legal-text cues
en.description: Activation cues are scattered: several fall on commun(icative), am character fragments, and legal negation/notice expressions; others occur in judgment formatting, forum emphasis words, NIH terminology, and patent word fragments, making a single semantic explanation difficult.

patterns.name: Communicative word forms
patterns.context: Communicative or non-communicative appears, especially split across multiple subword tokens; one instance describes the nature of legal evidence, another the function of vocalization.

patterns.name: Initial or medial am
patterns.context: Includes various words beginning with or containing am, with no consistent semantics; am is usually word-initial but also occurs word-medially.
patterns.domain: Law, medical research, forum discussions, patents

patterns.name: Negation and notice expressions
patterns.context: Legal contexts include negation, lack of notice, or statements of adverse information; also includes a negative sentence in forum text.

patterns.name: Pubic fragment in a patent
patterns.context: Appears in a patent description of the area covered by a condom's protective structure.

patterns.name: PER CURIAM in a judicial opinion
patterns.context: A court-opinion format marker at the beginning of a judgment.

patterns.name: Amendments and court citation format
patterns.context: Statements in court opinions about standards of review, dismissal, and amendments, interspersed with statutory or case citations.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in forum text
patterns.context: Informal discussion expressing freedom, raising doubts, or proposing alternatives; the words have no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Astrocytes and experimental terminology
patterns.context: A research plan describing receptors, second messengers, cultures, and toxins associated with hepatic encephalopathy.

3_1742.concept: 混合词形与法律文本线索
3_1742.description: 激活线索分散：多处落在 commun(icative)、am 字符片段及法律否定/告知表达；其余见于判决格式、论坛强调词、NIH 术语和专利词片段，难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: communicative 词形
patterns.context: 出现 communicative 或 non-communicative，尤其被拆分成多个子词 token；一处描述法律证据性质，一处描述发声功能。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: am- 词首或词中
patterns.context: 包含以 am 开头或词中出现 am 的多种词，语义并不统一；常位于词首，也有词中情况。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学研究、论坛讨论、专利

patterns.name: 否定与告知表达
patterns.context: 法律语境中出现否定、未获告知或不利信息陈述；另有论坛文本中的否定句。

patterns.name: 专利中 pubic 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专利对避孕套防护结构覆盖区域的描述中。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的 PER CURIAM
patterns.context: 判决正文开头的法院意见格式标记。

patterns.name: 修订及法院引用格式
patterns.context: 法院意见中关于审查标准、驳回及修订的表述，夹有法条或判例引证。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的强调词
patterns.context: 非正式讨论中表达自由、质疑或提出替代方案；各词之间缺少明确共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 星形胶质细胞与实验术语
patterns.context: 描述受体、第二信使、培养物及肝性脑病相关毒素的研究计划。

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and sporadic words
en.description: Strong patterns involve internal subword fragments of pubic, communicative, and Barreau; other activations occur on various common words in news and forum passages, with no consistent semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of pubic
patterns.context: Activation falls on the pub/ic subword fragments of pubic, referring to the pubic bone, pubic ramus, or pubic region of the body
patterns.domain: Medical, surgical, patent, and legal texts

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of communicative
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subwords of communicative, appearing in both negative descriptions and quoted legal statements

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of Barreau
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Bar/re string in a proper noun or name; contexts concern a Quebec lawyers' organization and the name of a Somali mayor, respectively

patterns.name: Common function and narrative words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across news narratives and informal forum text, with no clear semantic link to pubic, communicative, or Barreau

3_1742.concept: 特定子词片段及零散词
3_1742.description: 强模式是 pubic、communicative、Barreau 等词的内部子词片段；另有新闻与论坛段落中多种普通词激活，缺乏一致语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: pubic 的词内切分
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 pubic 的 pub/ic 子词片段上；指向耻骨、耻骨支或身体的耻区
patterns.domain: 医学、外科、专利及法律文本

patterns.name: communicative 的词内切分
patterns.context: 激活落在 communicative 的内部子词上，既出现于否定性描述，也出现于引号中的法律表述

patterns.name: Barreau 的词内切分
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或姓名中的 Bar/re 字符串上；上下文分别涉及魁北克律师组织及索马里市长姓名

patterns.name: 普通功能词与叙述词
patterns.context: 激活分散在新闻叙述和非正式论坛文字中，未见与 pubic、communicative 或 Barreau 的明确语义联系

en.description: Activations are distributed across several distinct word-form fragments: two European Parliament passages in different languages, pubic in medical/patent texts, not aware and communicative in legal texts, and Amid in a book title. There is insufficient evidence that they share a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation in Bulgarian
patterns.context: Activation markers are embedded within Cyrillic word forms, particularly intra-word fragments made up of adjacent characters; the context is a parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation in Romanian
patterns.context: Activations occur on Romanian word fragments or near punctuation, with several triggers falling inside words; the context discusses the Middle East and the Palestinian people.

patterns.name: Pubic-related word fragments
patterns.context: Falls within the English word pubic, concerning the pubic ramus, pubic region, or related anatomical locations; appears in various academic and patent contexts.

patterns.name: The phrase not aware
patterns.context: In legal narratives, not aware indicates that a party or witness lacked knowledge; it recurs, with aware marked.

patterns.name: Fragments in communication/evidence wording
patterns.context: Appears in negative legal arguments describing whether evidence is testimonial or communicative; triggers span word segmentation.

patterns.name: Amid in a book title
patterns.context: The trigger forms Amid in the book title Amid snowy wastes; no clear shared syntactic or thematic condition is evident.

3_1742.description: 激活分布于若干不同词形片段：两段不同语言的欧洲议会文本、医学/专利中的 pubic、法律中的 not aware 及 communicative，以及书名 Amid。没有充分证据证明它们共享单一语义。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内切分
patterns.context: 激活标记嵌在西里尔字母词形内部，特别是相邻字符组成的词内片段；语境为议会发言。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内切分
patterns.context: 对罗马尼亚语词或标点附近的片段激活，多个触发项落在词内；语境谈中东及巴勒斯坦人民。

patterns.name: pubic 相关词片段
patterns.context: 落在英文 pubic 一词内部，涉及耻骨支、耻骨区域或相关解剖位置；不同学术与专利语境均有出现。

patterns.name: not aware 搭配
patterns.context: 法律叙述中以 not aware 表达当事人或证人不知情；多次出现且 aware 被标记。

patterns.name: 沟通/证据措辞中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在否定的法律论证中，描述证据是否具有 testimonial 或 communicative 性质；触发项跨越单词分段。

patterns.name: 书名中的 Amid
patterns.context: 触发项组成书名 Amid snowy wastes 中的词 Amid；没有明显共享的句法或主题条件。

en.description: Primarily activates on aware, its negated form not aware, and the phrase aware of, commonly in legal texts assessing knowledge; a few activations fall on inconsistent intra-word fragments such as re and other sporadic words.

patterns.name: Negated form of aware
patterns.context: In legal narratives, states that a party or witness did not know a fact, condition, or claim; often appears in clauses assessing whether they had knowledge.

patterns.name: Aware of something
patterns.context: Aware of is followed by an event, identity, discrimination, or comment known to someone; occurs in both legal factual statements and research abstracts.

patterns.name: Elliptical use of aware
patterns.context: The local trigger is aware, often adjacent to a form of be and expressing knowledge or lack thereof in a legal context.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal documents, also research abstracts

patterns.name: Intra-word re string
patterns.context: Activation falls on intra-word fragments spanning tokens rather than a stable complete word or consistent semantics; trigger positions and contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Forum text, local news, Swedish parliamentary text

patterns.name: Other accompanying local activations
patterns.context: These tokens have no clear shared trigger with the dominant aware pattern and may be sporadic activations caused by context or tokenization.

3_1742.description: 主要对 aware 及其否定式 not aware、搭配 aware of 激活，常见于法律文本中的知情判断；少量激活落在词内 re 等不一致片段及其他零散词上。

patterns.name: aware 的否定式
patterns.trigger: « not»« aware»（第1、2、8、9段）；« were»« not»« aware»（第9段）
patterns.context: 法律叙述中，说明当事人或证人不知道某事实、状态或主张；常见于判断其是否知情的从句。

patterns.name: aware of 某事
patterns.context: “aware of”后接某人知悉的事件、身份、歧视或评论；既有法律事实陈述，也有研究摘要。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、社会科学/医学研究

patterns.name: aware 的省略式
patterns.context: 局部触发词为 aware；常与 be 动词相邻，并在法律语境中表达知情与否。
patterns.domain: 以法律文书为主，另见研究摘要

patterns.name: 词内 re 字符串
patterns.trigger: «re»，分别出现在 «App»«re»«icate»（appreciate）、Bar«re»（Barre）及 «f»«att»（拼接后为瑞典语词片段）中
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 的词内部片段，而非稳定的完整词或一致语义；触发位置与上下文差异明显。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、地方新闻、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 其他局部伴随激活
patterns.trigger: « time»、« accepting» 等；第5段另有「Inte»« hell」等瑞典语片段
patterns.context: 这些 token 与主导的 aware 模式无明确共同触发条件，可能是上下文或分词造成的零散激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、瑞典语议会文本

en.concept: Negated knowledge and sporadic word fragments
en.description: The most stable trigger is not aware in legal contexts, alongside too late and several intra-word fragments from medical, German, and common words; the remaining activations have no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Negated knowledge
patterns.context: In legal or medical statements, negates that someone or a medical history has a particular kind of knowledge or awareness; the core trigger in passages 1, 6, 8, 9, and 10 is aware, while passage 2 has only an adjacent negation expression.

patterns.name: Too late at the end
patterns.context: Expresses that an intervention, prevention, or action occurred too late; appears in accounts of delayed treatment and attempts to prevent an event.

patterns.name: Intra-word activation in antacids
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal subword fragment of antacids, in a description of abdominal pain history and factors providing relief.

patterns.name: German compound-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within the German word Interessen (interests), in a discussion of balancing social interests.

patterns.name: Sentiment-related intra-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a likely intra-word fragment of suffering; the sentence discusses whether someone is suffering from a condition, but the fragment is insufficient to confirm the full word form.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Occur within surprised, recklessly, insbesondere, and Saisonalität, respectively, with no common context or stable semantics.
patterns.domain: Online commentary, legal texts, German parliamentary text

3_1742.concept: 否定知晓及零散词片段
3_1742.description: 最稳定的触发是法律语境中“not aware”，另有“too late”及若干医学、德语和普通词的词内片段；其余激活缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 否定知晓
patterns.context: 在法律或医学陈述中，否定某人/病史具备某种认知或事实；段1、6、8、9、10 的核心触发是 aware，段2仅有相邻的否定表达。

patterns.name: too late 结尾
patterns.context: 表达干预、预防或行动发生得太晚；分别出现在治疗延误和阻止事件的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 公共议题评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 抗酸剂词内激活
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 antacids 的内部子词片段，处于腹痛病史与缓解因素的描述中。

patterns.name: 德语复合词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语 Interessen（利益）一词的内部片段，谈及社会利益之间的平衡。

patterns.name: sentiment 相关词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在疑似 suffering 的词内片段；句子讨论是否遭受某种情况，但片段不足以确证完整词形。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 surprised、recklessly、insbesondere、Saisonalität 的词内，未见共同上下文或稳定语义。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、法律文本、德语议会文本

en.concept: Cognitive states and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Primarily activates on cognitive-state words (aware, unaware, knew) and their negated forms; other activations are scattered across whitespace in legal formatting, word fragments describing educational observations, marketing copy, medical terminology, and mobile advertising terminology.

patterns.name: Not knowing or being unaware
patterns.context: Indicates that someone knows, is unaware, or lacks relevant knowledge; common structures include “not aware that/of”, “became aware that”, and “unaware of”. The meaning centers on cognitive state but does not require a specific construction.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical abstracts, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Whitespace in legal document layout
patterns.context: Areas of multiple spaces in court document titles or headers are marked; nearby are uppercase “FILED”, “NOT FOR PUBLICATION”, and a date.

patterns.name: Fragmented words in descriptions of appearance and response
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of classroom observations, decision-making, and observational information, concerning students' appearance, responses, and behavior; triggers fall on split word fragments.

patterns.name: Word fragments in advertising copy
patterns.context: In a sentence introducing Chinese e-commerce and digital marketing professionals and product promotion, the triggered fragments form advertise.

patterns.name: Hypoxia-related medical term
patterns.context: Occurs as the final fragment of “apneic” in an anesthesia/respiratory support context, near oxygen administration and a non-dependent lung.

patterns.name: Mobile advertising metric
patterns.context: Forms “click-through ads”, alongside mobile advertising revenue and app installs.

3_1742.concept: 认知状态及零散词片段
3_1742.description: 主要对认知状态词（aware、unaware、knew）及其否定表达激活；其余激活分散在法律排版空格、教育观察词片段、营销广告词、医学术语片段和移动广告术语中。

patterns.name: 不知道或未意识到
patterns.context: 表示某人知道、没意识到或缺乏相关知识，常见结构包括 “not aware that/of”、 “became aware that” 和 “unaware of”；语义上围绕认知状态，但不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学摘要及一般说明文

patterns.name: 法律文件版式中的空格
patterns.context: 法院文件标题或页眉中，多个空格组成的排版区域被标记；邻近大写的 “FILED”“NOT FOR PUBLICATION” 和日期。

patterns.name: 外观与反应描述中的残缺词
patterns.context: 出现在课堂观察、决策与观察信息的说明中，涉及学生外观、反应和行为；触发落在被拆分的词片段上。

patterns.name: 广告推广用语中的词片段
patterns.context: 在介绍中国电商与数字营销人员、推广产品的句子中，触发词片段组成 advertise。

patterns.name: 医学中的缺氧相关术语
patterns.context: 作为 “apneic” 的末尾片段，出现在麻醉/呼吸支持语境，邻近氧气吸入及非依赖肺。

patterns.name: 移动广告指标
patterns.context: 组成 “click-through ads”，与移动端广告收入、应用安装并列。

en.description: Primarily activates on unaware (not knowing or being conscious of something) across medical, legal, technology, and commentary contexts; two isolated patterns are silent describing a factory street and Finnish ammusten (ammunition).

patterns.name: Unaware indicating lack of knowledge
patterns.context: Describes an individual, group, or professional lacking knowledge, awareness, or information about something; often followed by of/about or indirect content. Also appears in forms such as remained unaware and were unaware.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including medical papers, legal texts, technical explanations, news, and commentary

patterns.name: Silent describing quiet or inactivity
patterns.context: Describes a street near a factory as quiet; the context suggests the factory is no longer operating or local activity has declined.

patterns.name: Finnish ammusten (ammunition)
patterns.context: In a Finnish sentence, refers to ammunition reserves; occurs in a statement about destroying the stockpile.

3_1742.description: 主要对 unaware（不知情、未意识到）激活，跨医学、法律、科技及评论语境；另有工厂街道 silent，以及芬兰语 ammusten（弹药）两处孤立模式。

patterns.name: unaware 表示不知情
patterns.context: 描述个人、群体或专业人员缺乏对某事的知识、意识或知情；常接 of/about，或接间接内容。也出现 remained unaware、were unaware 等形式。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、科技说明、新闻与评论等多种文体

patterns.name: silent 描述安静或停摆
patterns.context: 形容工厂周边街道安静；语境暗示工厂不再营业或当地活动减少。

patterns.name: 芬兰语 ammusten（弹药）
patterns.context: 芬兰语句中，指弹药储备；处于关于销毁储备的表达中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治文本，芬兰语

en.description: Primarily responds to unaware, especially when indicating that a subject does not know a fact, has not noticed a phenomenon, or is unaware of a knowledge gap; contexts span medicine, law, technology, economics, and encyclopedic texts. Passage 10's activation pattern does not fit.

patterns.name: Unaware word form
patterns.context: Directly predicates that a person or group does not know or is unaware of something, often taking complements such as of or that; spans different semantic fields.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory prose, abstracts, legal and encyclopedic narratives

patterns.name: Failure to notice due to lack of attention
patterns.context: A stimulus is not attended to, so its presence is not noticed; unaware describes a perceptual or attentional outcome.

patterns.name: Insufficient disease-related knowledge
patterns.context: Lacks knowledge about disease transmission or prevention, or does not know that family members are also affected.

patterns.name: Unaware of one's own knowledge gap
patterns.context: The subject believes they understand but does not realize that their knowledge is insufficient.
patterns.domain: Gynecological patient information and health education abstracts

patterns.name: Not informed of a fact or condition
patterns.context: A party claims not to have seen the relevant reports or received notice and therefore did not know that the company was insolvent.

patterns.name: Unaware of operational risks
patterns.context: Operators may damage optical fiber due to lack of awareness or forgetting strict requirements.

patterns.name: Unaware of hidden costs or benefits
patterns.context: An institution or the public does not know about undisclosed expenses or potential benefits.
patterns.domain: Public health economics, legal/marketing web text

patterns.name: Failure to observe an astronomical event
patterns.context: When the event occurred, potential observers failed to notice it due to conditions such as weather.

patterns.name: Unexplained activation
patterns.context: This passage contains no unaware or clear trigger related to being unaware or lacking knowledge; activations are concentrated on names, line breaks, and descriptive words.

3_1742.description: 主要响应 unaware，尤其是表示主体不知道某事实、未察觉现象或未意识到知识缺口；语境横跨医学、法律、技术、经济与百科文本。第10段激活模式与此不符。

patterns.name: unaware词形
patterns.context: 直接对“某人/群体不知道、未意识到某事”作谓语或表语，常接 of、that 等补语；覆盖不同词义场景。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、摘要、法律及百科叙述

patterns.name: 注意缺失导致未察觉
patterns.context: 未注意刺激，因而没有意识到其存在；unaware 描述知觉或注意结果。

patterns.name: 疾病相关认知不足
patterns.trigger: «unaware» regarding/about … transmission / prevention；«unaware» of a family «member» similarly affected
patterns.context: 不了解疾病传播或预防知识，或不知道家族成员也受影响。

patterns.name: 未意识到自身知识缺口
patterns.context: 主体自认为了解，但没有意识到自身知识不足。
patterns.domain: 妇科患者信息与健康教育摘要

patterns.name: 未获悉事实或状况
patterns.context: 当事人声称未看到相关报道或收到通知，因此不知道企业资不抵债。

patterns.name: 未意识到操作风险
patterns.trigger: «unaware» or «forget»ful of the strict bending requirements
patterns.context: 操作人员因缺乏认知或遗忘严格要求，可能损坏光纤。

patterns.name: 未察觉隐性成本或利益
patterns.trigger: «unaware» of its annual expenditures；«unaware» «of» the many hidden benefits
patterns.context: 机构或公众不知道未显明的支出或潜在利益。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生经济、法律营销类网络文本

patterns.name: 未观察到天文现象
patterns.context: 现象发生时，潜在观察者因天气等条件未能察觉。

patterns.name: 未解释的激活
patterns.context: 该段未出现 unaware 或明显的未察觉/无知语义触发，激活集中在人物名、换行及描述词上。

en.description: Most passages activate on unaware, indicating that a person or institution is unaware of a fact, risk, or knowledge gap; other patterns include a Finnish intra-word fragment, the contact field CONTACT, and silent describing a street, none of which have a clear semantic link to this pattern.

patterns.name: Unaware as a state or lack of knowledge
patterns.context: Directly describes an individual, group, institution, or government as not knowing a fact, risk, or behavior, or as unaware of its own knowledge gap; often followed by of/regarding.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health, neuropsychology, business, law, engineering explanations

patterns.name: Incomplete or tokenized aware
patterns.context: Part of a Finnish word form, adjacent to a context involving “resources/reserves”; it does not convey the English meaning of unaware here.

patterns.name: CONTACT in contact information
patterns.context: An uppercase contact-information field followed by a colon and institutional contact details; activation falls within CONTACT.

patterns.name: Silent state
patterns.context: Describes the quiet, soundless state of a street near a factory; has no apparent connection to the unaware/aware word forms.

3_1742.description: 多数段落激活于 unaware，表示人或机构未意识到某事实、风险或知识缺口；另有芬兰语词内片段、联系方式 CONTACT 和描述街道的 silent，均与该模式缺乏明确语义联系。

patterns.name: unaware 的状态或认知缺失
patterns.context: 直接描述个人、群体、机构或政府不知道某事实、风险、行为或自身知识缺口；常接 of / regarding。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生、神经心理、商业、法律、工程说明

patterns.name: 不完整或分词中的 aware
patterns.context: 芬兰语词形的一部分，邻接“资源/储备”一类语境；此处未见英语 unaware 含义。

patterns.name: 联系方式中的 CONTACT
patterns.context: 全大写联系信息字段，后接冒号及机构联系方式；激活落在 CONTACT 的词内。

patterns.name: 静默状态
patterns.context: 描述工厂周边街道安静、无人声的状态；与 unaware / aware 词形无明显联系。

en.concept: Noun phrases at the beginning of titles
en.description: Primarily responds to noun phrases at the beginning of paper titles or abstracts, especially structures like “Study/Utility/process/importance/cause/objective of”; also covers titles of various medical studies, title colons and line breaks, and a few titles about sexual health and vegetarianism, as well as business email salutations.

patterns.name: “of” and its preceding structure in medical paper titles
patterns.context: In noun phrases at the beginning of titles or abstracts, especially when of introduces the study subject, cause, or objective; stronger activations center on “of” and the immediately adjacent structure

patterns.name: “Study” in research titles
patterns.context: Title-like expressions at the beginning of a sentence, with of followed by the research topic

patterns.name: Colon and line break in abstract titles
patterns.context: A line break after a title, or a subtitle introduced by a colon

patterns.name: Specific terms and topic words in medical research
patterns.context: Specialty topic words in biomedical titles or abstracts; topics differ across examples, with no single shared term

patterns.name: Sexual behavior research titles
patterns.context: Titles describing sexual behavior and its determinants among unmarried young people in Malaysia

patterns.name: Vegetarianism transition research titles
patterns.context: Titles discussing the process of leaving vegetarianism

patterns.name: Email salutation and body introduction
patterns.context: Begins with the recipient’s name followed by a colon, then introduces new material on the next line

3_1777.description: 主要响应论文标题或摘要开头的名词短语，尤其是“Study/Utility/process/importance/cause/objective of”结构；也覆盖多类医学研究题名、标题冒号换行，以及少量性健康、素食主义题名和商务邮件称呼。

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的“of”及其前置结构
patterns.trigger: “Study of”“Utility of”“process of”“importance of”“principal cause of”“principal objective of”
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头的名词短语中，尤其是 of 引出研究对象、原因或目标时；较强激活集中在“of”及紧邻结构
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题与摘要

patterns.name: 研究题名中的“Study”
patterns.context: 句首标题式表达，Study 后接 of 及研究主题

patterns.name: 摘要标题中的冒号与换行
patterns.context: 题名后接换行，或标题以冒号引出副标题

patterns.name: 医学研究中的特定术语与主题词
patterns.trigger: “vitreous potassium”“protein expression”“protein-protein interaction”“human sis/PDGF-β gene”“cancer mortality”“magnetic resonance imaging”“appendicitis”“insulin injection”
patterns.context: 生物医学标题或摘要中的专科主题词；各例主题不同，未见单一共同术语

patterns.name: 性行为研究标题
patterns.context: 标题描述马来西亚未婚青年的性行为及其决定因素

patterns.name: 素食主义转变研究标题
patterns.context: 标题讨论退出素食主义的过程

patterns.name: 邮件称呼与正文引入
patterns.context: 以收件人名字加冒号开头，换行后引入最新材料

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the preposition “of,” especially when it connects a noun to its research subject, cause, importance, process, or objective in titles or scientific writing. A few activations fall on adjacent words, possibly due to tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Preposition “of”
patterns.context: Commonly follows a noun or nominalized expression, introducing possession, topic, cause, objective, or object; triggers across multiple syntactic environments
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles, abstracts, and research project texts

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Study of title format
patterns.context: A title begins with “Study of,” followed by the research object or topic

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The process of
patterns.context: “of” follows “The process” and introduces the object of the research process

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The importance of
patterns.context: “of” follows “The importance” and introduces what the importance concerns

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The principal cause of
patterns.context: “of” follows “cause” and introduces a cause-related object, followed by a description of cancer deaths and cell spread

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Utility of
patterns.context: “of” follows “Utility” and introduces the diagnostic technique or use being evaluated

patterns.name: objective of these studies
patterns.context: The research objective noun is followed by “of these studies,” then the research purpose is explained

patterns.name: of phrases after nominalized expressions
patterns.context: “of” occurs near nominalized expressions such as correlation, expression, death, or spread; in some examples, the marked activation falls on an adjacent content word rather than “of”

patterns.name: Highlight boundaries and tokenization noise
patterns.context: Tokenization splits or boundary markers may affect how activations appear on adjacent tokens; these fragments still contain highlighted “of” or other highlighted components
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, abstracts, and research texts

3_1777.description: 主要对介词“of”强烈响应，尤其在标题或科研表述中连接名词与其研究对象、原因、重要性、过程或目标。少数激活落在相邻词，可能与分词边界有关。

patterns.name: “of”介词
patterns.context: 常见于名词或名词化表达之后，引出所属、主题、原因、目标或对象；在多个不同句法环境中均触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题、摘要及科研项目文本

patterns.name: 句首 Study of 标题格式
patterns.context: 标题以“Study of”开头，后接研究对象或主题

patterns.name: 句首 The process of
patterns.context: “The process”之后由“of”引出研究过程的对象

patterns.name: 句首 The importance of
patterns.context: “The importance”之后由“of”引出重要性所涉及的事物
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题或项目文本

patterns.name: 句首 The principal cause of
patterns.context: “cause”之后由“of”引出病因相关对象，随后描述癌症死亡及细胞扩散

patterns.name: 句首 Utility of
patterns.context: “Utility”之后由“of”引出所评估的诊断技术或用途

patterns.name: objective of these studies
patterns.context: 科研目标名词后接“of these studies”，随后说明研究目的

patterns.name: 名词化表达后的 of 短语
patterns.context: 句中“of”处于相关性、表达、死亡或扩散等名词化表达附近；部分例子中标记激活落在相邻内容词而非“of”上

patterns.name: 高亮边界及分词噪声
patterns.context: 分词拆分或边界标记可能影响相邻 token 的激活呈现；这些片段仍包含高亮的“of”或其他高亮成分
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、摘要及科研文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across the title phrase “Study of,” the phrase “The United States,” display elements in patents, code structures, and local word forms such as “bastardized” and “Fix/Fixer”; the contexts differ substantially.

patterns.name: Study-initial word
patterns.context: The phrase begins with “Study of”; what follows is a research subject or relation, such as “vitreous potassium correlation” or “protein expression and protein-protein interaction”.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH research project titles

patterns.name: Consecutive phrase United States
patterns.context: The complete phrase “The United States” occurs, followed respectively by descriptions of military equipment or an evaluation of the United States.

patterns.name: Display element phrase
patterns.context: Describes liquid crystal display elements and their uses; “display elements” recurs, with a nearby mention of watches.

patterns.name: Code structure token
patterns.context: Activations occur near function-body closures, line breaks, and declaration/call structure symbols in C/C++ code; in the provided snippets, activations also fall on code identifiers.

patterns.name: Contested term in cultural cuisine
patterns.context: Discusses ownership, representation, and the alteration or appropriation of cultural and ethnic cuisine by white male chefs; activation falls on a tokenized segment of “bastardized”.

patterns.name: Fixing in formal mathematics
patterns.context: A theoretical computer science text uses “Fixing some optimal D” to introduce a subsequent definition; the same passage also contains formal terms such as “optimal”.

patterns.name: tmux-related Fix
patterns.context: A shell command comment uses “Fix tmux” to introduce a fix for tmux color display issues.

patterns.name: Fixer/fix function
patterns.context: Documentation comments describe indented text and a returned fixer function, with “Fix” and “fixer” appearing.

3_1777.description: 激活分散于标题短语“Study of”、短语“The United States”、专利中的显示元件、代码结构，以及“bastardized”和“Fix/Fixer”等局部词形；各处上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: Study 起始词
patterns.context: 短语以“Study of”开头；后接研究对象或研究关系，如“vitreous potassium correlation”或“protein expression and protein-protein interaction”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 研究项目标题

patterns.name: United States 连续短语
patterns.context: 出现完整短语“The United States”，后续分别接军队装备描述或对美国的评价。

patterns.name: 显示元件短语
patterns.context: 描述液晶显示元件及其用途；“display elements”重复出现，附近提到手表。

patterns.name: 代码结构 token
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码中函数体闭合、换行及声明/调用等结构符号附近激活；在给出的片段里激活也落在代码标识符上。

patterns.name: 文化菜肴争议词
patterns.context: 讨论文化与族裔菜肴的所有权、代表性及被白人男性厨师改造或挪用；激活落在“bastardized”的分词部分。
patterns.domain: 文化评论、会议讨论文本

patterns.name: 形式化数学中的 Fixing
patterns.context: 理论计算机科学文本中以“Fixing some optimal D”引出后续定义；同段另有“optimal”等形式化术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: tmux 相关 Fix
patterns.context: shell 命令注释中“Fix tmux”引出修复 tmux 颜色显示问题。
patterns.domain: GitHub 命令行配置与注释

patterns.name: Fixer/修复函数
patterns.context: 文档注释描述缩进文本与返回的 fixer 函数，出现“Fix”及“fixer”。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码文档/格式化工具

en.description: The most consistent cue is “Study of” at the beginning of academic titles; other activations are scattered across code (functions, struct, identifiers, and specific comments), contact-information phrasing in emails, Yahoo news alerts, and unrelated domain-specific phrases. Code snippets share code formatting but no single clear semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Study of in paper titles
patterns.context: Begins an academic title or title-like phrase, followed by the research subject or content.
patterns.domain: Medical literature abstracts, NIH project records

patterns.name: struct declaration in code
patterns.context: Appears in Go test code or code snippets declaring a struct.

patterns.name: Function/method structure in code
patterns.context: Function declarations, method calls, or block endings in code snippets; occurs across multiple languages.

patterns.name: Name tokenization in code
patterns.context: Identifiers are split into multiple tokens within code declarations, calls, or data structures; overlaps with function/struct contexts.

patterns.name: News email headline/alert
patterns.context: A copied news alert headline in an email body, followed by the news headline text.
patterns.domain: Forwarded/copied news content in Enron email

patterns.name: Contact information phrasing
patterns.context: Begins with contact information for an entity, followed by the company name and contact person’s name.

patterns.name: Code marker without an evident match
patterns.context: Option application and cookie/header comments in code; no clear shared trigger form with other snippets.

patterns.name: Unclear email/news text
patterns.context: News body text following a news alert headline; related to headline format, but the local activation cause is uncertain.

patterns.name: Unexplained local medical term combination
patterns.context: A phrase in an academic abstract title about the correlation between vitreous potassium and time; beyond sharing the title format, there is no obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: Unexplained research topic phrase
patterns.context: A title-like research phrase describing protein expression and interactions; overlaps only in title form and “Study of”.

patterns.name: Unexplained random URL code
patterns.context: PHP code generates a unique URL using a random parameter; its specific semantics differ from those of other code snippets.

3_1777.description: 最稳定的线索是学术标题开头的“Study of”；其余激活分散在代码（函数、struct、标识符及特定注释）、邮件中的联系人句式和 Yahoo 新闻警报，以及各自不同的领域词组。代码段共享代码格式但无单一明确语义触发点。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的 Study of
patterns.context: 作为学术标题或标题式短语开头，后接研究对象或研究内容。
patterns.domain: 医学文献摘要、NIH 项目记录

patterns.name: 代码中的 struct 声明
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 测试代码或声明结构体的代码片段中。

patterns.name: 代码中的函数/方法结构
patterns.trigger: «function»、«func»、«Get»、«Add»、«run» 等函数定义或调用附近，常伴随括号、花括号和换行
patterns.context: 代码片段中的函数声明、方法调用或块结束位置；多种语言均出现。

patterns.name: 代码里的名称分词
patterns.context: 标识符被切分成多个 token，位于代码声明、调用或数据结构中；与函数/结构体语境重叠。

patterns.name: 新闻邮件标题/警报
patterns.context: 邮件正文中复制的新闻提醒标题，随后接新闻标题文本。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的转发/复制新闻内容

patterns.name: 联系人信息句式
patterns.context: 以某实体的联系人信息开头，后接公司名称及联系人姓名。

patterns.name: 未明显对应的代码标记
patterns.context: 代码中选项应用及 cookie/header 说明；未见与其他片段明确共享的专门触发形式。

patterns.name: 未明晰的邮件/新闻文本
patterns.context: 新闻警报标题后的新闻正文片段，和标题格式有关，但局部激活原因不确定。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部医学术语组合
patterns.context: 学术摘要标题中研究玻璃体钾与时间相关性的短语；除同属标题外，没有明显共享触发点。

patterns.name: 未解释的研究主题短语
patterns.context: 研究标题式短语，描述蛋白表达及相互作用；仅与标题形式和 Study of 重叠。

patterns.name: 未解释的随机 URL 代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码通过随机参数生成唯一 URL；与其他代码片段的具体语义不同。

en.description: Activations cluster around recently, Study of, and several biomedical phrases in research texts; they also appear in PHP method/callback code and the phrase United States. There is also a string-processing code snippet, with no single trigger feature explaining all passages.

patterns.name: Emphasis word recently
patterns.context: In research prose, We is the subject and recently occurs before the verb; activation centers on recently rather than the specific research content that follows

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Study of
patterns.context: A title-like or abstract-like phrase beginning with Study of, followed by the research subject

patterns.name: PHP method/callback code
patterns.context: Object method calls, task execution, or assignment/construction of a method name and callback in PHP code

patterns.name: United States and Army phrases
patterns.context: The consecutive phrase United States appears in descriptions of U.S. Army equipment and in general statements about the United States

patterns.name: Biomedical named-entity fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on biomedical word fragments split across tokens; one occurs in a research findings and interactome context, the other in a title about vitreous potassium

patterns.name: Stable isotope tracing phrase
patterns.context: A methodology description introduces a research method after “recently developed”

patterns.name: Protein expression phrase
patterns.context: After Study of, protein expression and protein-protein interaction are listed as research topics

patterns.name: Specific amino acid phrase
patterns.context: A biochemical research statement following “We have recently shown that”

patterns.name: Cardiac myosin phrase
patterns.context: “We have recently characterized” is followed by the number of types and cardiac myosin

patterns.name: Unexplained PHP snippet
patterns.context: Code for string slicing and length calculation; its trigger differs from the object/method callback triggers in other snippets in the same batch

3_1777.description: 激活集中于科研文本中的 recently、Study of 及若干生物医学短语，也出现在 PHP 方法/回调代码和 United States 短语；另有字符串处理代码片段，未见单一触发特征能解释全部段落。

patterns.context: 科研叙述中以 We 作主语，recently 位于动词前；激活集中在 recently，而非后续具体研究内容

patterns.name: 句首 Study of
patterns.context: 以 Study of 开始的标题式或摘要式短语，后接研究对象
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 科研文本

patterns.name: PHP 方法/回调代码

patterns.name: 美国及 Army 短语

patterns.name: 生物医学专名片段

patterns.name: 未解释的 PHP 片段

en.description: Primarily activates on academically styled words containing “matically” (mathematically, schematically); it also responds sporadically to local word forms or terms such as array, weakly, supplies, Partitions, and applies.

patterns.name: Words containing mathematically
patterns.context: In academic sentences, the letter sequence “matically” occurs within a word or after its initial segment; contexts may describe modeling, diagrams, or applications.

patterns.name: array in PHP test code
patterns.context: Code snippets in PHPUnit tests involving array, foreach, and method checks.

patterns.name: Weakly negative definite link matrix terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical context describing a 3-manifold with boundary and matrix properties.

patterns.name: supplies in tax terminology
patterns.context: A court opinion discusses tax filing items; the word is split into prefix and suffix markers.

patterns.name: Partitions word form
patterns.context: The word “Partitions” in a title related to quantum theory; no clear local connection to other trigger words.

patterns.name: applies in web text
patterns.context: HTML text describes the objects to which a split graph feature applies; the word is split into prefix and suffix markers.

patterns.name: Weak equality constraint algebra
patterns.context: Discussion of the relationship between quantum and classical constraint algebras.

3_1777.description: 主要激活于词内含 “matically” 的 academically styled 词（mathematically、schematically）；另对 array、weakly、以及 supplies、Partitions、applies 等局部词形或术语有零散响应。

patterns.name: 单词中含 mathematically
patterns.context: 在学术句子中，单词内部或词首后出现字母串 “matically”；上下文可描述建模、图示或应用方式。

patterns.name: PHP 测试代码中的 array
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试代码中围绕 array、foreach 和方法检查的代码片段。

patterns.name: 弱负定链接矩阵术语
patterns.context: 描述带边界三维流形及其矩阵性质的数学语境。

patterns.name: 税务术语中的 supplies
patterns.context: 法庭意见讨论纳税申报项目，词形被拆成前缀与后缀标记。

patterns.name: Partitions 词形
patterns.context: 量子理论相关标题中的单词 “Partitions”；未见与其他触发词的明确局部联系。

patterns.name: 网页文本中的 applies
patterns.context: HTML 文本描述 split graph 功能适用的对象；词形被拆成前缀与后缀标记。

patterns.name: 弱相同约束代数
patterns.context: 量子约束与经典约束代数的关系讨论。

en.description: Primarily responds to the misc- stem: it occurs in miscellaneous (miscellaneous, various) and in miscues in sports reporting; it appears across domains. There is also local activation on a code class name that is difficult to fit into the main pattern.

patterns.name: miscellaneous stem
patterns.context: Occurs within the stem of the complete word miscellaneous or within the stem of miscues in baseball reporting; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: encyclopedias, law, academia, patents, Buddhist introductions, sports reporting

patterns.name: Suffix of miscellaneous
patterns.context: Joins with misc- to form miscellaneous, commonly modifying items, types, expenses, physical systems, and so on, to mean miscellaneous or various types.
patterns.domain: Explanatory texts on law, home repair, physics, patents, education, living expenses, and more

patterns.name: Baseball term miscues
patterns.context: In baseball game narration, refers to batting or fielding errors; one example uses miscues as a verb, another as a noun.

patterns.name: Unrelated local activation
patterns.context: The class name RedeemedCouponCollection in code; the context contains neither miscellaneous nor miscues.

3_1777.description: 主要响应 misc- 词干：涵盖 miscellaneous（杂项、各类）及体育报道中的 miscues（失误）；跨领域出现。另有代码类名局部激活，难以归入主模式。

patterns.name: miscellaneous 词干
patterns.context: 出现在完整单词 miscellaneous 的词干内部，或棒球报道中 miscues 的词干内部；不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：百科、法律、学术、专利、佛教介绍、体育报道

patterns.name: miscellaneous 的后缀

patterns.domain: 法律、家装维修、物理、专利、教育与生活费用等说明性文本

patterns.name: miscues 棒球用语

patterns.name: 不相关的局部激活
patterns.context: 代码中的类名 RedeemedCouponCollection；上下文没有 miscellaneous 或 miscues。

en.concept: Specific word-final fragments and legal dispute wording
en.description: The most consistent response is to controverted in legal documents, expressing that facts are disputed, especially the word ending “verted”; it also covers litigation phrasing, paper acknowledgment headings, code identifiers, and word-final fragments in confers and communicates in patent/research contexts. The latter categories have unclear links to the main pattern.

patterns.name: controverted in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal arguments or statements of fact, describes whether facts, evidence, or allegations are disputed; activation often centers on the word ending “verted”, and the split spelling “controverted” also appears.

patterns.name: Findings and procedural wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Litigation procedure or court hearing contexts, involving motions, affidavits, parties, and findings of fact; co-occurs with highly activated controverted or appears in adjacent arguments.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Section heading and acknowledgment marker
patterns.context: An acknowledgments section heading and its Markdown/formatting anchor appearing after the end of a paper appendix.

patterns.name: License terms and software identifiers
patterns.context: A Java package name immediately follows a license comment; strong activation falls on a split identifier fragment and is not obviously the same as the keyword in court opinions.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license comments

patterns.name: Communication wording in patent specifications
patterns.context: Describes a system communicating with a data processing center to record an employee’s time at a location; activation centers on a word-final fragment of communicates.

patterns.name: confers in biomedicine
patterns.context: Describes a locus conferring resistance to tumor development; activation falls on a word-final fragment of confers.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research abstracts or project descriptions

patterns.name: communicates in business information processing
patterns.context: Introduces an information processing system that processes, stores, or transmits business and personal information; activation falls on a word-final fragment of communicates.

3_1777.concept: 特定词尾片段与法律争议措辞
3_1777.description: 最稳定的响应是法律文书中表示事实有争议的 controverted，尤其是词尾“verted”；还覆盖法律诉讼措辞、论文致谢标题、代码标识符，以及专利/科研语境中 confers、communicates 的词尾片段，后几类与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 controverted
patterns.context: 在法律论证或事实陈述中，描述事实、证据或指控是否存在争议；重点常落在单词结尾的“verted”，也出现拆分拼写的“controverted”。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的判断与程序措辞
patterns.trigger: « summary»1« judgment»2、« motion»2、« affidavits、« facts、« Court、« plaintiff、« defendant
patterns.context: 诉讼程序或法院审理语境，围绕动议、宣誓书、双方当事人及事实认定；与高激活的 controverted 同现或处于相邻论证中。

patterns.name: 章节标题与致谢标记

patterns.name: 许可证条款与软件标识符
