patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码与许可证注释

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的通信表述
patterns.context: 描述系统与数据处理中心通信，以记录员工在某地点的时间；激活集中在 communicates 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的 confers
patterns.context: 描述某基因座赋予对肿瘤发展的抗性；激活落在 confers 的词尾片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要或项目说明

patterns.name: 商业信息处理中的 communicates
patterns.context: 介绍信息处理系统处理、存储或传递商业及个人信息；激活落在 communicates 的词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/信息技术说明

en.concept: Past tense and procedural narration in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to the past-tense/past-participle suffix ed in legal opinions and litigation narratives; it also covers adjudicative procedure terms, references to courts and parties, denials and rebuttals, and criminal search facts. There are also sporadic activations on dates, code copyright comments, and technical discussions.

patterns.name: Past participle ed in legal opinions
patterns.context: Activation often falls on the suffix ed, especially in past-tense or past-participle forms describing testimony, responses, evidence submissions, or court findings; in some examples the word stem is also activated.

patterns.name: Numbers in case numbers and dates
patterns.context: Years in legal document titles or date fields in code comments.

patterns.name: Fixed procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in court opinion titles, procedural histories, or judicial reasoning.

patterns.name: Entities and litigation relation words in legal texts
patterns.context: Refers to courts, government agencies, parties, or immigration status in legal cases; activations are scattered.
patterns.domain: Judicial opinions, especially state law and immigration cases

patterns.name: Negation or rebuttal expressions
patterns.context: Negates a judicial conclusion, describes a party’s denial, or expresses a rebuttal to evidence; usually in legal argumentation.

patterns.name: Vehicle searches and police encounters
patterns.context: Describes police questioning, vehicle searches, and related testimony.

patterns.name: Code copyright disclaimer
patterns.context: A comment at the top of a code file states that the author waives copyright.

patterns.name: System complexity and manageability
patterns.context: Discusses inadequate manageability as systems scale and quotes Alan Kay.

3_1777.concept: 法律文本中的过去时与程序叙述
3_1777.description: 主要响应法律判决及诉讼叙述中的过去时/过去分词词尾 ed，也覆盖裁判程序词、法院与当事人称谓、否定反驳及刑事搜查事实；另有日期、代码版权注释和技术讨论中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的过去分词 ed
patterns.context: 激活常落在词尾 ed，尤其出现在描述证言、回应、提交证据或法院认定的过去时/过去分词中；部分例子中词根也有激活。

patterns.name: 案件编号与日期中的数字
patterns.context: 法律文书标题中的年份，或代码注释中的日期字段。

patterns.name: 法律文书的固定程序术语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决标题、程序经过或裁判理由中。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的实体与诉讼关系词
patterns.context: 法律案件中指称法院、政府机构、当事人或移民身份；激活较零散。
patterns.domain: 司法判决，尤其州法与移民案件

patterns.name: 否定或反驳表达
patterns.context: 否定裁判结论、描述当事人的否认，或表达对证据的反驳；通常处于法律论证语境。
patterns.domain: 判决意见、证言与法律论证

patterns.name: 车辆搜查与警察接触
patterns.context: 描述警察询问、搜查车辆及相关证词。

patterns.name: 代码版权免责声明
patterns.context: 代码文件头部以注释声明作者放弃版权。

patterns.name: 系统复杂性与可管理性
patterns.context: 讨论系统规模扩张后可管理性不足，并引述 Alan Kay。

en.description: Activations cluster on the endings of several words: they occur repeatedly in relinquish (waiving rights or property), and also in embraces, acknowledges, disagrees, disregarded, again, and speak; these word endings occur across legal, news, and online texts.

patterns.name: Waiving, transferring, or releasing rights
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts describing someone voluntarily waiving, releasing, or transferring rights, interests, or property; the same stem triggers in both legal texts and fictional narratives.

patterns.name: Ending of embraces
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending «aces» of embrace; one instance is “embraces white nationalism”, another is “Britain embraces nuclear power”.

patterns.name: Ending of acknowledges
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of acknowledge; the sentence subject is state, and the content concerns acknowledging the trial court’s findings.

patterns.name: Ending of disagrees
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of disagrees, which the court uses to introduce a rebuttal to the preceding argument.

patterns.name: Ending of disregarded
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of disregarded, describing how the majority opinion ignored a factor.

patterns.name: Ending of again
patterns.context: In “again sampled”, activation covers again, meaning that sampling was performed once more.

patterns.name: speak ending in a nonstandard spelling
patterns.context: Appears in the underscore-separated nonstandard string “i_have_to_speak”; activation falls on the ending of speak, with HackerNews text nearby.

3_1777.description: 激活集中于若干词的词尾：多次出现于 relinquish（放弃权利或财产），也见于 embraces、acknowledges、disagrees、disregarded、again 和 speak；这些词尾分布跨法律、新闻及网络文本。

patterns.name: 放弃、让渡或释放权利
patterns.trigger: “relinquish” [1][3][9]；“relinquish her parental rights”“relinquish the same”“relinquish all their fortunes”
patterns.context: 出现在说明某人自愿放弃、释放或让渡权利、权益或财产的语境中；同一词干在法律文本和虚构情节中均触发。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、奇幻故事叙述

patterns.name: embraces 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 embrace 的词尾 «aces»；一处是“embraces white nationalism”，另一处是“Britain embraces nuclear power”。

patterns.name: acknowledges 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活在 acknowledge 的词尾，句中主语为 state，内容是承认审判法院的认定。

patterns.name: disagrees 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 disagrees 的词尾，法院以此引出对前述论点的反驳。

patterns.name: disregarded 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 disregarded 的词尾，描述多数意见忽视了某项因素。

patterns.name: again 的词尾
patterns.context: 在“again sampled”中，激活覆盖 again，表示再次进行取样。

patterns.name: 特殊拼写中的 speak 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在带下划线分隔的非标准字符串“i_have_to_speak”中，激活的是 speak 的词尾；周围是 HackerNews 文本。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、非标准格式文本

en.description: Activations cluster on internal or word-final fragments in several words: relinquish, promote, -gen/-gence, inherits, and acknowledges. Their meanings and registers differ substantially; the main commonality appears to be local word form rather than shared semantics.

patterns.name: relinquish and its forms
patterns.context: Occurs near the stem or ending of relinquish; semantics involve giving up rights, interests, or property.

patterns.name: Forms related to promoting or publicizing
patterns.context: The trigger is at the end of promote; used respectively to publicize denialism and jointly promote a drug.
patterns.domain: News links and discussion (3); business/pharmaceutical text (6)

patterns.name: Word endings such as -gen/-gence
patterns.context: Activation falls on intraword fragments containing gen, in different words such as resurgence, urgencia, and convergencia; no consistent semantic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Public health reporting (5); Spanish political text (10)

patterns.name: Forms of inherit
patterns.context: Activation falls near the end of inherits; contexts involve inheritance of kernel flags or values in subtasks.

patterns.name: Ending of acknowledge
patterns.context: Activation falls at the end of acknowledge; used to acknowledge a court finding.

3_1777.description: 激活集中在若干词的内部或词尾片段：relinquish、promote、-gen/-gence、inherits 和 acknowledges。各词义与语域差异较大，主要共同点似乎是局部词形，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: relinquish 及其词形
patterns.context: 出现在 relinquish 词的词干或词尾附近；语义涉及放弃权利、利益或财产。

patterns.name: 促成、宣传类词形
patterns.context: 触发位置在 promote 的词尾；分别用于宣传否认论、共同推广药品。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接与讨论（3）；商业/制药文本（6）

patterns.name: 词尾 -gen/-gence 一类
patterns.context: 激活落在含 gen 的词内片段，涉及 resurgence、urgencia、convergencia 等不同词；未见一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生报道（5）；西班牙语政治文本（10）

patterns.name: inherit 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 inherits 的词尾附近；语境涉及内核标志继承或子任务的值继承。

patterns.name: acknowledge 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 acknowledge 的词尾；用于承认法院作出的认定。

en.description: Activations often fall on intraword fragments, word endings, and case variants across English, Portuguese, and Spanish; uppercase text in two similar legal templates is especially dense. Sporadic activations also occur on short English words, with no overall shared semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: English intraword fragments or endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within English words or at their endings, often in participles and nominalized endings, and also within proper nouns or abbreviations; there is no consistent syntactic role.
patterns.domain: English news, legal, encyclopedic, and academic texts

patterns.name: Portuguese intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs within Portuguese inflected or derived words; in Segment 2, activation is on an intraword fragment of «Infelizmente».

patterns.name: Spanish intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within Spanish words, such as «urgencia» and «convergencia», with no apparent syntactic or semantic commonality.

patterns.name: Uppercase word fragments in legal citation formats
patterns.context: Multiple adjacent word fragments activate persistently in fully capitalized legal template text; the same or similar template appears in both segments.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents; explanatory notes quoting summary orders

patterns.name: Frequent short words in sentences
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in ordinary English legal narrative, especially in Segment 3; they do not form a stable semantic or syntactic combination.

3_1777.concept: 词内片段与大小写敏感模式
3_1777.description: 激活多落在词内片段、词尾及大小写变体上，跨英语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语；两段相似法律模板的大写文字尤为密集。另有零散英语小词激活，整体缺少统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段或词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的片段或词尾，常见于分词、名词化词尾，也包括专名或缩写内部；没有一致的句法角色。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、法律、百科、学术文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语屈折或派生词内部；第2段激活在«Infelizmente»的词内片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词内部，如«urgencia»和«convergencia»，未见明显句法或语义共性。

patterns.name: 法律引用格式中的大写词片段
patterns.context: 整段大写的法律模板文字中，多个相邻词片段持续激活；相同或近似模板在两段重复出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、摘要命令引用说明

patterns.name: 句中高频小词
patterns.context: 普通英语法律叙述中零散激活，尤其在第3段；不构成稳定的语义或句法组合。

en.description: A shared surface feature across segments is that activations often fall on subword fragments within words or at word endings, sometimes spanning line breaks or whitespace. Across languages and domains, this does not establish a shared meaning or topic.

patterns.name: Intraword/affix fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within complete words, across diverse vocabulary and languages, rather than on fixed word meanings.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text and English legal and economic texts

patterns.name: Portuguese intraword fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese, activation markers occur in the middle or at the end of words, covering inflections and common forms; the contexts have no shared topic.

patterns.name: German intraword fragments
patterns.context: Letter fragments within German compounds or inflected words are marked.

patterns.name: Internal and final fragments in English legal words
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or at the end of English words in legal text; content includes case law, litigation, and criminal cases, but the markers do not correspond to a stable legal concept.

patterns.name: Document layout symbols and whitespace
patterns.context: Line breaks and whitespace are also marked, often in court documents that preserve visible formatting; they co-occur with intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic English intraword fragments
patterns.context: Markers fall within or at the boundaries of several words in business emails; no single semantic trigger condition can be confirmed.

3_1777.description: 各段的共同表面特征是激活常落在词内部、词尾的子词片段上，且偶尔覆盖换行或空白。跨语言与领域，无法据此确定统一语义或主题。

patterns.name: 词内/词缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的内部子词片段上；跨多种词汇和语言，并非固定词义
patterns.domain: 多语种及英语法律、经济文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中，激活标记位于词的中段或词尾，涵盖屈折变化与常见词形；上下文没有统一主题
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 德语复合词或屈折词内部的字母片段被标记

patterns.name: 英语法律词中及词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律文本中英语词内部或词尾；内容包含判例、诉讼及刑事案件，但标记并未对应某个稳定法律概念

patterns.name: 文书排版符号与空白
patterns.context: 换行符及空白也被标记，常见于排版保留明显的法院文书；与词内片段同时出现

patterns.name: 零散英语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在经济邮件中若干词的内部或边界，未见可确认的单一语义触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to later inflectional or derivational fragments within words, especially the German verb ending «en» and noun endings; also responds to English verb endings, Spanish verb forms, and a few proper nouns or intraword fragments.

patterns.name: German infinitive endings
patterns.context: Activation often falls on German verb infinitive endings or similar conjugational endings; «entstehen» is especially prominent in Segments 1–3.
patterns.domain: German parliamentary text, patent descriptions, and philosophical texts

patterns.name: German noun plural or inflectional endings
patterns.context: In German noun plurals, case forms, or other inflected forms, activation falls at the word ending; this may overlap with the verb-ending pattern.

patterns.name: English verb endings
patterns.context: Activation is at English inflectional verb endings, specifically past participle and third-person singular forms; examples are sparse.

patterns.name: Internal letter fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on character fragments inside English words or proper nouns, without an obvious shared morphological function.

patterns.name: Spanish verbal morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of inflected Spanish verbs; similar to the German and English ending patterns, but examples are limited.

3_1777.description: 主要响应词内靠后的屈折或派生片段，尤其德语动词词尾「en」及名词词尾；也响应英语动词词尾、西班牙语动词形式，以及少数专名或词内片段。

patterns.name: 德语不定式词尾
patterns.trigger: 词干后接未标记或高亮的「en」，如「entste«hen»10」「erbring«en»9」「eingeg«ang»5«en»9」「erinner«n»4」「anmel«den»3」
patterns.context: 激活常落在德语动词的不定式词尾或类似动词变位词尾；第1—3段的「entstehen」尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、专利说明及哲学文本

patterns.name: 德语名词复数或屈折词尾
patterns.context: 在德语名词的复数、格或其他屈折形式中，激活落在词尾；可能与动词词尾模式重叠。

patterns.name: 英语动词词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于英语动词的屈折词尾，分别是过去分词形式和第三人称单数形式；样本稀少。

patterns.name: 专名内部字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词或专名内部的字符片段，不明显对应统一的词法功能。

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语动词的屈折形式内部或词尾；与德语、英语词尾现象相似但样本有限。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on intraword or word-final fragments, especially German and French verb endings (-en, -ons), as well as English verb -s; internal fragments in transliterated Russian proper nouns also occur, with no shared morphosyntactic condition.

patterns.name: German verb ending «-stehen»
patterns.context: «entstehen» appears as a complete verb in sentences describing consequences, risks, or the emergence of new things; strong activation is marked at the word ending.

patterns.name: French verb ending «-ons»
patterns.context: First-person plural present-tense verbs end in -ons and appear in parliamentary speeches or academic explanations; activation falls at the word ending.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary speeches and academic papers

patterns.name: German verb ending «-en»
patterns.context: Infinitive verbs end in -en in legal or administrative contexts involving obligations or requirements.

patterns.name: English sentence-/clause-final inflectional ending «-s»
patterns.context: The English third-person singular verb ending -s occurs in descriptions of court pleadings.

patterns.name: English noun ending «-s»
patterns.context: English third-person singular verbs end in -s; the activation marker covers the verb ending in sentences discussing a court’s attitude toward cited decisions.

patterns.name: English plural ending «-s»
patterns.context: A syllable or letter fragment within a proper noun is marked; no apparent regular inflectional or syntactic condition is evident.

3_1777.description: 强激活多落在词内或词尾片段，尤其是德语、法语动词词尾（-en、-ons），也见英语动词 -s；另有俄语转写专名内部片段，缺乏统一形态句法条件。

patterns.name: 德语动词词尾「-stehen」
patterns.context: 「entstehen」作为完整动词，出现在描述后果、风险或新事物产生的句子中；强激活标在词尾。

patterns.name: 法语动词词尾「-ons」
patterns.context: 第一人称复数现在时动词以 -ons 结尾，出现在议会发言或学术说明中；激活落在词尾。
patterns.domain: 法语议会发言、学术论文

patterns.name: 德语动词词尾「-en」
patterns.context: 不定式动词以 -en 结尾，处于法律或行政文本的义务／要求语境。

patterns.name: 英语句末/分句末屈折词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 英语第三人称单数动词词尾 -s，出现在法院对诉状内容的描述中。

patterns.name: 英语名词词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 英语第三人称单数动词以 -s 结尾；激活标记覆盖动词词尾，句子讨论法院对引用判决的态度。

patterns.name: 英语复数词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 专名内部的音节/字母片段被标记；未见明显的常规屈折或句法条件。

en.description: Activations occur in Italian and Swedish intraword morphemes and in citations, legal terminology, and title fragments in U.S. decisions; there are also intraword fragments in labor cases and biomedical methods vocabulary, with no shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Italian intraword subword activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final or morphological fragments within Italian words, including infinitive endings and inflected forms; it is not at whole-word boundaries.

patterns.name: Swedish intraword subword activation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on morphemes or endings within Swedish words, concentrated in compounds and inflected or derived forms.

patterns.name: Court abbreviations in U.S. case citations
patterns.context: Near case citations or standards of judicial review in legal text, especially abbreviations and numbers in U.S. Reports citations; some citation characters are unmarked.

patterns.name: Legal terms and fixed phrases in decisions
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of case-law arguments, litigation procedure, constitutional issues, or federal jurisdiction; trigger points are scattered across legal terms and common legal phrases.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in uppercase legal titles
patterns.context: In fully capitalized party titles or headers, activation falls on internal word fragments and final letters.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw decision titles and layout text

patterns.name: Intraword substrings in decision language
patterns.context: Occurs inside the name Lieckfelt and the word reinstate; accompanied by labor dispute narratives involving rulings, reinstatement, and compensation.

patterns.name: Research methods and biomedical vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across experimental methods, detection techniques, and biomedical terminology, with no apparent local pattern shared with legal or European parliamentary text.

3_1777.description: 激活分布在意大利语、瑞典语词内词素，以及美国判决的引文、法律术语和标题片段；另见劳动案词内片段与生物医学方法词汇，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语单词内部的词尾或词素片段，包含动词不定式词尾和屈折形式；并非整词边界。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会发言

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语词内部的词素或词尾，集中于复合词及屈折、派生形式。

patterns.name: 美国判例引文中的法院缩写

patterns.name: steady state

en.description: Activations are most concentrated in legal orders and litigation document formats, and also occur in balance sheet; strong activations appear on verb endings in several Romance languages and German plural endings, along with sporadic function-word fragments. patterns.name: Words related to balance sheet

patterns.name: Language of pending legal proceedings

patterns.name: Litigation document formats and identifiers
patterns.context: Includes case citations, signatory information, docket numbers, or formatting symbols; activations are scattered across legal-format fragments.

patterns.name: Semantically hard-to-classify function words and word-form fragments

en.description: Activations are scattered: plural endings, procedural terms, and restraining orders in legal text; German, Portuguese, and English intraword fragments; and mathematical terminology and an accounting collocation. patterns.domain: 数学/物理论文及公式排版

patterns.name: 函数泛函及积分泛函公式
patterns.context: 度量图上的 NLS 能量泛函与公式标签；激活部分落在泛函、公式环境及标签字符串中。
patterns.domain: 数学物理论文，非线性薛定谔方程

patterns.name: 科学论述中的事实、 dressing 与理论类比
patterns.context: 解释临界线非普适及其修饰，并用二阶相变理论作类比；不同激活词都处于说明/比较论述中。

patterns.name: 场论中的平均场与 gap equation
patterns.context: 讨论常数项对涨落和可观测量的作用，并引出满足 gap equation 的变量；激活分布在术语与一般词上。

patterns.name: 流动/剪切及能量注入术语
patterns.context: 描述固定层内的剪切流、稳定模非线性激发及涨落能量级联；激活包含复合词片段和物理术语。
patterns.domain: 流体/等离子体物理论文

patterns.name: 衍射扫描记录中的仪器标注
patterns.context: 石墨样品的实验参数表格，出现探测器和扫描说明及晶体学索引；激活落在标点、希腊字母片段和测量词上。

patterns.name: 材料表面与机械部件的性质描述
patterns.context: 说明星形垫圈在金属表面上的应用，以及齿部像弹簧一样变形并恢复平坦；激活涉及表面物质与动作/形状词。

en.concept: what comparative constructions and Schafer spelling fragments
en.description: Activations are most clearly concentrated on comparisons, analogies, or counterfactual clauses introduced by what, and on Schafer/Schaefer spelling fragments; several instances of to and technical words and symbols also highlight, but are difficult to explain as part of the main pattern.

patterns.name: what followed by a counterfactual or similar object
patterns.context: In a what-clause, what and the following predicate form a comparative, analogical, or counterfactual construction; examples include “faster than what…would be”, “similar to what…”, and “analogous to what…”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in computational physics, plasma physics, and phase-transition theory

patterns.name: Comparative preposition to in sentences
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on to, but its structures vary: the first two introduce objects of analogy, while the last introduces a switch to a different product; not every to triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and HackerNews blog text

patterns.name: Schafer/Schaefer name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of the Schafer/Schaefer name spelling; they occur mainly in academic citations, and also in a personal blog domain.

patterns.name: Other sporadic highlighted words and symbols
patterns.context: These highlights appear in different grammatical or technical contexts; the available snippets are insufficient to establish a shared trigger condition, so they cannot reliably be grouped with the patterns above.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics formulas, crystallographic tables, StackExchange questions and answers, and academic papers

3_1908.concept: what 比较结构与 Schafer 拼写片段
3_1908.description: 激活最明确地集中于 what 引导的比较、类比或反事实从句，以及 Schafer/Schaefer 拼写片段；若干 to 和技术词、符号也有高亮，但难以与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: what 后接反事实或相似对象
patterns.trigger: “what would be” [2]；“what has been found” [3]；“what happens” [4]
patterns.context: 在 what 引导的从句中，what 与后续谓语构成比较、类比或反事实结构；分别出现在“faster than what…would be”“similar to what…”及“analogous to what…”中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涉及计算物理、等离子体物理和相变理论

patterns.name: 句中比较介词 to
patterns.context: 激活集中在 to，但它所处结构不同：前两处引出类比对象，后一处引出改换到的产品；并非所有 to 都触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及 HackerNews 博客文字

patterns.name: 文献引用中的 Schafer/Schaefer 姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的 Schafer/Schaefer 姓名拼写片段中；主要位于学术文献引用，另见个人博客域名。

patterns.name: 其他零散高亮词及符号
patterns.context: 这些高亮出现在各自不同的语法或技术语境中；现有片段不足以确定它们共享触发条件，不能可靠归入上述模式。
patterns.domain: 天体物理公式、晶体学表格、StackExchange 问答及学术论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments in patent search names, academic citation author names, and physics and biomedical terminology; apart from proper names and citation formats, no unified meaning or stable word class is apparent.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in patent citations
patterns.context: Personal names and database names appear in patent or patent-search backgrounds; activations concentrate on spelling fragments like Scif/Sciffer.

patterns.name: Author name fragments in literature citations
patterns.context: Authors or citation keys are listed with brackets or @ markers in academic text; activations fall on fragments of name spellings.

patterns.name: Wave-related vocabulary in physical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes physical phenomena involving particle collisions, photons, and undulating propagation along a wire.

patterns.name: Anti-de Sitter spacetime terminology
patterns.context: AdS terminology appears in theoretical results on high-curvature gravity and conformal field theory.

patterns.name: Stillwell spelling fragments in a proper name
patterns.context: A historical figure's name appears in the references of an encyclopedia entry.

patterns.name: RNA structural classification abbreviation
patterns.context: Introduces a database for classifying RNA structural data and gives its abbreviation.

3_1908.description: 激活分散在专利检索名、学术引文作者名及物理、生物医学术语等局部片段；除专名和引用格式外，未见统一语义或稳定词类。

patterns.name: 专利引用中的姓氏片段
patterns.trigger: «Sc»1«if»10res and« Burn»1ham；The Sc«if»9inder and Delphion databases
patterns.context: 专利或专利检索背景中出现人名、数据库名；激活集中在 Scif/Sciffer 一类拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、药物化学综述

patterns.name: 文献引文中的作者姓名片段
patterns.context: 学术文本中以方括号、@标记列举作者或文献键；激活落在姓名拼写的片段上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 物理描述中的波动词汇
patterns.context: 描述粒子碰撞、光子以及沿导线起伏传播的物理现象。

patterns.name: 反德西特时空术语
patterns.context: 高曲率引力与共形场论的理论结果中出现 AdS 术语。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Stillwell 拼写片段
patterns.context: 历史人物姓名出现在百科条目的参考资料中。

patterns.name: RNA 结构分类缩写
patterns.context: 介绍 RNA 结构数据分类数据库并给出其缩写。

en.concept: Specific name tokenization and academic technical text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized fragments of the name Scha(e)fer, and also to fragments of the name Faddeev; there are also activations on collocations such as in/terms/of in scientific papers and on scattered technical words, citations, and proper names.

patterns.name: Subwords of the name Schafer/Schaefer
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized subwords of the name Schafer/Schaefer; sometimes it is an author in a reference, sometimes a HackerNews username or URL.
patterns.domain: ArXiv citations, technical blogs, and HackerNews comments

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of Faddeev
patterns.context: Occurs in the physics terms Faddeev–Popov determinant or Faddeev techniques; activation corresponds to a specific tokenized fragment within the name.

patterns.name: in terms of collocation in scientific text
patterns.context: Academic phrasing includes the preposition in, especially in combinations with terms, of, and field in formulas or descriptions of decomposition and expansion; the examples are not all identical continuous phrases.

patterns.name: Local vocabulary in other technical papers
patterns.context: Appears respectively in contexts of quantum gate evolution decomposition, conformal field theory, and anti-de Sitter space; no obvious shared trigger structure is apparent.
patterns.domain: Quantum information, field theory, and gravity papers

patterns.name: Sporadic scientific vocabulary
patterns.context: These activations occur in nuclear reactions, relativistic physics, and astrophysics texts, and are difficult to group into the same stable collocation.

patterns.name: Citation fragments that do not fit other patterns
patterns.context: Includes local subword activations in author names or product names; apart from their proper-name character, there is insufficient evidence that they share the main pattern.

3_1908.concept: 特定姓名分词与学术技术文本片段
3_1908.description: 主要响应 Scha(e)fer 姓名的分词片段，也响应 Faddeev 姓名片段；另有科学论文中 in/terms/of 等搭配及分散的技术词、引文和专名激活。

patterns.name: 人名 Schafer/Schaefer 的子词
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名 Schafer/Schaefer 的分词子词上；有时是参考文献中的作者，有时是 HackerNews 用户名或 URL。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 引文、技术博客及 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: Faddeev 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在物理学术语 Faddeev–Popov determinant 或 Faddeev techniques 中，激活对应姓名内部的特定分词片段。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的 in terms of 搭配
patterns.trigger: « in»4 the« background»2« field»2（[4]）、« in»4« terms»9（[8]）、« in»6« terms»9« of»2« a»1（[9]）
patterns.context: 学术表述中出现介词 in，尤其与 terms、of、field 等组成公式或描述分解、展开的搭配；各段并非完全相同的连续短语。

patterns.name: 其他技术论文中的局部词汇
patterns.context: 分别出现在量子门演化分解、共形场论及反德西特空间语境中，未见共同的明显触发结构。
patterns.domain: 量子信息、场论与引力论文

patterns.name: 零散科学词汇
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在核反应、相对论物理和天体物理文本中，难以归为同一个稳定搭配。

patterns.name: 难以归入其他模式的引用片段
patterns.context: 包含作者姓名或产品名的局部子词激活；除姓名/专名性质外，没有足够证据表明它们与主模式相同。
patterns.domain: 学术引文与 HackerNews 博客

en.concept: Mixed triggers from word fragments and formula markup
en.description: Activations are scattered across letter fragments in names and citations, a few within-word fragments in ordinary words, French word segments, and theoretical physics formulas and terminology; name fragments are most common, but the trigger types are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Schafer/Schäfer spelling fragments in names
patterns.context: When personal names are tokenized, activations occur on letter fragments inside the names; spellings vary and may include hyphens or appear as cited authors.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, QCD literature, technical forum usernames, and blog links

patterns.name: extr (extra- word-initial fragment)
patterns.context: Appears within the word extragalactic, referring to a supernova outside the Milky Way.

patterns.name: Negative n't
patterns.context: The stem in doesn't is marked; the context describes a background operation that does not block rendering.

patterns.name: French agriculture and Finnish word endings
patterns.context: Appears in French sentences concerning the term of office and cooperation of the President of the European Parliament's Agriculture Council; activations fall on fragments within phrases or words.

patterns.name: lat in a latitude word
patterns.context: In an astronomical context, describes distant regions of the galactic plane with lower dust extinction; the activated fragment is part of latitudes.

patterns.name: Dense activations on theoretical physics terminology and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In theoretical physics passages, formula-introduction wording and LaTeX equation environments show multiple activations, including gravity theory, Horndeski action, and two-dimensional dilaton theory.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics papers and LaTeX mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Diverse author citation fragments with no unified explanation
patterns.context: Appears in literature author lists and parenthetical citations; somewhat resembles the name-fragment pattern, but the trigger forms are scattered and a common trigger condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Possible Schlegel proper-name fragment
patterns.context: An astrophysics paper mentions the Schlegel map; activation falls within the personal name in the map name.

3_1908.concept: 词片段与公式标记的混合触发
3_1908.description: 激活分散于姓名及引用中的字母片段、少数普通词内部片段、法语词段，以及理论物理公式和术语；姓名片段最常见，但各类触发并不一致。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Schafer/Schäfer 拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆分标注时激活姓名内部的字母片段；形式存在变体，且可能包含连字符或用作文献引用作者名。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、QCD 文献、技术论坛用户名及博客链接

patterns.name: extr（extra-词首片段）
patterns.context: 出现在 extragalactic 一词内部，指银河系外的超新星。

patterns.name: 表示否定的 n't
patterns.context: doesn't 中的词干部分被标记；语境是在描述某个后台操作不会阻塞渲染。

patterns.name: 法语农业与芬兰语词尾
patterns.context: 出现在法语句子中，涉及欧洲议会农业理事会主席任期及合作；激活落在短语或词内部的片段。

patterns.name: 纬度词中的 lat
patterns.context: 天文学语境中描述尘埃消光较小的 galactic-plane 远距离区域；激活片段属于 latitudes。

patterns.name: 理论物理术语与数学表达式的密集激活
patterns.trigger: «deriv»、«ative»、« equations»、« of»、« motion»、« by»、« Horn»、«deski»、« action»；以及 «dil»、«aton»、« action»、«begin»、«aligned»、«S»、«int»、«sqrt» 等
patterns.context: 理论物理段落中，公式引入语及 LaTeX 方程环境出现多处激活，包括引力理论、Horndeski action 和二维 dilaton theory。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理论文与 LaTeX 数学公式

patterns.name: 多样且无法统一解释的作者引用片段
patterns.trigger: «Bert»、«rand»、«Cl»、«app»、«J»、«as»、«ra» 等，嵌在作者姓名或文献引用中
patterns.context: 出现在文献作者列表和括号引用内；与姓名片段模式有一定相似，但触发形式分散，难确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文参考文献

patterns.name: 可能的 Schlegel 专名片段
patterns.context: 天文学文献中提到 Schlegel map；激活落在地图名称对应的人名内部。

en.description: Activations are scattered across letter fragments inside split words, formula symbols, and several words in academic text; they also cover collisional excitation and dryness in experimental procedures, and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: String fragments in compound words
patterns.context: Activations fall within tokenized words, especially names, terms, or URLs containing letter sequences a, af/ae, or sch…a…f; surrounding meanings vary
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, references, forum usernames, and URLs

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and structures in formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical expressions, vector/probability formulas, or alignment environments, markings concentrate on symbols, parentheses, and formula structures

patterns.name: Function words and concept words in academic writing
patterns.context: When paper text describes transformations, representations, or explanations, multiple ordinary words and technical terms are marked at once
patterns.domain: Quantum dynamics and probability theory papers

patterns.name: Collision-related expressions
patterns.context: In a description of the emission mechanism of an astrophysical gas flow, collisions modify the excitation process

patterns.name: Word ending indicating dryness
patterns.context: The noun form of dry appears in experimental steps involving solvent evaporation and cooling the mixture after a reaction

3_1908.concept: 混合的词形与符号片段
3_1908.description: 激活分散于拆分词内部的字母片段、公式符号及学术文本中的若干词；还覆盖碰撞激发和实验步骤里的 dryness，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 复合词中的字符串片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的词内部，尤其是含字母序列 a、af/ae 或 sch…a…f 的姓名、术语或网址；周围语义各异
patterns.domain: 天体物理、参考文献、论坛用户名与网址

patterns.name: 公式中的数学符号与结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式、向量/概率公式或对齐环境中，标记集中于符号、括号和公式结构

patterns.name: 学术行文中的功能词和概念词
patterns.context: 论文正文描述变换、表示或解释时，多个普通词与技术术语同时被标记
patterns.domain: 量子动力学与概率论论文

patterns.name: 碰撞相关表达
patterns.context: 天体气体流的发射机制描述中，碰撞修饰激发过程

patterns.name: 词尾干燥状态
patterns.context: 反应后蒸去溶剂、冷却混合物的实验步骤中出现 dry 的名词形式

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: many fall on Schaefer name fragments with varying spellings; others occur on formula integral notation, common English function words, and several physics terms. These fragments do not establish a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Schaefer spelling fragments in names or citations
patterns.context: Appears in author names, references, usernames, or URLs; characters may be tokenized into non-contiguous fragments

patterns.name: Integral and differential notation in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially integrals and their measures

patterns.name: English function words and common phrases
patterns.context: In local contexts such as comparisons, analogies, or noun phrases in ordinary English syntax; the examples have no obvious unified meaning

patterns.name: Specific English word fragment
patterns.context: In the physics term “free-energy functional”

patterns.name: Emission-related word fragment
patterns.context: Describes radiation produced when a cold gas flow is excited by collisions

patterns.name: Word fragment describing behavior after an intensity threshold
patterns.context: Describes an optical medium behaving like a plasma after laser intensity exceeds a threshold

patterns.name: Spectral density terminology
patterns.context: Describes the bath spectral density in definitional text following a formula

3_1908.description: 激活线索分散：多处落在不同拼写的 Schaefer 姓名片段；另见公式积分记号、常见英文功能词及若干物理术语。无法由这些片段确定单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 姓名或引文中的 Schaefer 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓名、参考文献或用户名/网址中；字符可能被分词成不连续片段
patterns.domain: 学术引文与 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 数学公式中的积分微分记号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式里，尤其是积分及其测度

patterns.name: 英文功能词及常见短语
patterns.context: 普通英文句法中，在比较、类比或名词短语等局部上下文里；各例之间没有明显统一语义

patterns.name: 特定英文词片段
patterns.context: 物理学术语“free-energy functional”中

patterns.name: 发射相关词片段
patterns.context: 描述冷气流通过碰撞激发而产生的辐射

patterns.name: 强度阈值后的行为变化词片段
patterns.context: 激光强度超过阈值后，描述光学介质表现得像等离子体

patterns.name: 光谱密度术语
patterns.context: 描述浴的频谱密度，位于公式后的定义性文字中

en.description: Activations are scattered across formulas, equation references, and citation name fragments in physics papers, and also across tokenized names in forum bylines and URLs; no single stable lexical trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments within astrophysics terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of astrophysics terms or names; the context discusses variable stars, supernovae, or cited research.

patterns.name: Fragments in names and reference strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in author surnames or citation keys rather than continuous concepts in ordinary body text.

patterns.name: Ginzburg–Landau functional expression
patterns.context: The text introduces the GL free-energy functional, followed by a LaTeX formula containing field variables and an integral.

patterns.name: Surname in a code project byline
patterns.context: Appears in the byline of a Hacker News post; surrounding text discusses lightweight buttons and a proof of concept.

patterns.name: Vortex pair action formula
patterns.context: A vector relation for a vortex pair and the action are rewritten as formulas, containing mathematical symbols and LaTeX.

patterns.name: Integral equation and tensor symbols
patterns.context: Field equations contain an integral kernel, indices, and an external-field parameter; the formula continues across lines.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in a surname and URL
patterns.context: A Hacker News post mentions a blog draft and 1Password; activation falls on a name fragment in the URL.
patterns.domain: Technical forum and personal blog link, [8]

patterns.name: Rewriting a probability expression
patterns.context: Discusses cylinder probabilities and rewrites them as a formula with a citation label and mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Equations of motion and action formula
patterns.context: Introduces the Horndeski action and equations of motion, followed by a LaTeX aligned formula with an integral, metric, and square root.

3_1908.description: 激活分散在物理论文的公式、方程引述及引文人名片段，也出现在论坛署名和网址中的拆分姓名；未见单一稳定的词义触发模式。

patterns.name: 天体物理术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的天体物理名词或人名片段中；上下文讨论变星、超新星或引用相关研究。

patterns.name: 人名与参考文献字符串中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在作者姓氏或文献引用键中，而非连续的普通正文概念。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文的参考文献与引文，[2][3]

patterns.name: Ginzburg–Landau 泛函表达式
patterns.context: 正文引出 GL 自由能泛函，随后给出含场变量与积分的 LaTeX 公式。

patterns.name: 代码项目署名中的姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 帖子的署名行；周围谈轻量级按钮和概念验证。

patterns.name: 涡旋对作用量公式
patterns.context: 涡旋对的矢量关系及作用量改写为公式，含数学符号与 LaTeX。

patterns.name: 积分方程与张量符号
patterns.context: 场方程中出现积分核、指标与外场参数，公式跨行延续。

patterns.name: 姓氏及网址中的拆分片段
patterns.context: Hacker News 帖子提到博客草稿与 1Password，激活落在网址中的姓名片段。

patterns.name: 概率表达式改写
patterns.context: 讨论柱概率并将其改写成公式，带有引用标签和数学记号。

patterns.name: 运动方程与作用量公式
patterns.context: 介绍 Horndeski 作用量及运动方程，后接含积分、度规和根号的 LaTeX 对齐公式。

en.description: Activations cluster around the word form “summary”: one sense refers to an overview or abstract, while another occurs in the fixed legal term “summary judgment”; examples span multiple corpora and genres.

patterns.name: Uses of summary
patterns.context: Appears in contexts such as emails, news commentary, abstracts, document descriptions, and web pages, referring to an overview, abstract, or summary content; sometimes adjacent to “page,” “sheet,” or “of.”
patterns.domain: Email, news, academic writing, technical documentation, web pages, and commentary

patterns.name: Legal term summary judgment
patterns.context: Forms the fixed term “summary judgment” in legal rulings or case narratives.

3_2061.description: 激活集中于词形“summary”：一类表示概述或摘要，另一类出现在法律固定术语“summary judgment”中；跨多种语料与文体出现。

patterns.name: summary用法
patterns.context: 出现在邮件、新闻评论、摘要、文件说明、网页文档等语境中，指概述、摘要或摘要内容；有时紧邻“page”“sheet”“of”。
patterns.domain: 邮件、新闻、学术、技术文档、网页及评论

patterns.name: 法律术语 summary judgment
patterns.context: 法律裁判或案件叙述中，构成固定术语“summary judgment”。

en.description: All 10 passages activate on summary, covering abstracts, summaries, plot synopses, the legal term summary judgment, and HTML attributes; the core trigger form is stable, while semantics and genre vary by context.

patterns.name: The word summary
patterns.context: Activates when the word itself or a compound containing it appears; it can mean an abstract or summary, or be part of a legal term.
patterns.domain: Email, news discussion, academic abstracts, web pages, legal texts

patterns.name: summary as part of a legal term
patterns.context: summary is adjacent to judgment and refers to summary judgment; activation falls on summary.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Abstract or summary contexts
patterns.context: summary is followed by of to introduce what is being summarized, or is used to label an abstract or overview.

patterns.name: HTML attribute name
patterns.context: summary appears in an HTML table tag as an attribute name rather than an ordinary noun.

patterns.name: Sentence-final summary marker
patterns.context: A sentence-initial prepositional phrase introduces a conclusion to the preceding text.

patterns.name: Film and television synopsis
patterns.context: summary refers to a plot synopsis or translated synopsis of a film or television work.

3_2061.description: 10 段均在 summary 上激活，涵盖摘要、总结、剧情简介、法律术语 summary judgment 及 HTML 属性；核心触发形式稳定，语义和文体随上下文变化。

patterns.name: summary 一词
patterns.context: 该词本身或其复合词中出现时激活；可作摘要、总结，也可作法律术语的一部分。
patterns.domain: 邮件、新闻讨论、学术摘要、网页、法律文本

patterns.name: summary 作法律术语的一部分
patterns.context: summary 紧邻 judgment，指简易判决；激活落在 summary 上。

patterns.name: 摘要或总结的语义语境
patterns.context: summary 后接 of 引出概述对象，或用于标示摘要、概要。

patterns.name: HTML 属性名
patterns.context: summary 出现在 HTML table 标签中，作为属性名而非普通名词。

patterns.name: 句末总结标记
patterns.context: 句首介词短语用来引出前文结论。

patterns.name: 影视内容简介
patterns.context: summary 指影视作品的剧情简介或译文简介。

en.concept: Recognition of words and their substrings
en.description: One group of activations relates to the word form secret, appearing in secret lists, credentials, and news URLs; another occurs in specialized terms or word fragments from different fields, such as Litigation, WIMP, properties, summary, and annotations, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: secret morpheme and names
patterns.context: secret appears as a word, part of an identifier, or URL path component; surrounding meanings include API keys, covert operations, and news headlines, with no consistent specific semantics

patterns.name: Technical terms and internal fragments of longer words
patterns.context: Activations fall on specialized terms, technical labels, or components of longer words, rather than on words of a single semantic class; the examples respectively involve a litigation subject line, an academic term, build-configuration XML, an HTML table, and a legal annotation marker
patterns.domain: Business email, academic papers, configuration files, HTML/legal texts

3_2061.description: 一组激活与 secret 词形相关，涵盖秘密列表、凭据和新闻 URL；另一组落在不同领域的专业词或长词片段，如 Litigation、WIMP、properties、summary、annotations，语义并不统一。

patterns.name: secret 词素及名称
patterns.trigger: «secret»10（[1]、[2]）；«secret»9（[5]、[8]、[10]）；[1] 另有 "secret list"，[5] 有 `client_secret`， [8]、[10] 为连字符 URL 中的 `secret`
patterns.context: 出现 secret 作为词、标识符的一部分或 URL 路径成分；前后语义涵盖 API 密钥、隐秘行动和新闻标题，具体语义并不统一
patterns.domain: 代码、技术文档、新闻链接

patterns.name: 专业术语与长词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专业词、技术标签或较长词的组成部分，而非均为同一类语义词；各例上下文分别是诉讼主题行、学术术语、构建配置 XML、HTML 表格及法律注释标记
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、学术论文、配置文件、HTML/法律文本

en.description: Most passages activate on the word-initial subword fragment Lit, found in different forms and contexts such as Litigation, LitC…, Litv…, Litouwen, and Litigation Tracking; other activations occur on a final fragment of film and on code symbols.

patterns.name: Word-initial Lit substring
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment Lit is marked; subsequent spellings vary, and it may be a complete word or just the beginning of a longer word.

patterns.name: Nanofilm-related fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “DNA nanofilm thickness measurement,” with activation concentrated on the final letter fragment of film.

patterns.name: Structured symbols
patterns.context: A code snippet marks an empty object and an underscore symbol, surrounded by Go test and API-call code.

3_2061.description: 多数段落激活词首子串 Lit，见于 Litigation、LitC…、Litv…、Litouwen、Litigation Tracking 等不同词形和语境；另有 film 末尾片段及代码符号激活。

patterns.name: Lit 词首子串
patterns.context: 词首片段 Lit 被标记；后续拼写各异，可能是完整词，也可能只是更长词的开头。

patterns.name: 纳米薄膜相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在“DNA nanofilm thickness measurement”中，激活集中于 film 的末尾字母片段。

patterns.name: 结构化符号
patterns.context: 代码片段中标记空对象与下划线符号，周围是 Go 测试和 API 调用代码。

en.concept: Lit string and its word forms
en.description: Activations cluster around the string Lit, especially the beginning of litigation; it also responds to LitC in URLs, the surname Litvak, and the abbreviation Lit. with a period, across multiple genres.

patterns.name: Litigation word forms
patterns.context: The Lit prefix within a trigger word; appears in legal case names, case titles, legal departments, or database names, as well as securities legislation names.
patterns.domain: Law, court documents, corporate email, and securities disclosures

patterns.name: LitC URL fragment
patterns.context: LitC appears contiguously in a URL path or domain-related text, surrounded by mentions of search, websites, or Covid.

patterns.name: Litvak name fragment
patterns.context: The beginning of the surname Litvak, appearing in law-firm or party lists.

patterns.name: Lit. degree or field abbreviation
patterns.context: The abbreviation is followed by a period and appears in author bylines, academic titles, or institutional descriptions.
patterns.domain: Old-style book title pages, academic bylines

3_2061.description: 激活集中于字符串 Lit，尤其是 litigation 的词首；也响应网址中的 LitC、姓氏 Litvak，以及带句点的 Lit. 学术缩写，出现在多种文体中。

patterns.name: Litigation 词形
patterns.context: 触发词内部的 Lit 前缀；出现在法律诉讼名称、案件标题、法律部门或数据库名称中，也出现在证券法案名称里。
patterns.domain: 法律、法院文书、企业邮件与证券披露

patterns.name: LitC 网址片段
patterns.context: LitC 连写在网址路径或域名相关文本中，周围提及搜索、网站或 Covid。

patterns.name: Litvak 人名片段
patterns.context: 作为姓氏 Litvak 的开头，出现在律师事务所或当事人名单中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的律师名录

patterns.name: Lit. 学位或专业缩写
patterns.context: 缩写后接句点，位于作者署名及学术职衔、机构介绍中。
patterns.domain: 旧式书籍扉页、学术署名

en.description: Activations cluster on the substring “Lit”: most often in “Litigation” and legal case citations, but also in the literary abbreviation “Lit.” and the proper name “Get Lit.” The shared feature is the literal substring, not a single meaning.

patterns.name: Litigation word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in legal terms or case names, such as “Corporate Litigation,” “Litigation Counsel,” “Securities Litigation,” and “In re … Litigation”; it may also be a subword fragment within a word

patterns.name: Literary abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a work comparison or course name: “One Litre of Tears” and “English Language & Lit.”; unrelated to litigation
patterns.domain: Film and television reviews, educational courses

patterns.name: Get Lit proper name
patterns.context: Part of the nonprofit’s name, “Get Lit”

3_2061.description: 激活集中在子串“Lit”：多见于“Litigation”及法律案件引文，也出现在文学缩写“Lit.”和专名“Get Lit”中。共同点是字面子串，而非单一语义。

patterns.name: Litigation 词项片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律术语或案件名称中，如“Corporate Litigation”“Litigation Counsel”“Securities Litigation”“In re … Litigation”；也可能是单词内部的分词片段

patterns.name: 文学缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在作品比较或课程名称中：“One Litre of Tears”以及“English Language & Lit.”，与诉讼义无关

patterns.name: Get Lit 专名
patterns.context: 作为非营利组织名称“Get Lit”的组成部分

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting patterns
en.description: Activations mix that-clauses, place-related vocabulary, HTML/XML attributes and indentation, and a few formatting fragments, the abbreviation e.g., and an energy-related proper name; no single pattern explains all passages, and some may reflect local word forms or grammar.

patterns.name: that in English subordinate clauses
patterns.context: Introduces a relative or content clause in English, adding a qualification to a preceding noun or proposition; the marker is concentrated on that itself or its immediate context.
patterns.domain: English prose, argumentative writing, and explanatory text

patterns.name: HTML/XML attribute assignments and markup structure
patterns.context: Appears in tags or XML-like structured text, where an attribute name is adjacent to a quoted attribute value; [7] and [8] contain duplicate content.

patterns.name: Letters within the abbreviation e.g.
patterns.context: Appears in parentheses to give examples with e.g., preceded by a general statement and followed by a list of instances; activation falls on multiple subword fragments of the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Patent background section, examples involving electronic systems

patterns.name: Place-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Refers to a physical location; [5] asks about car-service locations, while [10] discusses location entry, addressing, or delivery issues.

patterns.name: Energy-security proper name
patterns.context: Appears after “Energy security” as a subword fragment of an energy-related name or proper noun; its specific reference cannot be determined from the passage alone.

patterns.name: Indentation and tag starts after HTML line breaks
patterns.context: After a line break in HTML code, a tab indents the next line before a new tag begins; this co-occurs with the attribute-structure pattern above, but may also be sensitive to line breaks or indentation itself.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial question “Are there places”
patterns.context: A sentence-initial general question asking whether locations offering a service exist; aside from places, the constructional cue appears only once.

patterns.name: Discuss after a number and line break
patterns.context: A document begins with what appears to be a number or formatting fragment, followed by an issue introduced with Discuss; the relationship between the number and activation is unclear.
patterns.domain: Web/text formatting fragments and argumentative writing

patterns.name: Sex-related vocabulary and taboo relationships
patterns.context: Discusses psychological inhibition of sexual behavior between relatives and genetic explanations; strong activations are scattered and may relate to the syntax of a that-clause, so it is unclear whether the topic independently triggers them.

3_2061.concept: 多种局部词形与格式模式
3_2061.description: 激活混合了 that 从句、地点词汇、HTML/XML 属性与缩进，以及少量格式残片、e.g. 缩写和能源专名；没有单一模式能解释全部片段，部分模式可能来自局部词形或语法。

patterns.name: 英文限定从句中的 that
patterns.trigger: «that»（[1]“that The United States face…”，[9]“that stops us…”，[10]“places that have…”）
patterns.context: 英语关系从句或内容从句中，引出对前述名词或命题的补充限定；标记集中在 that 本身，或其紧邻上下文。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、议论及说明文

patterns.name: HTML/XML 属性赋值与标记结构
patterns.context: 出现在标签或类似 XML 的结构化文本中，属性名与引号括起的属性值相邻；[7]与[8]内容重复。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML/XML 源码

patterns.name: e.g. 缩写内部字母
patterns.context: 位于括号中，用 e.g. 举例，前接概括性陈述、后接实例列表；激活落在缩写的多个子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，电子系统举例

patterns.name: 地点相关词汇
patterns.context: 指实际地点；[5]询问汽车服务地点，[10]谈论地点的入口、寻址或配送问题。
patterns.domain: 网络问答与商业/配送说明

patterns.name: 能源安全专名
patterns.context: 出现在“Energy security”之后，作为能源相关名称或专名的分词片段；具体指代无法仅凭片段确定。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会讨论、能源政策

patterns.name: HTML 换行后的缩进与标签起始
patterns.context: HTML 代码换行后以制表符缩进，再开始新标签；与前述属性结构模式同现，但可能对换行/缩进本身也敏感。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 源码

patterns.name: 问句开头的 Are there places
patterns.context: 句首一般疑问句，询问是否存在可提供某项服务的地点；除 places 外，句式信号仅出现一次。

patterns.name: 编号及换行后的 Discuss
patterns.context: 文档开头出现似乎是编号或格式残片，随后以 Discuss 开始议题；无法确定编号与激活的关系。
patterns.domain: 网页/文本格式残片与议论性文章

patterns.name: 性相关词汇及禁忌关系
patterns.context: 讨论亲属间性行为的心理抑制及遗传学理由；强激活词分散，可能与句法上的 that 从句有关，主题是否独立触发不确定。
patterns.domain: 通俗说明或议论性文章

en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish sentence-initial causal word “Därför” and the English exclusive qualifier “only”; it also activates on x in hexadecimal number prefixes and on that introducing a relative clause in a patent sentence.

patterns.name: Swedish causal connective
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, introduces a result, conclusion, or action following a previously stated reason; may be preceded by the question “Varför?”
patterns.domain: Swedish political argumentation in the European Parliament

patterns.name: English exclusive qualifier only
patterns.context: Qualifies applicable subjects or conditions, expressing “only …” or “merely …”; common in technical restrictions, commentary, and contrastive sentences

patterns.name: x in hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Appears in hexadecimal numbers with a 0x prefix, surrounded by a tab-aligned table of constants

patterns.name: that introducing a relative clause
patterns.context: Follows “problems” and introduces a clause describing the problems

3_2061.description: 主要响应瑞典语句首因果词“Därför”和英语排他限定词“only”；另对十六进制数值前缀中的 x、专利句中引出关系从句的 that 激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语因果连接词
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头，用来引出前文所述原因的结果、结论或行动；有时前接问句“Varför?”
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语政治论述

patterns.name: 英语排他限定词 only
patterns.context: 限定适用对象或条件，表达“只有……才……”或“仅仅……”；常见于技术限制、评论和对比句

patterns.name: 十六进制常量中的 x
patterns.context: 出现在 0x 前缀的十六进制数值中，周围是制表符对齐的常量表

patterns.name: 关系从句引导词 that
patterns.context: 接在“problems”之后，引出描述问题的从句

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly on the example-introducing word as (such as), sentence-initial Should/Shouldn't questions, and explanatory namely; there is also one trigger in a question about uploading large files. Overall, the pattern tends toward introducing examples or asking questions.

patterns.name: Examples after such as
patterns.context: Introduces specific examples after a description of drawbacks, problems, or conditions; the trigger falls on as.

patterns.name: Should questions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Should in a question, often in a title or post asking for advice or posing a normative question.

patterns.name: Shouldn't questions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial negative question with Shouldn't; activation is distributed across the split form.

patterns.name: namely introducing an explanation
patterns.context: Uses namely after a statement to introduce a specific explanation or list.

patterns.name: Large-file upload issue
patterns.context: Raises an issue encountered when uploading files larger than a specified size.

3_2061.description: 强激活主要出现在举例引导语 as（such as）、句首 Should/Shouldn't 疑问句，以及 namely 说明语；另有一次关于大文件上传问题的触发。整体偏向引出例子或提出问题。

patterns.name: such as 后举例
patterns.context: 在说明缺点、问题或条件后，引出具体例子；触发落在 as。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利技术文本

patterns.name: Should 疑问句
patterns.context: 疑问句开头的 Should，常见于征求意见或提出规范性问题的标题、发帖正文。

patterns.name: Shouldn't 疑问句
patterns.context: 句首否定疑问 Shouldn't；激活分布在分词形式上。

patterns.name: namely 引出说明
patterns.context: 在陈述后用 namely 引出具体说明或列举。

patterns.name: 大文件上传问题
patterns.context: 提出上传超过特定大小文件时遇到的问题。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to sentence-initial Should in English questions asking whether advice or an action is appropriate; it also responds consistently to word-initial Issues in titles. The remaining activations are sporadic fragments involving Cyrillic text, punctuation, and layout, with no clear unifying condition.

patterns.name: Should in English questions
patterns.context: In English questions, Should occurs at the beginning of the sentence or an embedded interrogative clause, asking whether advice, responsibility, or an action is appropriate; it is followed by a subject and verb.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A and commentary; topics include healthcare policy, conference bans, personal behavior, and code operations

patterns.name: Word-initial Issues in English
patterns.context: The word is split into two tokens, Iss and ues, combining to form Issues; each appears at the start of a title or short heading, followed by a prepositional phrase specifying the topic.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in Cyrillic text
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of Russian or Bulgarian Cyrillic word forms; the scripts and lexical contexts of the two passages differ, so the material does not establish a stable shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Russian copyright notice; Bulgarian parliamentary text

patterns.name: Numbers and layout markers
patterns.context: Appears in web-text line breaks, separators, font-size descriptions, or punctuation and layout; activation locations are sporadic and show no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Code repository comments and scraped web/forum text

patterns.name: Unclear isolated marker
patterns.context: The marker is sparse; it is unclear whether it represents an independent pattern or merely an incidental activation adjacent to a highly activating word.

3_2061.description: 主要对英文疑问句中的句首 Should 强烈响应，询问建议或行动是否恰当；另对标题中的词首 Issues 有稳定响应。其余激活分散于西里尔文字、标点与版式片段，缺乏明确统一条件。

patterns.name: 英文疑问句中的 Should
patterns.context: 在英文疑问句中，Should 位于句首或从句疑问部分开头，询问建议、责任或行动是否适当；后接主语和动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论讨论；涵盖医疗政策、会议禁令、个人行为、代码操作等主题

patterns.name: 英文词首 Issues
patterns.context: 词被分成 Iss 与 ues 两个 token，合成词 Issues；分别出现在标题或短标题开头，后接介词短语说明议题。
patterns.domain: 标题、出版物或学术文本

patterns.name: 西里尔文字内的词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语或保加利亚语西里尔文字词形的部分 token 上；两段的文字与词法环境不同，无法从材料中确定稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 俄语版权声明；保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 数字与版式标记
patterns.context: 出现在网页文本的换行、分隔线、字号描述或标点版式中；具体激活位置零散，未显示一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库注释及网页/论坛抓取文本

patterns.name: 不明的孤立标记
patterns.trigger: ««»等（段[2]中分散的功能词也有弱标记）
patterns.context: 标记稀疏，无法确认是独立模式，或只是与高激活词相邻的偶发激活。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is advice or judgment questions introduced by Should/Shouldn’t, across forums, Q&A, and titles. It also responds to Cyrillic fragments and appears around line breaks and the starts of new posts/comments on HackerNews.

patterns.name: Should I/Shouldn’t this question form
patterns.context: Should appears at the beginning or within a sentence, often followed by the first-person I or this/the, to ask for advice, judgment, or a normative opinion; the word itself is a prominent trigger.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, StackExchange comments and help-seeking posts; also interrogative topics in PubMed titles

patterns.name: Word-initial Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Words in Russian or related Cyrillic scripts, especially initial letters or subword fragments; all examples are in non-English text.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Pile-CC, and Russian code comments

patterns.name: Post/comment start markers after line breaks
patterns.context: In HackerNews text, line breaks separate posts or comments; activation occurs near the line break and the start of a following question.

3_2061.description: 最突出的模式是 Should/Shouldn’t 引出的建议或判断问题，跨论坛、问答及标题；另对俄语西里尔字母片段有反应，也出现在 HackerNews 的换行和新帖/评论开头。

patterns.name: Should I/Shouldn’t this 提问句式
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现 Should，常接第一人称 I 或 this/the，提出建议、判断或规范性问题；该词本身是突出触发点。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、StackExchange 评论与求助帖，也见 PubMed 标题中的疑问式主题

patterns.name: 西里尔字母词首片段
patterns.context: 俄语或相关西里尔文字词语中，尤其词首字母/子词片段；这些例子均处于非英语文本。

patterns.name: 换行后新帖/评论起始标记
patterns.context: HackerNews 文本中换行分隔帖子或评论，激活出现在换行及后续提问开头附近。

en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on Should (at the start of advice-seeking requests), only in the Not only construction, and a tokenized fragment of PHP Illuminate; there are also isolated cases involving the Russian word-final а and a period, with differing trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Initial subword fragment of Should
patterns.context: Appears in questions or requests for advice, followed by subjects such as I/we and advice, actions, or decisions; it may also begin a sentence in a quotation.

patterns.name: Not only inversion
patterns.context: Appears in the “Not only” construction, followed by an auxiliary or modal verb, such as “Not only will...” or “Not only was...”

patterns.name: PHP Illuminate namespace code
patterns.context: PHP code spelling the Laravel Illuminate namespace; the tokenized token falls within Illuminate.

patterns.name: Russian genitive ending
patterns.context: In a Russian copyright notice, the token corresponds to the final letter of “права”.

patterns.name: Ordinary period
patterns.context: Sentence-final punctuation; in this example it is preceded by a space and followed by a new sentence or line break.

3_2061.concept: 常见但异质的文本片段
3_2061.description: 强激活最集中于 Should（建议请求句开头）、Not only 结构中的 only、PHP Illuminate 的分词片段；另有俄文词尾 а 与句号的孤例，触发条件各异。

patterns.name: Should 的首词片段
patterns.context: 出现在疑问句或请求建议的句子中，后接 I/we 等主语及建议、行动或决策内容；也可能是引用中的句子开头

patterns.name: Not only 倒装结构
patterns.context: 位于“Not only”结构中，后接助动词或情态动词，如“Not only will...”或“Not only was...”

patterns.name: PHP Illuminate 命名空间代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码中拼写 Laravel Illuminate 命名空间，分词 token 落在 Illuminate 内

patterns.name: 俄文所有格词尾
patterns.context: 俄语版权声明中，token 对应“права”的末尾字母

patterns.name: 普通句号
patterns.context: 句末标点；该例中前有空格，后接新句或换行

en.description: Activation covers PHP/Laravel file headers and Illuminate imports, the negative question shouldn't, place-name fragments such as Algiers/Algak, and the Not only construction; these triggers have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: PHP file header
patterns.context: The standard opening tag at the beginning of PHP source code, followed by a blank line and PHP statements.

patterns.name: Laravel/Illuminate namespaces and imports
patterns.context: An Illuminate/Laravel namespace appears in a PHP namespace or use declaration; activation falls especially on the segmented Illuminate subword.

patterns.name: shouldn't in an English negative question
patterns.context: In the HackerNews colloquial question “Why shouldn't this be up to the mouse driver?”, both parts of shouldn't activate strongly.

patterns.name: Subword of the place name Algiers
patterns.context: The g subword in Algiers/Algeria-related place names activates strongly; examples occur in historical accounts, geographic entries, and event titles.

patterns.name: Name fragment in Algak Island
patterns.context: The g subword in the island name Algak Island in a Kitikmeot/Nunavut geographic entry activates strongly.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase Not only
patterns.context: The English sentence contains the “Not only ...” construction; only is the strongest activation component and may be followed by will, is, etc.
patterns.domain: Web exposition, promotional copy, and forum comments

3_2061.description: 激活涵盖 PHP/Laravel 文件头与 Illuminate 导入、shouldn't 否定问句、Algiers/Algak 等地名片段，以及 Not only 构式；这些触发条件并无明显统一语义。

patterns.name: PHP 文件头
patterns.context: PHP 源代码开头的标准 opening tag，后接空行和 PHP 语句。

patterns.name: Laravel/Illuminate 命名空间与导入
patterns.context: PHP 的 namespace 或 use 声明中出现 Illuminate/Laravel 命名空间，激活尤其落在被拆分的 Illuminate 子词上。

patterns.name: 英文否定问句中的 shouldn't
patterns.context: HackerNews 口语问句 “Why shouldn't this be up to the mouse driver?” 中，shouldn't 的两部分均强激活。

patterns.name: 地名 Algiers 的子词
patterns.context: Algiers/Algeria 相关地名中，Algiers 的 g 子词强激活；可见于历史叙述、地理条目和赛事标题。

patterns.name: Algak Island 的名称片段
patterns.context: Kitikmeot/Nunavut 地理条目中的岛屿名 Algak Island，g 子词强激活。

patterns.name: Not only 固定搭配
patterns.context: 英文句子出现 “Not only ...” 构式；only 是最强激活部分，后续可接 will、is 等。
patterns.domain: 网页说明文、宣传文字与论坛评论

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and Not only
en.description: Activation is concentrated in three local fragments: um in the Laravel identifier Illuminate, g in the place name Algiers, and only in the construction Not only. The latter occurs across genres and often introduces progression or contrast.

patterns.name: um in a Laravel namespace
patterns.context: Appears in the Laravel identifier Illuminate in PHP, especially in the tokenized fragment of Illuminate; nearby text includes use, namespace separators, or framework class names.

patterns.name: g in Algiers
patterns.context: Appears inside the place name Algiers, followed by iers; the context concerns a location or historical event.

patterns.name: Not only construction
patterns.context: The phrase Not only is followed by various auxiliaries or predicate components, such as will, was, do, in, or is; it introduces progression or contrast.

3_2061.concept: 特定子词片段及 Not only
3_2061.description: 激活集中于三类局部片段：Laravel 标识符 Illuminate 中的 um、地名 Algiers 中的 g，以及句式 Not only 中的 only；后者跨多种文体，常引出递进或对照。

patterns.name: Laravel 命名空间中的 um
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 的 Laravel 标识符 Illuminate 中，尤其是 Illuminate 的分词片段；周围有 use、命名空间分隔符或框架类名。

patterns.name: 阿尔及尔中的 g
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Algiers 的分词内部，后接 iers；上下文涉及地点或历史事件。

patterns.name: Not only 结构
patterns.context: 短语 Not only 后接不同助动词或谓语成分，如 will、was、do、in、is；用于引出递进或对照。
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论及论坛文本

en.concept: Not only construction and miscellaneous fragments
en.description: The most stable pattern is the “not only” additive-emphasis construction, often followed by but also. Other scattered activations involve negative contractions, fragments within proper names, and line-break punctuation; they span genres and are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: not only construction
patterns.context: Appears in “not only X but (also) Y” or variants, emphasizing additive parallel elements; X and Y may be phrases or clauses.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, technical descriptions, parliamentary speeches, and online text

patterns.name: Negative contraction in a question
patterns.context: A question contains a contraction of should not, followed by “this be up to the mouse driver?”.

patterns.name: Tokenization in an Algiers-related proper name
patterns.context: The proper name Algiers is marked by tokenization; nearby text concerns a military trial and a swimming event, respectively.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a place name or personal name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the name Alonso in a chapter list; no obvious shared syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Boundary line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Appears at line breaks and dash separators in code discussion snippets, alongside miscellaneous text.

patterns.name: Scattered activations on short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on line breaks, periods, or common function words, without a stable shared local construction.

3_2061.concept: not only 结构及杂项片段
3_2061.description: 最稳定的模式是“not only”并列强调结构，常接 but also；另有若干分散激活，涉及否定缩写、专名内部片段及换行标点，跨文体且难以统一解释。

patterns.name: not only 结构
patterns.context: 出现在“not only X but (also) Y”或其变体中，强调并列补充成分；X、Y可为短语或分句。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的散文、技术说明、议会发言及网络文本

patterns.name: 问句中的否定缩写
patterns.context: 疑问句中出现 should not 的缩写，后接“this be up to the mouse driver?”。

patterns.name: 阿尔及尔相关专名分词
patterns.context: 专名 Algiers 被分词标记；附近分别是关于军事审判和游泳赛事的文字。

patterns.name: 地名或姓名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在章节目录中的人名 Alonso 内部，未见明显语义句式条件。

patterns.name: 边界换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在代码讨论片段的换行、横线分隔处，伴随杂项文本。

patterns.name: 短词及标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在换行、句号或常见功能词上，未表现出稳定的共同局部句式。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual word fragments, English function words, proper names, and numbers. Romanian and place-name examples are relatively common, but the examples are inconsistent across corpora and word classes and cannot be reduced to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in place names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal letter fragments in place names or demonyms, often spellings containing g; adjacent fragments are sometimes marked too, but not consistently.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, news commentary, and medical conferences

patterns.name: Romanian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across initial, medial, or final substrings in continuous Romanian text, including articles, affixes, and fragments within ordinary words; no single meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: English common-word or phrase fragments
patterns.context: Function words or local phrases in English sentences are marked; the trigger is unstable and has no obvious connection to the sentence topic.

patterns.name: English place names and geographic names
patterns.context: Activation appears within geographic proper names or their components, including archipelagos, islands, directions, cities, and state abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geographic entries, web image pages

patterns.name: Internal fragments in English scientific terms
patterns.context: Activation falls within terms and personal names in an English account of meteor observation; the isolated example does not establish a more specific semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Line-break markers and questions in forum text
patterns.context: Text includes line breaks, separators, and forum-style quotations/questions, along with an English negative question. The relationship of this pattern to examples in other languages or place names is unclear.

patterns.name: Numerals or quantity expressions
patterns.context: Activation occasionally occurs near numbers or numerical values, but the triggering forms are inconsistent; marked numbers appear only in individual snippets.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, European Parliament text, forum posts

3_2061.description: 激活散布于多语种词内片段、英语功能词、专名与数字；罗马尼亚语和地名例子较集中，但跨语料、跨词类均不一致，无法归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 地名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在地名或国籍词的内部字母片段，常见于包含 g 的拼写；有时前后片段也被标记，但并非固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻评论、医学会议等多种文体

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在罗马尼亚语连续文本中的词首、词中或词尾子串，涉及冠词、词缀和普通词内部片段；没有明显单一词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 英语常用词或短语片段
patterns.trigger: « of»、« shouldn»«'t»、« this»« be»、« from»、« that»、« was»« produced»« by»等
patterns.context: 英文句子中的功能词或局部短语被标记；触发范围不稳定，且与所在句子的主题无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、网页文本、百科

patterns.name: 英语地名与地理名称
patterns.context: 地理专名或地名组成部分内部出现激活，覆盖群岛、岛屿、方位、城市和州缩写。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、网页图片页面

patterns.name: 英语科学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在关于流星观测的英文叙述中的术语和人名内部；不能从单例确定更具体的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的断行标记与疑问表达
patterns.context: 文本含换行、分隔线和论坛式引用/提问；同时有英语否定疑问句。该模式与其他语种或地名例子关系不明。

patterns.name: 数词或数量表达
patterns.context: 数字或数值附近偶有激活，但触发形式不一致；标记数字仅在个别片段中出现。
patterns.domain: 百科、欧洲议会文本、论坛帖子

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting triggers
en.description: Activation occurs mainly on g in the place name Algiers, with in the phrase “problem … with”, and sector in the username badsectoracula. There are also line breaks, g in Montgomeryshire, and various scattered word fragments; some contexts lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the name Algeria
patterns.context: The place name Algiers is marked by segmentation, with activation concentrated on the internal letter g; nearby text describes Algerian cities, history, or events.

patterns.name: Negative/problem statements with with
patterns.context: Comments or questions contain phrases such as “problem lies with…” or “problem is not with…”.

patterns.name: Username badsectoracula
patterns.context: A HackerNews post is signed with this username, followed by a line break and quoted or comment text.

patterns.name: g in other place names
patterns.context: The internal letter g in the Welsh place name Montgomeryshire is marked; its context has no obvious connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Physical line break
patterns.context: Text contains paragraph or post line breaks, and the line-break character itself activates.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, and other mixed text

patterns.name: Other scattered word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments belong to different words and sentence contexts, with no stable shared condition.

3_2061.concept: 局部词片段与格式触发
3_2061.description: 主要在地名 Algiers 的 g、短语“problem … with”的 with，以及用户名 badsectoracula 的 sector 处激活；另有换行、Montgomeryshire 的 g 和多种零散词片段，部分上下文缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 阿尔及利亚名称内部片段
patterns.context: 地名 Algiers 被拆分标记，激活集中在内部字母 g；周围介绍阿尔及利亚城市、历史或赛事

patterns.name: 与 with 搭配的否定/问题表述
patterns.context: 评论或问题中出现“problem lies with…”或“problem is not with…”这类搭配

patterns.name: 用户名 badsectoracula
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子以该用户名署名，后接换行及引用或评论内容

patterns.name: 其他地名中的 g
patterns.context: 威尔士地名 Montgomeryshire 的内部字母 g 被标记；无明显与其他模式相同的上下文

patterns.name: 物理换行符
patterns.context: 文本包含段落或帖子换行，换行符本身被激活
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各片段分属不同词语及句境，未见稳定共同条件

en.description: Activation is scattered across several local formats and phrases: the with construction for attributing problems in comments, a colon and tab after an email subject field, negative rhetorical questions, and a file-name field in code comments. No single clear semantic feature covers them all.

patterns.name: with introducing the source of a problem
patterns.context: When explaining, evaluating, or attributing, points out where the problem lies, often followed by the, rats, open source, etc. In segments [1] and [6], with itself is unmarked, but the lies with construction also occurs.
patterns.domain: Comments, forum discussions, and news commentary

patterns.name: Separator in email subject field
patterns.context: In an email header, a tab separates Subject: from the subject text, which may begin with RE:, etc.; activation is concentrated on the separator, not a particular subject word.

patterns.name: Negative rhetorical question of the form “shouldn’t…?”
patterns.context: A forum post asks a rhetorical question using a negative modal form, followed by this be up to the mouse driver?

patterns.name: Filename in a code comment
patterns.context: In a C/C++ source file header comment, the field name file is followed by a filename and extension.

3_2061.description: 激活分散在几类局部格式与短语：评论中归因问题的 with 结构、邮件主题字段后的冒号与制表符、否定反问形式，以及代码注释里的 file 文件名字段；没有单一明确语义可覆盖全部。

patterns.name: with 后接问题所在
patterns.context: 在解释、评估或归因时，指出问题出在哪里，常见后续为 the、rats、open source 等；段[1]、[6]中 with 本身是未标记的，但同样出现 lies with 结构。
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛讨论及新闻评论

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件头中 Subject: 后用制表符分隔主题内容，主题可能以 RE: 等开头；激活集中在分隔符而非特定主题词。

patterns.name: 不应……？的反问
patterns.context: 论坛发言中以否定情态形式提出反问，后接 this be up to the mouse driver?

patterns.name: 代码注释中的文件名
patterns.context: C/C++ 源文件头部注释中，字段名 file 后跟文件名及扩展名。

en.concept: Structural markers and fixed phrases in expository text
en.description: Activation occurs most consistently in the “e.g.” exemplification construction, and also in the problem-attribution phrase “the problem lies with”, colon-introduced lists, and descriptions of environmental conditions. There are also domain-specific signals involving clinical exclusion criteria, email headers, research aims, and DNA repair.

patterns.name: Exemplification abbreviation e.g.
patterns.context: Introduces examples in parentheses, especially in the “(e.g., …)” construction; activation falls on the abbreviation components and adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Problem-attribution construction
patterns.context: A problem or defect is attributed to an object, often followed by a definite article and noun.

patterns.name: List after a colon
patterns.context: A colon introduces criteria, exclusion conditions, or email body text; the surrounding context varies considerably when this occurs alone.

patterns.name: Descriptions of road and weather conditions
patterns.context: Describes environmental conditions and events that affect safety, facilities, or infrastructure.

patterns.name: Research aims and factor roles
patterns.context: A statement of research aims explains the role of a factor being assessed.

patterns.name: Comparison of cable installation methods
patterns.context: Compares overhead and underground telecommunications cable installation, and recounts the risk of weather damage.

patterns.name: Email header fields and names
patterns.context: Email headers or forwarded-email formats, with tabs, colons, and line breaks between fields.

patterns.name: Clinical exclusion criteria
patterns.context: Lists conditions under which patients are excluded from a study; examples are often placed in parentheses.

patterns.name: Parallelism of DNA damage and repair
patterns.context: Discusses damage recognition, repair, and their coordination with chromatin function.

3_2061.concept: 说明性文本中的结构标记与固定搭配
3_2061.description: 激活最稳定地出现在“e.g.”例示结构，也见于问题归因句“the problem lies with”、冒号列表和环境条件描述；另有临床排除标准、邮件头、研究目的及DNA修复等领域特有信号。

patterns.name: 例示缩写 e.g.
patterns.context: 引出括号中的例子，尤其在“(e.g., …)”结构中；激活落在缩写各部分及邻近标点上
patterns.domain: 学术、专利等说明性文体

patterns.name: 问题归因句式
patterns.context: 问题或缺陷被归因于某对象，常接定冠词及名词

patterns.name: 冒号后的列表
patterns.context: 冒号引出标准、排除条件或邮件正文；单独出现时上下文差异较大

patterns.name: 道路与天气条件表述
patterns.context: 描述影响安全、设施或基础设施的环境条件与事件

patterns.name: 研究目的与因素角色
patterns.context: 研究目的句中说明评估某因素的作用

patterns.name: 电缆铺设方式对比
patterns.context: 对比电信线缆地上架设与地下铺设，并转述天气损害风险

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与姓名
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件格式，字段间有制表符、冒号和换行

patterns.name: 临床排除标准
patterns.context: 列明患者不纳入研究的条件，例子常置于括号中

patterns.name: DNA损伤与修复并列
patterns.context: 讨论损伤感知、修复及其与染色质功能的协调

en.concept: Email subject formatting and the lies with collocation
en.description: The main pattern is a tab after the colon in an email subject field. Email subjects, FW:, and timestamps also show scattered activation. In two non-email passages, with activates strongly in the “the problem lies with” collocation. The email-format patterns are related to one another, but have no obvious connection to this collocation.

patterns.name: “lies with” collocation
patterns.context: The “the problem lies with …” or “the problem lies with … rather than …” construction; activation is concentrated on with.

patterns.name: Tab in the email subject field
patterns.context: The tab between Subject: and the subject text in Enron email headers; subject content varies.

patterns.name: FW marker in forwarded email subjects
patterns.context: FW: marks a forwarded message in an email subject field.

patterns.name: Specific administrative topics in email subjects
patterns.context: Email subject fields mention matters such as system capacity, contract processes, training, software rights, meetings, or lists; the subject words themselves show only scattered activation.

patterns.name: PM marker in date and time
patterns.context: An afternoon time marker in an email header timestamp; activation is weak and appears in only a few snippets.

3_2061.concept: 邮件主题格式与 lies with 搭配
3_2061.description: 主要模式是邮件主题栏冒号后的制表符；邮件主题、FW:及时间戳也有零散激活。另在两段非邮件文本中，with 强烈激活于“the problem lies with”搭配。邮件格式模式彼此相关，但与该搭配无明显关联。

patterns.name: “lies with”搭配
patterns.context: “the problem lies with …”或“the problem lies with … rather than …”结构；激活集中在 with。

patterns.name: 邮件主题栏的制表符
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头中 Subject: 后、主题文本前的制表符；主题内容各异。

patterns.name: 邮件转发主题中的 FW 标记
patterns.context: 邮件主题栏内以 FW: 标示转发。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的具体行政事项
patterns.trigger: «off»2«system»2« capacity»2；«Terminated Contract Process»；«Power World Training»；«RE: Ownership and Rights to Software»；«conf call»；«lists»
patterns.context: 邮件主题栏出现系统容量、合同流程、培训、软件权利、会议或列表等事项；主题词本身仅有零散激活。

patterns.name: 日期时间中的 PM 标记
patterns.context: 邮件头日期时间中的下午时间标记；激活较弱且只见于少数片段。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across varied texts: they recur in word forms such as failing, tripled, and coupled, and also involve reports, requests, screening, and deadlines; no single semantic theme explains all instances.

patterns.name: Failure and inability to achieve
patterns.context: Describes failure to complete a goal, qualify, or succeed, often following “after” or “at”; also appears in political commentary in “failing to act”.

patterns.name: Tripling in size
patterns.context: A quantity or size becomes three times its original value; used for ferry passenger numbers and building area.

patterns.name: Coupled
patterns.context: Appears as part of a protein name, meaning G Protein Coupled Receptor.

patterns.name: Listing similar objects
patterns.context: Lists common objects or actions in the same category.

patterns.name: Coiled coil in a compound term
patterns.context: Appears in the term “coiled coil” describing a protein structural region.

patterns.name: Request and response
patterns.context: Discusses a PayPal request and the experience of not getting the desired answer.

patterns.name: Carrier screening
patterns.context: A research abstract reports carrier screening for a specific genetic disease.

patterns.name: Reporting research findings
patterns.context: Papers use “reports” to introduce survey or interview findings.

patterns.name: Waiting until the last minute
