patterns.context: Describes waiting until the last minute to act; the surrounding text consists of news snippets about passengers or crowds.

patterns.name: Deadline and report
patterns.context: Requests submission of an expense report by the 13th of this month.

patterns.name: Project assignment and personal choice
patterns.context: Contrasts tasks selected for you by others with projects you choose yourself.

3_2327.description: 强激活分散在多种文本中：反复出现在 failing（失败）、tripled（三倍）及 coupled（耦合）等词形，也涉及报告、请求、筛查和截止日期；没有一个语义主题能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: 失败与未能达成
patterns.context: 描述未能完成目标、资格或成功，常接在“after”或“at”之后；也出现在政治评论中“failing to act”。
patterns.domain: 评论、创业叙事、个人随笔

patterns.name: 三倍增长
patterns.context: 数量或规模变为原来的三倍；分别用于渡轮客流量和建筑面积。

patterns.name: 耦合
patterns.context: 作为蛋白质名称中的组成部分，表示 G Protein Coupled Receptor。

patterns.name: 同类对象列举
patterns.context: 列举同一类别的常见对象或行为。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 coiled coil
patterns.context: 出现在描述蛋白质结构区域的“coiled coil”术语中。

patterns.name: 请求与回应
patterns.context: 讨论 PayPal 请求以及未获得所需答案的经历。

patterns.name: 载体筛查
patterns.context: 研究摘要报告对特定遗传病的携带者筛查。

patterns.name: 报告研究结果
patterns.context: 论文用“reports”引出调查或访谈结果。

patterns.name: 逾期等待
patterns.context: 描述等到最后一分钟才行动；周围是关于乘客或人群的新闻片段。

patterns.name: 截止日期与报告
patterns.context: 要求在本月 13 日前提交费用报告。

patterns.name: 项目归属与个人选择
patterns.context: 对比别人替你选择的任务与自己选择的项目。

en.concept: The failing word form and its contexts
en.description: The most consistent pattern is the range of forms of failing, appearing in contexts of failure to act, failing an exam, organ failure, or inability to complete something, across multiple genres. Another passage contains a split and resumed personal name; date and duration words in two emails also activate, with no clear connection between them.

patterns.name: Various forms of failing
patterns.context: The word form appears in different constructions: infinitive “failing to + verb” (3, 9, 10), progressive/participle “failing + noun” (4, 6), and nominal or gerund use “Failing at ...” (5).
patterns.domain: Across genres: news commentary, payment service descriptions, medical applications, personal essays, medical patent backgrounds, musical instrument patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Name split into subwords and resumed
patterns.context: A standalone personal name is split into multiple subwords and then restarted after a line break; it has no apparent semantic connection to the failing-form pattern.

patterns.name: Time and number phrases
patterns.context: Everyday work emails report a deadline or time spent; activations cluster on ordinal dates and time-related narrative words.

3_2327.description: 最稳定模式是 failing 的多种词形，出现在未能行动、未通过、器官衰竭或未能完成等语境，横跨多类文体。另有一段人名拆分续写；两封邮件中的日期、时长词也激活，彼此未见明确联系。

patterns.name: failing 的多种形态
patterns.context: 词形出现于不同结构中：不定式 “failing to + 动词”（3、9、10），进行/分词形式 “failing + 名词”（4、6），以及名词性或动名词用法 “Failing at ...”（5）。
patterns.domain: 跨文体；新闻评论、支付服务说明、医学申请、个人随笔、医学专利背景、乐器专利背景

patterns.name: 人名分词与续写
patterns.context: 孤立的人名拆分成多个子词，随后在换行后重启；与 failing 词形模式无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目或列表

patterns.name: 时间与数字短语
patterns.context: 日常工作邮件中报告截止日期或已花费的时间；激活集中于序数日期及时间叙述词。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on fruit, failing, and generate, spanning literal and figurative contexts, expressions of failure, and different senses of generation, respectively; several other isolated words also activate strongly, with no unified semantic or stylistic cues.

patterns.name: Literal use of fruit
patterns.context: Connected with and, of, and similar words, it is used as a food or biological object, or figuratively for the product of thought; activation falls on fruit.

patterns.name: The failing word form
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “failing to act,” “After failing to qualify,” and “failing at ...,” meaning inability to do something or failure.

patterns.name: Forms of generate
patterns.context: Appears with public address or to mean producing negative publicity; the verb generate occurs in both senses.

patterns.name: Other words and local collocations
patterns.context: Each passage contains only isolated highly activated words or phrases, with no shared contextual condition.

3_2327.description: 激活主要落在 fruit、failing、generate 上，分别跨越字面与比喻语境、失败表达和不同含义的生成表达；另有若干孤立词语高激活，未显示统一语义或文体线索。

patterns.name: fruit 字面用法
patterns.context: 与 and、of 等连接，作为饮食或生物学对象，或比喻思想成果；激活落在 fruit 上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、学术文本、散文

patterns.name: failing 词形
patterns.context: 出现在“failing to act”“After failing to qualify”“failing at ...”等表达中，表示未能做到或失败。
patterns.domain: 评论、创业博客、个人叙述

patterns.name: generate 词形
patterns.context: 与 public address 连用，或表示产生负面舆论；不同语义下均出现在动词 generate 上。

patterns.name: 其他词语及局部搭配
patterns.context: 各段仅有孤立的高激活词或短语，未见共同上下文条件。

en.concept: The fail word family and several subword fragments
en.description: Activations most consistently occur on the fail word family, covering personal setbacks, failure to achieve goals, and program errors; there are also sporadic responses to crops, fruit, the plural ending of rug, a textiles fragment, and fragments in reproductive development texts.

patterns.name: The fail word family and its participial forms
patterns.context: fail/failing appears in contexts involving failure, ineffectiveness, failing a grade, or program errors; the main marked form is failing
patterns.domain: Spoken narratives, news, technical texts, commentary

patterns.name: Fruit and crop vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses fruit and vegetable consumption or agricultural crops; both triggers occur in noun phrases
patterns.domain: Public health abstracts, agricultural patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Rug and its plural ending
patterns.context: When discussing rugs, the stem of rug and its plural ending are marked separately

patterns.name: Clothing vocabulary
patterns.context: An internal fragment of textiles appears in a list of products related to commercially important crops

patterns.name: Atypical reproductive development vocabulary
patterns.context: Studies sex determination in Drosophila germ cells; triggers are distributed across biological terminology and species names

3_2327.description: 激活最稳定地落在 failing 词族，涵盖个人挫败、未能达成目标及程序故障；另对 crops、fruit、rug 复数词尾、textiles 片段及生殖发育文本中的词片段有零散响应。

patterns.name: fail词族及其分词形式
patterns.context: fail/failing 出现在失败、未能奏效、成绩不及格或程序故障等语境中；标记形式主要是 failing
patterns.domain: 口语叙述、新闻、技术文本、评论

patterns.name: 果实与农作物词汇
patterns.context: 谈及水果蔬菜消费、农业作物；两处触发都位于名词短语
patterns.domain: 公共卫生摘要、农业专利背景

patterns.name: rug 及复数词尾
patterns.context: 谈论地毯时，rug 的词干与复数词尾分别标记

patterns.name: 服装词汇
patterns.context: 列举商业重要农作物相关产品时出现 textiles 的词内片段

patterns.name: 非典型生殖发育词汇
patterns.context: 研究果蝇生殖细胞性别决定；触发分散在生物学术语和物种名词中

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word form “failing,” covering failure, poor performance, and inability to achieve a goal; there are also sporadic activations on several subword fragments in code filenames, personal names, medical terminology, and URLs.

patterns.name: The “failing” word form
patterns.context: The word means failure, poor performance, or inability to do something; strong activation occurs whether the subject is an individual, political action, or qualification application.

patterns.name: Code file path fragments
patterns.context: A filename or path-like string in a Go comment; activation is concentrated on split path/identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Name fragments and repetition
patterns.context: The repeated proper name “Douglas McLelland”; activation falls on subword-split name fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia title or entry text; passage 7

patterns.name: Lactating cell terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical phrases related to secretion, autophagy, and prolactin cells; activation falls on subword fragments of the terms.

patterns.name: Web URL fragments
patterns.context: A URL path following an article title; activation is concentrated on URL substrings rather than the title text.

3_2327.description: 主要对词形“failing”强烈响应，涵盖失败、表现不佳和未能达成目标；另对代码文件名、人名、医学术语及网址中的若干分词片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: “failing”词形
patterns.context: 该词在句中表示失败、表现不佳或未能做到；无论是个人、政治行动还是资格申请，均触发强激活。

patterns.name: 代码文件路径片段
patterns.context: Go 注释中的文件名或路径样式字符串，激活集中于被拆分的路径/标识符片段。

patterns.name: 人名片段与重复
patterns.context: 重复出现的专名“Douglas McLelland”，激活落在分词后的姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 百科标题或条目文本；段7

patterns.name: 泌乳细胞术语
patterns.context: 分泌、自噬与催乳素细胞相关的生物医学短语，激活落在术语的分词片段。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 片段
patterns.context: 文章标题后的网址路径，激活集中在 URL 的子串而非标题正文。

en.description: Strong activations fall respectively on English to, Swedish den, and Hungarian ves-; each is triggered by lexical and syntactic contexts in its own language, with the corpus spanning parliamentary texts and forums.

patterns.name: English infinitive marker/directional preposition to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive verb or the purpose of an action in English sentences; also appears mid-sentence and in the title link “dev.to”
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, quotations, and webpage titles/URLs

patterns.name: Swedish den
patterns.context: The definite article den in Swedish noun phrases, as in “den inre marknaden” and “den ... milisen”; in passage 5 it is used pronominally as “den”

patterns.name: Hungarian ves- stem
patterns.context: A stem fragment in Hungarian word forms, appearing in “veszélyre” and “vesznek”

3_2327.description: 强激活分别落在英语 to、瑞典语 den 和匈牙利语 ves-上；各自受不同语言的词法、句法语境触发，语料跨议会文本与论坛。

patterns.name: 英语不定式/方向介词 to
patterns.context: 英语句子中引出不定式动词或动作目的；也出现于句中及标题链接“dev.to”
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、引述及网页标题/URL

patterns.name: 瑞典语 den
patterns.context: 瑞典语名词短语中的定冠词 den，如“den inre marknaden”“den ... milisen”；第5段中为代词式用法“den”

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 ves-词干
patterns.context: 匈牙利语词形中的词干片段，分别出现在“veszélyre”和“vesznek”中

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the token «to»; in the English passages it often precedes an infinitive after a line break, across varied contexts and topics. Passage 3 hits in Swedish text; boundary markers and fragments show no distinct stable pattern.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Followed by a base-form verb, often appearing after a line break or sentence boundary; there is also a weaker «to»7.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions, EuroParl Swedish text, film reviews, and other genres

patterns.name: Infinitive constructions after line breaks
patterns.context: A syntactic construction continues after a line break with to + base-form verb, as in “to answer,” “to get,” “to be,” “to sustain,” “to think,” and “to implement”; the hit in passage 3 is a subword fragment within a Swedish word and does not show the same English construction.
patterns.domain: Primarily English forum posts, plus Swedish parliamentary text

patterns.name: Paragraph/miscellaneous boundary cues
patterns.context: Separators or text fragments appear in the same context, but show no clear stable connection to the strongly activated token «to»10.
patterns.domain: Forum scrape text, webpage snippets, and corpus noise

3_2327.description: 所有段均强激活于 token「to」；英语段多为换行后接不定式，语境和主题各异。第3段在瑞典语文本中命中，边界符与碎片未显示独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 后面接动词原形，常出现在换行或句子边界之后；也有较弱的 «to»7。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、EuroParl 瑞典语文本及影评等多种文体

patterns.name: 断行后的不定式结构
patterns.context: 换行后以 to + 动词原形继续句法结构，如 “to answer”“to get”“to be”“to sustain”“to think”“to implement”；第3段的命中为瑞典语单词内部的子词片段，未呈现相同的英语结构。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛正文为主，另有瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 段落/杂项边界线索
patterns.context: 同一上下文中出现分隔符或文本碎片，但与强激活 token «to»10 并无明显稳定联系。
patterns.domain: 论坛抓取文本、网页片段及语料噪声

en.description: Across a range of genres, activations often fall on subword fragments within or at the boundaries of English words, especially hyphenated titles, proper names, URLs, and word endings; there are also sporadic examples involving dates, short function words, and forum signature remnants, with no stable single semantic theme.

patterns.name: English internal suffix fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split word fragments, internal hyphens, and locations near the ends of words or phrases, often forming a complete expression with preceding unmarked words; there is no single fixed affix.
patterns.domain: English prose, titles, emails, and Q&A across domains

patterns.name: Rare proper names or name fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper names, usernames, or subword fragments within proper names; sometimes they overlap with internal word splits, and nearby ordinary words in the same passage may also activate.
patterns.domain: Tech news, links, music entries, emails, and titles

patterns.name: Hyphenated strings in titles and URLs
patterns.context: Words in phrases are joined with hyphens in titles or URLs; activation spans hyphens and some word segments, but not every hyphenated word activates.
patterns.domain: HackerNews link titles, entertainment show titles, news headlines

patterns.name: Time markers and sentence/paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Date numbers and years in news links, as well as the beginning of the following line, occasionally activate; they are adjacent to word fragments and title structures, but this does not establish dates themselves as a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Short function words in questions or direct quotations
patterns.context: A few common short words activate when appearing in questions, quotations, or sentences; distribution is inconsistent and may overlap with the word-boundary or tokenization effects above.

patterns.name: Forum signature fragment after a salary statement
patterns.context: A signature or username and the start of the next sentence appear after a paragraph divider; activation falls on a trailing username fragment. This example has no clear connection to the other patterns.

3_2327.concept: 英文子词边界与词片段
3_2327.description: 跨多种文体，激活常落在英文词内部或边界的子词片段，尤其是连字符标题、专名、网址和词尾；另有日期、短功能词及论坛签名残片等零散例子，未见稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英文词内后缀片段与词界
patterns.trigger: 词内或词首位置的子词片段，如 «so»-«-»«secret»、«-»«zmitri»、«-»« Fidel»、«-»«bring»、«-»«to»-«ta»、«embar»-«r»-«ased»、«come»-«out»、«to»-«fix»
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分的词片段、词内连字符以及词或短语末尾附近，常与前面未标记的词构成一个完整表达；并非统一的固定词缀。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、标题、邮件与问答

patterns.name: 罕见专名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、用户名或专名内部的分词片段；有时与词内切分交叠，且同一段内邻近普通词也可激活。
patterns.domain: 科技新闻、链接、音乐条目、邮件及标题

patterns.name: 标题与网址中的连字符词串
patterns.context: 标题或网址把短语词语以连字符连接；激活跨越连字符及部分词段，但并非每个连字符词都激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews链接标题、娱乐节目标题、新闻标题

patterns.name: 时间标记与句段边界
patterns.context: 新闻链接中的日期数字、年份和下一行开头偶有激活；与词片段及标题结构相邻，但不能据此确认日期本身是稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 问句或直接引语中的短功能词
patterns.context: 少量常见短词在问句、引语或句中出现时激活，分布不一致，可能与上述词边界或分词效应重叠。
patterns.domain: 标题、邮件、新闻文字、问答

patterns.name: 薪资语句后的论坛签名残片
patterns.context: 段落分隔线后出现签名或用户名及下一句开头，激活落在用户名末尾碎片；此例难与其他模式建立明确联系。

en.description: The most prominent trigger is across, especially in come across meaning to encounter or discover by chance; there are also collocations involving out/at/go with come or go, as well as sporadic activations in technical terms, URLs, and hyphenated subwords.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come across”
patterns.context: The phrase means to encounter, discover, or come upon something by chance; it can occur in different constructions, including negation or perfect tense
patterns.domain: Informal or narrative texts such as forums, Q&A, and emails

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come out”
patterns.context: Discusses an album being released in a given year

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come at”
patterns.context: The idiom “Space comes at a premium” means space is very scarce

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “go live”
patterns.context: Means to go online or broadcast live in webpage titles or link text

patterns.name: to within a split word
patterns.context: to occurs in the tokenization-marked technical compound net-to-next-to-leading order, rather than as an independent grammatical word

patterns.name: to in URLs and hyphenated strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in URLs, titles, or split compounds; the local pattern may relate to punctuation or subword boundaries
patterns.domain: Tech links, titles, and technical terms

patterns.name: Unexplained local activations
patterns.context: These snippets show no obvious shared semantic or stable contextual pattern; they may relate to subword tokenization, punctuation, or incidental co-occurrence
patterns.domain: Various texts, including forums, encyclopedias, and papers

3_2327.description: 最显著的触发是 across，尤其在 come across 表示偶然遇见或发现时；另有 out/at/go 等与 come、go 构成的搭配，以及技术术语、网址和连字符子词中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come across”
patterns.trigger: “come”后接“across”，其中 across 被标记为 «across»10
patterns.context: 短语表示偶然遇到、发现或碰见某物；前面可有否定或完成时等不同结构
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、邮件等非正式或叙述性文本

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come out”
patterns.context: 谈论专辑在某年发行

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come at”
patterns.context: “Space comes at a premium”惯用表达，意为空间十分紧缺

patterns.name: 固定搭配“go live”
patterns.context: 网页标题或链接文本中表示上线、直播

patterns.name: 分词内部的 to
patterns.context: to 位于拆分标注的技术复合词 net-to-next-to-leading order 中，并非独立语法词

patterns.name: 网址及连字符串中的 to
patterns.trigger: “«to»10”及周围多处带标记的连字符片段，如“«-»…«-»”
patterns.context: 激活出现在 URL、标题或被拆分的复合词中；局部模式可能与标点或子词边界有关
patterns.domain: 科技链接、标题及技术术语

patterns.name: 无法解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些片段没有明显共享的语义或稳定上下文；可能与子词切分、标点或偶然共现有关
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、论文等多种文本

en.description: The most consistent response is to in hyphen-connected phrases, particularly on either side of the hyphen; there are also sporadic triggers such as go lucky, Hades, domain-squatters, names, and URL tokenization. Overall, activations are influenced by subword boundaries and webpage title formatting.

patterns.name: to in hyphen-separated phrases
patterns.context: to/for occurs in hyphen-connected phrases or titles; activation is concentrated on the hyphen and short prepositions, especially the hyphens around to.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, product/technical discussions, news links

patterns.name: Fixed expression go lucky
patterns.context: go forms a fixed expression or phrase with the following word; activation may fall on go or the immediately following letter fragment. The text is usually a title or slogan.

patterns.name: Hyphens in dates and number strings
patterns.context: Hyphens and adjacent fragments activate in mixed strings that appear to be dates or numeric sequences.

patterns.name: Internal tokenization of hesitate/hesitated
patterns.context: Appears in the rhetorical question “why-in Hades don’t they just bring back...”; activation spans a subword of Hades and surrounding short words.

patterns.name: Word ending in domain squatters
patterns.context: In domain-squatters, activation is concentrated on an internal suffix fragment, especially «ters».

patterns.name: The compound phrase fairness-of-disclosure
patterns.context: In hyphenated compounds such as fairness-of-disclosure, activation falls on the connecting element and hyphens.
patterns.domain: Commentary about disclosure and viewing options

patterns.name: Word endings in names and cast lists
patterns.context: Names in a cast list are split into subwords, and the ending fragment of an occasional name activates unusually strongly.

patterns.name: The phrase up-to-date
patterns.context: A fixed adjective phrase joined by hyphens; the strongest location is the hyphen before to.

patterns.name: Tokenization in names/brands and URL paths
patterns.context: In HIBP-related links and domains/paths, proper names or URL segments are split, with activation concentrated on the split fragments.

patterns.name: Hyphens in title compounds
patterns.context: Compounds and hyphenated phrases in titles or link paths activate across internal word divisions and the hyphen before a preposition.
patterns.domain: Energy project news titles and URLs

3_2327.concept: 连字符短语及子词边界
3_2327.description: 最稳定的反应是连字符连接的短语，尤其连字符两侧的 to；另有 go lucky、Hades、domain-squatters、姓名及 URL 切分等零散触发，整体受子词边界和网页标题格式影响。

patterns.name: 连字符分隔短语中的 to
patterns.context: to/for 位于由连字符连接的词组或标题中；激活集中在连字符和短介词，尤其 to 前后的连字符。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、产品/技术讨论、新闻链接

patterns.name: 固定表达 go lucky
patterns.context: go 与后续词组成固定表达或短语，激活可落在 go 或紧随其后的字母片段；所在文本多为标题或宣传语。

patterns.name: 日期及数字串中的连字符
patterns.context: 看似日期或数字序列的混合字符串中，连字符及其邻近片段激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 片段中的异常字符串

patterns.name: hesitate/hesitated 词内切分
patterns.context: 出现在 “why-in Hades don’t they just bring back...” 这一反问表达中，激活覆盖 Hades 的子词及周边短词。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、口语化网页文章

patterns.name: 域名 squatters 的词尾
patterns.context: domain-squatters 一词中，激活集中在词内部后缀片段，特别是 «ters»。

patterns.name: fairness-of-disclosure 复合短语
patterns.context: fairness-of-disclosure 这类连字符复合表达中，激活落在连接成分及连字符上。
patterns.domain: 关于披露与查看选项的评论

patterns.name: 人名及演员表中的词尾
patterns.context: 演员名单中姓名被子词切分，个别姓名末尾片段异常强激活。

patterns.name: 短语 up-to-date
patterns.context: 固定形容词短语由连字符连接；最强位置是 to 前的连字符。
patterns.domain: 生活方式或商店相关网页文章

patterns.name: 人名/品牌与 URL 路径中的切分
patterns.context: HIBP 相关链接及域名/路径中，专名或 URL 词段被拆分，激活集中在切分片段。

patterns.name: 标题复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 标题或链接路径中的复合词与连字符短语，激活覆盖词内分段及介词前的连字符。
patterns.domain: 能源项目新闻标题及 URL

en.description: Activations occur across intraword substrings, hyphens, and word boundaries in multilingual text. English out phrases appear occasionally, but there is no stable semantic or syntactic condition across passages, making it difficult to assign a single pattern.

patterns.name: out in English idioms
patterns.context: In English conversation or Q&A, out appears in phrasal verbs or idioms such as “check it out” and “figured it out”; passage 1 also contains the compound word checkboxes.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments such as -ment / -ent
patterns.context: Across English, French, and Portuguese texts, activations occur inside words, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Q&A and multilingual European Parliament proceedings

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Occurs in long Swedish words or inflected and derived forms, with no consistent lexical meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: English content words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In commentary and startup guides, activations fall on different words or hyphens, with no apparent shared contextual function.

patterns.name: URL and hyphen-separated segments
patterns.context: Occurs in URLs in news links, where words are joined by hyphens and marked as separate segments.

patterns.name: Italian IRC word-segment fragments
patterns.context: In chat channel titles and Italian conversational messages, activations are scattered across intraword substrings and hyphens.

3_2327.description: 激活分布于多语种文本的词内子串、连字符与词边界；英语中偶见 out 短语，但跨段缺乏稳定语义或句法条件，难以归为单一模式。

patterns.name: 英语习语中的 out
patterns.context: 英语口语或问答中，out 出现在短语动词或习语里，如“check it out”“figured it out”；段 1 另有复合词 checkboxes。

patterns.name: 词内的 -ment / -ent 等片段
patterns.trigger: «ment»、«ent»：如 «relationship» 中的词片段、«contamination» 中的 «ment»，以及 «indispensável» 等词内的分段激活
patterns.context: 跨英语、法语、葡萄牙语文本；激活出现在词内部，未见统一的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 问答及欧洲议会多语种议事文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语的长词或屈折、派生词中，未显现一致的词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 英文内容词与词内片段
patterns.context: 在评论性文字和创业指南中，激活落在不同词或连字符上；没有明显共享的上下文功能。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 评论、HackerNews 创业文章

patterns.name: URL 与连字符分段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻链接的 URL 中，词语被连字符连接并分段标记。

patterns.name: 意大利语 IRC 分词片段
patterns.context: 聊天频道标题和意大利语口语消息中，激活分散在词内子串及连字符处。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text, favoring intraword token fragments: Swedish “kunna,” “tror,” and others; Portuguese “trate”; French “belges”; and fragments of Danish book titles and technical terms. Many occur in parliamentary policy contexts, but there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Swedish infinitive verbs
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, often follows “att” and means “be able to/can”; commonly followed by a verb or action plan.

patterns.name: Swedish speculation and judgment
patterns.context: Expresses “think/believe” in Swedish, followed by a clause introduced by “att.”

patterns.name: Portuguese conditional verb
patterns.context: Occurs in the construction “quer se trate de,” meaning “whether it concerns …”.

patterns.name: Swedish frequency adverb
patterns.context: Modifies a statement that the WTO mechanism continues to function.

patterns.name: Swedish nominalizing suffix
patterns.context: Occurs in noun phrases about legislation that must be observed or applied.

patterns.name: French nationality adjective
patterns.context: Modifies the Belgian authorities in a sentence about an investigation into dioxin contamination.

patterns.name: Danish book-title form
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of works as part of a book title.

patterns.name: Substring in a technical term
patterns.context: Occurs in a tokenized fragment of the machine-learning tool name scikit-learn, alongside “books like” and other programming tools.

patterns.name: Unexplained salient fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, activations fall on several tokenized fragments; their forms are not adequately explained by triggers in the other passages.

3_2327.description: 激活散布于多语种文本，偏向词内分词片段：瑞典语“kunna”“tror”等、葡语“trate”、法语“belges”、丹麦语书名及技术名词片段；不少落在议会政策语境，但没有统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语动词不定式
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中，常位于“att”之后，表示“能够/可以”；附近常接动词或行动方案。

patterns.name: 瑞典语推测与判断
patterns.context: 瑞典语中表达“认为/相信”，后接“att”引导的从句。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语条件式动词
patterns.context: 出现在“quer se trate de”结构中，意为“无论涉及……”。

patterns.name: 瑞典语频率副词
patterns.context: 修饰关于 WTO 机制继续发挥作用的陈述。

patterns.name: 瑞典语名词化词尾
patterns.context: 出现在有关须遵守、适用的立法的名词短语中。

patterns.name: 法语国籍形容词
patterns.context: 修饰比利时当局，处于关于二噁英污染调查的句子中。

patterns.name: 丹麦语书名词形
patterns.context: 出现在作品清单中，属于书名的一部分。

patterns.name: 技术名词内部子串
patterns.context: 出现在机器学习工具名称 scikit-learn 的分词片段中，与“books like”及其他编程工具并列。

patterns.name: 未解释的突出片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，激活落在若干分词片段上；无法由其他段的触发形式充分解释。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on intraword subword fragments and morphological boundaries, especially in inflected, derived, and compound Nordic words, as well as French words and names. In mathematical text, to also stands out in mapping or approach notation.

patterns.name: Intraword suffixes or morpheme boundaries
patterns.context: Highlights typically fall at boundaries between stems and suffixes, components of compounds, or inflected forms; many tokens are only part of a longer word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary text, English biographies, and mathematical text

patterns.name: Nordic inflected forms and compound fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur in inflected, compound, and derived Swedish or Danish words, often as part of a complete syntactic word rather than as standalone words.
patterns.domain: Swedish and Danish passages in EuroParl

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in French
patterns.context: Highlights occur inside French words or word-form fragments; the supplied context is parliamentary speech about the president and elections.

patterns.name: Mapping arrows in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: «to» occurs in notation mapping a set or space to another space; it is not an independent preposition in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Approach expressions in mathematical prose
patterns.context: «to» occurs in an explanation of a formula, indicating that a variable takes a limit or approaches another variable.

patterns.name: Fragments inside proper names and surnames
patterns.context: Highlights fall inside Norwegian personal names rather than ordinary vocabulary; the text introduces a scholar’s biographical work.

3_2327.description: 激活广泛落在词内的子词片段与形态边界，尤见北欧语屈折、派生和复合词，也见法语及人名；另在数学文本中突出映射或趋近记号里的 to。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词素边界
patterns.trigger: 单词内部被拆开的高亮片段，如「«te»」「«bar»」「«sl»」「«ant»」「«by»」「«er»」；也包括跨词片段「«to»」
patterns.context: 高亮通常落在完整词的词干与后缀、复合词组成部分或词形变化边界上；不少 token 只是较长词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、英文传记及数学文本

patterns.name: 北欧语词形与复合词片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在瑞典语或丹麦语的屈折词、复合词和派生词中，常与完整句法词相连，而非独立单词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的瑞典语、丹麦语段落

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 高亮出现在法语词内部或词形片段中；所给上下文是对主席及选举的议会发言。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的映射箭头
patterns.context: «to» 位于集合或空间到另一空间的映射记号中，不是普通散文中的独立介词。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、度量空间定义

patterns.name: 数学散文中的趋近表达
patterns.context: «to» 出现在公式说明中，表示变量取极限或趋近另一个变量。

patterns.name: 专名与姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在挪威人名的内部，而非普通词汇；文本在介绍学者传记著作。

en.description: Covers intraword fragments, shambles, repost, forum signatures, and path-encoding fragments, as well as scattered function words, word fragments, and formula symbols. Apart from a few repeated word forms, there is no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activations fall inside token-split words, while the rest of each word is unmarked; examples include sklearn, monnaie, and Blamey.
patterns.domain: Machine-learning discussions, French political economy, academic literature

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in shambles
patterns.context: Two word fragments are marked in the phrase “in shambles”; the context denotes confusion or disorder.

patterns.name: Forms related to repost
patterns.context: Activations fall on the stem and inflectional ending of repost in descriptions of publishing articles or content again.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments or spelling fragments
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur within words or word forms; there is insufficient evidence that they share stable semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Commentary, forum text, and general text

patterns.name: Syntactic words and phrase fragments in formulas
patterns.context: Several function and lexical words activate in ordinary English commentary; in a formula explanation, to, y, and $ activate in “Taking x to y $”. These triggers are scattered and cannot yet be grouped under a single condition.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments in English sentences
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English sentences about learning materials and actors, with no shared condition more specific than general syntactic position.

patterns.name: End of a forum signature or username
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the signature “andrewjshults,” immediately after the forum post body and username separator.

patterns.name: Fragments in path or encoded text
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across file paths, underscore-separated strings, and percent-encoded text, with no consistent lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: Hacker News path or Markdown text

3_2327.description: 覆盖词内部片段、shambles、repost、论坛署名和路径编码碎片，也包括分散的功能词、词片段与公式符号；除少数重复词形外，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 特定词内的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的词内部，且词的其余部分未标记；分别见 sklearn、monnaie、Blamey。
patterns.domain: 机器学习讨论、法语政经、学术文献

patterns.name: shambles 词尾片段
patterns.context: 在“in shambles”短语中，两个词片段被标记；语境表示混乱或失序。

patterns.name: repost 相关形式
patterns.context: 激活落在 repost 的词干及其屈折词尾，出现在再次发布文章或内容的叙述中。

patterns.name: 内部词片段或拼写碎片
patterns.context: 在各自的词或词形内部出现标记片段；没有足够证据表明这些片段共享稳定语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛文字及一般文本

patterns.name: 句法词与公式中的短语片段
patterns.context: 在英语评论的普通句子中激活若干功能词和词汇词；另在公式说明的“Taking x to y $”中激活 to、y 和 $。这些触发分散，尚不能归为同一条件。

patterns.name: 英文句中零散词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于学习材料与演员的普通英文句子中，缺乏比一般句法位置更具体的共同条件。

patterns.name: 论坛签名或用户名末尾
patterns.context: 出现在署名“andrewjshults”的末尾，紧接论坛帖子正文与用户名分隔线之后。

patterns.name: 路径或编码文本中的碎片
patterns.context: 激活分布在文件路径、下划线分隔的字符串和百分号编码文本内，未显示一致的词义触发条件。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 路径或 Markdown 文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword subwords, hyphens, URL markers, and several complete words. A few cluster on the -les ending of shambles; the rest lack stable semantic or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Intraword token fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall inside words or on separators, with the surrounding characters forming common words; the trigger words themselves differ.
patterns.domain: Multidomain prose, news, legal texts, and online articles

patterns.name: Word-final -les
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the noun shambles, which means a chaotic or poor state.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, the fragment occurs inside bli.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs, punctuation, and special strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in URLs, punctuation, or technical strings joined by hyphens, rather than consistently corresponding to a semantic word.
patterns.domain: Hacker News websites and technical discussions

patterns.name: Fragments of common words or phrases
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across words, subwords, and phrases with varying capitalization; there is no apparent shared grammatical position or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed genres including news headlines, legal texts, commentary, and dialogue

3_2327.description: 激活分散在词内子词、连字符、网址标记和若干完整词上；少数集中于 shambles 词尾 -les，其余缺乏稳定语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部片段 token
patterns.trigger: 词内被拆分并标记的片段，如 [3] «om»（broom）、[5] «url»（hurl）、[8] «bl»（blame）、[9] «v»（vigilante）；另有 [2] «-»（-politician）
patterns.context: 激活落在词的内部或连接符上，前后字符共同组成常见单词；触发词本身彼此不同
patterns.domain: 多领域散文、新闻、法律文本与网络文章

patterns.name: 词尾的 -les
patterns.context: 出现在名词 shambles 的词尾；该词表示混乱或糟糕状态

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内部片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，片段位于 bli 词内

patterns.name: 网址、标点及特殊字符串片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在网址、标点或由连字符连接的技术字符串中，并非稳定对应某一语义词
patterns.domain: Hacker News 网页与技术讨论

patterns.name: 常见词或短语片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在大小写各异的词、子词及短语中，没有明显共同语法位置或语义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、法律文本、评论、对话等混合文体

en.concept: Substrings in Bloomberg domains and scattered spellings
en.description: Primarily activates on “oom” in the “Bloomberg” domain in HackerNews links. Other examples include up in crop up, ob in The Blob, and scattered substrings in reference-list names.

patterns.name: Bloomberg link domains
patterns.context: When a news headline is followed by a Bloomberg news link, “oom” in the domain activates most strongly; topics vary across multiple headlines, but the trigger location is consistent.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb crop up
patterns.context: In the phrase “crop up again,” meaning that something appears again, especially “up” activates strongly.

patterns.name: The word Blob
patterns.context: The proper name or metaphorical spelling “The Blob” occurs in a hypothetical sentence about Google advertising; there are too few examples to determine the condition.

patterns.name: Substrings in names
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside names or usernames in reference-style lists; trigger fragments vary and may simply be sporadic spelling matches.

3_2327.concept: Bloomberg 域名子串及零散拼写
3_2327.description: 主要对 HackerNews Bloomberg 链接域名中 “Bloomberg” 的 “oom” 激活；另有 crop up 的 up、The Blob 中的 ob，以及参考文献姓名中的若干零散子串。

patterns.name: Bloomberg 链接域名
patterns.context: 新闻标题后接 Bloomberg 新闻链接时，域名中的 “oom” 激活最强；多个标题主题各异，触发点一致。

patterns.name: 短语动词 crop up
patterns.context: 表示某事物再次出现的短语 “crop up again” 中，尤其是 “up” 强激活。

patterns.name: Blob 字样
patterns.context: Google 广告的假设句中出现专名或比喻性写法 “The Blob”；缺少更多例子判断条件。

patterns.name: 姓名中的子串
patterns.context: 参考文献式列表中的姓名或用户名内部片段；触发片段各异，可能只是零散的拼写匹配。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on scattered intraword subwords: broom, Blob, personal names, German words, and howl. Function words, common words, and word-final fragments also occur across diverse texts, without a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in “broom”
patterns.context: Activations fall on an intraword fragment of broom; one occurrence is “broom clean,” describing a cleaning standard in a lease, and another is the plant disease name “witches' broom.”

patterns.name: Intraword fragments containing blob
patterns.context: In a discussion of advertising, traffic, and business impact, Blob in the phrase “The Blob” is split across multiple tokens; activations concentrate on intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in tokenized proper names
patterns.context: Hebrew names, titles, and place names are split into multiple subwords, with several fragments activating; there is no apparent shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Local fragments in German word forms
patterns.context: In German political argumentation, intraword subword fragments in several words activate; the passage concerns a dual system and actions Europe should take.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in howl
patterns.context: Occurs in the punning spelling “Howl-oween” in a canine activity announcement; a single example cannot establish a broader condition.

patterns.name: English inflectional or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on intraword or phrase fragments of common English words, in a forum verb phrase, an evaluative expression in an email, and a plural noun in a paper.
patterns.domain: Online forums, business email, academic papers

patterns.name: Scattered function words and word fragments
patterns.context: These activations occur in different syntactic positions and semantic categories, with no stable pattern explained by the same specific contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, political speeches, event announcements, business email

3_2327.concept: 词内子词片段（弱而分散）
3_2327.description: 强激活集中于零散词内子词：broom、Blob及人名、德语词、howl等；另有功能词、普通词和词尾片段散见多领域文本，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: “broom”词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 broom 的词内片段；一处是租约中表示清洁标准的“broom clean”，一处是植物病害名“witches' broom”。
patterns.domain: 法律文本；植物学/生物医学

patterns.name: 含 blob 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «<»、«The»、«Bl»、«ob»（[4]“If Google contextual ads weren't like The Blob”）
patterns.context: 讨论广告、流量与商业影响时，短语“The Blob”中的 Blob 被分成多个 token；激活集中在词内片段。

patterns.name: 分词形成的专名片段
patterns.context: 希伯来人名、头衔及地名被切分为多个子词，若干片段激活；没有明显的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语词形中的局部片段
patterns.context: 德语政治论述中，多个词的词内子词片段均有激活，句意涉及双重体系及欧洲应采取的行动。

patterns.name: howl 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在犬类活动通知中的“Howl-oween”双关拼写里；无法从单例确定更广泛条件。

patterns.name: 英语屈折或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在常见英语词或短语的词内/短语片段，分别处于论坛中的动词短语、邮件中的评价表达、论文中的复数名词。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、商务邮件、学术论文

patterns.name: 零散功能词与词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同句法位置和语义类别中，未显示可由同一具体上下文条件解释的稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、政治发言、活动通知、商务邮件

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword fragments in multiple languages, common short English words, and a few complete phrases. The fragments occur in lyrics, proper names, academic terminology, and ordinary narration, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Specific intraword character sequences
patterns.context: Activations fall on contiguous character sequences inside words, often crossing subword or morphological boundaries; the fragments do not always align with lexical boundaries.
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural language, proper names, and technical terminology

patterns.name: Short function words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences or passages, activations are scattered across pronouns, prepositions, conjunctions, and partial character sequences in common words; there is no stable syntactic position or semantic role.
patterns.domain: English conversation, emails, Q&A, and papers

patterns.name: Exclamations with strong tone
patterns.context: The exclamation has a direct address or admonishing tone; this pattern occurs alongside weaker activations on common words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Verb form in a literary quotation
patterns.context: In a poetry or lyric quotation, wind is the subject and the verb appears in the third-person singular form.

patterns.name: Evaluative phrase in narration
patterns.context: An email relays someone else’s assessment of a meeting’s outcome, with «well» and «very» used together.

patterns.name: Name character fragments in medical literature
patterns.context: Activations fall on contiguous fragments within author names cited in a systematic review.

patterns.name: Fragments in names of Jewish religious figures
patterns.context: Personal and rabbinic names occur in biographical accounts of religious figures, with activations inside the names.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Activations fall inside surnames in lists of lawyers or information about party representation.

3_2327.description: 激活分散于多语种词内片段、英文常见短词及少量完整短语；片段涉及歌词、专名、学术术语和普通叙述，未见一致语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内特定字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的连续字符片段上，常跨越子词或形态边界；片段并不总与词义边界重合。
patterns.domain: 多语种自然语言、专名及技术术语

patterns.name: 短功能词及词内片段
patterns.context: 普通英文句子或段落中，激活分散在代词、介词、连词及常见词的部分字符上；没有稳定的句法位置或语义角色。
patterns.domain: 英语对话、邮件、问答及论文

patterns.name: 强烈语气的感叹句
patterns.context: 感叹句中带有直接呼告或训诫语气；此模式与同段较弱的常见词激活并列。

patterns.name: 文学引文中的动词词形
patterns.context: 诗歌或歌词引文中，风作为主语、动词以第三人称单数形式出现。

patterns.name: 叙述中的评价性短语
patterns.context: 邮件转述他人对会议结果的评价，«well» 与 «very» 连用。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的姓名字符片段
patterns.context: 系统综述引用作者姓名时，激活分布在姓名内部的连续片段。

patterns.name: 犹太宗教人物姓名片段
patterns.context: 人物及拉比姓名出现在宗教人物传记叙述中，激活位于姓名内部。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 律师名单或当事人代理信息中，激活落在姓氏内部。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on intraword substrings in multilingual words, personal names, and email addresses/URLs; a few occur in English function words or narrative words. Examples span multiple languages, proper names, and string fragments, with no reliable unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within multilingual words
patterns.context: Activations fall inside natural-language words, often in morphologically complex words, endings, or stem-affix boundaries; no stable lexical or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: German, French, Danish, and other EuroParl parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Fragments inside personal and proper names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur inside personal names, titles, or institutional/product names; there is no consistent name type or language condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic metadata, parliamentary records, emails, and web headlines

patterns.name: Fragments in email addresses and URLs
patterns.context: Activations occur in email addresses and URL domains or paths, especially within strings separated by punctuation; their relationship to natural-language semantics is unclear.
patterns.domain: Email headers, web links, and technical/business websites

patterns.name: Function words or phrase fragments in general English sentences
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common words in English dialogue or narration. The surrounding text respectively concerns a conversation/exclamation after replacing a student card and a discussion of web traffic and paid alternatives; no unified grammatical condition emerges.

patterns.name: Split word forms and proper name Bloom
patterns.context: Capitalization variants of the same word form occur in headlines, URLs, and email display names; other activations fall on subword fragments in unrelated words, so a word-specific response cannot be established.
patterns.domain: HackerNews headlines/links and Enron email headers

3_2327.concept: 词内子串与字符串片段
3_2327.description: 激活多落在多语词语、人名及邮箱/网址中的词内子串；少数出现在英文功能词或叙述词。跨语种、专名和字符串片段均有例子，未见可靠的统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语言词中间的子词片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被标记的子串，如德语 «rit»、«gewähr«le»»、«Kontrol«le»；法语 «cad»、«form»；丹麦语 «prot«ok»ollen»
patterns.context: 激活落在自然语言词的内部，常处于形态复杂的词、词尾或词干与词缀边界；未见稳定的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 德语、法语、丹麦语等 EuroParl 议会发言

patterns.name: 人名与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在人名、称谓或机构/产品专名内部；没有一致的名称类型或语言条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术元数据、议会记录、邮件及网页标题

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与网址中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在电子邮件地址、URL 的域名或路径中，尤其是由标点分隔的字符串内部；与自然语言语义关系不明显。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、网页链接和技术/商业网页

patterns.name: 一般英文句子中的功能词或短语片段
patterns.context: 少量激活落在英文对话或叙述中的常见词，周围分别是补办学生卡后的对话/感叹，以及网页流量与付费替代方案的讨论；未形成统一语法条件。
patterns.domain: 网页语料中的口语/叙述文本

patterns.name: 拆分后的大小写词形与专名 Bloom
patterns.context: 同一词形的大小写变体出现在标题、URL 和邮件显示名中；另有多处激活落在其他词内的子词片段，故不能确定是词义特异性响应。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题/链接及 Enron 邮件头

en.description: Activations are distributed across intraword substrings in multiple languages. The clearest repetition is Bloom/Bloomberg and related spelling fragments; the rest involve English, German, Danish, and Swedish word forms, with no unified semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Bloom names or strings
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of Bloom/Bloomberg spellings, with varying capitalization and subword segmentation; these may be proper names or strings in URLs.
patterns.domain: Personal names, company names, blog titles, or URLs; spans [1][2][3]

patterns.name: Letter sequences at word endings or within words
patterns.context: Activations occur on local subwords in several different English words, with no consistent lexical meaning or syntactic condition; most are word-final or contiguous intraword character sequences.
patterns.domain: Author metadata, encyclopedia text, and forum comments

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in German
patterns.context: Activations fall inside inflected, compound, or derived German words; they do not cluster around a single root or semantic category.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Danish
patterns.context: Occurs inside Danish word forms, especially words split into multiple fragments; no clear unified semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Internal fragments of multiple words are marked in the same Swedish passage, including inflected forms and common letter sequences.

3_2327.description: 激活分布在多语种词内子串上；最明显的重复是 Bloom/Bloomberg 及相关拼写片段，其余涉及英语、德语、丹麦语、瑞典语词形，未见统一语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: Bloom 姓名或字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Bloom/Bloomberg 拼写的内部片段，大小写和子词切分不一；可能是专名，也可能是网址中的字符串。
patterns.domain: 人名、公司名、博客标题或 URL；覆盖 [1][2][3]

patterns.name: 词尾或词内的字母组合
patterns.context: 在若干不同英语词的局部子词上激活，词义和句法条件不统一；多为词尾或词内连续字母片段。
patterns.domain: 作者元数据、百科正文及论坛评论

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «griff»（ergriffen）、«le»（gewährleisten）及其他被标记的德语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语屈折词或复合/派生词的内部；并不集中于单一词根或语义类别。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段
patterns.context: 在丹麦语词形内部出现，尤其是含有多个被切分片段的词；未见明确统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 同一段瑞典语中多个词的内部片段被标记，包含词形变化和常见字母序列。

en.description: Strong activation is distributed across sentences related to creating, proper-name subwords, fixed wording in license disclaimers, and several sporadic words; some passages contain repetition or local subword fragments, but overall there is no consistent semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: creating and following subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is strong when creating appears; contexts mention creating a client, AWS resources, file links, game plans, or derivative works. The commonality across contexts seems to be creating and the sequence of words that follows, not always the same type of object.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, web text, software licenses

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or biological names; there is no evident shared syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Appears in fixed wording in liability disclaimers; the two passages are nearly identical.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Appears in disclaimers and descriptions of finding files or game resources; apart from their respective local contexts, it is difficult to identify a shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Licenses, technical support, and game descriptions

3_2342.description: 强激活分散在 creating 相关句子、专名子词、许可证免责声明固定措辞及若干零散词上；部分段落存在重复或局部词片段，但整体缺少统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: creating 及其后续词片段
patterns.trigger: « creating»9/10；以及« the»、« effective»等相邻标记
patterns.context: 出现 creating 时激活很强；语境分别提到创建客户端、AWS 资源、文件链接、游戏规划或衍生作品。不同上下文中的共同点似乎是 creating 及其后续词序列，而不总是同一种对象。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、网页文本、软件许可

patterns.name: 专名内部的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或生物学名称内部的子词片段；没有明显共同句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在责任限制免责声明的固定措辞中；两段内容近乎重复。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在免责声明和查找文件、游戏资源说明中；除各自的局部上下文外，难以确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 许可证、技术支持与游戏说明

en.description: The activation pattern is diffuse: subword fragments within words across multiple domains and creating; also Python’s import math and all-caps legal wording in license disclaimers. There is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: creating and subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Specific fragments activate when a word or subword is split into multiple tokens; some contexts contain “creating,” but it is not required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: programming discussions, Wikipedia, research text, and ordinary web content

patterns.name: Python import math
patterns.context: Activation follows the module name math in an import statement in Python scripts.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: All-caps wording of liability limitation clauses and nearby text in software license disclaimers.

3_2342.description: 激活模式较分散：跨多领域的词内子词片段与 creating；另见 Python 的 import math，以及许可证免责声明中的全大写法律措辞。缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: creating 及词内片段
patterns.context: 词或子词被拆分成多个 token 时，特定片段出现激活；部分上下文含有“creating”，但并非必要条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：编程讨论、维基百科、科研文本及普通网页内容

patterns.name: Python 导入 math
patterns.context: Python 脚本中 import 语句的模块名 math 后出现激活。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的固定措辞
patterns.context: 软件许可证免责声明中，责任限制条款的全大写措辞及其附近文本。

en.description: The strongest activations fall on the neurotransmitter stem in neuroscience text, mkdir in code, creating, Slip in Slip Op., and options in a trading context; apart from the same stem or code command, no unified semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Neurotransmitter stem
patterns.context: The word is tokenized within the line; appears in discussions of receptors, neurotransmitters, neuromodulation, or neuronal phenotypes.

patterns.name: mkdir command in code
patterns.context: The command creates a directory; one instance is a shell command string, another a Python path object method.

patterns.name: creating word form
patterns.context: Appears in “tried creating a node http client,” meaning an attempt to create a client.

patterns.name: Slip in the string Slip
patterns.context: Appears in “Slip Op.” near legal case headers or page numbers, denoting a slip opinion.

patterns.name: options word form
patterns.context: Listed alongside forwards and swaps as trading instruments.
patterns.domain: Energy and metals market business descriptions

3_2342.description: 最强激活分别落在神经科学文本中的 neurotransmitter 词干、代码中的 mkdir，以及 creating、Slip Op. 的 Slip、交易语境中的 options；除同一词干或代码命令外，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 神经递质词干
patterns.context: 该词在行内被分词标记；谈及受体、递质、神经调节或神经元表型时出现。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 代码中的 mkdir 命令
patterns.context: 命令用于创建目录；一处为 shell 命令字符串，一处为 Python 路径对象方法。

patterns.name: creating 词形
patterns.context: 出现在“tried creating a node http client”中，表示尝试创建客户端。

patterns.name: Slip 字符串中的 Slip
patterns.context: 出现在法律案卷页眉或页码附近的“Slip Op.”中，标记 slip opinion。

patterns.name: options 词形
patterns.context: 列举交易工具时，与 forwards、swaps 并列。
patterns.domain: 能源与金属市场业务描述

en.description: Mainly responds to the token Do in different capitalization forms (including Doing), often in questions or action expressions; isolated triggers also include fully, neurotransmitters, and branching, which are unrelated to one another.

patterns.name: Do/Doing token
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning or within a sentence, often introducing a question, suggestion, or action description, such as “Do you think,” “Do you know,” “Do we have,” and “Doing both.”

patterns.name: fully
patterns.context: Describes something that has been thoroughly or completely integrated.

patterns.name: neurotransmitters
patterns.context: Mentions neurotransmitters in a neuroscience context; this substring is marked in two research passages.

patterns.name: branching fractions
patterns.context: Describes branching fractions in particle decay.

patterns.name: creating
patterns.context: Mentions an attempt to create a type of client.

3_2342.description: 主要反应于大小写形式的 Do（包括 Doing）这一词元，多见于提问或动作表达；另有 fully、neurotransmitters、branching 等彼此不同的孤立词项触发。

patterns.name: Do/Doing 词元
patterns.context: 出现在句首或句中，常引出询问、建议或动作描述，如“Do you think”“Do you know”“Do we have”“Doing both”。

patterns.name: fully
patterns.context: 形容某物已经充分或完整地集成。

patterns.name: neurotransmitters
patterns.context: 神经科学语境中提及神经递质；该子串在两个科研片段中均被标记。

patterns.name: branching fractions
patterns.context: 描述粒子衰变的分支比。

patterns.name: creating
patterns.context: 谈及尝试创建某种客户端。

en.concept: Multiple local word forms and phrase triggers
en.description: Activations include the past three years, B-decay notation, research objectives and physiological mechanisms, collective behavior in complex systems, and strings beginning with Sl- in various contexts; the Sl- pattern spans domains and takes diverse forms.

patterns.name: Past-time phrase
patterns.context: After “During,” refers to the previous three years of work by a researcher or applicant; activation falls on words such as the, past, and three.

patterns.name: B-decay notation
patterns.context: In symbolic notation for particle-physics decay processes, activation is distributed around B, the arrow, and the decay products.

patterns.name: Research objectives and physiological mechanisms
patterns.context: States a long-term research objective and describes the physiological mechanisms to be understood or identified; also includes the split term catecholaminergic neurotransmitters.

patterns.name: Collective behavior in complex systems
patterns.context: Discusses how individual units in complex systems form overall dynamics, or how collective behavior can be decomposed into individual components.

patterns.name: Strings beginning with Sl-
patterns.context: Sl strings at the beginning of a word or fragment may be followed by ash, id, av, ide, and so on; they also appear in proper names, imperative short phrases, and before technical terms.
patterns.domain: Web text, encyclopedia entries, scientific text; varied styles

3_2342.concept: 多种局部词形与短语触发
3_2342.description: 激活包括过去三年、B 衰变记号、研究目标与生理机制、复杂系统的集体行为，以及多种语境中词首 Sl- 字符串；Sl- 模式跨领域且形式多样。

patterns.name: 过去时间短语
patterns.context: “During”之后，表示研究或申请人过去三年的工作；激活落在 the、past、three 等词上。

patterns.name: B 衰变记号
patterns.context: 粒子物理衰变过程的符号记法中，激活分布于 B、箭头及衰变产物附近。

patterns.name: 研究目标与生理机制
patterns.context: 陈述长期研究目标，并说明拟了解或确定的生理机制；另有被拆开的 catecholaminergic neurotransmitters 术语。

patterns.name: 复杂系统集体行为
patterns.context: 讨论复杂系统中个体单元如何形成整体动力学，或将集体行为拆解为个体成分。

patterns.name: Sl- 起始字符串
patterns.context: 词首或片段开头的 Sl 字符串，后续可接 ash、id、av、ide 等；也出现在专名、命令式短句及技术术语前。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、百科条目、科学文本；文体不一

en.concept: Mixed word strings and code markers
en.description: Activation spans several unrelated local patterns: LIN strings, specific proper-name fragments, Great fragments, and SQL query terms; they cannot be grouped into a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: LIN strings and related continuations
patterns.context: The letter string LIN appears in identifiers or ordinary words; sometimes following letters are also marked, and activation often falls on the LIN substring after tokenization.
patterns.domain: Code, technical text, ordinary English, and titles

patterns.name: Old Engine Company in a proper name
patterns.context: Forms part of the name “Old Engine Company No. 6” and activates again when the name recurs.

patterns.name: In-word fragment of Great
patterns.context: Appears in the date comparison identifier “DateGreaterThan” and in the conversational reply “Great, thanks”; the two instances differ in meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Code identifier; dialogue example in a patent background

patterns.name: SQL query structure
patterns.context: Appears in fields, subqueries, and grouping and ordering structures in query statements.

3_2342.concept: 混合的词串与代码标记
3_2342.description: 激活覆盖多种不相同的局部模式：LIN 字符串、特定专名片段、Great 片段及 SQL 查询词；无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: LIN 字符串及相关补全
patterns.context: 字母串 LIN 出现在标识符或普通词中；有时后续字母也被标记，激活位置常落在分词后的 LIN 子串。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术文本、普通英语及标题

patterns.name: 专名中的 Old Engine Company
patterns.context: 构成名称“Old Engine Company No. 6”，且在名称重复出现时再次激活。

patterns.name: Great 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在日期比较标识符“DateGreaterThan”中，也出现在对话回复“Great, thanks”中；两处语义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 代码标识符；专利背景中的对话示例

patterns.name: SQL 查询结构
patterns.context: 出现在查询语句的字段、子查询及分组排序结构中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 SQL 代码

en.concept: Mixed features of structural boundaries and common phrases
en.description: Activation is distributed across line breaks or structural boundaries, Do you questions, SharePoint/Share, and lot(s) local patterns; common words also activate sporadically. The fifth passage consists mainly of code comments and a copyright line, which are difficult to relate to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Line beginnings or paragraph separators
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near line breaks, paragraphs, or boundaries in structured text; in several passages it is also adjacent to markers at the beginning of a line or following words.
patterns.domain: Q&A, reports, emails, code, and academic text

patterns.name: Do you in questions
patterns.context: Questions begin with Do you and continue with an inquiry or request; it also appears at the end of technical discussions.

patterns.name: SharePoint-related word forms
patterns.context: The name SharePoint is split into share and point, or Share appears on its own; the contexts are not necessarily semantically identical.

patterns.name: Words related to lot / lots
patterns.context: lot(s) refers to a quantity or a specific lot in securities trading; the meanings differ somewhat across passages.

patterns.name: Local activation of common words at sentence beginnings
patterns.context: Sporadic activation on common words at sentence beginnings or within sentences, with no stable shared semantic condition.

3_2342.concept: 结构边界与常见短语的混合特征
3_2342.description: 激活分散在换行或结构边界、Do you 疑问句、SharePoint/Share、lot(s) 等局部模式；另有常见词零星激活。第5段主要是代码注释与版权行，难与其他模式对应。

patterns.name: 行首或段落分隔符
patterns.context: 激活集中在换行、段落或结构化文本的边界附近；在若干段里还与行首的标记或后续词相邻。
patterns.domain: 问答、报告、邮件、代码与论文文本

patterns.name: 问答中的 Do you
patterns.context: 疑问句中以 Do you 起句，后接询问或请求；也出现在技术讨论结尾。

patterns.name: SharePoint 相关词形
patterns.context: SharePoint 名称被拆成 share 与 point，或单独出现 Share；未必都在相同语义语境。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、报告标题

patterns.name: lot / lots 相关词
patterns.context: lot(s) 表示数量或证券交易中的特定批次；各段语义不完全相同。

patterns.name: 句首常见词的局部激活
patterns.context: 在句首或句间常见词上零星激活，缺少稳定的共同语义条件。

en.concept: Follow-up expressions with outlier word forms
en.description: Most activations concentrate on follow/follow-up expressions for follow-up care in medical literature, especially descriptions of follow-up duration, appointments, and studies; there are also two outlier patterns: apostrophe contractions in HackerNews and the patent term Power line communications.

patterns.name: Follow-up expressions
patterns.context: In medical studies, describes follow-up after treatment, examination, or patient care, often near durations, appointments, study design, or loss to follow-up; includes variants such as “Long term follow up,” “follow-up appointment,” and “followed-up as scheduled.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and clinical studies

patterns.name: follow within the hyphenated follow-up term
patterns.context: Hyphenated follow-up expressions appearing in contexts about study follow-up duration or follow-up appointments.

patterns.name: Apostrophe suffixes in English contractions
patterns.context: An apostrophe and the following s or m are marked in informal online text; they appear in “it’s,” “I’m,” and “there’s,” respectively, outside medical follow-up contexts.

patterns.name: Power line compound term
patterns.context: Power and line are strongly activated separately in the technical term “Power line communications (PLC)”; this does not match the other medical follow-up examples.

3_2342.concept: 随访表达，兼有离群词形
3_2342.description: 多数激活集中于医学文献中的 follow/follow-up 随访表达，尤其描述随访时长、预约及研究；另有 HackerNews 中撇号缩写，以及专利术语 Power line communications 两种离群模式。

patterns.name: 随访（follow-up）表达
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述治疗、检查或患者之后的随访，常与时长、预约、研究设计或失访情况相邻；包括“Long term follow up”“follow-up appointment”“followed-up as scheduled”等变体。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、摘要及临床研究

patterns.name: 缩写词 follow-up 中的 follow
patterns.context: 连字符形式的随访用语，出现在研究随访时长或随访预约语境中。

patterns.name: 英语缩写中的撇号后缀
patterns.context: 撇号及其后的 s 或 m 在口语化网络文本中被标记；分别出现在“it’s”“I’m”“there’s”中，并非医学随访语境。

patterns.name: 电力线复合词
patterns.context: “Power line communications (PLC)”这一技术术语中，Power 与 line 分别强激活；与其余医学随访例子不相符。

en.description: Activation is distributed across fragments of Knowledge, Power, and various proper names, brands, and code identifiers; it also occurs on Put and Wallet in titles and on possessive apostrophes. There is no stable, unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Knowledge subword fragment
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment Know- is followed by Knowledge; one instance is the phrase Knowledge Base, another is followed by of
patterns.domain: Knowledge-base documentation, popular science, or technical text

patterns.name: Power-related phrases
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving electricity, communications, company names, or system names; sometimes occurs at the beginning of a title or phrase

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names or brands
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments in proper names, product names, or word-initial subwords, with varying meanings and contexts
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedias, news headlines, technology news

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in source code
patterns.context: Located in text resembling C/C++ source filenames or paths, followed by underscore-separated fragments

patterns.name: Punctuation in possessive contractions
patterns.context: An apostrophe appears in an English contraction or possessive form; activation covers the punctuation and adjacent word fragments

patterns.name: Investment-related fragment in a company name
patterns.context: Part of the company name Power Generation Investco, L.L.

patterns.name: Put and its suffix in a headline
patterns.context: Appears in the news headline Obama Put(s) Pressure on GOP

patterns.name: Payment service name fragment
patterns.context: Forms part of the Google Wallet brand name; the following text mentions transferring money by text message

3_2342.description: 激活分散在 Knowledge、Power 及多种专名、品牌和代码标识符片段上，也见于标题中的 Put、Wallet 与所有格撇号；没有稳定统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: Knowledge 子词片段
patterns.context: 词首片段 Know- 后续组成 Knowledge；一次为短语 Knowledge Base，另一次接 of
patterns.domain: 知识库说明、科普或技术文本

patterns.name: Power 相关词组
patterns.context: 出现在电力、通信、公司名或系统名称中；有时处于标题或词组开头
patterns.domain: 百科、专利背景、商务邮件

patterns.name: 专名或品牌片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、产品名或词首子词上，具体语义和上下文各异
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、新闻标题、科技新闻

patterns.name: 源代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 位于类 C/C++ 源文件名或路径样式的文本中，后接下划线分隔的片段

patterns.name: 所有格缩写中的标点
patterns.context: 撇号位于英文缩写或所有格形式中，激活覆盖标点及相邻词片段
patterns.domain: 标题或新闻式英文文本

patterns.name: 公司名中的投资相关片段
patterns.context: 作为 Power Generation Investco, L.L. 公司名的一部分

patterns.name: 标题中的 Put 及其后缀
patterns.context: 位于 Obama Put(s) Pressure on GOP 的新闻标题中

patterns.name: 支付服务名称片段
patterns.context: 构成 Google Wallet 品牌名，后文提及通过短信转账

en.concept: English word-initial fragments and Here’s contraction
en.description: Activation is concentrated on several English word-initial fragments (Wal, Know, Extra, Power), with two additional instances on the apostrophe and s in “Here’s,” which introduces an example or link. Apart from word-initial position, no unified semantic or domain condition is evident.

patterns.name: Word-initial Wal- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation appears at the beginning of English words or proper names; the fragment may continue directly into the rest of the word or appear at the start of a line and recur after a line break.

patterns.name: Knowledge word beginning
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a line or phrase, followed by Knowledge; no fixed subsequent context is required.

patterns.name: Extra- prefix
patterns.context: A word-initial prefix in compound medical terms, followed by a hyphen and descriptive words.

patterns.name: Here’s phrase
patterns.context: Introduces an example, gallery, or link within a sentence; activation falls on the apostrophe and s in the contraction, not on Here.

patterns.name: Power word beginning
patterns.context: At the beginning of a patent sentence, forming the technical term “Power line.”

3_2342.concept: 英文词首片段及 Here’s 缩写
3_2342.description: 激活集中在若干英文词首片段（Wal、Know、Extra、Power），另有两例在引出示例或链接的“Here’s”中落于撇号和 s。除词首位置外，未见统一语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: 词首 Wal- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英文单词或专名的开头；片段后可直接接续词尾，也可位于行首并在换行后重复出现。

patterns.name: Knowledge 词首
patterns.context: 出现在行首或短语开头，后接 Knowledge；不要求固定后续语境。
patterns.domain: 网页内容、医学科研文本

patterns.name: Extra- 前缀
patterns.context: 作为复合医学术语的词首前缀，后接连字符及描述性词语。

patterns.name: Here’s 短语
patterns.context: 在句中引出示例、画廊或链接；激活落在缩写中的撇号及 s，而非 Here。
patterns.domain: 非正式网页评论、技术博客

patterns.name: Power 词首
patterns.context: 位于专利句子开头，构成技术术语“Power line”。

en.description: Activations occur relatively often on proper names beginning with Wal-, the introductory phrase Here’s, and several inconsistent word-internal fragments; there are also tildes, negative contractions, and draft-prediction terms. Overall, there is no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Wal-initial strings
patterns.context: Proper names or entry titles beginning with Wal-; activation is concentrated on Wal, with weaker subsequent tokens.

patterns.name: Here’s introductions
patterns.context: Here’s introduces resources, previews, or descriptions, such as gallery or early NHL mock draft; activation marks ’s.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: In medical titles, cultural text, or headings, activation falls on whole words or word-internal subword fragments, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: ~~~ marker
patterns.context: A sequence of tildes in code- or Markdown-style text, with a username and version-update notes nearby.

patterns.name: Past negative contraction
patterns.context: In a negative past-perfect form, activation is concentrated on a word-internal fragment; the following text shifts to commentary on game features.

patterns.name: Lottery-related terms
patterns.context: After the draft order is known, discussion turns to predicting which players each team will pick.

3_2342.description: 激活较集中地出现在 Wal- 专名、Here’s 引导语，以及若干彼此不一致的词内片段；另有波浪号、否定缩写和选秀预测词。整体没有统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Wal 起始字串
patterns.context: 以 Wal- 开头的专名或词条标题；激活集中在 Wal，后续词元较弱。

patterns.name: here’s 引导语
patterns.context: Here’s 后接资源、预览或介绍内容，如 gallery、early NHL mock draft；激活标记落在 ’s。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 医学标题、文化文本或标题中，激活落在完整词或词内子词片段，未见一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、网页文本、标题

patterns.name: ~~~ 标记
patterns.context: 代码或 Markdown 风格文本中的波浪号序列，附近出现用户名与版本更新说明。

patterns.name: 既往否定缩写
patterns.context: 否定过去完成形式中，激活集中于词内片段；后文转入对游戏功能的评论。

patterns.name: lottery 相关词
patterns.context: 选秀顺序已知后，讨论预测各队将挑选哪些球员。

en.concept: Common function words and introductory phrases
en.description: Responds mainly to Here’s introducing subsequent content and do in questions, especially How/Where do…; there are also sporadic triggers for don’t, What, mock draft, and tildes, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Here’s introducing content
patterns.context: After introducing something, Here’s introduces an example, link, explanation, or highlight.
patterns.domain: Web comments, sports reporting, health articles

patterns.name: do introducing questions
patterns.context: do appears in questions, especially How/Where do I/you…; asks about methods, choices, or preferences.
patterns.domain: Q&A posts, forum discussions, work emails

patterns.name: Contraction and apostrophe combination
patterns.context: The apostrophe and adjacent token in the negative auxiliary don’t activate; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: Decorative tilde
patterns.context: A standalone tilde separator appears before a username; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: What in questions
patterns.context: What appears in an indirect question asking about meaning or explanation; Here’s an example is also nearby.

patterns.name: mock draft phrase
patterns.context: mock draft names a draft prediction; activation is weak and occurs in only one sample.

3_2342.description: 主要响应引出后续内容的 Here’s，以及疑问句中的 do，尤其 How/Where do…；另有零散的 don’t、What、mock draft 和波浪号触发，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: Here’s 引出内容
patterns.context: 在前文介绍某项内容后，用 Here’s 引出示例、链接、解释或亮点。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、体育报道、健康文章

patterns.name: do 引导疑问
patterns.context: 疑问句中出现 do，尤其是 How/Where do I/you…；询问操作方法、选择或偏好。
patterns.domain: 问答帖、论坛讨论、工作邮件

patterns.name: 缩写与撇号组合
patterns.context: 否定助动词 don’t 中撇号及其相邻 token 激活；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 波浪号装饰
patterns.context: 独立的波浪号分隔符出现在用户名之前；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 问句中的 What
patterns.context: What 出现在询问含义或解释的间接疑问句中；同时邻近 Here’s an example。

patterns.name: mock draft 词组
patterns.context: mock draft 用作选秀预测的名称；激活较弱且仅此一例。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on the interrogative auxiliaries do/have and the negative imperative don’t; they also occur with am inversion, interrogative words, self-reference, and Be imperatives. A few formatting symbols and word-internal fragments are also present, but do not fit a unified syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: do in questions
patterns.context: Activation falls on the auxiliary do, which often introduces or forms a question; it is followed by a subject and verb/predicate.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum discussions, math questions, and general conversation

patterns.name: Negative imperatives and suggestions
patterns.context: The negative auxiliary don’t combines with a following verb to form advice, commands, or suggestions; activation spans subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Spoken language, inspirational copy, dialogue, and blogs

patterns.name: have in perfect-tense questions
patterns.context: have activates strongly when sentence-initial or in an interrogative structure; the first two cases are present-perfect questions, while another occurs in a farewell.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, explanatory text, and email

patterns.name: Self-reference and reflexive expressions
patterns.context: Self-referential expressions containing self or myself occur, but activation does not always fall on the complete word.
patterns.domain: Forum text, inspirational copy, business emails

patterns.name: Interrogative words in questions
patterns.context: Interrogative words introduce direct questions, often in dialogue or rhetorical questions; they occur only occasionally.

patterns.name: General interrogative auxiliary am
patterns.context: am and the subject I form an inverted structure in a question.

patterns.name: Be in statements/instructions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial imperative Be is followed by an identity or self-expression.

patterns.name: Fragment boundaries and polysemous residuals
patterns.context: Formatting markers, mathematical symbols, line breaks, or word-internal fragments are marked; there is no stable syntactic or semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Scraped forum text, Q&A formatting, and symbol-heavy text

3_2342.description: 激活主要集中于疑问句助动词 do/have，以及 don’t 否定祈使；也见于 am 倒装、疑问词、自我指称和 Be 祈使。另有少量格式符号及词内片段，难归入统一句法模式。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 do
patterns.trigger: «do»10、«do»9、«do»6，或 “do i need”“do you like”“do I need”等
patterns.context: 激活落在助动词 do 上，常引出或构成疑问句；后接主语与动词/谓语。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛讨论、数学提问及一般对话

patterns.name: 否定祈使与建议
patterns.context: 否定助动词 don’t 与后续动词构成劝告、命令或提议；激活跨分词片段出现。
patterns.domain: 口语、励志文案、对话及博客

patterns.name: 完成时疑问中的 have
patterns.trigger: «have»10 you searched、«have»10 they really never、«have»10 a good week
patterns.context: have 位于句首或疑问结构中时明显激活；前两处为现在完成时疑问，另有告别语中的 have。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、说明性文字及邮件

patterns.name: 自我指称与反身表达
patterns.context: 出现 self 或 myself 的自我指称表达；但激活并不总落在完整词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛文字、励志文案、商务邮件

patterns.name: 问句中的疑问词
patterns.context: 疑问词引出直接问句，常见于对话或反问；仅少量出现。

patterns.name: 一般问句助动词 am
patterns.context: am 与主语 I 构成疑问句中的倒装结构。

patterns.name: 陈述/指令中的 Be
patterns.context: 句首祈使式 Be，后接身份或自我表达。

patterns.name: 片段边界及多义词残余
patterns.context: 格式标记、数学符号、换行或词内片段被标记；没有稳定的句法或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛抓取文本、问答排版及符号混杂文本

en.description: The most prominent pattern is conversational imperatives, requests, and questions, especially tell; there are also sporadic responses to do, remember, interrogative words, and various word fragments across forum, Q&A, health, and education texts.

patterns.name: tell as imperative or request
patterns.context: In a request, suggestion, or instruction, tell introduces what or whom to address; also includes quoted requests made of others.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, web discussions, technical advice, and customer communication

patterns.name: Auxiliary do in conversation
patterns.context: In questions or suggestions, do combines with you to form a question; there is also the phrase do a test.
patterns.domain: Forum chat, health advice, real-estate discussions

patterns.name: Reminders and remembering
patterns.context: Readers are asked to remember a fact or follow advice; Keep appears as a standalone instruction.
patterns.domain: Social media comments, educational advice, health advice

patterns.name: Questions and requests for opinions
patterns.context: Questions ask why or solicit specific information, or Many introduces a group statement; trigger words are scattered.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, forum discussions, educational explanations

patterns.name: Word-internal or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a word or phrase, with no unified syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Forums, social media, education, health, and customer communication

patterns.name: Sporadic referential and modal words
patterns.context: These words each activate in different sentences, with no shared local collocation or clear pragmatic condition.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, technical Q&A, customer communication, real-estate discussions, etc.

3_2342.description: 最显著的模式是对话式祈使、请求和提问，尤其 tell；此外零散响应 do、remember、疑问词及不同词语片段，跨论坛、问答、健康和教育文本。

patterns.name: tell 作祈使或请求
patterns.context: 在请求、建议或指示中用 tell 引出要说的内容或对象；也包括引述对他人的要求。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、网页讨论、技术建议与客户沟通

patterns.name: 对话中的 do 助动词
patterns.context: 在提问或建议中，do 与 you 构成疑问；另有 do a test 的搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛闲聊、健康建议、地产讨论

patterns.name: 提醒与记住
patterns.context: 要求读者记住事实或遵循建议；Keep 是单独出现的指示语。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体评论、教育建议、健康建议

patterns.name: 疑问与征求意见
patterns.context: 疑问句中询问原因、征求具体内容，或以 Many 引入群体陈述；触发词分布零散。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、论坛讨论、教育说明

patterns.name: 词内或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或短语的一部分，未显示统一句法功能。
patterns.domain: 论坛、社交媒体、教育、健康与客户沟通

patterns.name: 零散的指代与情态词
patterns.context: 这些词各自在不同句子中激活，缺乏共同的局部搭配或明确语用条件。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、技术问答、客户沟通、地产讨论等

en.concept: Requests and instructions directed at others
en.description: Responds mainly to instructions, requests, or suggestions directed at others, especially tell (inform, explain), and also imperative or interrogative structures such as do/don't; there are sporadic expressions of action or requests such as remember, start, help, and could, along with scattered word fragments that do not fit a unified pattern.

patterns.name: tell introducing information or explanation
patterns.context: In an imperative or request, asks the other person to inform, explain, or give feedback, often with a personal-object pronoun; may also introduce content such as “the truth”.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, technical discussions, emails, or comments

patterns.name: do / don't forming requests or suggestions
patterns.context: Auxiliary or imperative structures express suggestions, polite requests, or questions; the specific meaning varies by sentence.

patterns.name: remember introducing a reminder
patterns.context: Reminds readers to remember a following general statement.

patterns.name: start introducing an action
patterns.context: An imperative suggests beginning to speak or taking action.

patterns.name: help requesting assistance
patterns.context: Directly asks for help, combining with “Please” and “us” to form a polite request.

patterns.name: could in questions
patterns.context: Begins with could you, politely asking whether the other person can discuss something.

patterns.name: Ordinary word fragments in common phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in the different local contexts “reating”, “exaggerate”, “those things”, “Just remember”, “what to do”, “your cellForRowAtIndexPath”, “empty modal”, “load function”, and “aligning this data”; no unified semantic or syntactic trigger is evident.

3_2342.concept: 面向他人的请求与指令表达
3_2342.description: 主要响应面向他人的指令、请求或建议，尤其是 tell（告知、解释），也包括 do/don't 等祈使或疑问结构；另有 remember、start、help、could 等零散行动或请求表达，以及若干分散词片段，无法归入统一模式。

patterns.name: tell 引出告知或说明
patterns.context: 祈使句或请求中要求对方告知、解释、给出反馈，常带人称宾语；也可接“the truth”等内容。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、邮件或评论

patterns.name: do / don't 组成请求或建议
patterns.trigger: «do»，包括 «Don't do it»、«do not hesitate»、«do I still care»
patterns.context: 助动词或祈使结构中表达建议、礼貌请求，或提出疑问；具体语义随句子变化。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、评论

patterns.name: remember 引出提醒
patterns.context: 提醒读者记住后续的一般性陈述。

patterns.name: start 引出开始行动
patterns.context: 祈使句中建议开始说话或采取行动。

patterns.name: help 请求协助
patterns.context: 直接请求帮助，且与“Please”及“us”构成礼貌请求。

patterns.name: 问句中的 could
patterns.context: 以 could you 开头，礼貌询问对方是否能谈论某事。

patterns.name: 常见短语中的普通词片段
patterns.context: 分别处于“reating”“exaggerate”“those things”“Just remember”“what to do”“your cellForRowAtIndexPath”“empty modal”“load function”“aligning this data”等不同局部语境，未见统一的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、评论、一般文章

en.concept: Instructions and interactive expressions directed at readers
en.description: Activations often fall on verbs and collocations that instruct or remind readers, such as tell, remember, look, and do/don't; there are also interrogative structures, advertising calls to action, try suggestions, and right rhetorical questions, in varied contexts.

patterns.name: Asking or suggesting that someone speak up
patterns.context: Directly asks the other person in conversation to provide information, express an opinion, or inform someone; may be imperative or occur in a conditional sentence.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum dialogue, emails, and persuasive writing

patterns.name: “Remember” with an object
patterns.context: Reminds readers to remember a fact or previously mentioned situation.

patterns.name: look-related expressions
patterns.context: Asks someone to view, notice, or observe; the specific meaning depends on the collocation and context.

patterns.name: Imperative do/don't
patterns.context: Prohibits or advises against an action, or discusses something to do.

patterns.name: Auxiliaries/interrogative words in questions
patterns.context: Asks a question or expresses a conjecture, appearing sentence-initially or in interrogative structures; no clear shared collocation with other patterns.

patterns.name: Call-to-action phrases in social marketing
patterns.context: Addresses consumers with imperatives encouraging them to visit a store, shop, or follow a social account.

patterns.name: Suggestions introduced by try
patterns.context: Suggests that readers try a subsequent action; one instance asks them to check a situation, another asks someone else to take action.

patterns.name: right rhetorical question in a transaction
patterns.context: Uses a rhetorical question to introduce a correction to a profit calculation.

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的指令与互动表达
3_2342.description: 激活常落在对读者发出指令或提醒的动词及其搭配上，如 tell、remember、look、do/don't；另有疑问结构、广告号召、try 建议及 right 反问，语境分散。

patterns.name: 请求或建议对方说出来
patterns.context: 对话中直接要求对方提供信息、表达观点或告知他人；可带祈使语气，也可出现在条件句中。
