patterns.name: 博客导航语境中的强调词
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中代词 I 或 my 被标记，出现在个人经历、博客或评论语境。
patterns.domain: 博客及 Hacker News 个人评论

patterns.name: 邮件模板中的 you
patterns.context: 直接称呼读者或用户，出现在确认邮件提示或面向用户的说明中。
patterns.domain: 网页邮件文案、技术问答

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 多段文本中换行符反复被标记，尤其是问答格式、日志与分隔内容。
patterns.domain: 网页、问答、日志和评论排版

patterns.name: 非主模式：编号与版本号
patterns.context: 数字出现在软件版本号、时长或百分比等具体数值中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：格式化文本中的冒号
patterns.context: 答案标签“A:”后接换行，属于问答排版。

patterns.name: 非主模式：地点词 location
patterns.context: 设置默认位置并涉及 GPS 的说明中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：强调程度词 really
patterns.context: 求助或表达强烈希望、感受的第一人称句子中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：代码格式符号
patterns.context: 讨论代码实现与 dynamic_cast 时，括号、下划线等代码格式片段有激活。

patterns.name: 非主模式：格式化个人偏好词
patterns.context: 描述对代码格式和结构的偏好；与一般技术叙述相邻。

en.description: The highest activation in every passage falls on the first-person possessive my, followed by nouns such as personal problems, resources, work, devices, or accounts; the surrounding context is often forum help-seeking or personal-experience narration.

patterns.name: Possessive my followed by a self-related object
patterns.context: In dialogue or posts, the first-person possessive my is immediately followed by a noun or noun phrase; objects include problems, contacts, posts, columns, devices/services, wardrobes, and email addresses.
patterns.domain: Questions, help-seeking posts, and comments on StackExchange and HackerNews

patterns.name: Tense or judgment words in first-person narration
patterns.context: A predicate or related narrative follows first-person I, while strong activation on my remains the primary target; only these words activate weakly, possibly reflecting nearby context.

patterns.name: First-person experience in conversational questions
patterns.context: my occurs with first when explaining a first post or a first encounter with a situation; activation still falls on my.

3_2754.description: 各段最高激活都落在第一人称所有格 my，后接个人问题、资源、作品、设备或账户等名词；周围常是论坛求助或个人经历叙述。

patterns.name: 所有格 my 后接自我相关对象
patterns.trigger: «my»10 issue；«my»10 contact；«my»10 first post；«my»10 column；«my»10 Open；«my»9 wardrobe；«my»9 email
patterns.context: 对话或帖子中的第一人称所有格 my 后，紧接名词或名词性成分；对象涵盖问题、联系人、帖子、列、设备/服务、衣橱和邮箱地址。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 的提问、求助和评论

patterns.name: 第一人称叙述中的时态或判断词
patterns.trigger: «I»2«'m»4 only showing；«I»3 am creating；«I»2 often update；«I»3 know；«I»3 need；«I»3 would；«I»2 translate
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后的谓语或相关叙述中，my 的强激活仍是主要靶点；仅这些词的激活较弱，可能反映其邻近上下文。

patterns.name: 口语式提问中的第一人称经历
patterns.context: 在解释首次发帖或首次遇到某种情况时，my 与 first 连用；激活点仍落在 my。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the positive evaluative word nice in comments, commonly in the sentence pattern “It's nice” and its extensions, praising tools, ideas, content, experiences, or approaches; also covers adjacent technical contexts such as mobile reading, recollections of link services, and technical Q&A.

patterns.name: It’s nice evaluative sentence pattern
patterns.context: Positively evaluates a tool, idea, feature, article, or situation in a comment or reply; nice is often marked as a strong trigger, and the pattern can include really, to see, but, and other elements
patterns.domain: Mostly HackerNews comments, also blog contexts

patterns.name: nice and easier evaluative combination
patterns.context: The author describes their approach becoming easier and praises how the relevant feature works

patterns.name: AMP speed and reading experience
patterns.context: Introduces AMP’s speed and relates it to the experience of reading news on a phone; nice appears in an adjacent comment context

patterns.name: nice idea and reservations
patterns.context: First affirms an idea, then expresses regret, limitations, or further doubt with "too bad" or a question

patterns.name: API application development context
patterns.context: A Q&A title or technical question describes building and authenticating a Web application; the main nice evaluative pattern is absent

patterns.name: nice and information discovery
patterns.context: Praises a blog article with extensive references and says it helps discover sources of inspiration

patterns.name: nice describing a service’s continued availability
patterns.context: Recounts the migration or continuation of a link-bookmarking service, with nice introducing a positive evaluation of the service’s later status
patterns.domain: Personal recollections and online service comments

patterns.name: nice to see and optimization
patterns.context: Affirms that something is explicitly treated as an optimization problem

3_2754.description: 主要对评论中的正面评价词 nice 敏感，常见句式为 “It's nice”及其扩展，用于称赞工具、想法、内容、体验或处理方式；另覆盖移动阅读、链接服务回忆及技术问答等相邻技术语境。

patterns.name: It’s nice 评价句式
patterns.trigger: "It" + "'s" + " nice"，多见完整片段 "It's nice to see"、"It's nice idea" 或 "It's nice how"
patterns.context: 在评论或回复中对某个工具、想法、功能、文章或情况作正面评价；nice 常被标记为强触发词，句式可带 really、to see、but 等成分
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论为主，也见博客语境

patterns.name: nice 与 easier 的评价组合
patterns.context: 作者描述自身做法变得更容易，并称赞相关功能如何运作

patterns.name: AMP 快速与阅读体验
patterns.context: 介绍 AMP 的速度，并将其与手机阅读新闻的体验联系起来；nice 出现在相邻评论语境中
patterns.domain: 移动 Web 技术评论

patterns.name: nice idea 及其保留意见
patterns.context: 先肯定某个想法，随后以 "too bad" 或疑问句表达遗憾、限制或进一步质疑

patterns.name: API 应用开发语境
patterns.context: 以问答标题或技术问题描述 Web 应用构建与认证；未出现主要 nice 评价句式

patterns.name: nice 与信息发现
patterns.context: 称赞带有充分参考资料的博客文章，并说它有助于发现灵感来源

patterns.name: nice 描述服务持续可用
patterns.context: 回顾链接收藏服务迁移或延续，nice 引出对服务后来状况的正面评价
patterns.domain: 个人回忆及网络服务评论

patterns.name: nice to see 与优化
patterns.trigger: "It's nice to see this specifically treated as an optimization"
patterns.context: 肯定某项内容被明确作为优化问题处理

en.concept: Problem and analysis language in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of technical text: code identifiers and object types, performance optimization, statistical analysis, frontend scope, error reproduction, and whether security measures are wise; no single clear trigger word spans all passages.

patterns.name: Identifiers, member access, and assignment in code
patterns.context: Appears in VBA code lines, especially around object/range member access, assignment, and line breaks; activations concentrate on code syntax fragments and do not establish dedicated semantics for a single identifier.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; Excel/VBA programming Q&A and code

patterns.name: Performance optimization in programming questions
patterns.context: Discusses runtime performance of algorithms, data structures, or collections, often co-occurring with technical terms such as C++, OpenMPI, set intersection, and hashCode.

patterns.name: Types, objects, and generic collections
patterns.context: Discusses whether an object belongs to a type, type constraints on method parameters, or collection elements and type instances in questions or sample code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; object-oriented programming and Web development

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and relationships among multiple factors
patterns.context: Research abstracts report organizational data analysis results involving regression, correlation coefficients, and the contributions of multiple factors to change.

patterns.name: Frontend directives, variables, and scope access
patterns.context: Angular-style directive code and template explanations discuss whether variables defined in a controller can be accessed from a view.

patterns.name: Difficulty reproducing errors
patterns.context: A response explains that an error or problem is difficult to reproduce; activation falls on the phrase describing reproduction difficulty.

patterns.name: Security measures and whether they are wise
patterns.context: A Hacker News discussion asks whether a form is motivated by security considerations and whether a company’s approach is wise.

3_2754.concept: 技术文本中的问题与分析表述
3_2754.description: 激活分布在多类技术文本中：代码标识符与对象类型、性能优化、统计分析、前端作用域、错误复现，以及安全措施是否明智；没有贯穿所有段落的明确单一触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符、成员访问与赋值
patterns.context: 出现在 VBA 代码行中，尤其是对象/范围的成员访问、赋值及换行附近；激活集中于代码语法片段，不足以确定单个标识符的专属语义。

patterns.name: 编程问题中的性能优化
patterns.context: 讨论算法、数据结构或集合的运行性能，常与 C++、OpenMPI、set intersection、hashCode 等技术词共现。

patterns.name: 类型、对象与泛型集合
patterns.context: 在提问或示例代码中讨论对象是否属于某类型、方法参数的类型约束，或集合元素及类型实例。
patterns.domain: StackExchange；面向对象编程与 Web 开发

patterns.name: 统计分析与多因素关系
patterns.trigger: «multiple linear regression analysis»、«correlation coefficients»、«independent factors contribute»
patterns.context: 研究摘要中陈述组织数据分析结果，涉及回归、相关系数及多个因素对变化的贡献。

patterns.name: 前端指令、变量与作用域访问
patterns.context: Angular 风格的指令代码与模板说明，讨论控制器中定义的变量能否从视图访问。

patterns.name: 错误复现困难
patterns.context: 回答中解释某错误或问题难以复现；激活落在描述复现难度的短语。

patterns.name: 安全措施与是否明智
patterns.context: Hacker News 讨论表单是否出于安全考虑，以及对公司做法是否明智的疑问。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code punctuation and comments, Chinese software copy, technical Q&A phrasing, and words in medical discussions; no common trigger condition consistently covers all passages. Although the medical passages include terms such as evidence and long-term outcomes, they are difficult to unify with the code and Q&A patterns.

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundary symbols in code
patterns.context: Appears in code or code snippets, especially at separators in statements, expressions, and member access; the specific activated symbols vary across passages.

patterns.name: Apostrophe in example-introducing phrases
patterns.context: Appears in English explanatory text in expressions such as “here's an example” that introduce an example.

patterns.name: Evidence statements in English medical papers
patterns.context: Statements connecting research results, evidence, and long-term effects in medical-paper abstracts or main text; activations fall on multiple function and content words in the discussion.

patterns.name: Relationship and class-hierarchy terms in Chinese interface copy
patterns.context: Chinese software documentation or web navigation describes file-extension associations, category indexes, or class inheritance.

patterns.name: Clear action in English code comments
patterns.context: A comment describes clearing MIME attachments for the current request.

patterns.name: Chinese input prompt in a code string
patterns.context: A Chinese prompt in an Objective-C format string describes the passed-in content.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and verification language
patterns.context: The questioner expresses doubt about whether UUID-generation code is correct and whether uniqueness can be verified.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in English technical documentation
patterns.context: A common definite article is marked at a particular sentence position in a technical explanation; it occurs in only one passage, making it difficult to identify an independent semantic condition.

3_2754.description: 激活分散在代码标点与注释、中文软件文案、技术问答措辞及医学论述词语中；没有稳定覆盖所有片段的共同触发条件。医学片段虽有证据与长期结果等词，但与代码和问答模式难以统一。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与边界符号
patterns.context: 出现在代码或代码片段中，尤其是语句、表达式和成员访问的分隔位置；不同片段激活的具体符号不完全相同。

patterns.name: 示例引出语中的撇号
patterns.context: 英文说明文字中，出现在“here's an example”一类引出示例的表达里。

patterns.name: 英文医学论文中的证据表述
patterns.context: 医学论文摘要或正文中，连接研究结果、证据与长期影响的陈述；激活落在论述中的多个功能词和内容词上。

patterns.name: 中文界面文案中的关联与类层级术语
patterns.context: 中文软件文档或网页导航中，描述文件扩展名关联、类别索引或类继承关系。
patterns.domain: Github 软件文档/界面文本

patterns.name: 英文代码注释中的清除动作
patterns.context: 注释说明对当前请求的 MIME 附件执行清除操作。

patterns.name: 代码字符串中的中文输入提示
patterns.context: Objective-C 格式化字符串中，中文提示说明传入内容。

patterns.name: 不确定语气与验证表述
patterns.context: 提问者表达对 UUID 生成代码是否正确、是否能验证唯一性的疑虑。

patterns.name: 英文技术文档中的强调词
patterns.context: 技术解释中，普通定冠词在句子特定位置被标记；仅见于一段，难以确定独立语义条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code describing clearing and protection actions and type/call expressions, restrictions and explanatory wording in Q&A, and argumentation or mechanism descriptions in scientific, patent, and legal texts; no single trigger pattern covers all segments.

patterns.name: Clearing/protection actions
patterns.context: Code comments describe clearing certain content or bits; one instance clears MIME attachments, another clears certain bits of key coefficients.

patterns.name: Preventing, resisting, or constraining
patterns.context: Contexts involving preventing negative values, protecting materials from external forces, or restricting the objects accepted by a method.

patterns.name: Program calls and parameters/types
patterns.context: Software documentation or Q&A discusses function calls, command parameters, types, collections, instances, or request objects.

patterns.name: Examples, explanations, and question phrasing
patterns.context: Programming Q&A introduces examples, clarifies questions, or expresses confusion.

patterns.name: Connective/argumentative wording in general statements
patterns.context: Explains conclusions, evidence, or matters to be determined; activations occur near connectives or discourse structure.

patterns.name: Scientific mechanisms and research subjects
patterns.context: Discusses immune tolerance, autoreactivity, or astrocyte-related expression and regulation.

patterns.name: Legal appeal and voluntariness determinations
patterns.context: Determines whether a waiver of appeal rights in a plea agreement was knowing and voluntary, subject to whether the record is complete.

3_2754.description: 激活分散于代码中的清除、防护及类型/调用表述，问答里的限制与解释措辞，以及科学、专利和法律文本的论证或机制描述；未见覆盖所有段的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 清除/防护动作
patterns.context: 代码注释中描述清除某些内容或位；一次是清除 MIME 附件，一次是清除密钥系数的某些位。

patterns.name: 防止、抵御或约束
patterns.context: 涉及阻止负值、保护材料免受外力，或限制方法所接受对象的语境。

patterns.name: 程序调用与参数/类型
patterns.context: 软件文档或问答中讨论函数调用、命令参数、类型、集合、实例或请求对象。

patterns.name: 示例、解释与问题表述
patterns.context: 编程问答中引出示例、澄清问题或表达困惑。

patterns.name: 一般性陈述中的连接/论证措辞
patterns.context: 说明结论、证据或待判定事项；激活落在连接词或论述结构附近。
patterns.domain: 专利、论文摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 科学机制与研究对象
patterns.context: 讨论免疫耐受、自身反应，或星形胶质细胞相关表达与调控。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 法律上的上诉与自愿性判断
patterns.context: 判断认罪协议中的上诉权放弃是否知情且自愿，并受记录材料是否完整所限。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various programming code, technical Q&A, and papers, involving command completion, HTTP, collection properties, directory structures, iOS launch, loop copies, lattice paths, callback layout, and endpoint validation; outside technical texts, there is no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Bash/command-line completion fields
patterns.context: Code comments describe command arguments, categories, and completion functionality

patterns.name: Hard-coded HTTP request
patterns.context: Explains that an app without a user interface listens for connections and sends a fixed HTTP PUT request

patterns.name: Display name of a property in a strongly typed collection
patterns.context: Discusses how to obtain the display name of a collection element without referencing the first item or creating a new instance

patterns.name: Directory tree branch symbols
patterns.context: Uses a simplified directory structure to show folder hierarchy

patterns.name: iOS application launch delegate method
patterns.context: Objective-C AppDelegate launch callback and default comments

patterns.name: Copying before a loop to avoid repeated reads
patterns.context: When a class cannot be modified, suggests copying the object before the loop and using the copy within the loop

patterns.name: Non-intersecting lattice paths and Markov chains
patterns.context: Introduces an algorithm for generating sets of non-intersecting lattice paths and its research motivation

patterns.name: Callback triggers and style updates
patterns.context: Runs callbacks until no new content is visible, then updates after style or layout invalidation

patterns.name: Null endpoint validation
patterns.context: Iterates over comma-separated URL endpoints and checks for empty strings

3_2754.description: 激活分布在多种编程代码、技术问答和论文中，涉及命令补全、HTTP、集合属性、目录结构、iOS 启动、循环副本、格路径、回调布局及端点校验；除技术文本外无明显共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Bash/命令行补全字段
patterns.context: 代码注释描述命令参数、分类和补全功能

patterns.name: 硬编码 HTTP 请求
patterns.context: 说明一个无用户界面的 App 监听连接并发送固定 HTTP PUT 请求

patterns.name: 强类型集合中的属性显示名
patterns.context: 讨论不引用集合首项或创建新实例时，如何取得集合元素的显示名

patterns.name: 目录树分支符号
patterns.context: 以简化目录结构展示文件夹层级

patterns.name: iOS 应用启动委托方法
patterns.trigger: “application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:”及“Override point for customization after application launch.”
patterns.context: Objective-C 的 AppDelegate 启动回调及默认注释

patterns.name: 循环外复制以避免重复读取
patterns.trigger: “make a single copy before entering the loop”“local variable within the loop”
patterns.context: 无法修改类时，建议在循环前复制对象并在循环中使用副本

patterns.name: 非相交格路径与马尔可夫链
patterns.context: 介绍用于生成非相交格路径集合的算法及其研究动机

patterns.name: 回调触发与样式更新
patterns.context: 循环执行回调，直到没有新内容可见，并在样式或布局失效后更新

patterns.name: 端点为空值校验
patterns.context: 遍历逗号分隔的 URL 端点并检查空字符串

en.description: Activations are distributed across code indentation and types, programming questions, fixed legal wording, sports reporting, and geographic code; local preferences include code boundaries and several English collocations such as “trouble with” and “give rise to,” but these do not cover all contexts.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and code-block boundaries in Python or other code snippets; often accompanied by function definitions, return statements, or calls

patterns.name: char type and character representation
patterns.context: Discusses the size, signedness, or character encoding of the character type; also appears in code method names

patterns.name: Rulings or clause wording in legal texts
patterns.context: Court decisions discuss authority, disposition, or severability of clauses

patterns.name: give rise to phrase
patterns.context: The fixed phrase is followed by nouns such as presumption or claim to express causing or producing an outcome; appears in adjacent legal or insurance contexts

patterns.name: Questioners expressing difficulty
patterns.context: StackExchange posters use “having trouble with” when describing a specific programming problem

patterns.name: Player rankings and summary queries
patterns.context: Uses aggregated game scores to query top-ranked players and their names or IDs

patterns.name: Trying and subsequent actions
patterns.context: Describes trying something, or trying to call a method or find a result in a programming question

patterns.name: Verifying professional work
patterns.context: Discusses checking a chemist's work, emphasizing that verification is time-consuming or difficult

patterns.name: Required type or condition
patterns.context: Technical explanations state prerequisites for an implementation or data representation

patterns.name: Playing time and value
patterns.context: After a player returns from the injured list, competition makes playing time hard to get, affecting the player's season value

patterns.name: Map geometry center and error
patterns.context: An error occurs when calling a center-point method on a GeoJSON polygon or multipolygon
patterns.domain: Geospatial information and JavaScript programming Q&A

patterns.name: Abstract method placeholder exception
patterns.context: An abstract method in a class throws NotImplementedError to indicate that it has not yet been implemented

patterns.name: Insurance statements and scope of liability
patterns.context: States whether directors or officers knew of conduct, errors, or omissions that might give rise to a claim
patterns.domain: Corporate insurance documents or legal emails

patterns.name: Negating an inference in a legal opinion
patterns.context: Case analysis explains that a particular absence does not give rise to an adverse inference

3_2754.description: 激活分散于代码缩进与类型、编程提问、法律固定措辞、体育报道和地理代码等；局部偏好代码边界及若干英语搭配，如“trouble with”“give rise to”，但不能覆盖全部语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: Python 或其他代码片段中，换行、缩进和代码块边界；常伴随函数定义、返回语句或调用

patterns.name: char 类型与字符表示
patterns.context: 讨论字符类型的大小、符号性或字符编码；也出现在代码方法名中

patterns.name: 法律文本中的裁判或条款措辞
patterns.context: 法院判决中讨论权限、判决处理或条款可分割性

patterns.name: give rise to 短语
patterns.context: 固定短语后接 presumption 或 claim 等名词，表达导致、产生某结果；在相邻法律或保险语境中出现

patterns.name: 提问者表达遇到困难
patterns.context: StackExchange 发帖者在陈述具体编程问题时使用“having trouble with”

patterns.name: 玩家排名与汇总查询
patterns.context: 依据游戏评分汇总，查询排名靠前玩家及其姓名或 ID

patterns.name: 尝试与后续操作
patterns.context: 描述去尝试某事，或在编程问题中尝试调用方法、查找结果

patterns.name: 验证专业工作
patterns.context: 谈到核验化学家的工作，强调验证耗时或困难

patterns.name: 需要某一类型或条件
patterns.context: 技术说明中陈述实现或数据表示所需的前提条件

patterns.name: 时间、上场机会与价值
patterns.trigger: « harder» time« getting» playing« time»、«value» this« season»
patterns.context: 球员从伤病名单复出后，因竞争而难获上场时间，进而影响赛季价值
patterns.domain: 体育与 Fantasy 体育报道

patterns.name: 地图几何中心与报错
patterns.context: 对 GeoJSON 多边形或多多边形调用中心点方法时发生错误
patterns.domain: 地理信息与 JavaScript 编程问答

patterns.name: 抽象方法占位异常
patterns.context: 类中的抽象方法通过抛出 NotImplementedError 表明尚未实现

patterns.name: 保险声明与责任范围
patterns.trigger: «director» or officer、«might»« give»« rise» to« a» claim
patterns.context: 陈述董事或高管是否知悉可能引发索赔的行为、错误或遗漏
patterns.domain: 公司保险文件或法律邮件

patterns.name: 法律意见中否定推定
patterns.trigger: « does» not« give»« rise» to« a»« presumption»
patterns.context: 判例分析中说明某种缺失并不产生不利推定

en.concept: Expressions of difficulty in requests for help
en.description: The clearest pattern is trouble and its collocations with with/getting/figuring out in StackExchange help-seeking text. A few other activations fall on internal fragments of words such as Obstetrics, reflection, ticks, term, and Beats; their semantics and style are inconsistent, possibly reflecting subword fragments rather than a shared topic.

patterns.name: Help-seeking expressions with trouble
patterns.context: When asking a question or describing a problem, especially trouble followed by with, getting, figuring out, and similar phrases; no specific type of technical problem is required.

patterns.name: Preposition with after trouble
patterns.context: Trouble is followed by with and an object or problem to be dealt with; clear activations appear in [1], [6], and [8].

patterns.name: Getting after trouble
patterns.context: Describes difficulty obtaining, implementing, or completing something, with getting followed by a goal or task.

patterns.name: Figuring out after trouble
patterns.context: Describes difficulty finding a solution or understanding something.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal or ending fragments of longer words or identifiers; these examples differ in meaning and context.
patterns.domain: Medical institution names, code, forum text

patterns.name: Compound-word component of term
patterns.context: Appears in the expanded form of the neural network model name LSTM.

patterns.name: Final syllable in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the song title “Until It Beats No More,” with no context shared with the other patterns.

3_2754.concept: 求助中的 trouble 表达
3_2754.description: 最清晰的模式是 StackExchange 求助文本中 trouble 及其 with/getting/figuring out 搭配。另有少数激活落在 Obstetrics、reflection、ticks、term、Beats 等词的内部片段，语义和文体不统一，可能反映词形片段而非共同主题。

patterns.name: 求助式 trouble 表达
patterns.trigger: “trouble”及其邻近表达，如 “I'm having trouble”, “I have trouble”, “I am having trouble”
patterns.context: 在提问或说明问题时，尤其是 trouble 后接 with、getting、figuring out 等；不要求特定技术问题类型。

patterns.name: trouble 后的介词 with
patterns.context: trouble 与 with 连用，后接要处理的对象或问题；在 [1]、[6]、[8] 中有明显激活。

patterns.name: trouble 后接 getting
patterns.context: 描述难以取得、实现或完成某事，getting 后接目标或任务。

patterns.name: trouble 后接 figuring out
patterns.context: 描述难以找出解决办法或理解某事。

patterns.name: 技术术语内部的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词或标识符的内部/末尾片段；这些例子彼此语义与上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 医学机构名称、代码、论坛文本

patterns.name: term 的复合词部分
patterns.context: 出现在神经网络模型名称 LSTM 的展开形式中。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾音节
patterns.context: 出现在歌曲名 “Until It Beats No More” 中，未见与其他模式相同的语境。

en.concept: Expressions of difficulty and requests for help
en.description: Primarily responds to “having trouble” and its continuations in help-seeking text; it also responds to “harder time,” which means having greater difficulty doing something. Both share a difficulty-related meaning. One activation on an iterator-related substring in a Russian programming text is difficult to group with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Help-seeking expression of currently having difficulty
patterns.context: A first-person help-seeker states that they are having difficulty, usually followed by a phrase specifying the problem, such as with, getting, seeing, or figuring out; also includes “I'm trying to understand ... but ... trouble ...”

patterns.name: Time collocation on HackerNews
patterns.context: Time is preceded by harder and followed by a verb or gerund phrase, meaning greater difficulty doing something; it does not use the common StackExchange trouble-help phrasing.

patterns.name: Iterator in code context
patterns.context: A Russian technical text discusses function parameters and includes a programming context such as “iterable container”; activation is concentrated on a character substring in a split token.

3_2754.description: 主要响应求助文本中的“having trouble”及其接续结构；另响应表示做事更困难的“harder time”，二者共享困难语义。另有一次俄语编程文本中迭代器相关子串激活，难与主模式归并。

patterns.name: 正在遇到困难的求助表述
patterns.trigger: “I'm having trouble”“I am having trouble”“I'm having trouble seeing”“I'm having trouble figuring out”
patterns.context: 第一人称求助者陈述遇到困难，通常接 with、getting、seeing、figuring out 等说明困难所在的短语；也包括“I'm trying to understand ... but ... trouble ...”

patterns.name: HackerNews 中的 time 搭配

en.description: All passages show strong activation at the string ban, including the prohibition sense and noun sense of ban, as well as in-word matches in bananas, banter, email addresses, and technical strings. The prohibition sense is common in policy discussions, but is not required.

patterns.name: The word form ban

patterns.domain: Multiple domains, mainly narrative and discussion

patterns.name: Discussion of ban in the prohibition sense
patterns.context: Activation occurs when ban is a verb or noun meaning to prohibit or a prohibition; the context discusses prohibited objects such as cars, drones, tobacco and alcohol or drugs, and exports, often in a policy debate or critical tone.

patterns.name: Other senses or in-word matches of ban
patterns.context: The string ban appears in bananas and banter, not in the sense of “prohibition”; the bananas passage also includes the rebuttal context “we still have bananas”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments; Pile-CC accounts of gender relations

patterns.name: ban in proper names or technical strings
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the email-address fragment banavar and the nonstandard string banjanxed, rather than in a clear ordinary-English use meaning prohibition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv author email; StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Noun ban with prepositions
patterns.context: ban is a noun meaning a prohibition on discussion or exports; the examples occur in historical narrative and international trade reporting, respectively.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia historical entry; Pile-CC news report

en.concept: about introducing topics and heterogeneous fragments

patterns.name: Subwords within specific terms

patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language and code, covering [2][3][4][5][6][10]

patterns.name: Mappings and type annotations in code
patterns.context: Appears in code snippets, including functional mapping, type inference comments, and type assertions; the precise activation sites vary.

patterns.name: Quantum and computational theory terminology

patterns.name: Incomplete explicit pattern in research terminology

patterns.name: Scattered discourse and web markup

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is a stem followed by -ing, especially throttling (choking or network rate limiting) and hindering. The remaining activations are scattered across in-word fragments in papers, common words, and formatting markers, with no unified trigger condition; torrent contexts overlap only partially.

patterns.name: Inflectional suffix -ing

patterns.name: -ing in participles

patterns.name: In-word fragments in academic vocabulary

patterns.name: Function words or common word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is marked on common words, but different passages show no clear consistent local semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Markup and formatting tokens
patterns.context: Appears near document metadata, delimiters, or line breaks; there is no stable link to other highly activated words.

patterns.name: torrent-related terms
patterns.context: Both passages discuss torrent clients or traffic; aside from throttling, the activated words do not show a stable shared trigger form.

3_2765.description: 最清楚的重复是词干后接 -ing，尤其 throttling（掐、网络限速）和 hindering。其余激活散布于论文词内片段、普通词及格式标记，缺乏统一触发条件；torrent 语境仅部分重合。

en.concept: specific in-word fragments and term triggers
en.description: The main patterns are in-word fragment triggers: “rost” in a nigrostriatal-related word, “ward” in award in legal contexts, and also Betfair/Bet fragments, pretraining, and net benefits; these do not form a single semantic theme across domains.

patterns.name: Nigrostriatal vocabulary
patterns.context: The trigger falls within the split-marked word “nigrostriatal,” especially the “rost” segment; the context involves dopamine, the striatal system, or behavioral research.
patterns.domain: Neuroscience, Parkinson’s disease, and behavioral pharmacology

patterns.name: Betfair string
patterns.context: The trigger is at the beginning of the proper name “Betfair” or in isolated repeated “Bet” text; a neuroscience context is not required.

patterns.name: award word form
patterns.context: Appears within award and awarding forms in legal texts; strong marking is concentrated on the “ward” segment, while the prefix a may be unmarked.
patterns.domain: Judgments, arbitration, and legal documents on attorney fees

patterns.name: Fragments outside neuroscience
patterns.context: The marker appears within the word “pretraining”; the same passage also contains nigrostriatal-related content, but this trigger is an independent term.
patterns.domain: Behavioral experiments, learning and memory research

patterns.name: Economic evaluation terminology
patterns.context: The trigger appears in statements about a research project’s cost-effectiveness and net benefits.

3_2765.concept: 特定词内片段与词项触发
