patterns.context: Appears in the title-style, title-case phrase “Way Over Their Heads”.
patterns.domain: Web text, possibly involving a film or game plot

patterns.name: “P”, “ray”, “er” in a Wikipedia category name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final subword fragments of the category name, which together form “Prayer”; adjacent to a preceding navigation list and reference markers.

3_2765.description: 强烈共同触发项是 token“Over”，涵盖时间跨度、数量超出、overnight 及固定短语等用法；另有句首异常用法，以及维基百科分类名“Prayer”的分词激活。

patterns.name: 句首或大写形式的“Over”
patterns.context: “Over”位于片段开头，或处于标题中大写的单词位置；后文可接数字、数量、时间跨度或其他短语。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科研写作、专利背景、邮件及评论等

patterns.name: “Over”表示时间跨度
patterns.trigger: «Over» the last decade or so；«Over» the past five years；«Over» the past eleven years；«Over» the last couple of days
patterns.context: 后接 the last/the past 加时间段，表示“在……期间”；激活标记落在“Over”。

patterns.name: “Over”表示超过数量或比例
patterns.context: 后接金额、数字或比例，表达“超过”。

patterns.name: 标题中的固定短语“Overnight”
patterns.context: “Over”与后续 night 连成 overnight；出现在作品标题中。

patterns.name: 句首“Over”后的专名或缩写
patterns.context: 句首 Over 后直接接大小写混合字符串“TheGeicoE”，没有明显常规句法关系。

patterns.name: 标题式文本中的“Way Over”
patterns.context: 出现在标题式、各词首字母大写的短语“Way Over Their Heads”中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，可能涉及电影或游戏剧情

patterns.name: 维基百科分类名中的“P”“ray”“er”
patterns.context: 激活落在分类名末尾的分词片段，合起来为“Prayer”；与前文导航列表及参考文献标记相邻。

en.description: Activation spans Khmer, Polish, and English, often falling on short subword fragments within words; it also appears on English function words in phrases and several salient words in news passages. Languages, topics, and parts of speech vary, suggesting heterogeneous subword-fragment triggers overall.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Khmer script
patterns.context: Activation falls on Khmer letters or combinations of symbols, often embedded in code strings, identifiers, or quoted Khmer text.

patterns.name: Slavic word-internal fragments
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within a Polish word rather than as a standalone word; appears in continuous parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within English words or proper names, including cross-word fragments; surrounding topics vary, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Function words in an emphatic structure
patterns.context: The phrase “Not even as a hint” in continuous prose; activation centers on negation and degree/comparative structure. Only one example.

patterns.name: Content words in an emphatic structure
patterns.context: The sentence discusses data leaks and their risks; multiple semantically salient words are marked, but there is no single stable part of speech or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in beard-care text
patterns.context: Embedded in words such as “mischievous” and “dandruff”, describing beard-care issues; activation centers on word-internal fragments.

3_2765.concept: 词内部片段及局部词语
3_2765.description: 激活跨高棉语、波兰语和英语，常落在词内部的短子词片段；也见于英语短语功能词及新闻语句中若干显著词。语种、主题和词类均不统一，整体更像异质的词片段触发。

patterns.name: 高棉文字内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在高棉语文字的字母或组合符号上；常嵌在代码字符串、标识符或引号中的高棉语文本里。
patterns.domain: Github代码/标识符及高棉语文本

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于波兰语词内部，而非独立单词；出现在议会发言的连续正文中。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词或专名内部，包含跨词片段；周围主题各异，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 英语百科词条、议会文本

patterns.name: 强调结构中的功能词
patterns.context: 连续正文中的短语“Not even as a hint”，激活集中在否定和程度/比较结构；仅见此例。

patterns.name: 强调结构中的实词
patterns.context: 句子谈数据泄露及其风险，多个语义显著词被标记，但没有单一稳定的词类或句法位置。

patterns.name: 胡须护理词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“mischievous”“dandruff”等词中，描述胡须护理问题；激活集中在词内片段。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual word-internal fragments, Khmer text, code punctuation and identifiers, and comparative or result-related wording in news and abstracts; these contexts lack a clear, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Multilingual word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within continuous Polish and Czech words, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish and Czech parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Highlighted non-Latin script fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a UI field value consisting of Khmer script
patterns.domain: Multilingual UI text in GitHub code

patterns.name: Code punctuation and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript routing logic involving return values, comments, and method matching

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in news text
patterns.context: Appears in news headlines, URLs, and political news prose; some fragments are embedded in words, such as “prodded”
patterns.domain: News clippings or news material in Enron emails

patterns.name: Comparatives and movement terminology in research abstracts
patterns.context: Appears in comparisons of vaccine immune responses or descriptions of athletic performance, often alongside direction, outcomes, and degree comparisons

patterns.name: Expressions of outcomes, gains and losses, and degree
patterns.context: One instance occurs in a table of election outcomes, gains and losses; another is emphatic negation in news commentary; also appears in “not as much as” in a medical abstract
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news commentary, and medical abstracts

3_2765.description: 激活散落于多语种词内片段、Khmer 文本、代码标点与标识符，以及新闻和摘要中的比较、结果用语；这些上下文之间缺乏明确统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语、捷克语连续词内部的子词片段，未显示稳定的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语和捷克语议会文本

patterns.name: 高亮非拉丁文字片段
patterns.context: 出现在一段由 Khmer 文字组成的界面字段值中
patterns.domain: Github 代码中的多语言 UI 文本

patterns.name: 代码标点与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 路由逻辑中，涉及返回值、注释和方法匹配

patterns.name: 新闻文本中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 新闻标题、网址及政治新闻正文中出现；有些片段嵌在词内，如“prodded”
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件所含新闻剪报或新闻材料

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的比较与运动术语
patterns.context: 出现在疫苗免疫反应比较或运动表现描述中，常伴随方向、结果及程度比较

patterns.name: 结果、得失及程度表达
patterns.context: 一处是选举结果表格中的得失与变化，另一处是新闻评论中的否定强调；另见医学摘要“not as much as”
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻评论与医学摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to the ro subword fragment in ibuprofen, and also to words such as dropped/dropping and other tokenizations containing ro; isolated activations in saved and creep do not currently fit the same pattern.

patterns.name: ibuprofen substring in a drug name
patterns.context: The drug name ibuprofen is split into multiple subword tokens; it appears in various corpus contexts, with activation concentrated on «ro», though adjacent fragments may also activate.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent background sections, NIH research texts

patterns.name: Common English words beginning with ro
patterns.context: A word contains the ro subword, especially in spellings tokenized as D-ro, such as dropped/dropping; the fragment matches ro in ibuprofen.

patterns.name: Other words or proper names containing ro
patterns.context: Activation falls on token fragments containing ro; unrelated to the drug name, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia categories, email subject lines, and URLs

patterns.name: Numerical amount/quantity expressions related to “saved”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence discussing redirecting saved money to another use; this activation does not correspond to the ro fragment above and occurs in isolation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in creep
patterns.context: Activation falls on a tokenized fragment of the word creep, amid a HackerNews comment discussing a method; its connection to other patterns is unclear.

3_2765.description: 主要响应 ibuprofen 中的 ro 子词片段，也响应 dropped/dropping 等词及其他含 ro 的分词；另有 saved 和 creep 的孤立激活，暂无法归入同一模式。

patterns.name: 药名中的 ibuprofen 子串
patterns.context: 药名 ibuprofen 被拆分为多个子词 token；在多种语料上下文中出现，激活集中于 «ro»，相邻片段也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: ro 开头的常见英语词
patterns.context: 词中出现 ro 子词，尤其在 dropped/dropping 这类以 D-ro 开头的拼写分词中；与 ibuprofen 中的 ro 片段相同。

patterns.name: 其他含 ro 的词或专名
patterns.context: 激活落在含 ro 的分词片段上；与药名无关，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、邮件标题及 URL

patterns.name: 与“saved”相关的数字金额/数量表达
patterns.context: 出现在讨论将节省的资金转用于其他用途的句子中；该激活不对应上述 ro 片段，孤立出现。

patterns.name: creep 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 creep 的拆分片段上，周围是 HackerNews 评论中对方法的讨论；与其他模式的联系不明确。

en.concept: Subword-fragment responses across languages and formats
en.description: Activation broadly falls on word-internal substrings in different languages, as well as code, identifiers, escape sequences, and URL fragments; its position varies with tokenization, with no stable semantic theme, though a few ordinary words also activate.

patterns.name: English suffix fragments within words
patterns.context: When English words are split into multiple tokens, activation falls on word fragments; often seen in common verbs or compounds, but not in a fixed word form.
patterns.domain: News, marketing, web, and general English text

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, activation is distributed across word-internal or word-initial fragments; also appears in name fragments.

patterns.name: Czech word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Czech text, words are split into multiple fragments containing diacritics; activation centers on substrings within words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Tibetan transliteration
patterns.context: Latin transliterations of Tibetan proper names are split into multiple fragments, with activation inside the names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on history and religion

patterns.name: Code, paths, and terminal escape fragments
patterns.context: In code configuration paths, terminal color escapes, or directory-tree formatting, activation falls on symbols and fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within code identifiers
patterns.context: After camelCase or concatenated JavaScript identifiers are tokenized, activation appears on name fragments.

patterns.name: Case-sensitive and word-initial fragments in email subject lines
patterns.context: In subject lines or bullet items, activation falls on case-sensitive word-initial or word-internal fragments; no stable semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: Energy-market subject lines in Enron emails

patterns.name: Short fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Proper names or short words also show sporadic activation in ordinary English prose, with no stable word-form pattern to group them under.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in email and web titles
patterns.context: In excerpts from economic commentary, email signatures, or URLs, activation is scattered across ordinary words, title separators, and URL fragments.

patterns.name: Ordinary function words and word-final fragments in English sentences
patterns.context: A few common words in English natural-language sentences also activate, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

3_2765.concept: 跨语种与格式的子词片段响应
3_2765.description: 激活广泛落在不同语言的词内子串，以及代码、标识符、转义符和网址片段；位置随分词而变，未显出稳定语义主题，少量普通词也被激活。

patterns.name: 单词内部的英语后缀片段
patterns.context: 英语词语被拆分成多个 token 时，激活落在单词片段上；多见于常见动词或复合词，但并非固定词形。
patterns.domain: 新闻、营销、网页及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中，激活分布在词内或词首片段；也出现在人名片段。

patterns.name: 捷克语词内片段
patterns.context: 捷克语文本中，词被拆成多个带变音符号的片段；激活集中于词内子串。

patterns.name: 藏语转写中的词内片段
patterns.context: 藏语专名的拉丁转写被切分成多个片段，激活出现在名称内部。
patterns.domain: 百科全书历史与宗教条目

patterns.name: 代码、路径与终端转义片段
patterns.context: 代码配置路径、终端颜色转义或目录树格式中，激活落在符号和片段上。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 驼峰式或拼接式 JavaScript 标识符被分词后，激活出现在名称片段。

patterns.name: 邮件标题中的大小写及词首片段
patterns.context: 标题或项目符号条目中，激活落在大小写敏感的词首、词内片段；未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源市场标题

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的短片段
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述中，专名或短词也出现零散激活，无法归入更稳定的词形模式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及 StackExchange 文本

patterns.name: 邮件与网页标题中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 经济评论摘录、邮件签名或网址中，激活分散在普通词、标题分隔线及 URL 片段上。

patterns.name: 英文句中普通功能词与词尾片段
patterns.context: 英文自然语言句子中少量常见词也有激活，没有显示出一致的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and format strings
en.description: Activation is distributed across word-internal fragments in Dutch, French, Polish, English, and other texts, as well as URLs, number strings, and symbols. Some fragments occur in parliamentary, legal, marketing, and web contexts, but there is no clearly stable shared meaning or semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fragments within Dutch word roots
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-internal fragments in Dutch, often near morpheme boundaries; fragments include bet/ek, vers/lag, re/end, erg, ep, act/ief.

patterns.name: Dutch compounds and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Dutch text discussing Nietzsche, with trigger fragments distributed within words and compound components, such as over-spannen, gepubliceerde, werken.

patterns.name: Short fragments in URLs and text markers
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across URLs, number strings, and repeated symbols; it also appears in the string DupDetector.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English marketing goals
patterns.context: Appears in marketing goals or impact lists; activation centers on words such as Increase and Improve and adjacent word fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in French parliamentary wording
patterns.context: Located in French parliamentary speech, falling within or at the start of words such as efforcer, élargie, réponde, fin.

patterns.name: Polish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within words in Polish speeches, often on spelling fragments of longer words; also appears in expressions such as “bardzo późno”.

patterns.name: French and parliamentary-related word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary addresses and contexts involving the presiding officer’s term; trigger points fall within French words and related forms of address.

patterns.name: Fragments in Polish institutional long words
patterns.context: Located in parliamentary law titles or regulation names; activation falls within Polish administrative and legal vocabulary.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary-procedure word fragments
patterns.context: When discussing treaties, committee reports, and parliamentary procedures, activation falls within Polish words and parliamentary terminology.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English web copy
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across URL parameters, separators, and web navigation/promotional text, including Improve and weather.
patterns.domain: Web links and website copy in emails

3_2765.concept: 多语种词片段与格式串
3_2765.description: 激活分布于荷兰语、法语、波兰语和英语等不同文本的词内片段，也见于网址、数字串和符号。部分片段在议会、法律、营销及网页语境中出现，但没有明显稳定的共同词义或语义主题。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词根内部片段
patterns.trigger: « bet» «ek» « vers» « lag» « re» « end» « erg» « ep» « act» « ief»
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语单词的词内片段，常见于词素边界附近；片段包括 bet/ek、vers/lag、re/end、erg、ep、act/ief。

patterns.name: 荷兰语复合词及词内片段
patterns.trigger: « over» « sp» « ann» « bl» « uf» « g» « ep» « ubl» « wer»
patterns.context: 出现在讨论尼采的荷兰语文本中，触发片段分布在词内及复合词构成部分，如 over-spannen、gepubliceerde、werken。

patterns.name: URL及文本标记中的短片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在网址、数字串和重复符号中；另在 DupDetector 字样中出现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接与论坛/技术文本

patterns.name: 英语营销目标中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Incre» «ase» « the» « attract» « products» « sold» « sales» «Improve» « recall» « exposure»
patterns.context: 出现在营销目标或效果清单中，激活集中于 Increase、Improve 等词及其相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 法语议会措辞中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: « eff» « larg» « ie» « rép» « onde» « À» « fin»
patterns.context: 位于法语议会发言中，落在 efforcer、élargie、réponde、fin 等词的内部或词首片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.trigger: « prz» « ew» « ów» « mów» « ro» « bi» « zo» « p» « ó» « źno» « ep» « ros»
patterns.context: 激活分布于波兰语发言词内部，常落在较长词的拼写片段上；另有“bardzo późno”等表达。

patterns.name: 法语及议会相关词片段
patterns.trigger: « pour» « législ» « Pr» « ésident» « pendant» « fin» « est»
patterns.context: 出现在议会致辞与主席任期语境，触发点位于法语词及相关称谓中。

patterns.name: 波兰语制度性长词片段
patterns.context: 位于议会法规标题或条例名称中，激活落在波兰语行政、法律词汇内部。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会程序词片段
patterns.trigger: « ok» « re» « Tra» « kt» « Po» « wyd» « pr» « sp» « ra» « wo» « zd» « prz» « ep» « row» « ad» « proces»
patterns.context: 讨论条约、委员会报告及议会程序时，激活落在波兰语词内部及议会术语中。

patterns.name: 英语网页文案中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在网址参数、分隔线及网页导航/宣传语中，包含 Improve、weather 等。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页链接与网站文案

en.description: Activation spans multiple languages and genres, including English exceed, Polish word-internal fragments, French fragments, the name DupDetector, astrophysical symbols, and tabular data; no single semantic pattern explains all of them.

patterns.name: English word ending exceed
patterns.context: Trigger fragments all contain the root exceed; they appear in titles, teaching materials, or legal discussions, with varying forms and capitalization
patterns.domain: English energy headlines, experimental-design textbooks, online legal discussions

patterns.name: Polish word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Polish words, involving different forms related to apologizing, initiating procedures, and legal provisions; they are not complete word boundaries
patterns.domain: European Parliament Polish speeches and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: French word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across French words or phrases, with no word forms matching English exceed or the Polish fragments

patterns.name: DupDetector string
patterns.context: Triggered by the name of a duplicate detector and its abbreviation in a web excerpt, surrounded by URLs and separators

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and astrophysics word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in sentences and formulas about quasar radiation and super-Eddington accretion

patterns.name: Tabular and tab-separated formatting
patterns.context: Activation accompanies tab-separated table fields, part-of-speech labels, and Polish word forms; more likely a formatting or local subword trigger

3_2765.concept: 多语言子词与格式片段
3_2765.description: 激活跨多种语言和文体，包含英文 exceed、波兰语词内片段、法语片段、DupDetector 名称、天体物理符号及制表符表格；没有单一语义模式能解释全部。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 exceed
patterns.context: 触发片段都包含词根 exceed；出现在标题、教学材料或法律讨论中，词形和大小写不同
patterns.domain: 英语能源标题、实验设计教材、网络法律讨论

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语词的内部片段，涉及道歉、开展程序、法律条文等不同词形；并非完整词边界
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会波兰语发言与议会文本

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在法语词或短语中，未见与英文 exceed 或波兰语片段相同的词形

patterns.name: DupDetector 字符串
patterns.context: 触发于网页片段中的重复检测器名称及其缩写，周围有 URL 和分隔符

patterns.name: 数学符号及天体物理词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于类星体辐射和超爱丁顿吸积的句子及公式中

patterns.name: 表格与制表符格式
patterns.context: 激活伴随制表符分隔的表格字段、词性标签及波兰语词形；更像格式或局部子词触发

en.description: Activation is distributed across word forms related to growth/improvement, French expressions of action, code operators and identifiers, and medical terminology, abbreviations, and typographic symbols. Some word-form patterns recur, but they cannot explain all examples.

patterns.name: Growth, improvement, or enhancement
patterns.context: Describes increases, improvements, or reversing a suppressed state; triggers often fall at the beginning or within English words, but the entire word is not marked every time.

patterns.name: Adaptation, response, and completion
patterns.context: In formal French texts, discusses adapting, responding to needs, and acting toward a goal.

patterns.name: Operators, values, and formatting markers in code
patterns.context: Code, debug output, or terminal escape sequences; activation falls on operators, punctuation, numbers, or formatting control characters.

patterns.name: Fragments within program identifiers
patterns.context: The trigger is a token fragment in code or code-like strings, with no stable semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Specific word-internal fragments in English vocabulary
patterns.context: In legal text, activation centers on a stem fragment of exceed; the full phrase is exceed authorized access. This is an isolated example and does not establish a condition.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations, symbols, and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In tabulated brain-imaging research results, markers are distributed across abbreviations, statistical symbols, and fragments of increase/decrease forms.

patterns.name: Word fragments in book titles and headlines
patterns.context: Appears in book or promotional titles and table-of-contents entries; overlaps locally with the Improve forms in section 2, but here primarily occurs in title contexts.

patterns.name: Controlled gene expression and experimental terminology
patterns.context: Abstracts on RNA, gene expression, and cellular phenotypes; activation is scattered across terminology and ordinary narrative words.

patterns.name: Newline characters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at a text-structure marker, but appears only once and the context shows no stable semantic relationship.

3_2765.description: 激活分布在增长/改进词形、法语行动表达、代码运算符与标识符，以及医学术语、缩写和排版符号等多类局部片段。部分词形模式重复，但无法统一解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 增长、改进或增强
patterns.context: 描述增加、改善、逆转受抑制状态；触发常落在英语词的词首或词内，并非每次完整词都标记。

patterns.name: 适配、响应与完成
patterns.context: 法语正式文本中谈适配、回应需求及采取行动的目的。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符、数值及格式标记
patterns.context: 代码、调试输出或终端转义序列；激活落在运算符、标点、数字或格式控制符上。

patterns.name: 程序标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 触发的是代码或类似代码字符串中的分词片段，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 英文词汇中的特定词内片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中，激活集中在 exceed 的词干片段，完整短语为 exceed authorized access；孤例，无法据此确定条件。

patterns.name: 医学缩写、符号和词内片段
patterns.context: 表格化脑影像研究结果中，标记分布于缩写、统计符号及 increase/decrease 词形片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 表格/医学研究

patterns.name: 书名与标题中的词语片段
patterns.context: 书籍或宣传性标题、目录条目中出现；与段2的 Improve 词形有局部重合，但此处主要是标题语境。

patterns.name: 受控基因表达及实验术语
patterns.context: RNA、基因表达及细胞表型研究摘要；激活分散在术语和普通叙述词上。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 文本结构标记处出现激活，但仅见一次，且上下文未显示稳定语义关系。

en.concept: up strings and heterogeneous word fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across multiple text types and word-form fragments: it recurs in spellings related to up, and also appears in medical terminology, legal/business expressions, code operators, and imaging reports; there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: up substring within words
patterns.context: Words or phrases containing the letter string up; seen in upstart, up to, and up-and-coming, with different meanings and syntax

patterns.name: Pricing and risk expressions
patterns.context: Estimates a price range and juxtaposes rising prices with declining risk

patterns.name: Respiratory function and drug response
patterns.context: Appears in specialized terms containing similar character fragments, such as nond[e]pressed and nond[e]pleating

patterns.name: Legal contracts and electricity trading
patterns.context: Discusses whether a project agreement is in breach and mentions prepaid electricity contracts

patterns.name: Symbols in shift operators
patterns.context: Appears in shift operators in code examples and adjacent numerical values

patterns.name: Word fragments in imaging reports
patterns.context: Medical imaging results tables describe increases and decreases in signal; activation falls on tokenized word fragments

3_2765.concept: up 字符串及异质词片段
3_2765.description: 激活分散在多类文本与词形片段：反复出现在 up 相关拼写中，也见于医学术语、法律商务表达、代码运算符及影像报告；没有统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内 up 子串
patterns.context: 包含字母串 up 的词或短语；分别见于 upstart、up to、up-and-coming，词义和句法各异
patterns.domain: 体育报道、HackerNews 论坛讨论

patterns.name: 价格与风险表述
patterns.context: 估算价格范围，并将价格上升与风险下降并列

patterns.name: 呼吸功能及药物反应
patterns.context: 出现在 nond[e]pressed、nond[e]pleting 等含相似字符片段的专业术语中

patterns.name: 法律合同及电力交易
patterns.context: 讨论项目协议是否违约，并提及已付款的电力合约

patterns.name: 位移运算符中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在代码示例的位移运算符及其相邻数值中

patterns.name: 成像报告中的词片段
patterns.context: 医学影像结果表格中描述信号升降；激活落在被拆分的词片段上

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual word-internal fragments, code operators and control-flow tokens, URL fragments, and short phrases in ordinary text; the shared pattern is unclear and may depend on local token form or segmentation position.

patterns.name: “ep” substring
patterns.context: Activation falls within words containing the letters ep, despite differing meanings and surrounding contexts; the first two examples are tokenized English words, while the other is a Czech inflected form

patterns.name: Conditional operators
patterns.context: Appears near assignment or comparison operators in code

patterns.name: Code tokens and boundaries
patterns.context: Common control-flow elements, punctuation, or whitespace boundaries in code lines; specific trigger positions vary

patterns.name: URL path fragments
patterns.context: Located in the URL of a news link

patterns.name: Fragments within legal terminology
patterns.context: In sentences discussing the CFAA and interpretations of “exceeds authorized access”, activation falls on tokenized words or adjacent phrases

patterns.name: French word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Appears in fixed expressions in French political discourse

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in hockey coverage
patterns.context: Appears in evaluations of game performance

3_2765.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段、代码运算符与控制流 token、URL 片段及普通文本短语上；共同规律不明确，可能受局部 token 形式或切分位置影响。

patterns.name: “ep”子串
patterns.context: 激活位置落在包含 ep 字母的词内，词义和周围语境不一致；前两例是被拆分标记的英文词，另一例是捷克语词形
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、捷克语形态标注

patterns.name: 条件运算符
patterns.context: 出现在代码中的赋值或比较运算符附近

patterns.name: 代码 token 与边界
patterns.context: 代码行中常见的控制流、标点或空白边界；各段具体触发位置并不相同

patterns.name: 网址路径片段
patterns.context: 位于新闻链接的 URL 中

patterns.name: 法律术语内部片段
patterns.context: 讨论 CFAA 与“exceeds authorized access”解释的句子中，激活落在拆分词或相邻短语上

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语政治论述的固定表达中

patterns.name: 冰球报道中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在对比赛表现的评价中

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and boundary markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within technical words, code and format strings, email headers, mathematical expressions, and paper-structure words and citation markers; there is no clear, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Chemical/biomedical subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on subwords or morpheme fragments within English technical terms; common in technical terminology, but not tied to a fixed root or a single segmentation position.

patterns.name: Fragments in code identifiers and format strings
patterns.context: Activations occur near Python/Django code, identifiers, documentation comments, or format strings; multiple markers involve code words or string fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments in email header fields and addresses
patterns.context: Occurs in a quoted email header beginning with “>From:”, followed by a mailing-list address.

patterns.name: Numerical expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in a short problem asking for the cube root of a large integer and requesting the nearest integer.

patterns.name: Structural terms and citation markers in paper text
patterns.context: Occurs in paper text describing protein domains and containing figure cross-references; there are also table citations and descriptions of hydrogen bonds.

3_2893.concept: 异质文本片段与边界标记
3_2893.description: 激活分散于专业词内部片段、代码与格式串、邮件头、数学表达式及论文结构词和引用标记；没有明显统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文词内部的化学/生物医学子词片段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在英文术语内部的子词或词素片段；常见于专业术语，但并非固定词根或单一切分位置。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与格式字符串中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Python/Django 代码、标识符、文档注释或格式字符串附近；多个标记涉及代码词或字符串片段。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段及地址中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在以“>From:”开头的邮件引用头部，后接列表地址。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值表达式
patterns.context: 出现在询问某大整数立方根并要求取最近整数的简短题目中。

patterns.name: 论文正文中的结构性术语与引文标记
patterns.context: 出现在描述蛋白质结构域并带图表交叉引用的论文正文中；另有表格引用和氢键叙述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across many types of text fragments, including numbers, chemical/biomedical terms, email addresses, code identifiers, and punctuation; there is no single stable semantic or grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Numeric and numeric chemical-formula fragments
patterns.context: Numbers occur in math problems, compound names, or paper titles; activations cover numbers and their immediately adjacent token fragments.

patterns.name: Token fragments in element names
patterns.context: The element name erbium is split into multiple subwords, with activations concentrated within the name rather than in a general syntactic position.

patterns.name: Token fragments in email addresses and identifiers
patterns.context: An email header address consists of multiple word forms and underscores; stronger activations fall on fragments within the address.

patterns.name: Structural markers and name fragments in code
patterns.context: In code or code documentation, activations fall on keywords, identifiers, punctuation such as parentheses and semicolons, and near line breaks and default arguments; trigger locations are not consistent.

patterns.name: Subword in a specific subject name
patterns.context: In academic text about researchers’ emotions and influence, activation falls on an in-word subword of “lesbians”; the topic itself may also be relevant.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Angiogenesis
patterns.context: The term angiogenesis recurs in a title and adjacent text, with activations concentrated at the beginning of the word and within it.

3_2893.description: 激活分散在数字、化学/生物医学术语、邮件地址及代码标识符和标点等多类文本片段中；没有单一稳定的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与数字化学式片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在数学题、化合物名称或论文标题中；激活覆盖数字及其紧邻的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 数学、化学与生物医学文献

patterns.name: 元素名称中的分词片段
patterns.context: 元素名 erbium 被拆成多个子词，激活集中在名称内部，而非一般句法位置。

patterns.name: 邮件地址与标识符中的切分片段
patterns.context: 邮件头的地址由多个词形和下划线组成；较强激活落在地址内部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性标记和名称片段
patterns.context: 代码或代码文档中，激活落在关键字、标识符、括号/分号等标点，以及换行和默认参数附近；具体触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 特定研究对象名称中的子词
patterns.context: 关于研究者情绪与影响的学术文本中，激活落在“lesbians”的词内子词；上下文主题本身也可能相关。

patterns.name: Angiogenesis 词内片段
patterns.context: 术语 angiogenesis 在标题及相邻正文中重复出现，激活集中在词首和词内片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目标题/摘要

en.description: Activations cluster around several specific strings: obligation in legal documents, the project name gimpact, mathematical values, HPV, legal citation numbers, and readership; these contexts have no clear shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Legal obligation
patterns.context: obligation appears in legal discussion, often adjacent to to, of, has, any, his, and other words, concerning the duties of a party or institution.

patterns.name: gimpact string
patterns.context: The project URL http://gimpact.sourceforge.net/ appears in a code comment, with activation concentrated on the substring gimpact.

patterns.name: Number sequence or numerical problem
patterns.context: Asks for the square root of a number and requests the nearest integer; the surrounding text contains values from a math problem.

patterns.name: HPV types
patterns.context: types follows HPV, introducing identified types of human papillomavirus.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in fragments of volume and page numbers in U.S. legal citations.

patterns.name: readership quantity phrase
patterns.context: Discusses readership data provided by advertising information and the number of readers.

3_2893.description: 激活集中于若干特定字符串：法律文书中的 obligation、项目名 gimpact、数学数值、HPV、法律引文数字及 readership；这些语境没有明显共同的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: obligation 法律义务
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现 obligation，常与 to、of、has、any、his 等相邻，讨论当事人或机构的义务。

patterns.name: gimpact 字符串
patterns.context: 代码注释中的项目网址 http://gimpact.sourceforge.net/，激活集中在 gimpact 子串。

patterns.name: 数字序列或数值问题
patterns.context: 询问某个数的平方根并要求取最近整数；周围是数学题中的数值。

patterns.name: HPV 类型
patterns.context: HPV 后紧接 types，介绍已识别的人乳头瘤病毒类型。

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 出现在美国法律引文的卷页编号片段中。

patterns.name: readership 数量短语
patterns.context: 谈及广告信息所提供的 readership 数据及读者数量。

en.description: The subword token «b» shows strong activation in all ten passages, across words, identifiers, code, tables, and poetry; hexadecimal/alphanumeric sequences in code are a narrower recurring context, but do not explain a unique semantic pattern.

patterns.name: b subword fragments in code
patterns.context: The trigger is the standalone subword token «b», appearing in identifiers, code, or ordinary words with no clear semantic connection; it is often surrounded by letters, numbers, underscores, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Code, medical abstracts, literary texts, and data tables

patterns.name: Numeric and letter-b code sequences
patterns.context: In hexadecimal constants or debugging identifiers, b occurs within numeric or mixed alphanumeric sequences.

3_2893.description: 十段都出现强激活的子词 token «b»，位置横跨单词、标识符、代码、表格和诗歌；代码中的十六进制/字母数字序列是较窄的重复场景，但不足以解释为唯一语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的 b 子词片段
patterns.context: 触发点是独立的子词 token «b»，出现在多种无明显语义联系的标识符、代码或普通词中；周围常有字母、数字、下划线或标点。
patterns.domain: 代码、医学摘要、文学文本及数据表

patterns.name: 数字与字母 b 的代码序列
patterns.context: 十六进制常量或调试标识符中，b 出现在数字或混合字母数字序列里。

en.concept: Term/stem and polysemous triggers for obligation
en.description: Activations fall into two main groups: a stem fragment of the full word energetics in biomedical contexts, and obligation in legal contexts (statutory duties, contractual duties, and so on); there are also postal patent wording and sporadic legal formulas and occurrences of will.

patterns.name: Bioenergetics terminology
patterns.context: The word occurs in sentences about energy metabolism, mitochondrial genes, enzyme catalysis, or molecular biology processes; the prefix token «energet» is the main strong trigger, followed by «ics».
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical and molecular biology academic text

patterns.name: Legal obligation
patterns.context: obligation appears in legal text concerning statutory duties, child support obligations, trial-related duties, bank contractual obligations, or lawyers’ duties to clients.

patterns.name: Postal and mailing operations
patterns.context: Patent background text describing postal systems, mail batches, mailing declarations, and delivery services.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial will
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a sentence or clause in legal discussion or patent descriptions; the word also appears in passages with other strong activation patterns, but does not form a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Case citations and procedural language
patterns.context: Court decision citations or procedural discussion; activations are scattered across wording about courts, litigation, and rulings, without showing a stable single lexical item.

3_2893.concept: 术语/词干与 obligation 多义触发
3_2893.description: 激活分成两大类：生物医学语境中完整词 energetics 的词干片段，以及法律语境中 obligation（法定义务、合同义务等）；另有邮政专利措辞和若干法律套语、will 的零散激活。

patterns.name: 生物能学术语
patterns.context: 该词出现在讨论能量代谢、线粒体基因、酶催化或分子生物学过程的句子中；前缀分词 «energet» 是主要强触发，后接 «ics»。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学与分子生物学学术文本

patterns.name: 法律义务
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现 obligation，谈及法定义务、子女抚养义务、审判相关义务、银行合同义务或律师对委托人的义务。

patterns.name: 邮政邮寄事务
patterns.context: 描述邮政系统、邮件批次、邮寄声明及邮递服务的专利背景文本。

patterns.name: 句首 will
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述或专利描述中的句首或分句开头；该词也在其他强激活模式所在段中出现，但不构成统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 判例引文与诉讼程序表述
patterns.trigger: « District»« Court»、« speedy»« trial»、« prima»« facie»
patterns.context: 法院判决的引文或程序性论述；激活分散在法院、诉讼与裁判措辞中，并未显示稳定的单一词项。

en.concept: Rare terms and infinity expressions in academic text
en.description: Activations occur mainly on “infinitely” in mathematical text and “linkage disequilibrium” in genetics text; there are also biomedical disease/wound outcomes and sporadic citation markers and terms such as GWAS, MACS, and AD.

patterns.name: Expressions of infinitely many/repeatedly
patterns.context: Discusses limits, repeated returns, the number of objects, or distance tending to infinity; the trigger falls on “infinitely” itself

patterns.name: Linkage disequilibrium (LD) terminology
patterns.context: In contexts involving genetic variants, SNPs, and gene association analyses; the term is mentioned directly in the sentence

patterns.name: Worsening/injury outcomes in diseases or biological processes
patterns.context: Describes worsening disease or changes related to skin tissue or wound healing; differs from the LD and mathematical uses in the passages

patterns.name: Special citation markers and author names
patterns.context: When citing studies and authors, the marker is adjacent to author initials or citation numbers

patterns.name: Genomic data abbreviation
patterns.context: When discussing conversion of SNP association P values and genome-wide analyses

patterns.name: General cohort-study abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears as part of the name Multi-center AIDS Cohort Study in descriptions of genotyping studies

patterns.name: Expressions of geometric spatial boundaries
patterns.context: Describes hyperbolic distance in the Poincaré ball model increasing toward the disk boundary; this shares the semantics of “infinity” with other mathematical passages, but the trigger string differs

patterns.name: Specific disease abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears as a disease abbreviation in genetic candidate-gene studies

3_2893.concept: 学术文本中的稀有术语与无穷表述
3_2893.description: 激活主要出现在数学文本的“infinitely”及遗传学文本的“linkage disequilibrium”；另有生物医学的病情/伤口结局，以及零散的引文标记、GWAS、MACS和AD等术语。

patterns.name: 无穷多/无限次的表述
patterns.trigger: “infinitely”及其后续词，如 “infinitely narrow”、“infinitely often”、“infinitely many”、“infinitely distant”
patterns.context: 讨论极限、反复返回、对象数量或距离趋于无穷时；触发点落在“infinitely”本身

patterns.name: 连锁不平衡（LD）术语
patterns.context: 遗传变异、SNP、基因关联分析的语境；术语在句中被直接提及
patterns.domain: 遗传学、生物医学与基因组学

patterns.name: 疾病或生物过程中的加重/损伤结果
patterns.context: 描述病情加重，或皮肤组织、伤口愈合相关变化；与段落里的 LD 和数学用法不同

patterns.name: 特殊引文标记与作者姓名
patterns.context: 引述研究及作者时，标记紧邻作者缩写或引文编号

patterns.name: 基因组数据缩写
patterns.context: 讨论 SNP 的关联 P 值转换及基因组范围分析时

patterns.name: 一般队列研究缩写
patterns.context: 作为 Multi-center AIDS Cohort Study 名称的一部分，出现在基因分型研究描述中

patterns.name: 几何空间边界的表述
patterns.context: 描述 Poincaré 球模型中双曲距离朝圆盘边缘增长；此处与其他数学段落共享“无穷”语义，但触发串不同

patterns.name: 特定疾病缩写
patterns.context: 作为遗传学候选基因研究中的疾病缩写出现

en.concept: Polysemous English words and frequent academic collocations
en.description: Activations cluster around polysemous words: inferential connector “thus,” quantity/equivalence expression “amounts,” mathematical limit “bound,” and “bound” in a protein name. The surface forms recur across disciplines, but their meanings and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Causal/inferential connector thus
patterns.context: Appears after a preceding statement to introduce a result, inference, or summary; often occurs mid-sentence or at the beginning of a sentence
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, or papers

patterns.name: amounts in a quantity phrase
patterns.context: In the noun phrase “relative amounts of A-βeta and sB-APP”

patterns.name: amounts in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: In “amounts to the flatness,” meaning “is equivalent to”

patterns.name: bound in graph theory
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical discussion involving χ(G), upper/lower bounds, or complexity estimates
patterns.domain: Graph theory, combinatorics, and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: bound in a receptor/protein name
patterns.context: Part of the protein name “growth factor receptor bound protein”

3_2893.concept: 英文多义词与高频学术搭配
3_2893.description: 激活集中于多义词：推论连接词“thus”、数量/相当于表达“amounts”、数学界限“bound”，以及蛋白名中的“bound”。词面跨学科复现，但语义和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 因果/推论连接词 thus
patterns.context: 出现在前文陈述之后，引出结果、推论或总结；常位于句中或句首
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研计划或论文

patterns.name: 数量短语中的 amounts
patterns.context: “relative amounts of A-βeta and sB-APP”这一名词短语中

patterns.name: 数学表达中的 amounts
patterns.context: “amounts to the flatness”中，意为“相当于”

patterns.name: 图论中的 bound
patterns.context: 出现在χ(G)、上界/下界或复杂度估计等数学论述中
patterns.domain: 图论、组合数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 受体/蛋白名称中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为“growth factor receptor bound protein”蛋白名称的一部分

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific abstracts, patents, and license text, respectively involving increased blood pressure, reduced synthesis or function, restrictions, delays, phrases describing liability, and cellular force generation; no stable shared lexical sense or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Increased blood pressure
patterns.context: Studies the response of noradrenergic neurons to acute increases in arterial blood pressure

patterns.name: Reduced protein synthesis
patterns.context: Studies changes in protein synthesis after whole-brain ischemia and their relationship to heat-shock protein induction
patterns.domain: NIH ischemia and stress biology research abstracts

patterns.name: Reduced fracture resistance
patterns.context: Studies the effects of collagen glycation on bone fracture properties

patterns.name: Restricting iNOS
patterns.context: Describes inhibition of nitration and oxidative damage

patterns.name: Immune response restriction
patterns.context: Investigates factors that limit B-cell precursors and induced antibody responses

patterns.name: Signal transmission delay
patterns.context: Delay caused by resistance and capacitance when transmitting drive signals between pixel circuits

patterns.name: Manner phrase in a liability clause
patterns.context: A software disclaimer describes liability arising from use of the software in any manner

patterns.name: Force-generation modifier
patterns.context: Describes the connection between focal adhesions and the intracellular actin cytoskeleton

patterns.name: Doubt or questioning
patterns.context: Raises questions about experimental results and says computational results also support this doubt

3_2893.description: 激活分散于科学摘要、专利和许可证文本，分别落在血压升高、合成或功能下降、限制、延迟、责任方式短语及细胞力生成等局部语境；未见稳定共享的词义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 血压升高
patterns.context: 研究去甲肾上腺素神经元对动脉血压急性升高的反应
patterns.domain: NIH 神经生理学研究摘要

patterns.name: 蛋白质合成减少
patterns.context: 全脑缺血后研究蛋白质合成变化及其与热休克蛋白诱导的关系
patterns.domain: NIH 缺血与应激生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 骨折抵抗力下降
patterns.trigger: «decreases»10，指 AGEs 在骨基质积累后骨的 fracture resistance 下降
patterns.context: 研究胶原糖化对骨断裂性质的影响
patterns.domain: NIH 骨生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 限制 iNOS
patterns.trigger: «limits»10，指髓系细胞中的 A1 上调限制 iNOS 来源的作用
patterns.context: 描述对硝化及氧化损伤的抑制
patterns.domain: NIH 神经血管退化研究摘要

patterns.name: 免疫应答限制
patterns.trigger: «restrictions»10，指 eliciting HIV 广谱中和抗体相关免疫原时的限制
patterns.context: 探究 B 细胞前体及诱导抗体应答的限制因素
patterns.domain: NIH HIV 疫苗研究摘要

patterns.name: 电信号延迟
patterns.trigger: «due»10，处于“delay due to the resistance and the capacitance”中
patterns.context: 像素电路间传输驱动信号时，由电阻和电容造成延迟

patterns.name: 责任条款中的方式短语
patterns.trigger: «WAY»10，处于“ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS SOFTWARE”中
patterns.context: 软件免责声明中描述因任何方式使用软件而产生的责任
patterns.domain: 软件许可证法律文本，免责声明

patterns.name: 力生成修饰语
patterns.context: 描述黏着斑与细胞内肌动蛋白骨架的连接
patterns.domain: NIH 细胞生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 怀疑或质疑
patterns.context: 对实验结果提出疑问，并称计算结果也支持这种疑问

en.description: Almost all passages activate in mechanical or idiomatic collocations containing force/forces; these include mechanical force, applied force, and force measurement, as well as nonliteral collocations such as driving force and forces to.

patterns.name: Force and force-related terms
patterns.context: Involves the generation, application, or measurement of force, or its biophysical effects; sometimes occurs in adjacent phrases with «with», «by», «of», and so on.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and molecular biology, including muscle, immunity, sensation, cell migration, and molecular measurement

patterns.name: Idiomatic collocation driving force
patterns.context: «force» combines with «driving» to refer to a factor that drives a process, not necessarily a direct mechanical force.
patterns.domain: Biomedical discussion; concerning antibody industry development or antibiotic uptake

patterns.name: Incomplete idiomatic phrase
patterns.context: «forces» is used as a noun followed by «to», meaning to cooperate in doing something; this differs from the mechanical sense.

3_2893.description: 几乎所有段落都在含 force/forces 的力学或惯用搭配中激活；包括机械力、受力与测力，也包括 driving force 和 forces to 等非字面搭配。

patterns.name: 力及受力相关术语
patterns.context: 涉及力的产生、施加、测量或其生物物理效应；有时出现在邻近的 «with»、«by»、«of» 等短语中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与分子生物学，包括肌肉、免疫、感觉、细胞迁移和分子测量

patterns.name: 驱动力惯用搭配
patterns.context: «force» 与 «driving» 连用，指推动某种过程的因素，而非必然指直接的机械力。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论述；涉及抗体产业发展或抗生素摄取

patterns.name: 不完整的惯用短语
patterns.context: «forces» 作名词，后接 «to»，表示协力开展某事；与力学含义不同。
patterns.domain: 科研项目介绍、团队合作文体

en.description: Activations most consistently occur with force and its collocations; there are also sporadic responses to the sentence-final parenthetical anyways, against in force contexts, discourse-related direction, and words related to inclination/consequences. Overall, contexts span multiple fields, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final adverb way(s)
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or in a parenthetical position, means “anyway / that said,” and is followed by a period or comma; activation is concentrated on ways

patterns.name: Semantic collocations of force
patterns.context: force occurs in compound words or noun phrases referring to a driving force, a physical force, or a force-bearing entity; surrounding word forms vary with tokenization
patterns.domain: Patents, biomedicine, physics, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Object acted against after against
patterns.context: Describes a door being released and hitting or pressing against a storage container

patterns.name: Discourse-related use of direction
patterns.context: Combines with intellectual property rights and one to refer to the direction of changes in rights

patterns.name: Terms related to changes in direction
patterns.context: Describes tilting and rotation of crystal structures and their consequences

3_2893.description: 激活最稳定地出现在 force 及其搭配中；另对句末插入语 anyways、受力语境中的 against、论述性 direction，以及倾斜/后果相关词有零散反应。整体跨领域，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: way(s) 句末副词
patterns.context: 句首或插入语位置表示“无论如何／话说回来”，后接句号或逗号；激活集中在 ways

patterns.name: force 的语义搭配
patterns.context: force 出现在复合词或名词短语中，表示驱动力、作用力或力载体；前后词形因分词而有所变化
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学、物理学与科研摘要

patterns.name: against 后的受力对象
patterns.context: 描述门被释放后撞向或抵住储物箱

patterns.name: 方向的论述性用法
patterns.context: 与 intellectual property rights 和 one 搭配，指权利变化的方向

patterns.name: 方向变化相关词
patterns.context: 描述晶体结构倾斜、旋转及其后果

en.description: Activations concentrate on fixed phrases and formatting fragments: DENYING in court titles, driving force, no influence on, and sporadic instances of anyways, repercussions, name fragments, and HTML submission fields; no single semantic theme covers all instances.

patterns.name: Imperative “deny” ruling title
patterns.context: Legal documents announce that a court denies a motion in an uppercase title; the DENYING token fragment is especially prominent in titles.

patterns.name: drive/force collocation
patterns.context: The phrase driving force describes a force that promotes expansion or uptake, often near behind or of.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technology discussions, biomedical papers

patterns.name: influence on collocation
patterns.context: Experimental results state that an intervention has no effect on an object, commonly in the structure no influence on.

patterns.name: “anyways” discourse marker
patterns.context: Colloquial anyways appears at the end of a sentence or in parentheses to shift topics or wrap up preceding content.

patterns.name: Expression of long-term consequences
patterns.context: Combined with early postnatal experience and long-term, it denotes subsequent effects caused by early experience.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans or biomedical texts

patterns.name: Word-ending fragment in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the researcher name Quesenberry, with no clear semantic or syntactic connection.

patterns.name: HTML form submission field
patterns.context: In a form following an HTML table, the submit button’s value attribute is set to Submit.

3_2893.description: 激活集中于固定短语与格式片段：法院标题中的 DENYING、driving force、no influence on，以及零散的 anyways、repercussions、姓名片段和 HTML 提交字段；没有单一语义主题覆盖全部实例。

patterns.name: “deny”命令式裁定标题
patterns.context: 法律文书以大写标题宣布法院驳回动议；在标题中 DENYING 的分词片段尤为显著。

patterns.name: drive/force 搭配
patterns.context: 短语 driving force 描述促成扩张或摄取的力量，附近常有 behind 或 of。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科技讨论、生物医学论文

patterns.name: influence on 搭配
patterns.context: 实验结果陈述某种干预对某对象没有影响，常见结构为 no influence on。

patterns.name: “anyways”话语标记
patterns.context: 句末或括号内以口语化 anyways 转换话题或收束前述内容。

patterns.name: 长期后果表达
patterns.context: 与 early postnatal experience、long-term 连用，表示早期经历造成的后续影响。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划或生物医学文本

patterns.name: 姓名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在研究者姓名 Quesenberry 内，缺乏明显的语义或句法关联。

patterns.name: HTML 表单提交字段
patterns.context: HTML 表格之后的表单中，提交按钮的 value 属性设置为 Submit。

en.description: Activations center on “influence” and its collocation with “on,” used to describe the effects of a factor on behavior, physiological measures, retention, printing, splicing, transport, vibration, policy outcomes, or catalytic activity; also includes qualifiers such as negation and degree.

patterns.name: Object following influence on
patterns.context: Describes the effect of a factor on an outcome, property, activity, or object; common in statements about having or not having an effect, or the strength of an effect.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent backgrounds, and policy discussions

3_2893.description: 激活集中于“influence”及其与“on”的搭配，用于陈述某因素对行为、生理指标、保留、印刷、剪接、运输、振动、政策结果或催化活性的影响；也包括否定、强弱等限定。

patterns.name: influence on 后接对象
patterns.trigger: “influence”后接“on”（如 “influence on the behavior”“influence on myogenic tone”“influence on who bears the brunt”）；也包括 “influence … on” 的变体
patterns.context: 描述某因素对结果、性质、活动或对象的影响；常见于“有/没有影响”“影响强弱”等陈述。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利背景及政策讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to the collocation of influence with on, denoting the effect of a factor on an outcome, object, or process in scientific and policy contexts; also activates on DENYING in court titles.

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: The noun influence is immediately followed by on, introducing the affected object; may include degree or negation modifiers such as no or major.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, scientific texts, energy policy texts

patterns.name: DENYING in legal titles
patterns.context: Appears in the court order title ORDER DENYING, followed by the defendant’s motion.

3_2893.concept: 影响关系及否定裁决词
3_2893.description: 主要响应 influence 与 on 的搭配，表示某因素对结果、对象或过程的影响，见科研及政策语境；另对法院标题中的 DENYING 有激活。

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: 名词 influence 后紧接 on，引出受影响的对象；可带程度或否定修饰，如 no、major。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研文本、能源政策文本

patterns.name: 法律标题中的 DENYING
patterns.context: 出现在法院命令标题 ORDER DENYING，后接被告的动议。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of influence relations such as “influence/impact on,” including positive or negative effects across different domains; also includes “impediment to” and “ORDER DENYING” in court ruling titles.

patterns.name: Influence/effect relation
patterns.context: “Influence/impact on” denotes whether a factor affects an object; may be preceded or followed by degree, negation, or qualifying terms.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal texts, and general discussion

patterns.name: Impediment to a process
patterns.context: The noun “impediment” is followed by “to,” referring to something that hinders development or action.

patterns.name: Legal ruling title
patterns.context: An uppercase term in a court order or ruling title, indicating denial of the defendant’s motion; distinct from influence relations in the body text.

3_2893.description: 主要响应“influence/impact on”一类影响关系表达，包含肯定或否定影响及不同领域语境；另见“impediment to”和法院裁定标题中的“ORDER DENYING”。

patterns.name: 影响/作用关系
patterns.context: “influence/impact on”表示某因素对对象产生或不产生影响；前后可有程度、否定或限定语。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律及一般论述

patterns.name: 阻碍某过程
patterns.context: 名词“impediment”后接“to”，指妨碍某项发展或行动。

patterns.name: 法律裁定标题
patterns.context: 法院命令或裁定标题中的大写词，表示驳回被告动议；不同于正文中的影响关系。

en.description: Primarily activates in “influence/impact on,” covering the effects of factors on outcomes, behavior, responses, or markets, including whether effects occur and their degree; also includes “driving force behind,” denoting a force that promotes development.

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: “Influence” denotes an effect of one factor on a subsequent object, commonly in collocations such as “no influence on” and “direct influence on”; the effect may vary in presence, strength, or target.

patterns.name: impact on
patterns.context: “Impact on” denotes an effect and often occurs with negation or degree modifiers.

patterns.name: driving force behind
patterns.context: “Driving force behind” expresses a force that promotes development or expansion; it does not use the “on” structure.

3_2893.description: 主要在“influence/impact on”中激活，涵盖因素对结果、行为、反应或市场的作用及其有无、程度；另见“driving force behind”表示推动发展的力量。

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: “influence”表示某因素对后续对象产生影响，常见于“no influence on”“direct influence on”等搭配；影响可有无、强弱或具体作用对象。

patterns.name: impact on
patterns.context: “impact on”表示影响或作用，常与否定或程度修饰语搭配。

patterns.name: driving force behind
patterns.context: 以“driving force behind”表达推动某种发展或扩张的力量；没有“on”结构。

en.description: Activations fall almost entirely on the word influence, especially in discussions of the effects of factors on outcomes or biological processes; also includes negative effects and social or policy effects. A few contexts also cover adjacent prepositions or objects.

patterns.name: influence and its object
patterns.context: The sentence discusses whether, how, or to what extent factors affect outcomes, behavior, concentrations, or biological processes; activation centers on influence, with some passages also covering the following preposition or object.
patterns.domain: Primarily biomedical research abstracts and research plans; also policy texts

patterns.name: Factors may influence an outcome
patterns.context: Factors are introduced first, followed by the outcome or process of interest; intervening material may occur, and the syntactic form varies.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Factors affect outcomes or presentation
patterns.context: Discusses factors affecting patient outcomes or disease presentation, not necessarily with may.

patterns.name: Negative or no significant effect
patterns.context: Reports that a variable or experimental treatment did not affect a measured outcome, vascular tone, or reporting behavior.

patterns.name: Social or policy effects
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of policy measures on costs or who bears the burden; distinct from biomedical contexts.

3_2893.description: 激活几乎都落在 influence 一词上，尤其是讨论因素对结果或生物过程的影响，也包括否定影响和社会政策影响；少数上下文还覆盖紧邻的介词或宾语。

patterns.name: influence 及其宾语
patterns.trigger: «influence»（常与前面的 “factors … may” 或 “no” 相连）
patterns.context: 句中讨论某些因素是否、如何或在何种程度上影响结果、行为、浓度或生物过程；激活集中于 influence，部分段落也覆盖紧随其后的介词或宾语。
patterns.domain: 以生物医学研究摘要和研究计划为主，也见政策文本

patterns.name: 因素可能影响某结果
patterns.context: 先提出影响因素，再说明关注的结果或过程；词间可有插入成分，句法形式不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 因素影响结局或表现
patterns.trigger: “factors influence the result”及“factors influence disease presentation”
patterns.context: 讨论影响患者结局或疾病呈现的因素，未必有 may。

patterns.name: 否定或无显著影响
patterns.trigger: “no significant influence on”及“had no influence on”
patterns.context: 报告某变量或实验处理未对测量结果、血管张力或报告行为造成影响。

patterns.name: 社会或政策影响
patterns.trigger: “have an influence on who bears the brunt”
patterns.context: 讨论政策措施对成本或负担由谁承担的影响；与生物医学语境不同。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to influence in academic biomedical corpora: it covers both influence on objects and direct-object constructions, and can occur in negative results, factors affecting outcomes, research aims, and discussions of results. Other nearby words are sporadic and cannot be confirmed as independent triggers.

patterns.name: influence with an on structure
patterns.context: The verb influence is followed by on and its object, commonly in statements about having or not having an effect on an outcome or process.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper results or discussion, research abstracts

patterns.name: Object following influence
patterns.context: Influence directly takes a noun object; the object denotes research variables such as risk, concentration, willingness, or pregnancy outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, research aims, or background

patterns.name: Sensitivity to the word influence and its local constructions
patterns.context: Across different grammatical structures, the core trigger is influence; it commonly occurs with on or a direct object, including in contexts of negation, possibility, and research questions.

patterns.name: Surrounding academic result/variable expressions
patterns.context: Influence relations are often qualified by significance, directness, possibility, or future conditions; influence remains the main activation target rather than any single qualifier.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, research design, and results reporting

patterns.name: No clear pattern independent of influence
patterns.context: These words occur in different syntactic positions and do not form a shared trigger pattern that can be confirmed from the available excerpts.

3_2893.concept: 学术语境中的影响关系
3_2893.description: 主要对学术生物医学语料中的 influence 高度响应：既覆盖 influence on 宾语，也覆盖直接宾语结构；可出现在否定结果、影响因素、研究目的和结果讨论中。其余邻近词分布零散，不能确定为独立触发。

patterns.name: influence 与 on 结构
patterns.trigger: «influence»10« on»7（1、2、3）；«influence»9« on»7 the»1（4）；«influence»9« on»5« the»2« suppression»3« of»4（9）
patterns.context: 动词 influence 后接 on 及其宾语，常见于“对某结果/过程没有或有影响”的陈述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文结果或讨论、研究摘要

patterns.name: influence 后接宾语
patterns.trigger: «influence»9« the»2« risk»3（6）；«influence»9« the»1 concentrations（7）；«influence»9 willingness（8）；«influence»9« the»1 pregnancy result（10）
patterns.context: influence 直接支配名词宾语；宾语指风险、浓度、意愿或妊娠结果等研究变量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、研究目标或背景

patterns.name: 对 influence 一词及其局部构式的敏感
patterns.context: 不同语法结构中，核心触发均为 influence；常伴随 on 或直接宾语，且在否定、可能性、研究问题等语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学语料中的学术英语

patterns.name: 周边学术结果/变量表达
patterns.trigger: « significant»1« influence»10（3）；« direct»3« influence»9（4）；« factors»2 may« influence»9（8）；« factor»1« will»1« influence»9（10）
patterns.context: 影响关系常由显著性、直接性、可能性或将来条件等限定；激活主体仍是 influence，而非单一限定词。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、研究设计与结果报告

patterns.name: 未见独立于 influence 的明确模式
patterns.trigger: 局部还有 « increased»4« times»2、« aggregation»1、« factors»3、« response»1 等，但与 influence 的构式无稳定对应
patterns.context: 这些词分布于不同句法位置，未形成可由现有例段确认的共同触发模式。

en.concept: Expressions of influence relations in research
en.description: Primarily responds to research-style expressions in which factors influence outcomes, commonly with factors adjacent or near influence(s); also covers exposures affecting immune responses and environmental modulation of the association between risk factors and disease.

patterns.name: Expressions of influencing factors/relations
patterns.context: In research abstracts or plans, a factor is proposed to influence an outcome, risk, choice, change, or trajectory; factors and influence are usually close together.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, public health, clinical, and social science research writing

patterns.name: Exposure effects on immune responses
patterns.context: The effects of combined airway exposure to TLR ligands and pesticides on immune responses, specifically in relation to allergic asthma.
patterns.domain: Immunology, allergy, and environmental health research plans

patterns.name: Modulation of influence associations
patterns.context: The environment does not act directly on a single outcome, but affects the association between behavioral risk factors and cancer.

3_2893.concept: 研究中的影响关系表述
3_2893.description: 主要响应科研文体中“因素影响结果”的表述，常见因素与 influence(s) 相邻或近邻；也涵盖暴露影响免疫反应，以及环境调节风险因素与疾病的关联。

patterns.name: 影响因素/影响关系表述
patterns.context: 科研摘要或研究计划中，围绕某种结果、风险、选择、变化或轨迹，提出因素会影响该结果；多数出现 factors 与 influence 的近距离搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、临床与社会科学研究文体

patterns.name: 暴露影响免疫反应
patterns.context: TLR 配体与农药等联合气道暴露对免疫反应的影响，具体关联过敏性哮喘。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、过敏与环境健康研究计划

patterns.name: 影响关联的调节表述
patterns.context: 环境并非直接作用于单一结果，而是影响行为风险因素与癌症之间的关联。
patterns.domain: 环境流行病学研究计划

en.description: Sensitive to “influence” and its context, especially expressions of factors acting on outcomes: effects on willingness, risk, treatment response, immunity, memory effects, disease severity, risk expression, or clinical measures.

patterns.name: Effects on willingness or behavior
patterns.context: A feature of an intervention or product may change people’s willingness to use it; practical difficulties faced by potential users are often mentioned beforehand.

patterns.name: Effects on disease risk or incidence
patterns.context: Genetic variation, host genetics, or microbes are associated with disease risk, age of onset, or disease presentation.

patterns.name: Effects on treatment response
patterns.context: Pharmacogenetic differences may alter the response of particular patients to drug treatment.

patterns.name: Effects on immune responses
patterns.context: The relation between environmental exposure and immune responses, in the context of research on allergic asthma.

patterns.name: Effects on the memory benefits of acute exercise
patterns.context: The timing of exercise relative to memory encoding or retrieval, and exercise intensity, may alter its effects on memory.

patterns.name: Effects on disease severity or onset
patterns.context: Compensatory secretory pathways may alter the severity or age of onset of cystic fibrosis-associated phenotypes.

patterns.name: Effects on the expression of genetic risk
patterns.context: Behavioral and environmental factors may affect the expression of genetically conferred cardiovascular risk.

patterns.name: Effects on clinical measures
patterns.context: Factors such as prostate volume, post-implant edema, and the number of implanted seeds may alter the D90 dosimetric measure.

3_2893.description: 对“influence”及其上下文敏感，尤其响应因素作用于结果的表述：影响意愿、风险、治疗反应、免疫、记忆效应、疾病严重度、风险表达或临床指标。

patterns.name: 影响意愿或行为
patterns.context: 某种干预或产品的特征可能改变人群使用意愿；此前常提到潜在使用者的实际困难。

patterns.name: 影响疾病风险或发病
patterns.context: 遗传变异、宿主遗传或微生物等因素与疾病风险、发病年龄或疾病表现相关。
patterns.domain: 医学与遗传流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 影响治疗反应
patterns.context: 药物遗传差异可能改变特定患者对药物治疗的反应。

patterns.name: 影响免疫反应
patterns.context: 环境暴露与免疫反应之间的作用关系，置于过敏性哮喘研究中。

patterns.name: 影响急性运动的记忆效应
patterns.trigger: «influence»10« the»« effects» of acute exercise« on» memory
patterns.context: 运动相对记忆编码或提取的时机及运动强度可能改变运动对记忆的效应。

patterns.name: 影响疾病严重程度或起病
patterns.trigger: «might»1« influence»9« the»3 severity and/or disease onset
patterns.context: 代偿性分泌通路可能改变囊性纤维化相关表型严重程度或起病时间。

patterns.name: 影响遗传风险表达
patterns.trigger: «influence»9« the»3« expression» of genetically« conferred»« risk»
patterns.context: 行为和环境因素可能影响遗传赋予的心血管风险表达。
patterns.domain: 心血管流行病学研究计划

patterns.name: 影响临床指标
patterns.context: 前列腺体积、植入后水肿和植入粒子数等因素可能改变D90剂量学指标。
patterns.domain: 前列腺近距离放疗研究

en.description: The strongest common signal is the verb influence, especially «influence»10 immediately followed by «the»; its objects are often research outcomes, risks, responses, expression, or choices. It sometimes takes a bare noun object directly, often with factors as its subject.

patterns.name: influence followed by the
patterns.context: The core high-activation sequence is the verb influence immediately followed by the definite article the; subsequent objects may include result, capability, risk, secretion, treatment response, expression, choice, and others. Often occurs in clauses or interrogative structures.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research plans, and scientific discussion across fields including medicine, biology, and statistics

patterns.name: influence followed by a noun object without the
patterns.context: The verb influence directly takes a noun object, without the immediately preceding the.

patterns.name: Factors as the subject of influence
patterns.context: The noun factors or genetic and microbial factors serve as the subject, followed by influence; the form of the object is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Disease mechanisms, statistical modeling, and research plans

3_2893.description: 最强共同线索是动词 influence，尤其是 «influence»10 后紧接 «the»；宾语多为研究中的结果、风险、反应、表达或选择。少数直接接无冠词宾语，且常见因素作其主语。

patterns.name: influence 后接 the
patterns.context: 核心高激活序列是动词 influence 后紧接定冠词 the，后续宾语可以是 result、capability、risk、secretion、treatment response、expression、choice 等；多出现在从句或疑问结构中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要、研究计划及科学论述，涉及医学、生物学、统计学等领域

patterns.name: influence 后接名词宾语但无 the
patterns.trigger: «influence»10 后接 disease presentation 或 immune responses
patterns.context: 动词 influence 直接支配名词宾语；宾语前没有紧邻的 the。
patterns.domain: 免疫学与疾病机制研究计划

patterns.name: 因素作 influence 的主语
patterns.trigger: « factors»2« influence»10；« host genetics»1 and microbial« factors»2« influence»10
patterns.context: 名词 factors 或遗传与微生物因素作为主语，后接 influence；其后宾语形式不固定。
patterns.domain: 疾病机制、统计建模及研究计划

en.description: Activations appear in legal citations, mathematical phrases, garbled characters, connectors, health records, hardware models, biomedical terms, JSON whitespace and color words, and song descriptions; no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numeric and citation fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and punctuation interleave to form legal document numbers or citations, with activations concentrated on parts of the citation;

patterns.name: replacement phrase
patterns.context: A math problem describes sampling without replacement, with activation on the phrase “without replacement”;

patterns.name: Characters in garbled text
patterns.context: Non-Latin text appears as suspected encoding errors or garbled text, with activations on repeated byte/character fragments;

patterns.name: Connector terminology
patterns.context: Describes electrical connectors used to connect wires;

patterns.name: child’s health records phrase
patterns.context: A title about organizing health records for parents;

patterns.name: Graphics card model fragment
patterns.context: In the AMD Radeon R9 280X graphics card model, activation falls on brand/model characters;

patterns.name: receptors and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Discusses the number and regulation of insulin receptors on cell surfaces;

patterns.name: JSON indentation and color word
patterns.context: A JSON fragment lists files and keywords; activations also occur on space indentation and the British spelling colour;

patterns.name: Payback song terms
patterns.context: Introduces a song by the band Flaw and its album/single release information;

3_2896.description: 激活散见于法律编号、数学短语、乱码字符、连接器、健康记录、硬件型号、生物医学术语、JSON空格与颜色词及歌曲介绍；未见稳定共享的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数字与编号碎片
patterns.context: 数字、字母和标点交错组成法律文书编号或引文，激活集中在编号各部分；

patterns.name: replacement短语
patterns.context: 数学题描述不放回抽取，激活落在短语“without replacement”上；

patterns.name: 乱码文本中的字符
patterns.context: 非拉丁语文本以疑似错误编码或乱码形式呈现，激活落在重复的字节/字符片段；

patterns.name: 连接器术语
patterns.context: 描述用于连接电线的电气连接器；

patterns.name: child’s health records短语
patterns.context: 面向家长的健康记录整理标题；

patterns.name: 显卡型号片段
patterns.context: AMD Radeon R9 280X 显卡型号中，激活落在品牌/型号字符；

patterns.name: receptors及数量表述
patterns.context: 讨论细胞表面胰岛素受体的数量及调节；

patterns.name: JSON缩进与颜色词
patterns.context: JSON片段中列举文件、关键词；同时激活空格缩进和英式拼写 colour；

patterns.name: Payback歌曲词项
patterns.context: 介绍 Flaw 乐队歌曲及其专辑/单曲发行信息；

en.description: Activations are scattered across separators, proper names and subword boundaries, punctuation, and formatting fragments; they also occur in technical commentary, configuration lists, hardware models, and personal narratives. No unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation at sequence start
patterns.context: A fragment of short numbers, letters, and punctuation, followed by a newline and “US”; more likely a citation or formatting fragment in legal text.

patterns.name: Sampling terminology and letter strings
patterns.context: After “without replacement from” appear letter variables or garbled repeated characters, followed by a question mark and numbers.

patterns.name: Delimiter with number
patterns.context: A standalone tilde separator appears where a comment ends, a signature appears, or the next passage begins.

patterns.name: Capitalization and word boundaries in place names/proper nouns
patterns.context: After a separator or at the beginning of a signature or short text, activation falls on split initial letters, proper-name fragments, or capitalization boundaries.
patterns.domain: HackerNews usernames, signatures, and short texts

patterns.name: Social media and technical vocabulary
patterns.context: When discussing software dependencies, container security, or nuclear reactor transport, a few technical entity terms and adjacent words activate; these examples have different themes.

patterns.name: Function words and punctuation in discourse
patterns.context: Activations occur near pronouns, negation, determiners, and sentence-final punctuation in comments or argumentative sentences; there is no stable single theme.

patterns.name: Descriptions of emotion and behavior
patterns.context: Appears when discussing whether animals or behavior are endearing or disappointing, and when discussing emotional investment.

patterns.name: Hardware model strings
patterns.context: A graphics card brand, model, and product name split into subwords.

patterns.name: JSON/JavaScript list formatting
patterns.context: An indented JSON-style object lists array fields, file extensions, and keywords item by item.

patterns.name: First-person relocation narrative
patterns.context: A first-person recollection of conflict with others, wanting to solve a problem, and eventually moving to a developed country.

patterns.name: Fragments not assignable to a stable category
patterns.context: These activations have clear local triggers, but span domains and cannot confidently be grouped into a shared semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: mathematics, product text, and multi-topic comments

3_2896.concept: 分隔符及碎片化文本特征
3_2896.description: 激活分散在分隔线、专名与子词边界、标点和格式片段上，也涉及技术评论、配置清单、硬件型号及个人叙述；看不出统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 序列开头的数字与标点
patterns.context: 短数字、字母和标点构成的片段，后接换行及“US”；更像法律文本中的编号或格式碎片。

patterns.name: 抽样术语与字母串
patterns.context: “without replacement from”之后出现字母变量/乱码般的重复字符，并接问号和数字。

patterns.name: 带数字的分隔符
patterns.context: 评论段落结束、署名或下一段文字开始前，独立出现的波浪线分隔符。

patterns.name: 地名/专名中的大小写与词界
patterns.context: 分隔符之后的署名或短文本开头，激活落在被拆分的首字母、专名片段或大小写边界上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 用户名、署名及短文本

patterns.name: 社交媒体与技术词汇
patterns.context: 讨论软件依赖、容器安全或核反应堆运输时，少量技术实体词及其相邻词出现激活；这些例子主题彼此不同。

patterns.name: 论述中的功能词与标点
patterns.context: 评论或议论性句子中，代词、否定形式、限定词及句末标点附近激活；没有稳定的单一主题。

patterns.name: 情感和行为描述
patterns.context: 谈论动物或行为是否令人喜爱、失望，以及情感投入时出现。

patterns.name: 硬件型号字符串
patterns.context: 一串被拆分为子词的显卡品牌、型号和产品名。

patterns.name: JSON/JavaScript 清单格式
patterns.context: 缩进的 JSON 样式对象中，数组字段、文件名扩展名及关键词列表被逐项列出。

patterns.name: 第一人称迁居叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆与他人冲突、想解决问题、最终迁往发达国家的经历。

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定类别的片段
patterns.trigger: « Radeon» 型号、« replacement» 抽样语句及若干分散的普通词语
patterns.context: 这些激活有明确的局部触发，但内容跨领域，不能稳妥归为共同语义模式。
patterns.domain: 数学、商品文本及多主题评论

en.description: Activations occur in the English stem protagonists, the has become construction, and health vocabulary, as well as disease names, legal numerical citations, mathematical formulas, personal names, and fragments within German words. They span languages and genres, with no unified trigger that accounts for all fragments.

patterns.name: English stem protagonists
patterns.context: Appears in English narratives, often followed by -ists; one instance describes characters in a game title, another introduces protagonists in a novel plot.

patterns.name: have has become construction
patterns.context: In English sentences, has and become form a present perfect construction; different material may occur between the two words.
patterns.domain: academic abstract, political or encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Health-related vocabulary
patterns.context: health appears in a specialist discussion of glove safety; health records appears in a practical title for parents.

patterns.name: Word segments in a rare disease name
patterns.context: Multiple activation fragments occur within the segmented name facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy and related genetics text.

patterns.name: Numeric and legal citation fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on broken sequences of numbers, letters, and punctuation, apparently in a legal case number or citation format; local context is insufficient to confirm the exact structure.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and numbers
patterns.context: Appears in a derivative problem formula, interspersed with variables, exponents, fractions, and coefficients.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Appears in a title about Allen Iverson and Tameka Foster and a report on their divorce case; activation covers parts of the names.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words
patterns.context: Located within German compound words such as bereits and Antwort; the context is a parliamentary speech about oral questions and committee responses.

3_2896.description: 激活分布在英语 protagonists 词干、has become 结构及 health 词汇，也出现在病名、法律数字引文、数学公式、人名和德语词内片段；跨语言与文体明显，未见能覆盖全部片段的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 英语词干 protagonists
patterns.context: 出现在英语叙述中，常接 -ists；一处在描述游戏标题中的角色，另一处在小说情节中介绍主角。

patterns.name: have has become 结构
patterns.context: 英语句子中 has 与 become 形成现在完成时结构；两词之间可有不同成分。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、政治或百科叙述

patterns.name: 健康相关词汇
patterns.context: health 出现在 glove safety 的专业讨论中；health records 出现在给家长的实用标题中。

patterns.name: 罕见病名称中的词段
patterns.context: 多个激活片段嵌在分词呈现的 facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy 名称及相关遗传学文字中。

patterns.name: 数字与法律引文碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在断裂的数字、字母和标点序列中，似为法律案号或引文格式；局部上下文不足以确认具体结构。

patterns.name: 数学公式记号及数字
patterns.context: 出现在导数题的公式中，夹杂变量、幂次、分数和系数。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Allen Iverson 与 Tameka Foster 的标题及离婚案报道中；触发覆盖姓名局部。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 位于德语连写词的内部，如 bereits、Antwort；上下文是关于口头提问及委员会答复的议会发言。

en.description: The clearest commonality is English being, often used as a progressive passive auxiliary followed by used, drafted, linked, or lexed; it also responds to protecting in biomedical contexts. The remaining code and text examples lack a clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Protected object following protecting
patterns.context: After the verb protecting, describes patients or drugs being protected, often followed by a from or of phrase

patterns.name: being used in progressive passive
patterns.context: being acts as a progressive auxiliary followed by a past participle, forming the passive voice

patterns.name: being in a description of linking architecture
patterns.context: Describes an operation in progress during compilation or linking

patterns.name: being with the intra-word fragment lex
patterns.context: A code comment uses being + an intra-word participial form to explain that the current line is being lexically analyzed

patterns.name: Unexplained being
patterns.context: The remaining fragments have no obvious shared local syntactic or semantic trigger
patterns.domain: code, Q&A, documentation, emails, and papers

3_2896.description: 最明显的共同点是英语 being，常作进行时被动助动词，接 used、drafted、linked、lexed；另在生物医学语境中响应 protecting。其余代码与文本样例缺少清晰共同触发。

patterns.name: protecting 后接受保护对象
patterns.trigger: protecting«9 patients»、protecting«9 the drug»；另有 protecting patients from widespread neurodegeneration
patterns.context: 动词 protecting 后描述患者或药物受到保护，常接 from 或 of 短语

patterns.name: being used in progressive passive
patterns.context: being 作为进行时助动词，后接过去分词，构成被动语态

patterns.name: 链接架构说明中的 being
patterns.context: 描述编译或链接时正在进行的操作

patterns.name: 词内片段 lex 的 being
patterns.context: 代码注释中以 being + 词内分词形式说明当前行正在被词法分析

patterns.name: 未解释的 being
patterns.trigger: “« being»9« drafted»”之外的激活上下文均未见稳定共享触发模式
patterns.context: 其余片段中没有明显共同的局部语法或语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 代码、问答、文档、邮件及论文

en.concept: Technical and explanatory text across domains
en.description: Activation fragments have dispersed topics, including code cleanup, SQL NULL, configuration, legal argumentation, linking failures, medical disclaimers, and unique naming. Repeated medical disclaimers are the clearest recurring pattern; no unified lexical or semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: C# designer-generated cleanup comment
patterns.context: Near comments in automatically generated component code and resource cleanup methods

patterns.name: SQL NULL semantics
patterns.context: Discusses NULL, comparison results, and conditional evaluation

patterns.name: Configuration key-value pairs and browser prefetching
patterns.context: Configuration entries listed line by line, involving browser or network features

patterns.name: Weapon reference in a legal ruling
patterns.context: Cites a case and explains the meaning of an allegation concerning a deadly weapon

patterns.name: URL path and link error
patterns.context: Points out incorrect slash placement in a URL that causes a link to be generated incorrectly

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer and advice
patterns.context: States that the content is for education, research, or reference only and does not replace professional medical advice

patterns.name: Generate a unique image name
patterns.context: Asks how to generate a globally unique name for an image

3_2896.concept: 多领域技术与说明文本
3_2896.description: 激活片段主题分散，含代码清理、SQL NULL、配置、法律论证、链接故障、医疗免责声明及唯一命名；重复的医疗免责声明构成最明确的重复模式，未见统一词汇或语义触发点。

patterns.name: C# 设计器生成的清理注释
patterns.trigger: “/// Required designer variable”及“/// Clean up any resources being used.”
patterns.context: 自动生成的组件代码注释和资源清理方法附近

patterns.name: SQL NULL 语义
patterns.context: 讨论 NULL、比较结果及条件判断

patterns.name: 配置键值与浏览器预取
patterns.context: 配置项逐行列出，涉及浏览器或网络功能

patterns.name: 法律判决中的武器指称
patterns.context: 引用判例并解释关于致死武器的指控涵义

patterns.name: 网址路径与链接错误
patterns.trigger: “item link address”、“placed after”及“generating links like this”
patterns.context: 指出网址斜线位置不当、导致链接生成异常

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明与劝告
patterns.context: 声明内容仅供教育、研究或参考，不替代专业医疗建议
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / 医学免责声明

patterns.name: 生成唯一图像名称
patterns.context: 提问如何为图像生成全局唯一名称

en.description: Primarily responds to the intra-word fragment Creat (create/creates/creator) in code and documentation; also occurs in a Japanese property-word ending, Has/ht in InnerHashtable, political recount phrasing, and Has in a JSON question. No clear match for the first passage.

patterns.name: Word fragment Creat
patterns.context: The marked segment falls at the beginning of or within English words such as create/creates/creator; following suffixes are usually unmarked, and the surrounding text may be code identifiers or ordinary English explanations.
patterns.domain: code documentation, source code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Property characters in a specific identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the katakana word ending in the Japanese XML summary comment “プロパティ：”; other Japanese characters also activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Hasht-related identifier fragments
patterns.context: Appears at Contains/Remove member access in C# InnerHashtable; the Has and subsequent ht fragments of the same identifier activate.

patterns.name: Selective recount phrasing
patterns.context: Political commentary about a U.S. election recount mentions counting again and counties with a Democratic majority.

patterns.name: Has in a JSON.parse context
