patterns.context: A user asks whether JSON.parse will throw an exception, and Has appears at the beginning of a sentence near an error report; there is insufficient context to show that it follows the same pattern as code identifiers.

3_2896.description: 主要响应词内片段 Creat（create/creates/creator），见于代码与文档；另有日文属性词尾、InnerHashtable 的 Has/ht、政治重计票措辞，以及 JSON 问句中的 Has。第1段无明显对应。

patterns.name: 单词片段 Creat
patterns.context: 标记落在英文 create/creates/creator 等词的开头或词内片段；后续词尾通常未标记，周围可为代码标识符或普通英文说明。
patterns.domain: 代码文档、源代码及技术问答

patterns.name: 特定标识符中的属性字符
patterns.context: 出现在日文 XML summary 注释“プロパティ：”中的片假名词尾；其余日文字符也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 含日文注释的 VB.NET 代码

patterns.name: Hasht 相关标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C# 中 InnerHashtable 的 Contains/Remove 成员访问处；同一标识符的 Has 和后续 ht 片段激活。

patterns.name: 选择性重计票措辞
patterns.context: 关于美国选举重计票的政治评论中，提及再次重计票及民主党占多数的县。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的政治评论

patterns.name: JSON.parse 语境中的 Has
patterns.context: 用户询问 JSON.parse 是否会抛出异常，错误报告附近出现句首 Has；没有足够上下文证明其与代码标识符模式相同。

en.description: Responds to plainly expressing an obvious judgment, seriously expressing degree of importance, and wrongfully describing unlawful conduct; it also responds to often in a question about frequency and to two words beginning with trium-. Triggers span legal, forum, and academic text and cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Semantic emphasis of plainly
patterns.context: Emphasizes that something is clear or obvious in a judgment or statement, often alongside a legal claim or explanation.
patterns.domain: legal documents; also HackerNews evaluations of website usability

patterns.name: Degree adverb seriously
patterns.context: Modifies take (take seriously) or takes (attach importance to), asking how seriously advice or teaching is regarded.

patterns.name: Legal use of wrongfully
patterns.context: Describes breach of contract or misappropriation of property; activation is concentrated within the segmented word wrongfully.

patterns.name: triumphalist lexical fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a triumphant/triumphalist tone contrasted with a pessimistic tone criticizing modern society; activation falls on the initial word fragment.

patterns.name: Frequency question with how often
patterns.context: Asks about how frequently an event occurs in the interrogative structure how often should I….

patterns.name: triumvirate lexical fragment
patterns.context: Describes a combination of three departments in an interdisciplinary project; activation falls on the initial word fragment.

3_2896.description: 响应 plainly 的显然判断、seriously 的重视程度、wrongfully 的不法行为，也响应 often 的频率疑问及两个以 trium- 开头的词。触发分布跨法律、论坛、学术文本，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: plainly 的语义强调
patterns.context: 在判断或陈述中强调某事清楚、显然，常与法律主张或解释并用。
patterns.domain: 法律文书；另见 HackerNews 对网页可用性的评价

patterns.name: seriously 的程度副词
patterns.context: 修饰 take（认真看待）或 takes（重视），询问对建议或教学的重视程度。

patterns.name: wrongfully 的法律用法
patterns.context: 描述违反合同或侵占财产的行为；激活集中在被切分标注的 wrongfully 内部。

patterns.name: triumphalist 词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在与批判现代社会的悲观语调相对照的 triumphant/triumphalist 语调描述中；激活落在词首片段。

patterns.name: how often 频率询问
patterns.context: 在 how often should I… 的疑问结构中询问事件发生频率。

patterns.name: triumvirate 词汇片段
patterns.context: 修饰跨学科项目中的三个院系组合；激活落在词首片段。

en.concept: make word family and action expressions
en.description: Primarily responds to make/making/made and Q&A titles beginning “How to make”; it also covers making rulings, property division, and design format in legal contexts. The o in a mathematical expression is difficult to unify with these patterns.

patterns.name: Operational use of make
patterns.context: make/making is followed by an action or goal to be carried out; in [1][2] it refers to an activity in progress, and in [3]–[7] it appears in the “How to make …” structure of question titles.
patterns.domain: tutorials, technical Q&A, legal ruling narratives

patterns.name: Q&A title template
patterns.context: StackExchange question titles begin with Q: and then use “How to make” to ask about implementation or an operation; the activation pattern also includes common function words.

patterns.name: making a legal ruling
patterns.context: making combines with rulings to mean issuing the previously mentioned rulings; this is a fixed legal context, not general production or operation.

patterns.name: making a property division
patterns.context: making combines with division to refer to carrying out or making a property division.

patterns.name: made meaning formed or designed
patterns.context: The passive phrase made in such a way describes why a format was designed in a particular form; it is lexically related to make/making but is not a “How to make” construction.

patterns.name: Symbol in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: The symbol o appears in an algebraic expression in a factorization problem; activation falls on a formula symbol rather than a natural-language action verb, and may be an independent incidental pattern.

3_2896.description: 主要响应 make/making/made 及“How to make”问答标题，也覆盖法律语境中的作出裁定、财产分割和设计格式；数学式中的 o 难以与这些模式统一。

patterns.name: make 的操作性用法
patterns.context: make/making 后接要执行的动作或目标；[1][2] 中是进行中的活动，[3]–[7] 中出现在问题标题的“How to make …”结构。
patterns.domain: 教程、技术问答、法律判决叙述

patterns.name: 问答标题模板
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题以 Q: 开头，随后用“How to make”提出实现或操作问题；触发组合也包含常见功能词。

patterns.name: making 表示作出法律裁定
patterns.context: making 与 rulings 搭配，表示法院作出前述裁定；这是固定法律语境，不是一般制作或操作。

patterns.name: making 表示财产分割
patterns.trigger: «making»5 division of the parties' separate and community property
patterns.context: making 与 division 搭配，指作出或进行财产分割。

patterns.name: made 表示形成或设计
patterns.context: 被动式 made in such a way 描述某种格式为何被设计成特定形式；与 make/making 有词形关联，但不是“How to make”结构。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号
patterns.context: 符号 o 出现在因式分解题的代数表达式中；激活落在公式符号而非自然语言操作动词上，可能是独立的偶发模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to “First” and listing markers such as commas in patent text: these include the first item in a problem, requirement, or reason, as well as the beginning of a process, principle, or section description. There are also scattered activations in citation numbers and patent boilerplate such as “which follows”.

patterns.name: First, listing problems or requirements
patterns.context: Begins a list of multiple requirements, defects, reasons, or advantages in a patent background or invention description; often occurs at the beginning of a sentence or clause

patterns.name: First, beginning to describe steps or principles
patterns.context: Introduces a process, operating principle, or manufacturing step in a technical description, followed by a specific operation or process
patterns.domain: process and equipment descriptions in USPTO patents

patterns.name: First, section or component introduction
patterns.context: First describes a component, part, or topic, usually followed by further information rather than a list of defects or process steps
patterns.domain: description of embodiments in USPTO patents

patterns.name: First, listing conditions or causal reasons
patterns.context: When explaining shortcomings of existing solutions, first introduces the first reason, followed by a causal phrase

patterns.name: Number fragments in patent citation numbers
patterns.context: Patent citation context; activation markers fall on “example”, “in”, and numbers in the citation rather than a clear First-listing structure

patterns.name: Closing or preview phrase in patent descriptions
patterns.context: Summarizes that the invention's purposes or advantages will emerge from the following description; there is no First structure here, and this may be an independent trigger adjacent to other patent boilerplate
patterns.domain: preview of the purpose and contents of a patent specification

3_2896.concept: 专利文本中的首项/起始标记
3_2896.description: 主要响应专利文本中“First”及逗号等列举标记：既包括问题、要求和原因的首项，也包括流程、原理及章节说明的起始；另有引证编号和“which follows”等专利套语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: First，罗列问题或要求
patterns.trigger: “First,” / “first,”，通常紧接逗号，前文出现“requirements”“deficiencies”或一段问题陈述
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明说明中开始列举多个要求、缺陷、原因或优点；常位于句首或分句开头

patterns.name: First，开始描述步骤或原理
patterns.trigger: “First,” / “First”及其后的步骤内容；常与“as follows”“operates according to the following principle”或制作流程相邻
patterns.context: 在技术说明中引入流程、工作原理或制造步骤，后接具体操作或过程
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利中的工艺与设备说明

patterns.name: First，章节或部件引导语
patterns.context: 先说明某个部件、部分或主题，后续通常继续介绍其他内容，而非列举缺陷或工艺步骤
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利中的实施例说明

patterns.name: First，列举条件或因果理由
patterns.context: 在解释现有方案的缺点时，以 first 引出第一项原因，后接原因状语
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的问题分析

patterns.name: 专利引证编号中的数字词片段
patterns.trigger: “for example, in Japanese Patent Publication No. 20403…”中的“for example, in”及编号片段
patterns.context: 专利文献引用语境；激活标记落在“example”“in”和编号中的数字，而非清楚的 First 列举结构

patterns.name: 专利说明的收束或预告语
patterns.trigger: “which follows”以及“in part, will be obvious”
patterns.context: 概述发明目的或优点将从后文说明中呈现；此处没有 First 结构，可能是与其他专利套语相邻的独立触发
patterns.domain: 专利说明书的目的与内容预告

en.description: Primarily responds to structured lists and navigation terms in formal documents, such as First/second, issues, and section numbers; scattered activations also occur in code snippets and legal document formatting, with no unified trigger pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Itemized lists in legal opinions
patterns.context: Introduces disputed issues, grounds for appeal, or sequentially stated conditions in legal decisions or arguments; numbered structures are common.

patterns.name: Structural markers in patent specifications
patterns.context: Lists existing defects, invention objectives, and the contents of subsequent explanations in patent backgrounds or specifications.

patterns.name: Document section navigation
patterns.context: Previews content by section in a paper's abstract or main text, alongside section numbers and content summaries.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax fragments in code
patterns.context: In code contexts, markers are scattered around Go type/comment structures and Python numerical computation code; no clear shared semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Isolated punctuation or paragraph formatting in legal text
patterns.context: In paragraphs, headings, or factual narratives in judicial documents, activations do not clearly correspond to the itemized lists described above.

3_2896.description: 主要响应正式文档中的结构化列举与导航词，如 First/second、issues 和章节编号；另有代码片段及法律文书格式处的零散激活，难以归入统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的分项列举
patterns.context: 法律裁判或论证中，介绍争议事项、上诉理由或按顺序陈述条件；常见编号式结构。

patterns.name: 专利说明书的结构标记
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中列出既有缺陷、发明目的及后续说明内容。

patterns.name: 文档章节导航
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中按章节预告内容，伴随章节编号及内容概述。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与语法片段
patterns.context: 代码语境中，标记分散落在 Go 类型/注释结构和 Python 数值计算代码周围；未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的孤立句读或段落格式
patterns.context: 裁判文书的段落、标题或事实叙述处，激活未明显对应前述分项列举。

en.concept: Legal citation formats and local textual transitions
en.description: Primarily responds to parentheses, years, and explanatory citation formats for statutes and case law in legal documents, and also activates at transitions between legal paragraphs. Other examples include Go code type words, superconducting materials terminology, and common words in comments; these latter categories are more weakly associated.

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In citations to statutes, cases, or regulations, years, subsection identifiers, amendment information, or explanations are enclosed in parentheses; often adjacent to U.S.C. citations.

patterns.name: Types and identifiers in Go code
patterns.context: Near type declarations, struct fields, or interface names in Go source code; activation occurs on code identifiers and type words.

patterns.name: Iron-based superconducting materials terminology
patterns.context: Academic text discussing the Fermi level, electron-doped systems, and iron-based materials.

patterns.name: Emphasis or contrast expressions
patterns.context: In ordinary expository sentences, words indicating, linking, introducing articles, or expressing intent appear; specific trigger locations differ from the legal citation pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial transitions in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal paragraphs, a sentence-initial word introduces subsequent statements about the court, case, or parties after citing a regulation or presenting an argument.

3_2896.concept: 法律引文格式与局部文本衔接
3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文书中法条、判例引文的括号、年份及说明性引文格式，也在法律段落衔接处激活；另见 Go 代码类型词、超导材料术语和评论中的常用词，后几类关联较弱。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的括号及标点
patterns.context: 法律条文、判例或法规引文中，年份、条款子项、修订信息或说明被括号括起；常与 U.S.C. 引文相邻。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的类型与标识符
patterns.context: Go 源码中，类型声明、结构体字段或接口名附近；激活分布在代码标识符及类型词上。

patterns.name: 铁基超导材料术语
patterns.context: 讨论费米能级、电子掺杂体系及铁基材料的学术文本。

patterns.name: 强调或转折表达
patterns.context: 普通论述句中出现指示语、系词、冠词或表达意愿的词；具体触发位置与法律引文模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的句首衔接词
patterns.context: 法律段落中引述法规或论证后，以句首词转入法院、案件或当事人的后续陈述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple corpora: two hits on the ending of firstly and two on Imai fragments; the rest involve code comments and declarations, legal citations and opinion headings, academic proper-name fragments, and contrastive expressions in comments, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Ending of “firstly”
patterns.context: “firstly” is used at the beginning or within a sentence to enumerate or introduce an explanation; both instances are followed by additional content

patterns.name: Imai name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a personal name or bibliographic citation

patterns.name: Header fields in code comments
patterns.context: Comment fields and explanatory text near C/C++ macro definitions

patterns.name: Ingress code and type declarations
patterns.context: Interfaces, struct declarations, and comments in Go code

patterns.name: Punctuation in statutory citations
patterns.context: Statutes are cited in court opinions, with dense punctuation and numbering

patterns.name: Opinion heading and start of body
patterns.context: The statement of case facts begins after a heading in a court opinion

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in academic text
patterns.context: Proper names or subword fragments in technical paper text and bibliographic citations; no consistent trigger condition observed

patterns.name: Sentence-final and contrastive words in quotations
patterns.context: After quoting an online comment, “Until then” expresses a judgment about the spam problem

3_2896.description: 激活分散在多种语料：两处命中 firstly 的词尾，两处命中 Imai 片段；其余涉及代码注释与声明、法律引文和意见标题、学术专名片段及评论中的转折表达，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “firstly”中的词尾
patterns.context: “firstly”用作句首或句中列举、引入说明；两处均伴随后续内容

patterns.name: Imai 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或文献引用中

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标题字段
patterns.context: C/C++ 宏定义附近的注释字段及说明文本

patterns.name: Ingress 代码与类型声明
patterns.context: Go 代码中的接口、结构体声明及注释

patterns.name: 法律条文引文标点
patterns.context: 判决文本中引用法条，标点和编号密集

patterns.name: 判决意见标题与正文起始
patterns.context: 法院判决的意见标题后开始陈述案件事实

patterns.name: 学术文本中的零散片段
patterns.context: 技术论文正文与文献引用中出现的专名或词片段；未见一致触发条件

patterns.name: 引述中的句末与转折词
patterns.context: 引述网络评论后，以“Until then”表达对垃圾邮件问题的判断

en.description: Activations occur across proper names and formatting boundaries in formal, structured text: legal citations and normative wording, code declarations and file headers, paper citations, email headers, and commercial service lists; no single domain accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory numbering
patterns.context: In court opinions or legal texts, statutory numbers, parenthetical years, and citation formats appear together.

patterns.name: License and legal obligation wording
patterns.context: License terms, language indicating being bound by them, or wording pursuant to regulations appears in software license descriptions or formal rules.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type declarations in Go code
patterns.context: Declarations and implementations of interfaces, structs, fields, or identifiers in code.

patterns.name: Visualisation toolkit heading
patterns.context: Program and module headings in code comments, using separators and field labels.

patterns.name: Academic citations and scientific symbols
patterns.context: In research papers, bibliographic citations occur near technical discussions of superconducting materials and electron doping, as well as mathematical typesetting.

patterns.name: Forwarded email headers and timestamps
patterns.context: A forwarded email header follows the message body and contains sender, date/time, and recipient fields.

patterns.name: Commercial service advertising language
patterns.context: Lists services such as procurement, quality inspection, and shipping, and advertises free service or factory-direct supply.

3_2896.description: 激活分布于正式、结构化文本中的专名与格式边界：法律法条引文和规范措辞、代码声明及文件头、论文引注、邮件头和商业服务列表；没有单一领域可覆盖全部样例。

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条编号
patterns.context: 法律判决或法律文本中，法条编号、括号内年份及引文格式相邻出现。

patterns.name: 许可证与法律义务措辞
patterns.trigger: 「copyright and license terms」「governed by the License」「in accordance with」
patterns.context: 软件许可证说明或正式规定中，出现许可条款、受其约束或依照规定的表述。
patterns.domain: Github 软件文档；政府法规文本

patterns.name: Go 代码中的标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: 代码中接口、结构体、字段或标识符的声明与实现。

patterns.name: Visualisation 工具包标题
patterns.context: 代码注释中的程序与模块标题，使用分隔线和字段标签。

patterns.name: 学术文献引注与科学符号
patterns.context: 研究论文中，文献引用紧邻超导材料、电子掺杂等技术讨论和数学排版。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头与时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件正文后附转发邮件头，包含发件人、日期时间和收件人字段。

patterns.name: 商业服务宣传措辞
patterns.trigger: 「provide」「Quality Inspection」「all kinds of services」「FREE sourcing service」「OEM Chinese factories」
patterns.context: 列举采购、质检、货运等服务，并以免费或工厂供货作宣传。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in legal documents: citations to statutes and rules, parenthetical docket references, and their punctuation formats are most prominent; other examples involve proofreading and layout, government bill names, and wording about litigation, liability, and judicial determinations.

patterns.name: Citations and parenthetical source references
patterns.context: In legal documents, citations to cases, statutes, or docket materials include parenthetical years, jurisdictions, document types, page numbers, or explanatory notes; activations occur near both parentheses and citation markers.
patterns.domain: Federal and state court opinions, pleadings, and legal citation formats

patterns.name: Statute and rule numbers
patterns.context: Rules, codes, section numbers, and adjacent punctuation or parentheses appear in legal argument; often near parenthetical citation references, but may also occur directly in the body text.

patterns.name: Docket citations and document labels
patterns.context: Abbreviations identify docket documents, pleadings, joint appendices, or paragraph and page numbers, often in references to the case record or litigation claims.
patterns.domain: Court opinions and litigation docket citations

patterns.name: Layout and proofreading notes in legal documents
patterns.context: Near citations, pagination or indentation artifacts appear, or notes indicate that changes in a quotation or brackets were present in the original.
patterns.domain: Citations in legal opinions and OCR/layout text

patterns.name: Government legal program names
patterns.context: Words in the names of government agencies and federal acts are activated in descriptions of court website publication obligations.
patterns.domain: Federal court administration and government e-government regulations

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in legal argument
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of attorney misconduct, whether a claim is valid, or employer explanations and factfinder credibility assessments in employment discrimination cases.
patterns.domain: Appellate review and employment discrimination opinions

patterns.name: Wording of claims and legal allegations
patterns.context: Appears when describing class action claims, constitutional violation allegations, grounds for sanctions, or damages claims.
patterns.domain: Civil opinions, pleadings, and sanctions discussions

3_2896.concept: 法律文书引用与诉讼语汇
3_2896.description: 激活集中于法律文书：法条和规则引用、案卷出处括注及其标点格式最突出；另涉及排版校勘、政府法案名称，以及诉讼、责任和司法判断措辞。

patterns.name: 引文及出处括注
patterns.trigger: “(1994) (federal question jurisdiction)”“(Tex. Sept. 28, 2017); see also”“(M. ag. Rep. and Recommend[ation])”“(App. 24)”“(emphasis omitted) (citation omitted)”
patterns.context: 法律文书中，引用判例、法条或案卷材料时，括号内标注年份、司法辖区、文件类型、页码，或引用说明；括号与引文标记附近均有激活。
patterns.domain: 联邦及州法院意见、诉状和法律引文格式

patterns.name: 法条与规则编号
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现规则、法典、条款编号及其紧邻的标点或括号；常与引文出处括注相邻，但也可直接出现在正文中。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼文书及法条引用

patterns.name: 案卷引用与文书标签
patterns.context: 以缩写标明案卷文档、诉状、联合附件或段落和页码，常出现在对案件记录或诉讼主张的引用中。
patterns.domain: 法院意见及诉讼案卷引用

patterns.name: 法律文书中的版式与校勘说明
patterns.context: 引文附近出现分页、缩进等排版残留，或说明引文中的改动及括号来自原文。
patterns.domain: 法律判决的引文及 OCR/版式文本

patterns.name: 政府法律项目名称
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Federal Claims”“E-Government Act of 2002”“Federal Management and Promotion of Electronic”
patterns.context: 叙述法院网站发布义务时，政府机构、联邦法案及其标题中的词语被激活。
patterns.domain: 联邦法院行政及政府电子政务法规

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定措辞
patterns.context: 讨论律师失职、诉求是否成立，或就业歧视案件中雇主理由及事实认定者可信度判断时出现。
patterns.domain: 上诉审查及就业歧视法律意见

patterns.name: 诉讼请求与法律主张措辞
patterns.trigger: “class action”“other prisoners, past and present”“constitutional violation”“intentional or even negligent misconduct”“sanctions under Rule 38”“exemplary damages”
patterns.context: 描述集体诉讼请求、宪法侵权指控、制裁依据或损害赔偿请求时出现。
patterns.domain: 民事诉讼意见、诉状及制裁讨论

en.concept: Federal opinion citations and legal argument
en.description: Primarily sensitive to citation boundaries, Id./page numbers, and parenthetical punctuation in federal opinions; also responds to citation-editing notes, statutory citations, and legal argument vocabulary. Some activations fall on ERISA insurance disputes and split subword fragments.

patterns.name: Citing cases and pinpoint pages
patterns.context: An opinion cites a prior case or document and adds a page number, year, and citation note; often occurs at the end of a citation.

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Formatting boundaries in legal citations, footnotes, or document citations, especially parentheses, periods, line breaks, and layout whitespace.

patterns.name: Notes on the source or alterations in quotations
patterns.context: After a quotation, notes indicate whether it is reproduced as in the original or emphasize that emphasis was added by the quoting author.

patterns.name: Legal claims and adjudication analysis vocabulary
patterns.context: Substantive legal discussion involves attorney misconduct, class actions, conflicts of law, sanctions, or evidence; not all terms appear together in every passage.

patterns.name: Statutory and rule citations
patterns.context: Discussion relies on or cites procedural rules, code provisions, and jurisdictional grounds.

patterns.name: ERISA and insurance disputes
patterns.context: Discusses pension benefits, insurance plans, or insurer reserves, often in connection with federal jurisdiction or class actions.

patterns.name: Case or publication names in citations
patterns.context: Proper names such as case names, reporters, and abbreviated statutes appear in body text or citations; activation may be interwoven with citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Case law and legal reference citations

patterns.name: Anomalously split words and local word-form fragments
patterns.context: A word is split by token boundaries, and activation falls on an internal fragment; the fragment itself does not constitute a stable, independent semantic category.

3_2896.concept: 联邦判决引文与法律论述
3_2896.description: 主要对联邦判决中的引文边界、Id./页码及括号标点敏感，也响应引文编辑说明、法条引用和法律论述词汇；部分激活落在ERISA保险争议及拆分词片段上。

patterns.name: 引述判例与页码引用
patterns.context: 判决意见在引用先前判例或文书后，附页码、年份及引文说明；多见引文结束处。

patterns.name: 法律引文括号与标点
patterns.context: 法律引文、脚注或文书引用的格式边界，尤其是括号、句点、换行和排版空白。

patterns.name: 引述内容的来源或改动说明
patterns.context: 引文后说明引文是否保留原样，或强调标记是否由引述者添加。

patterns.name: 法律主张与裁判分析词汇
patterns.context: 实体法律论述涉及律师失职、集体诉讼、法律冲突、制裁或证据；并非所有词在每段都共同出现。

patterns.name: 法条与规则引用
patterns.context: 论述依据或援引程序规则、法典条文和管辖权依据。

patterns.name: ERISA与保险争议
patterns.context: 讨论养老金福利、保险计划或保险公司准备金，常与联邦管辖或集体诉讼相连。

patterns.name: 引文中的判例或文献名称
patterns.context: 正文或引文中出现案件、报告、法规简称等专名；激活可能与引文格式交织。

patterns.name: 异常拆分词与局部词形片段
patterns.context: 词被 token 边界拆分，激活落在词内片段；片段本身不构成稳定独立语义类别。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的子词切分

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are concentrated on “unless otherwise” clauses, the ending subword of counsel in legal text, and the eg string across domains; they also respond to the legal abbreviation M and long whitespace in court documents.

patterns.name: unless otherwise clauses
patterns.context: “otherwise” follows “unless otherwise” and is followed by stated, noted, or indicated

patterns.name: Ending subword of counsel
patterns.context: Refers to an attorney in a legal opinion, with activation on the sel portion of counsel

patterns.name: eg string
patterns.context: The same character substring appears across proper names, Dutch words, and protein names
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, European Parliament texts, biomedical lists

patterns.name: Legal abbreviation M
patterns.context: Appears in an abbreviation or split form of magistrate

patterns.name: Extensive whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Long spaces or indentation appear after line breaks in court documents

3_2896.concept: 异质文本片段与格式特征
3_2896.description: 激活集中于“unless otherwise”条款、法律文本中的 counsel 末尾子词，以及跨领域的 eg 字符串；另对法律缩写 M 和法院文书长空白有反应。

patterns.name: unless otherwise 条款
patterns.context: “otherwise”位于“unless otherwise”之后，后接 stated、noted 或 indicated
patterns.domain: 免责声明、条款及技术说明

patterns.name: counsel 的末尾子词
patterns.context: 法律意见中提及律师，激活落在 counsel 的 sel 部分

patterns.name: eg 字符串
patterns.context: 跨专名、荷兰语词及蛋白质名称出现相同字符子串
patterns.domain: 百科、欧洲议会文本、生物医学列表

patterns.name: 法律缩写 M
patterns.context: 出现在 magistrate 的缩写或拆分形式中

patterns.name: 大量空白格式
patterns.context: 法院文件中换行后出现长空格或缩进

en.description: Most passages activate in legal citations, regulatory numbering, and parenthetical citation notes; other independent patterns include class action wording, Java manifest fields, code file headers, and fragments within Dutch words.

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket locators
patterns.context: In opinions, pleadings, or legal documents, docket page numbers, case numbers, dates, or statutory provisions identify a source; often accompanied by parentheses, quotation marks, abbreviations, and periods
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and judicial citations

patterns.name: Regulatory numbers and statutory citations
patterns.context: Chapter and section numbers of regulations, rules, or sentencing guidelines, usually adjacent to abbreviations, numerals, periods, or the § symbol

patterns.name: Quotation and parenthetical markers in legal text
patterns.context: When quoting an opinion or material, notes about editorial treatment, emphasis, or the original source are usually placed in parentheses after the quotation

patterns.name: Claim wording in legal pleadings
patterns.context: Describes class action claims brought on behalf of a group and defines the affected group; these words do not form a stable repeated pattern in other passages

patterns.name: JAR manifest metadata
patterns.context: Key-value fields introduced by colons and hyphenated attribute names, followed by hash digest data

patterns.name: Code file headers and comment markers
patterns.context: Comments, docstrings, platform markers, or import statements at the start of code files; often include special delimiters, language declarations, and copyright information
patterns.domain: Github code (JavaScript comments and Python file headers)

patterns.name: Subword activation within Dutch words
patterns.context: Activates on internal subword fragments in Dutch speech text; the fragments have no clear legal citation or code-format trigger

3_2896.concept: 带结构标记的文档片段
3_2896.description: 多数段落在法律引证、法规编号及引文括注中激活；另有集体诉讼措辞、Java 清单字段、代码文件头，以及荷兰语词内片段等独立模式。

patterns.name: 法律引证与案卷定位
patterns.trigger: “Rec. doc. 15 at 27-35”“J.A. at 10”“R. at 574”“Id. at 5”“Docket No. 17-19128”
patterns.context: 出现在判决、诉状或法律文件中，用案卷页码、案号、日期或法规条文定位来源；常伴随括号、引号、缩写及句点
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书与司法引证

patterns.name: 法规编号与条文引用
patterns.trigger: “Sec. 1B1.3”“Fed. R. Civ. P. Rule 26”“TEX. GOV’T CODE ANN. § 73.5001”
patterns.context: 法规、规则或量刑指南的章节和条款编号，通常紧邻缩写、数字、句点或§符号

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引述和括注标记
patterns.trigger: “(Mag. Rep. and Recommendation”“(emphasis in original)”“(alterations and parentheses in original)”
patterns.context: 引述判决或材料时说明编辑处理、强调或原文出处，通常置于引文后的括号内

patterns.name: 法律诉状中的诉求措辞
patterns.context: 描述代表某类人提出集体诉讼请求，并界定受影响群体；这些词并未在其他段落形成稳定重复模式

patterns.name: JAR 清单元数据
patterns.context: 冒号引出的键值字段与连字符连接的属性名，后接散列摘要数据

patterns.name: 代码文件头与注释标记
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的注释、文档字符串、平台标记或导入语句；常有特殊分隔符、语言声明及版权信息
patterns.domain: Github 代码（JavaScript 注释及 Python 文件头）

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 荷兰语演讲文本中，对词语内部的子词片段激活；片段内没有清晰的法律引证或代码格式触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to citation and quotation formats in U.S. opinions, especially Id. at page numbers and parenthetical source notes; also appears in legal disputes, procedural rules, and docket locations, with a small number of activations on layout artifacts.

patterns.name: Pinpoint citations in quoted cases
patterns.context: An opinion cites a preceding case or material, often with a parenthetical quotation, citation note, or paragraph number; activation is concentrated on citation formatting and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Parenthetical citation sources
patterns.context: After a quotation or paraphrase, parentheses identify emphasis in the original, docket pages, quotation sources, or omitted information; occurs alongside case citation formats.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal citation and quotation conventions

patterns.name: Legal claims and procedural language
patterns.context: Wording about legal disputes, claims, or procedural handling usually occurs in the reasoning of an opinion and may be followed by a citation.
patterns.domain: U.S. litigation opinions, including civil rights, benefits, criminal, and insurance cases

patterns.name: Formal rule or order citations
patterns.context: Legal rules, curricula, or institutional requirements are expressed in formal normative language; not all passages are related to case citation themes.
patterns.domain: Legal rules and formal policy text

patterns.name: Locating the adjudicative record at the end of a citation
patterns.context: Identifies materials reviewed by the court by docket, joint appendix, or record document, often alongside notes such as “emphasis in original”.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and docket citations

patterns.name: Isolated layout and page-number artifacts
patterns.context: Formatting, page numbers, or extraction noise near citations or pagination; no clear independent semantic trigger condition.

3_2896.description: 主要响应美国判决中的引证与引述格式，尤其是 Id. at 页码及括号出处说明；同时见于法律争议、程序规则和案卷定位，少量激活落在版式残片上。

patterns.name: 引述判例的页码引证
patterns.trigger: “Id.” 后接 “at” 和页码，如 “Id. at 472”, “Id. at 639”, “Id. at 136”
patterns.context: 判决书引用前文判例或材料，常伴随括号中的引述、引证说明或段落编号；激活集中在引证格式及其邻近 token。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、法律判决

patterns.name: 引证出处括号
patterns.context: 引述或转述后用括号标明原文强调、案卷页码、引述来源或省略信息；与判例引证格式相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书的引证与引述规范

patterns.name: 法律主张与程序表述
patterns.trigger: “class action”、“ERISA”、“ineffective assistance of appellate counsel”、“Rule 12(b)(6)”、“prosecutorial misconduct”
patterns.context: 法律争议、诉讼请求或程序处理的表述，通常位于判决理由中，并可能随后附引证。
patterns.domain: 美国诉讼判决，含民权、福利、刑事及保险案件

patterns.name: 正式规则或命令引文
patterns.context: 法律规则、课程或机构要求以正式规范性措辞呈现；并非所有段落都与判例引证主题相连。
patterns.domain: 法律规则及正式政策文本

patterns.name: 引文末尾的裁判记录定位
patterns.context: 以案卷、联合附录或记录文档定位法院审查的材料，常与“emphasis in original”等说明并列。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及案卷引证

patterns.name: 孤立的版式与页码残片
patterns.context: 引文或分页附近出现的排版、页码或抽取噪声；没有清楚的独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本的版面／语料抽取

en.description: Activations occur primarily in U.S. legal documents, especially near opinion citations, page numbers, and parenthetical quotation notes; they also cover party claims, procedural rules, and diverse factual disputes, with no unified specific case theme observed.

patterns.name: Citations and citation formats in litigation documents
patterns.context: When an opinion or legal brief cites a prior decision, record, or docket material, especially near page numbers, paragraph numbers, and parenthetical notes; this pattern covers most passages but does not explain all activation locations.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Rights, liabilities, or claims in legal contexts
patterns.context: Discusses parties’ claims, procedural handling, liability, or court determinations, usually before or after citation passages; appears alongside citation formatting but is not necessarily triggered by a single vocabulary item.
patterns.domain: U.S. litigation documents involving criminal, civil, and constitutional disputes

patterns.name: Specific legal rules or factual disputes
patterns.context: Separately concerns course instruction requirements, territorial incorporation elections, insurance benefit eligibility, and medical causation; the topics vary and lack a shared specific semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Statements of facts and rules in legal opinions

3_2896.concept: 法律文书引证与诉讼叙述
3_2896.description: 激活主要出现在美国法律文书中，尤其是判决引证、页码及括号内引文说明附近；也覆盖当事人主张、程序规则和多种不同事实争议，未见统一的具体案件主题。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的引文及引证格式
patterns.trigger: “at”后的页码、括号内的引文说明（如“(emphasis in original)”“(quoting…)”“(citations omitted)”）以及“Id.”
patterns.context: 判决或法律意见书引用先前判决、记录或案卷材料时，尤其在页码、段落号和括号说明附近；该模式覆盖多数段落，但不能解释全部激活位置。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、诉讼文件

patterns.name: 法律诉讼语境中的权利、责任或主张
patterns.context: 讨论当事人的诉讼主张、程序处理、责任或法院判断，通常出现在引证段落前后；与引证格式同时出现，但未必是单一词汇触发。
patterns.domain: 美国诉讼文书，涉及刑事、民事及宪法争议

patterns.name: 特定法律规则或事实争议
patterns.trigger: “all students must be in residence”“incorporation elections”“policyholder”“coronary artery”
patterns.context: 分别涉及课程授课要求、领地建制选举、保险收益资格和医疗因果关系；主题各异，缺少共同的具体语义触发。
patterns.domain: 法律意见书中的事实与规则陈述

en.description: Primarily responds to citation locator formats in U.S. legal documents (especially at, Id., document abbreviations, page numbers, and paragraph numbers), alongside litigation terminology; also activates on a place name in an author address in a paper. The citation format is present in the second passage, but the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Citation and source locators
patterns.context: The neuron often activates near punctuation marking the end of a legal citation or locating its source, citation page/paragraph numbers, and document abbreviations; especially in formats such as “Id. at …” and “(emphasis in original)”.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, pleadings, and legal opinions

patterns.name: Statutory and procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Statutes, legal principles, party roles, and procedural terminology appear in litigation arguments, procedural review, or claims of rights; activation often occurs alongside nearby citation formats.

patterns.name: at in case citations
patterns.context: In a legal citation, appears after the case or document number and before the page number as a page locator.

patterns.name: Author affiliation address format
patterns.context: Institutional addresses list city, district, postal code, and country, followed by author/title metadata; differs from the other legal passages.

3_2896.description: 主要响应美国法律文书的引文定位格式（尤其 at、Id.、文书缩写、页码及段号），并伴随诉讼术语；另对一段论文作者地址中的地名激活。第2段有引文格式但具体触发不明。

patterns.name: 引文及出处定位
patterns.context: 神经元常在法律文书中引文结束或定位引文出处的标点、引文页码/段号及文档缩写附近激活；尤见“Id. at …”“(emphasis in original)”等引用格式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、诉状及法律意见书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法条与程序用语
patterns.context: 诉讼论证、程序审查或权利主张中出现法条、法律原则、当事人身份和程序术语；激活往往与邻近的引文格式同时出现。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的 at
patterns.context: 法律引文中位于判例或文书编号之后、页码之前，作为页码定位标记。

patterns.name: 作者单位地址格式
patterns.context: 机构地址按城市、区、邮编、国家排列，后接 author/title 元数据；与其余法律段落不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据/作者地址

en.description: Words ending in “ations” appear in all ten segments, with activation on the suffix; word meanings and domains vary, while the suffix pattern remains consistent.

patterns.name: -ations suffix
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on words ending in -ations; meanings and sentence positions vary, including both body text and headings.
patterns.domain: Across medical papers, biographies, project texts, and railway entries

3_3047.description: 十段均出现以 “ations” 结尾的词，激活落在该词尾；相关词义与领域多样，词尾模式一致。

patterns.name: -ations 词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 -ations 结尾的词中；词义和句子位置不一，既有正文词，也有标题。
patterns.domain: 跨医学论文、传记、项目文本和铁路条目

en.description: Most segments show activation on the “ation(s)” suffix of different words, including biomedical terms and a few general nouns; there is also localized activation on the section marker Sec1 and within citation identifiers.

patterns.name: Suffix in medical or biological terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “ation(s)” fragment at the end of English nouns or word forms; stems and specific meanings vary widely, and several examples occur at word boundaries or in tokenized subwords.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, ecology papers, historical narratives

patterns.name: Structured section marker
patterns.context: Appears in the formatted section heading “Key question {#Sec1}”.

patterns.name: Sec substring in citation identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in reference markers, with activation on a citation character fragment; differs from the body-text suffix pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric section field
patterns.context: Adjacent to the section number in “{#Sec1}”, possibly part of a structured heading marker.

3_3047.description: 多数段落在不同词语的“ation(s)”词尾激活，涵盖生物医学名词及少数一般名词；另有章节标记 Sec1 和引用标识中的局部激活。

patterns.name: 医学或生物学术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在英语名词或词形末尾的“ation(s)”片段；词干和具体词义差异很大，多个例子位于分词边界或 token 化子词中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研计划、生态学论文、历史叙述

patterns.name: 结构化章节标记
patterns.context: 出现在“Key question {#Sec1}”这一格式化章节标题中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的结构化文档

patterns.name: 引用标识中的 Sec 子串
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献标记中，激活落在引用字符片段；与正文词尾模式不同。

patterns.name: 数字章节字段
patterns.context: 与“{#Sec1}”的章节编号相邻，可能是结构化标题标记的一部分。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的结构化文档

en.description: Primarily responds to the verb determines and its contexts: a factor determines a property, state, function, or outcome across patents, research, and mathematical texts; there is also one response to the suffix in pigmentations in a medical description.

patterns.name: Causal or determinative use of determines
patterns.context: A subject, equation, or design is described as determining performance, state, function, feasibility, or a mapping; the target word is the predicate head and is often followed by an object.
patterns.domain: Patents, research papers, technical descriptions, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: pigmentations in an anatomical description
patterns.context: Adjacent to “Homogeneous, brownish, regular bandlike”, describing bandlike pigmentation and its border; activation falls on the plural suffix.

3_3047.description: 主要响应动词 determines 及其语境：某因素决定某种性质、状态、功能或结果，跨专利、科研和数学文本；另有一次响应医学描述中的 pigmentations 词尾。

patterns.name: determines 的因果/判定用法
patterns.context: 句中主语或方程、设计等被描述为决定性能、状态、功能、可行性或映射；目标词是谓语核心，常接宾语
patterns.domain: 专利、科研论文、技术说明及数学文本

patterns.name: 解剖描述中的 pigmentations
patterns.context: 紧邻“Homogeneous, brownish, regular bandlike”，描述带状色素及边界；激活落在复数词尾

en.description: Responds to the structured boundary format following section headings in PMC articles: a section marker, line break, and equals-sign divider appear after the heading. Heading and subsequent body topics vary, suggesting they are not the primary trigger.

patterns.name: PMC section metadata and divider
patterns.context: Appears after a section heading and before the start of the body text in a structured section marker; most snippets have the heading “Introduction”, with one “Key question”. The words at the start of the body vary and do not appear to be primary triggers.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers and their structured text format

3_3047.description: 对PMC文章章节标题后的结构化边界格式反应：标题后出现章节标记、换行和等号分隔线。标题及随后正文主题多样，似非主要触发因素。

patterns.name: PMC章节元数据与分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在章节标题之后、正文开头之前的结构化章节标记；多数片段标题为“Introduction”，另有“Key question”。正文开头的词语各异且未显示为主要触发项。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central论文及其结构化文本格式

en.description: Activation is scattered across common sentence-initial words, existential constructions and perfect/passive structures, copular statements, and a few word fragments, numbers, and line breaks; it spans domains, with no consistent trigger word or semantics.

patterns.name: Common words at the start of a sentence or clause
patterns.context: Located at the start of a sentence or new clause, followed by a full statement or question; trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: Patents, emails, research abstracts, and other body text

patterns.name: there followed by predicates such as are/has
patterns.context: there introduces an existential construction, with activation on there and the adjacent predicate.

patterns.name: Perfect or passive structures with be + been
patterns.context: Uses be/have-series words in the sentence to form perfect, passive, or related predicate structures.

patterns.name: “Den” word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the name Karen Denne or in Denied in a legal document; the local word form is shared but the meanings differ.

patterns.name: Common copulas and following constituents in body text
patterns.context: States the subject’s condition, definition, or research topic; there is no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Line breaks near sentence endings
patterns.context: Activation appears at line breaks in list items or court-ruling entries.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments and numbers
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in a server name, spam-content keywords, a grant identifier, and a population figure, with no shared contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, low-quality web content, research abstracts

3_3047.description: 激活分散在句首常见词、存在句与完成/被动结构、系词陈述及少数词片段、数字和换行处；跨领域且触发词与语义不统一。

patterns.name: 句首或分句开头的常见词
patterns.context: 位于句首或新分句开头，后接完整陈述或提问；触发词种类并不一致
patterns.domain: 专利、邮件、科研摘要及其他正文

patterns.name: there 后接 are/has 等谓语
patterns.context: there 引导存在句，激活落在 there 及相邻谓语

patterns.name: be + been 的完成或被动结构
patterns.context: 句中使用 be/have 系列词构成完成、被动或相关谓语结构
patterns.domain: 专利、商务邮件、科研摘要

patterns.name: “Den”词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Karen Denne 中，或法律文书的 Denied 中；局部词形相同但词义不同
patterns.domain: 企业公关邮件、法院判决

patterns.name: 正文中的常见系词及其后续成分
patterns.context: 陈述主体的状态、定义或研究对象；没有一致的语义主题

patterns.name: 句末附近的换行符
patterns.context: 列表条目或判决书条目换行处出现激活

patterns.name: 零散词片段及数字
patterns.context: 分别位于服务器名称、垃圾内容关键词、资助编号和人口数字中，缺少共同上下文条件
patterns.domain: 论坛、低质量网页内容、科研摘要

en.concept: Structured relations and symbols in diverse text
en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic simplification expressions containing variable powers, fractional exponents, and nested parentheses; other triggers include a course-enrollment notice, video sampling terminology, a legal investigation duty, and a software test-coverage statement, with unrelated topics.

patterns.name: Variables and exponents in nested algebraic expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical simplification problems, variable letters recur with powers, fractional exponents, or positive-value assumptions; also includes algebraic expression snippets without an explicit Simplify.

patterns.name: “enrolled in class” collocation
patterns.context: A user-facing course enrollment or course information notice.

patterns.name: Video scan conversion and sampling-rate terminology
patterns.context: Discusses video signal conversion and sampling issues.

patterns.name: Statutory investigation duty and Native American child status
patterns.context: Explains how particular circumstances trigger a statutory investigation duty and cites Iowa law.

patterns.name: Test coverage status and relations
patterns.context: Describes usage relations between software components and the coverage status shown in a test coverage report.

3_3047.concept: 多样文本中的结构化关系与符号
3_3047.description: 主要响应含变量幂、分数指数和嵌套括号的代数化简表达式；其余触发分别是课程报名通知、视频采样术语、法律调查义务及软件测试覆盖语句，主题各异。

patterns.name: 嵌套代数式中的变量与指数
patterns.trigger: “m**”, “g**”, “Simplify”, “assuming … is positive”；大量括号、分数和负指数
patterns.context: 数学化简题中，变量字母反复出现并带有幂、分数指数或正值假设；也包括未显式出现 Simplify 的代数式片段。

patterns.name: enrolled in class 搭配
patterns.trigger: “You are enrolled in the following class”
patterns.context: 面向用户的课程报名或课程信息通知。

patterns.name: 视频扫描转换与采样率术语
patterns.context: 讨论视频信号转换及采样问题。

patterns.name: 法定调查义务及印第安儿童身份
patterns.trigger: “duty of inquiry”, “potential Indian child’s status”, “Iowa Code section 232B.15”
patterns.context: 说明特定情形如何触发法定调查义务，并引用爱荷华州法条。

patterns.name: 测试覆盖状态与关联
patterns.context: 描述软件组件之间的使用关系，以及测试覆盖报告显示的覆盖状态。

en.concept: Word-form triggers for presented and Cook
en.description: High activation most consistently falls on presented across paper, legal, patent, and news contexts; it also responds to Cook (including cooking and names) and a few line-break/paragraph markers, with one high activation on print.

patterns.name: presented
patterns.context: In passive constructions or other sentence forms, presented is followed by complements such as in terms of, with, or herein; sometimes a name or subject is adjacent to presented.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including papers, legal texts, patents, and news

patterns.name: Cook
patterns.context: Cook appears as a cooking verb/noun or as a name; activation falls on the Cook substring, including cases where the word form is split into Cook + ing.

patterns.name: Formatting and structural markers
patterns.context: Near line breaks, paragraph symbols, or numbering in documents; may relate to the structured formatting of legal texts.

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Expressions such as print out instructions in operational guidance; this high activation does not clearly share terms with the others.

3_3047.concept: presented 与 Cook 的词形触发
3_3047.description: 高激活最稳定地落在 presented，跨论文、法律、专利、新闻语境；另对 Cook（含 cooking、人名）和少数换行/段落标记有反应，print 也有一次高激活。

patterns.name: presented
patterns.context: 在被动结构或句式中，presented 后接 in terms of、with、herein 等补语；有时是姓名或主语紧邻 presented。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律、专利及新闻等多种文体

patterns.name: Cook
patterns.context: Cook 作为烹饪动词/名词或人名出现；激活落在 Cook 子串，包含词形被分成 Cook + ing 的情形。
patterns.domain: 生活指南、哲学、科技新闻

patterns.name: 排版及结构标记
patterns.context: 文档中的换行、段落符号或编号附近；可能与法律文本的结构化排版有关。

patterns.name: 其他零散触发
patterns.context: 操作指引中，print out instructions 一类表达；该高激活不与其余明显共享词项。

en.description: Primarily responds to mathematical expressions with multiplication asterisks and exponentiation, commonly found in math problems; some problems also ask about common factors or multiples. There are also three code contexts: a macro identifier, a Finish-key comment, and Node/children interface documentation, with no unified surface trigger.

patterns.name: Asterisks, exponents, and algebraic operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas or expressions contain multiplication asterisks, exponent symbols, variables, and numbers; no specific variable or operation order is required.

patterns.name: Common-factor/multiple phrasing in math problems
patterns.context: In questions asking for common multiples, common factors, greatest common factors, and so on, of numbers or expressions.

patterns.name: Underscore identifiers in C/C++-style macros
patterns.context: A macro definition uses an identifier with an uppercase prefix and underscore separators, combined with parentheses and comparison operators.

patterns.name: Finish key and naming in code comments
patterns.context: A documentation comment explains key functionality, followed by a string constant declaration or description of a UI display.

patterns.name: Node/children interface description in Java documentation comments
patterns.context: HTML-style documentation comments describe an interface method and note that certain nodes may not have children.

3_3047.description: 主要响应含星号乘法、幂运算的数学表达式，常见于数学题；部分数学题同时询问公因数或公倍数。另有三段代码语境：宏标识符、Finish 按键注释、Node/children 接口文档，未见统一的表面触发形式。

patterns.name: 数学式中的星号、幂与代数运算符
patterns.context: 公式或表达式中出现乘法星号、幂符号、变量及数字；不要求特定变量或运算顺序

patterns.name: 数学题里的公因数/倍数措辞
patterns.context: 在询问数或表达式的公倍数、公因数、最大公因数等问题时

patterns.name: C/C++ 风格宏中的下划线标识符
patterns.context: 宏定义里使用大写前缀、下划线分隔的标识符，并与括号、比较运算符组合

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Finish key 与命名
patterns.context: 文档注释解释按键功能，并紧接着声明字符串常量或描述界面显示

patterns.name: Java 文档注释中的 Node/children 接口说明
patterns.context: HTML 风格文档注释说明接口方法及特定节点可能不具备 children

en.description: The most consistent cue is “spouse” and its family-relationship context; there are also expressions related to residence and household size, as well as sporadic activation on code configuration identifiers. Other trigger words lack a consistent context.

patterns.name: Spouse (legal or family relationship)
patterns.context: A spouse appears as a person in relationships involving insurance, property, litigation, a teaching partner, or a caller; the word repeatedly triggers in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Legal, insurance, family, and charitable education texts

patterns.name: Residence or cohabitation
patterns.context: Describes where a person lives, a move, household members living together, or household size.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, population statistics, narrative text

patterns.name: UI or configuration identifiers in code
patterns.context: Appears in XML project configuration or code comments, involving project keywords, help keys, and display functions.

patterns.name: Sporadic English function words and general narrative words
patterns.context: These words occur in varied contexts and show no stable, independent shared semantic condition; they may reflect local context or incidental co-activation.
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, telephone service descriptions, general narrative

3_3047.description: 最稳定的线索是“spouse”及其家庭关系语境；另有居住、家庭人数相关表达，以及代码配置标识处的零散激活。其余触发词缺少一致语境。

patterns.name: 配偶（法律或家庭关系）
patterns.context: 配偶作为保险、财产、诉讼、授课搭档或来电者等关系中的人物出现；该词在多个不同句法位置重复触发。
patterns.domain: 法律、保险、家庭与公益教育文本

patterns.name: 生活地点或共同居住
patterns.context: 描述人物居住地点、迁居、家庭成员同住，或统计家庭人数。
patterns.domain: 百科人物简介、人口统计、叙事文本

patterns.name: 代码中的界面或配置标识
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 项目配置或代码注释中，涉及项目关键字、帮助键及显示功能。

patterns.name: 零散的英语功能词和一般叙事词
patterns.context: 这些词所在语境各异，未呈现稳定、独立的共同语义条件；可能是局部上下文或偶然共激活。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、电话服务说明、一般叙事

en.description: Strong activation centers on three local forms: living in a population-statistics sentence (age description of people living alone), Op in case citations, and the beginning of Opens in a code comment. Their contexts differ; the main commonality is local string overlap.

patterns.name: living in residence statistics
patterns.context: In population or household statistics, describes the age of people living alone; a common structure is “had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or …”

patterns.name: Op in case names and legal citations
patterns.context: Standard case-name or citation formats in New York decisions, such as “NY Slip Op 089…”, often accompanied by line breaks and repeated headings.

patterns.name: Op in help-key descriptions
patterns.context: A code comment explains that the Help key opens or toggles a display; the trigger here is the beginning of an ordinary word, matching the spelling of Op in case citations.

3_3047.description: 强激活集中在三类局部形式：人口统计句中的 living（独居年龄描述）、判例引注中的 Op，以及代码注释单词 Opens 的开头。各自上下文不同，主要共同点是局部字符串重合。

patterns.name: 居住统计中的 living
patterns.context: 人口或家庭统计句中，描述独居者的年龄；常见结构为“had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or …”
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文人口普查／地方概况统计

patterns.name: 法律案名与判例引注中的 Op
patterns.trigger: « Op»10，出现在 «Slip» 后、年份及案号附近
patterns.context: 纽约州判例的标准案名或引注格式，如“NY Slip Op 089…”，常伴随换行和重复标题

patterns.name: 帮助键说明中的 Op
patterns.context: 代码注释说明 Help 键会打开或切换某种显示；这里触发的是普通单词开头，与判例引注中的 Op 拼写相同

en.concept: word forms such as living / householder
en.description: Primarily responds to living (especially living alone) and householder in demographic text; also responds to household-composition statistical templates. Op appears in two case citations, showing a distinct legal-format pattern.

patterns.name: living in demographic sentences
patterns.context: When describing people living alone and their ages, “living” is the strongest activating token; nearby terms often include someone, alone, and age qualifiers for older adults.

patterns.name: householder in demographic sentences
patterns.context: Appears in household-composition statistics, often alongside female, no husband present, or male, no wife present.

patterns.name: Op in demographic sentences
patterns.context: In New York State court citations, a case number follows Op; this legal citation format differs from demographic sentences.

patterns.name: Template vocabulary in demographic paragraphs
patterns.context: Recurring in demographic descriptions of household composition; these words occur in the same paragraph as living and householder, but are not the highest-response tokens.

3_3047.description: 主要响应人口统计文本中的 living（尤指 living alone）和 householder；也响应家庭组成统计模板。另有两个判例引注中的 Op，呈现独立的法律格式模式。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 living
patterns.trigger: “living”及其后接“alone”“who was 65 years of age or”
patterns.context: 描述独居者及其年龄时，“living”是最强激活 token；周围常见 someone、alone 和老年年龄限定。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 householder
patterns.context: 出现在家庭构成统计中，常与 female、no husband present 或 male、no wife present 连用。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 Op
patterns.context: 纽约州法院判例引注里，Op 后接案号；该法律引注格式与人口统计句不同。

patterns.name: 人口统计段落的模板性词汇
patterns.trigger: “households”“non-families”“made up of individuals”及百分比数字
patterns.context: 反复出现于人口统计的家庭组成描述中；这些词与 living、householder 同处一段，但并非最高响应 token。

en.concept: household composition and ages of people living alone in demographic statistics
en.description: Primarily responds to census household-composition statistics, especially people aged 65 and older living alone, and also to householder gender, spouse presence or absence, and nonfamily percentages; outlier patterns include legal conviction contexts and lists of game-character skins.

patterns.name: age groups living alone in demographic statements
patterns.context: At the end of statistical sentences describing household composition, reporting the number or percentage of people living alone who meet a specified age threshold; living in this phrase activates most strongly.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia city or regional census statistics

patterns.name: female householder with no husband present
patterns.context: A parallel clause listing household types in demographic statistics; the category of female householder with no husband present.

patterns.name: statistics on nonfamily households and individuals
patterns.context: Listed alongside householder categories, giving household-composition percentages for nonfamilies and one-person households.

patterns.name: male householder with no wife present
patterns.context: The male-householder category corresponding to the female-householder category in household-composition statistics.

patterns.name: conviction and applicability in legal rulings
patterns.context: Discusses whether an enhanced-penalty statute applies to a conviction and cites cases related to murder or shootings.

patterns.name: game characters and skin counts
patterns.context: Bullet lists of the number of skins owned by game characters and their names.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC game wiki or fan description

3_3047.concept: 人口统计中的家庭构成与独居年龄
3_3047.description: 主要响应人口普查家庭构成统计，尤其是独居者中65岁以上者，并兼及户主性别、配偶在场与否及非家庭比例；另有法律定罪语境和游戏角色皮肤列表两类离群模式。

patterns.name: 人口统计表述中的独居年龄组
patterns.trigger: «someone» living «alone» who was «65» years of age or
patterns.context: 位于描述家庭构成的统计句末，报告独居者中达到特定年龄的人数或比例；该短语中的 living 激活最强。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 城市或地区的人口普查统计

patterns.name: 女性户主且无丈夫在场
patterns.context: 人口统计中列举家庭类型的并列分句；女性户主与丈夫不在场这一类别。

patterns.name: 非家庭及个人组成的家庭统计
patterns.context: 与户主类别并列，给出非家庭、个人住户等家庭构成比例。

patterns.name: 男性户主且无妻子在场
patterns.context: 家庭构成统计中与女性户主类别相对应的男性户主类别。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的定罪与适用性
patterns.context: 讨论增强刑罚法规是否适用于某项定罪，并援引杀人或枪击相关判例。

patterns.name: 游戏角色与皮肤数量
patterns.context: 以项目符号列举游戏角色拥有的皮肤数量及角色名。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 游戏百科或粉丝说明

en.description: Most passages come from math exercises, with activations broadly distributed across numbers, problem templates, answers, and line breaks; topics include radicals/powers, base conversion, and remainders. A passage about sexism and a legal citation may be triggered by numbers, punctuation, or formatting, and do not fit a unified mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: number sequences in math Q&A
patterns.context: DM Mathematics problems and short answers appear consecutively; activations occur on numbers, problem templates, and line breaks, often in radical, exponent, and rounding problems

patterns.name: base-conversion problems
patterns.context: A number is followed by its source base and a request to convert it to a target base; problem and answer are separated by a line break

patterns.name: remainder problems
patterns.context: Asks for the remainder when one integer is divided by another, usually followed by a short numeric answer

patterns.name: quoted offensive language and reaction
patterns.context: The narrator quotes a sexist stereotype about women drivers and describes an angry reaction

patterns.name: paragraph and citation formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Case citations in legal argument, accompanied by line breaks, quotations, and footnote-style formatting

3_3047.concept: 数字与结构化文本特征
3_3047.description: 多数段落来自数学练习，激活广泛分布于数字、运算题模板、答案及换行；覆盖根式/幂、进制转换和求余数。另有一段性别歧视叙述及一段法律引文，可能是数字、标点或排版触发，无法与数学模式统一。

patterns.name: 数学问答中的数字序列
patterns.trigger: 数字与运算表达式，如“32”“1/2”“145”，以及答案后的“↵”
patterns.context: DM Mathematics题目与短答案连续排列；数字、问题模板和换行处均可见激活，常出现根式、幂和取整题

patterns.name: 进制转换题
patterns.trigger: “(base 13) to base 8”“(base 16) to base 4”“Convert 16 (base 7) to base”
patterns.context: 数字后标注源进制，并要求转换到目标进制；题目与答案以换行分隔

patterns.name: 求余数题
patterns.trigger: “Calculate the remainder when”“What is the remainder when”
patterns.context: 询问一个整数除以另一个整数后的余数，题目后通常跟短数字答案

patterns.name: 带引号的冒犯性措辞及其反应
patterns.context: 叙述者引用针对女性驾驶者的性别刻板印象，并描述愤怒反应

patterns.name: 法律文书中的段落与引文格式
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用判例，伴随换行、引文和脚注式排版

en.description: Primarily responds to “Here” introducing case-specific analysis after a citation in a court opinion; also responds more weakly to rulings, code header files/Go dependency paths, and phrasing about segmented modeling.

patterns.name: Here introducing case-specific analysis in court opinions
patterns.context: Appears after a case citation, procedural background, or legal rule, introducing the court’s application to the facts or arguments of the current case; often followed by a comma and factual assessment.

patterns.name: ruling statements in court opinions
patterns.context: After citing legal authority, transitions to the court’s conclusion based on the case record.

patterns.name: C/C++ header-file include directives
patterns.context: A code line uses a preprocessor directive to include a project header file; activations are distributed across path fragments and filenames.

patterns.name: Go dependency paths and module names
patterns.context: Dependency labels in build configuration or vendored Go package paths, containing repository paths and library target names.

patterns.name: divide-and-conquer modeling and data segmentation
patterns.context: Discusses splitting data and developing models for each segment to address difficulties with overall modeling.

3_3047.description: 主要响应判决书引证后以“Here”引入本案分析；另对裁判结论语、代码头文件/Go 依赖路径及分段建模措辞有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 判决书中的 Here 转入具体分析
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文、程序背景或法律规则之后，引出法院对当前案件事实或主张的适用分析；常与逗号及后续事实判断相连。

patterns.name: 判决书中的裁判结论表述
patterns.context: 引证法律依据后，转入法院对案件记录作出的结论。

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件包含指令
patterns.context: 代码行以预处理指令包含项目内头文件；触发分散在路径片段和文件名中。

patterns.name: Go 依赖路径与模块名
patterns.context: 构建配置中的依赖标签或 vendored Go 包路径，含仓库路径与库目标名。

patterns.name: 分治建模及数据分段
patterns.trigger: “divide and conquer strategy”“models on segments of the data”
patterns.context: 讨论将数据拆分并在各段上开发模型，以应对整体建模困难。

en.description: Activations span common legal-opinion words and citations, fragments of names, and proper-name fragments such as code paths/selectors, signatures, and drug names; they are cross-domain and mostly local word fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: language in legal opinions and case records
patterns.context: Appears in statements by courts about the record, pleadings, standards of review, or appellate outcomes, often with phrases such as “we conclude,” “the record,” and “the briefs.”

patterns.name: fragments in citations and legal names
patterns.context: Embedded in case citations and the names of parties or attorneys; activation falls on tokenized name fragments.

patterns.name: encoded fragments in Go import paths
patterns.context: Appears near the Go source import path `golang.org/x/text/encoding`, composed of slashes and segmented identifiers.

patterns.name: XPath selectors in code
patterns.context: Python/Selenium-style code calls an XPath-based element lookup and constructs a selector containing `select[@id=...]`.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A or code snippets

patterns.name: license comments and Java package paths
patterns.context: In a Java package declaration following a license notice, the activated fragment belongs to an Apache internal function’s package name.
patterns.domain: GitHub Java source code and license comments

patterns.name: word-ending fragments in medical author names
patterns.context: In author/location lists in medical papers, activation appears within proper names rather than obvious medical terminology.

patterns.name: fragments within drug names
patterns.context: In clinical descriptions of drug dosages and regimens, activation falls within drug names; other drugs and dosages are listed in the same passage.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central clinical cases or treatment records

3_3047.description: 激活分布在法律判决常用词与引证、人名片段，以及代码路径/选择器、署名和药名等专名片段；跨领域且多为局部词片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律意见与判决记录用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对案卷、诉状、审查标准或上诉结果的表述中，常与“we conclude”“the record”“the briefs”等搭配。

patterns.name: 引证与法律人名中的片段
patterns.context: 嵌在案件引证、当事人或律师姓名中；激活具体落在被切分的人名片段上。

patterns.name: Go 导入路径中的编码片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 源码的 import 路径 `golang.org/x/text/encoding` 附近，路径由斜杠和分段标识符组成。

patterns.name: 代码中的 XPath 选择器
patterns.context: Python/Selenium 风格代码中调用按 XPath 查找元素，并构造包含 `select[@id=...]` 的选择器。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答或代码片段

patterns.name: 许可证注释与 Java 包路径
patterns.context: 许可证说明之后的 Java 包声明中，触发片段属于 Apache 内部函数的包名。
patterns.domain: GitHub Java 源码及许可证注释

patterns.name: 医学作者姓名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学论文作者/地点列表中，激活出现在专名内部，而非明显的医学术语上。

patterns.name: 药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 药物剂量和给药方案的临床叙述中，激活落在药名内部；同段还列有其他药物和剂量。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 临床病例或治疗记录

en.concept: multiple local patterns in code and text
en.description: Responses are scattered: yt in proper names, keyboard API paths, GMP/C++ identifiers, options-writing terminology, the phrase “no such thing as,” and indentation/type words in type tables, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Skyttrain / Skytte proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring “yt” within proper names, appearing in an aircraft name and a personal name.

patterns.name: keyboard-event API paths
patterns.context: Path components and keyboard-event-related identifiers in MDN Web API documentation URLs.

patterns.name: GMP and related code identifiers
patterns.context: Near C/C++ preprocessor directives, header paths, library names, or type names; trigger locations vary.

patterns.name: trade writing and returns terminology
patterns.context: Explanations of options trading discuss selling, returns, and writing covered calls; “as” is also strongly marked.

patterns.name: fixed phrase “no such thing as”
patterns.context: In the phrase “There is no such thing as …,” followed by different nouns; not tied to a specific topic.

patterns.name: structured fields and type tables
patterns.context: In aligned columns of field names, indentation, and type declarations, activations occur near tabs and type words.

3_3047.concept: 多类代码与文本局部模式
3_3047.description: 响应分散：专名中的 yt、键盘 API 路径、GMP/C++ 标识符、期权写入术语、“no such thing as”句式及类型表的缩进/类型词，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Skyttrain / Skytte 专名片段
patterns.context: 在专名内部，激活落在子串“yt”上；分别位于飞机名称和人名中。

patterns.name: 键盘事件 API 路径
patterns.context: MDN Web API 文档 URL 中的路径组件及键盘事件相关标识符。

patterns.name: GMP 及相关代码标识符
patterns.context: C/C++ 预处理指令、头文件路径、库名或类型名附近；各处触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 交易写入与收益术语
patterns.context: 期权买卖解释中，讨论卖出、收益及写出买入合约；“as”也被强烈标记。

patterns.name: 固定短语“no such thing as”
patterns.context: 短语“There is no such thing as …”中，后接不同名词；不依赖特定话题。

patterns.name: 结构化字段与类型表
patterns.context: 按列排列的字段名、缩进和类型声明中，制表符及类型词附近激活。

en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: numbers, minus signs, bases, and multiplication stand out in math problems; other passages concern report labels, Web API links, Go imports, string examples, medical devices, and patent-law wording.

patterns.name: numeric and arithmetic expressions in math problems
patterns.context: In exercise or Q&A-style math text, asks for a product, multiplication, or conversion of a number from one base to another; a numeric answer often follows immediately

patterns.name: interface feedback labels and category options
patterns.context: In webpage or platform feedback forms, explains why an option was clicked by mistake or selects a content-report category; activation concentrates on label words and periods

patterns.name: keyboard-event APIs and key-value documentation paths
patterns.context: Repository text cites MDN documentation links whose paths contain pages about keyboard events or key values

patterns.name: testing and text-encoding imports in Go source
patterns.context: Go package declarations and import lists appear after a BSD-style license

patterns.name: strings and API documentation links in code examples
patterns.context: Q&A or examples concern the string type of an object property and include an MDN API documentation link

patterns.name: medical-device terminology
patterns.context: Describes a tension-free sling system and its placement, related complications, and device names

patterns.name: patent novelty and prior-art wording
patterns.context: In patent background or invention descriptions, fixed legal language states that a new device was not anticipated or suggested by prior art

3_3047.description: 激活模式多样：数学题中突出数字、负号、进制与乘法；其他段分别涉及举报标签、Web API 链接、Go 导入、字符串示例、医学器械及专利法律措辞。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算表达
patterns.trigger: 如 “0.60”“-4 times -0.021463”“the product of -0.406 and -0.05”“(base 6) in base 4”；强标记常落在数字片段、负号或运算词上
patterns.context: 练习题或问答式数学文本中，要求计算乘积、乘法，或将数从一种进制转换到另一种进制；题后常紧跟数值答案

patterns.name: 界面反馈标签与分类选项
patterns.trigger: “This is NOT abusive.”、“I pressed this button by accident.”、“It is spam / self promotion.”、“It is offensive or harmful.”
patterns.context: 网页或平台的反馈表单中，说明误点原因或选择内容举报类别；激活集中于标签词和句号

patterns.name: 键盘事件 API 与键值文档路径
patterns.context: 代码仓库文本引用 MDN 文档链接，路径包含键盘事件或按键值相关页面

patterns.name: Go 源码中的测试与文本编码导入
patterns.context: BSD 风格许可证之后出现 Go 包声明和导入列表

patterns.name: 代码示例中的字符串和 API 文档链接
patterns.context: 问答或示例围绕对象属性值的字符串类型，并附 MDN API 文档链接

patterns.name: 医学器械相关术语
patterns.context: 描述无张力吊带系统及其放置方式、相关并发症和器械名称

patterns.name: 专利新颖性与现有技术措辞
patterns.trigger: “not anticipated, rendered obvious, suggested, or even implied by any of the prior art”
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明描述中，以固定法律措辞说明新器械未被现有技术预见或暗示

en.concept: math problems and structured task prompts
en.description: Primarily responds to product/times wording in multiplication exercises and the base/in base/to base format in base-conversion problems; also responds to report options and form language in a webpage moderation passage.

patterns.name: connective wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Appears in math problems asking for the product of two numbers, usually followed immediately by an arithmetic answer; numbers may be positive, negative, decimal, or integer

patterns.name: base expressions in base-conversion problems
patterns.context: Requests conversion or representation of a number in different bases; nearby words often include numbers, base labels, and an answer on the following line

patterns.name: moderation/report options in feedback forms
patterns.context: Community moderation or report-form context; an evaluation of the answer comes first, followed by report options and a description of accidentally pressing a button
patterns.domain: Pile-CC webpage comments or form text

3_3047.concept: 数学题与结构化任务提示词
3_3047.description: 主要响应数学练习中乘法题的 product/times 等表述，以及进制转换题的 base/in base/to base 格式；另在一段网页审核文本中响应举报选项与表单用语。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的连接词
patterns.trigger: “What is the product of”“Product of”“times”“Calculate”；其中“product”标记较强，“times”较弱
patterns.context: 出现在询问两个数乘积、通常紧接着给出算式答案的数学题中；数字可为正负数、小数或整数

patterns.name: 进制转换题中的基数表述
patterns.context: 要求在不同进制之间转换或表示数；相关词周围常有数字、进制标号及换行后的答案
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 进制转换练习

patterns.name: 反馈表单中的审核/举报选项
patterns.trigger: “Other:”“NOT abusive”“spam / self promotion”“offensive or harmful”；另有“Thank you!”和“button”
patterns.context: 社区内容审核或举报表单语境；先有对答案的评价，随后列出举报选项，并描述误按按钮
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页评论或表单文本

en.description: The strongest pattern is multiplication problems and product wording; weaker activations also occur in an internal fragment of the mathematical term Gromov, community report-option language, and financial trading vocabulary. Each has a clear local lexical trigger.

patterns.name: product wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Appears in problems asking for the product of two numbers; negative numbers and decimals are common, and passages mix questions with answers.

patterns.name: Gromov name fragment
patterns.context: The name or term appears in mathematical text concerning abstracts, distances, or invariants; activation falls on a fragment within the name.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math abstracts, StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: community report-option wording
patterns.context: Discusses answer quality or explains the options and meanings of a report button.

patterns.name: selling and cash in financial trading
patterns.context: Discusses options or trading contracts, premiums, and ways to profit.

3_3047.description: 最强模式是乘法题及乘积措辞；另对数学术语 Gromov 的内部片段、社区举报选项语言，以及金融交易词汇有较弱激活。各类均有明确的局部词汇触发。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的乘积措辞
patterns.trigger: “the product of”, “Product of”, “times”, “Multiply”及相邻的乘数
patterns.context: 出现在询问两个数乘积的题目中；常见负数、小数，且段内混有题目和答案。

patterns.name: Gromov 名称片段
patterns.context: 数学文本中该人名或术语出现于抽象、距离或不变量相关表述；激活落在名称内部片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学摘要、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 社区举报选项措辞
patterns.context: 讨论回答质量或解释举报按钮的选项及其含义。

patterns.name: 金融交易中的卖出与现金
patterns.context: 讨论期权或买卖合约、溢价及获利方式。

en.description: Primarily responds to product, times, and adjacent numeric expressions in multiplication exercises (including negatives, decimals, and asterisks); also responds to base-conversion problems. Other triggers are scattered across Go configuration paths, moderation comments, format-string security discussions, and Java license source code.

patterns.name: product wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Asks for the product of two numbers in math exercises; operands are often positive or negative decimals, and an answer usually follows the problem.

patterns.name: operator notation in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Multiplication is written with an asterisk or in words, appearing in equations or “Calculate” problems; numbers are not limited to decimals.

patterns.name: base-conversion questions
patterns.context: Asks to convert a number from one base to another; the passage also contains subsequent problems or answers.

patterns.name: default library paths and configuration identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in Go dependency or configuration paths, containing directory names, package names, and underscore-separated identifiers.

patterns.name: positive answer feedback and report categories in comments
patterns.context: First evaluates an answer positively, then lists content moderation or report reasons and whether a button was pressed by mistake.

patterns.name: code-expression security discussions
patterns.context: Discusses automatic evaluation of expressions in format strings and requirements for variable lists.

patterns.name: license statements and Java package paths
patterns.context: Legal disclaimers occur directly next to Apache-style license comments and Java package declarations.

3_3047.description: 主要响应乘法练习中的 product、times 及相邻数值算式（含负数、小数和星号）；另响应进制转换题。其余触发分散于 Go 配置路径、审核评论、格式字符串安全讨论及 Java 许可证源码。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的乘积措辞
patterns.context: 在数学练习题中询问两个数的乘积；操作数常为带小数的正数或负数，题后通常接答案。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的运算符写法
patterns.context: 以星号或文字表示乘法，出现在算式或“Calculate”题目中；数值并不限于小数。

patterns.name: 进制转换提问
patterns.context: 询问一个数从一种进制转换到另一种进制，片段还包含后续题目或答案。

patterns.name: 默认库路径与配置标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 依赖或配置路径中，包含目录名、包名及下划线连接的标识符。

patterns.name: 评论中的答案肯定与举报类别
patterns.trigger: “only real answer”“abusive”“spam / self promotion”“offensive or harmful”
patterns.context: 先评价回答有效，再列出内容审核或举报理由及是否误触按钮。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页评论/审核文本

patterns.name: 代码表达式安全讨论
patterns.trigger: “Security concerns”“automatic evaluation of expressions”“explicit list of variables”
patterns.context: 讨论格式字符串中的表达式自动求值及变量列表要求。

patterns.name: 许可证声明与 Java 包路径
patterns.trigger: “KIND, either express or implied”“See the License”“package com.sun.org.apache.xpath”
patterns.context: 法律免责声明紧邻 Apache 风格许可证注释和 Java 包声明。
